G0001G.d:
Α, α, ἄλφα (which see), τό, indecl.,
alpha, the first letter of the Greek alphabet. As a numeral, ά = 1, α = 1000. As a prefix, it appears to have at least two and perhaps three distinct senses:
__1. ἀ- (before a vowel, ἀν-) negative, as in ἄ-γνωστος, ἄ-δικος.
__2. ἀ-, ἁ- copulative, indicating community and fellowship, as in ἁ-πλοῦς, ἀ-κολουθέω, ἀ-δελφός.
__3. An intensive force (LS, s. α), as in ἀ-τενίζω is sometimes assumed (but see Boisacq, see word).
(AS)
G0001G.s: the first letter of the alphabet; figuratively, only (from its use as a numeral) the first:

G0002.d:
Ἀαρών (Heb. אַהֲרוֹן), indecl. (in FlJ, -ῶνος),
Aaron (Exo.4:14, al.): Luk.1:5, Act.7:40, Heb.5:4, 7:11, 9:4.†
(AS)

G0003.d:
Ἀβαδδών (Heb. אֲבַדּוֹן, destruction; LXX, ἀπώλεια, only in Wisdom Lit., of the place of the ruined dead: Job.26:6, 28:22, 31:12, Psa.88:12, Pro.15:11*), indecl.;
in NT, Abaddon, the angel of the Abyss: Rev.9:11.†
(AS)

G0004.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G922 (βάρος);

G0005.d:
Ἀββά (T, -ᾶ), indecl. (Aram, אַבָּא, emphatic form of אַב = Heb. אָב, father),
used in the phrase Ἀ. ὁ παήρ, Abba, Father (see Swete on Mk, I.with): Mrk.14:36, Rom.8:15, Gal.4:6.†
(AS)

G0006.d:
Ἄβελ, (WH, Ἅ-), ὁ, indecl.
(הֶבֶל),
Abel (Gen.4:2-10): Heb.11:4, 12:24; αἵμα Ἄ., Mat.23:35, Luk.11:51.†
(AS)

G0007G.d:
Ἀβιά (Heb. אֲבִיָּה, אֲבִיָּהוּ), ὁ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἀβίας, -α),
Abia, Abijah.
__1. Son of Rehoboam (3Ki.14:1): Mat.1:7.
__2. A priest of the line of Eleazar (1Ch.24:3, 10): Luk.1:5.
† (AS)
G0007G.s: Abijah, the name of two Israelites

G0007H.d:
Ἀβιά (Heb. אֲבִיָּה, אֲבִיָּהוּ), ὁ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἀβίας, -α),
Abia, Abijah.
__1. Son of Rehoboam (3Ki.14:1): Mat.1:7.
__2. A priest of the line of Eleazar (1Ch.24:3, 10): Luk.1:5.
† (AS)
G0007H.s: Abijah, the name of two Israelites

G0009.d:
Ἀβειληνή (T, Rec. Ἀβι-), -ῆς, ἡ, (sc. χώρα),
Abilene, a district in the Anti-Lebanon: Luk.3:1.†
(AS)

G0011.d:
Ἀβραάμ (Heb. אַבְרָהָם), ὁ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἄβραμος, -ου; MM, VGT, see word),
Abraham (Gen.17:5 al.): Mat.1:1, 2 al.
(AS)

G0012.d:
ἄ-βυσσος, -ον (Ion. βυσσός = βυθός),
__1. in cl., boundless, bottomless (e.g. ἄ. πέλαγος, ἄ. πλοῦτος Æsch.).
__2. [In LXX (for תְּהוֹם, Gen.1:2, al.; exc. Isa.44:27, Job.41:22 for צוּלָה, מְצוּלָה, Job.36:16 for רַחַב) and] NT, as subst. (MM, VGT, see word), ἡ ἄ. (sc. χώρα), the abyss;
__(a) of the sea (Gen.1:2);
__(b) of the underworld, as the abode of the dead: Rom.10:7 (a paraphrase of Deu.30:13 LXX); as the abode of demons, Luk.8:31, Rev.9:1, 2, 11, 11:7, 17:8, 20:1, 3 (Cremer, 2).
† (AS)
G0012.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a variation of G1037 (βυθός);

G0014.d:
ἀγαθοεργέω, -ῶ,
to do good, show kindness: 1 Ti 6:18 (Cremer, 8).†
ἀγαθουργέω, -ῶ, contracted form (rare, see WH, App., 145) of ἀγαθοερ- (which see),
to do good: Act.14:17.†
(AS)

G0015.d:
ἀγαθὀ-ποιέω, -ῶ (= cl. ἀγαθὸν ποιεῖν, εὐεργετεῖν),
[in LXX: Num.10:32, Jdg.17:13 A, Zep.1:12 (יטב hi.), Tob.12:13 B, 1Ma.11:33, 2Ma.1:2 * ;]
to do good;
__(a) univ.: 1Pe.2:15, 20, 3:6, 17, 3Jo.11;
__(b) for another's benefit: Mrk.3:4 (T, ἀγαθὸν ποιῆσαι), Luk.6:9;
__(with) accusative of person(s), Luk.6:33, 35 (Cremer, 8).
† (AS)
G0015.s: to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty)

G0017.d:
ἀγαθοποιός, -όν = cl. ἀγαθουργός,
[in LXX, of a woman who deals pleasantly in order to corrupt, Sir.42:14 * ;]
doing well, acting rightly (Plut.): 1Pe.2:14 (Cremer, 8; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0018.d:
ἀγαθός, -ή, -όν,
[in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;]
in general, good, in physical and in moral sense, used of persons, things, acts, conditions, etc., applied to that which is regarded as "perfect in its kind, so as to produce pleasure and satisfaction, . . . that which, in itself good, is also at once for the good and the advantage of him who comes in contact with it" (Cremer, 3): γῆ, Luk.8:8; δένδρον, Mat.7:18; καρδία, Luk.8:15; δόσις, Jas.1:17; μέρις, Luk.10:42; ἔργον (frequently in Pl.), Php.1:6; ἐλπίς, 2Th.2:16; θησαυρός, Mat.12:35; μνεία, 1Th.3:6 (cf. 2Ma.7:20); as subst., τὸ ἀ, that which is morally good, beneficial, acceptable to God, Rom.12:2; ἐργάζεσθαι τὸ ἀ,…

G0019.d:
ἀγαθωσύνη (on the termination, see: ἁγιότης, and cf . WH, App., 152; MM, VGT, see word), -ης, ἡ
(ἀγαθός), [in LXX for טוֹבָה, טוֹב, טוּב, only in Heb. bks. ;]
goodness (representing "the kindlier, as δικαιοσύνη, the sterner element in the ideal character," AE, Eph., 5:9; on its relation to χρηστότης, see Tr., Syn., §lxiii): Rom.15:14, Gal.5:22, 2Th.1:11.†
(AS)

G0020.d:
ἀγαλλίασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀγαλλιάω), [in LXX (most frequently in Pss. and often coupled with εὐφροσύνη, as Ps 44(45):15) chiefly for גִּיל ;]
exultation, exuberant joy: Luk.1:44, Act.2:46, Heb.1:9, Ju 24; χαρὰ καὶ ἀ., Luk.1:14 (Cremer, 592).†
(AS)

G0021.d:
ἀγαλλιάω, -ῶ, Hellenistic form of cl. ἀγάλλω, to glorify, mid. -ομαι, to exult in;
[in LXX (most frequently in Pss.) chiefly for גיל, רנן pi. ;]
to exult, rejoice greatly: before ἐπί, with dative, Luk.1:47; with dative mod., 1Pe.1:8, Rev.19:7. Mid., with same sense: Mat.5:12, Luk.10:21, Act.2:26, 16:34, 1Pe.4:13; before ἵνα, Jhn.8:56; ἐν, Jhn.5:35 (1 aor. pass. perh. as mid.; but see Mozley, Psalter, 5), 1Pe.1:6 (Cremer, 590).†
(AS)
G0021.s: properly, to jump for joy, i.e. exult
G0021.k: be (exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly)

G0022.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1062 (γάμος);

G0023.d:
ἀγανακτέω, -ῶ (ἄγαν, much, ἄχομαι, to grieve),
[in LXX: Wis.5:22, 12:27, Da TH Bel 28, 4Ma.4:21 * ;]
to be indignant: Mat.21:15, 26:8, Mrk.10:14, 14:4; before περί, Mat.20:24, Mrk.10:41; before ὅτι, Luk.13:14 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0023.s: akin to the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη)); to be greatly afflicted, i.e. (figuratively) indignant
G0023.k: be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation

G0024.d:
ἀγανάκτησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀγανακτέω), [in LXX: Est.18:3 א 1 * ;]
indignation: 2Co.7:11 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0025.d:
ἀγαπάω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for אהב ;]
to love, to feel and exhibit esteem and goodwill to a person, to prize and delight in a thing.
__1. Of human affection, to men: τ. πλησίον, Mat.5:43; τ. ἐχθρούς, ib. 44; to Christ, Jhn.8:42; to God, Mat.22:37; with accusative of thing(s), Luk.11:43, Jhn.12:43, Eph.5:25, II Tim 4:8, 10, Heb.1:9, 1Pe.2:17, 3:10, 2Pe.2:15, 1Jn.2:15, Rev.12:11.
__2. Of divine love;
__(a) God's love: to men, Rom.8:37; to Christ, Jhn.3:35;
__(b) Christ's love: to men, Mrk.10:21; to God, Jhn.14:31; with cogn. accusative, Jhn.17:26, Eph.2:4.
SYN.: φιλέω. From its supposed etymology (Thayer, LS; but…
G0025.s: to love (in a social or moral sense)

G0026.d:
ἀγάπη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for אַהֲבָה, which is also rendered by ἀγάπησις and φιλία ;]
love, goodwill, esteem. Outside of bibl. and eccl. books, there is no clear instance (with Deiss., LAE, 18:4, 70:2, cf. the same writer in Constr. Quar., ii, 4; and with MM, VGT, see word, cf. Dr. Moulton in Exp. Times, xxvi, 3, 139). In NT, like ἀγαπάω, -ῶ,
__1. Of men's love:
__(a) to one another, Jhn.13:35;
__(b) to God, 1Jn.2:5.
__2. Of divine love;
__(a) God's love: to men, Rom.5:8; to Christ, Jhn.17:26;
__(b) Christ's love to men: Rom.8:35.
__3. In pl., love feasts: Ju 12 (DB,…
G0026.s: love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a love-feast

G0027.d:
ἀγαπητός, -ή, -όν
(ἀγαπάω), [in LXX chiefly for יָתִיד, יָדִיד ;]
beloved (see M, Pr., 221);
__(a) by God: of Christ, Mat.3:17; of men, Rom.1:7;
__(b) by Christians, of one another: 1Co.4:14; frequently as form of address, ib. 10:14; opposite to ἐχθρός, Rom.11:28 (see AR, Eph., 229; Cremer, 17; MM, VGT, see word).
(AS)

G0028.d:
Ἅγαρ (Rec. Ἄ-), ἡ, indecl. (in FlJ, Ἀγάρα, -ης, Heb. הָגָר),
Hagar (Gen.16): Gal.4:24,25.†
(AS)

G0029.d:
ἀγγαρεύω (from the Persian; cf. Vg. angiare, and the Heb. אִגֶרֶת; on the orthogr., see Bl., §6, 1; M, Pr., 46),
to impress into public service, employ a courier; hence, to compel to perform a service (prob. common in the vernac.; cf. Deiss., BS, 86f., MM, Exp., iv; VGT, see word): Mat.5:41, 27:32, Mrk.15:21.†
(AS)
G0029.s: properly, to be a courier, i.e. (by implication) to press into public service

G0030.d:
ἀγγεῖον, -ου, τό
(ἄγγος), [in LXX chiefly for כְּלִי ;]
a vessel (see MM, VGT, see word): Mat.25:4.†
(AS)
G0030.s: compare the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη)); a receptacle

G0031.d:
ἀγγελία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄγγελος), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁמוּעָה ;]
a message: 1Jo.1:5, 3:11 (Cremer, 18; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0032G.d:
ἄγγελος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for מַלְאָךְ ;]
__1. a messenger, one sent: Mat.11:10, Jas.22:25.
__2. As in LXX, in the special sense of angel, a spiritual, heavenly being, attendant upon God and employed as his messenger to men, to make known his purposes, as Luk.1:11, or to execute them, as Mat.4:6. The ἄ. in Rev.1:20-2:1, al., is variously understood as
__(1) a messenger or delegate,
__(2) a bishop or ruler,
__(3) a guardian angel,
__(4) the prevailing spirit of each church, i.e. the Church itself. (Cf. Swete, Ap)., in l.; DB, iv, 991; Thayer, see word; Cremer, 18; MM, VGT, see word)
…
G0032G.s: compare G34 (ἀγέλη)) (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor

G0032H.d:
ἄγγελος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for מַלְאָךְ ;]
__1. a messenger, one sent: Mat.11:10, Jas.22:25.
__2. As in LXX, in the special sense of angel, a spiritual, heavenly being, attendant upon God and employed as his messenger to men, to make known his purposes, as Luk.1:11, or to execute them, as Mat.4:6. The ἄ. in Rev.1:20-2:1, al., is variously understood as
__(1) a messenger or delegate,
__(2) a bishop or ruler,
__(3) a guardian angel,
__(4) the prevailing spirit of each church, i.e. the Church itself. (Cf. Swete, Ap)., in l.; DB, iv, 991; Thayer, see word; Cremer, 18; MM, VGT, see word)
…
G0032H.s: compare G34 (ἀγέλη)) (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor

G0033.d:
ἄγε, prop. imperat. of ἄγω,
come! used as adv. and addressed, like φέρε, to one or more persons: Jas.4:13, 5:1.†
(AS)

G0034.d:
ἀγέλη, -ης, ἡ
(ἄγω), [in LXX chiefly for עֵ֫דֶר ;]
a herd: Mat.8:30-32, Mrk.5:11, 13, Luk.8:32,33.†
(AS)

G0035.d:
ἀγενεαλόγητος, -ον
(γενεαλογέω),
without genealogy, i.e. without recorded pedigree (cf. Neh.7:64): Heb.7:3 (Cremer, 152; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0035.o: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1075 (γενεαλογέω);

G0036.d:
ἀγενής, -ές
(γένος),
__1. unborn (Plat.);
__2. of no family, ignoble, base (opposite to ἀγαθός, Soph., Fr., 105): opposite to εὐγενής, 1Co.1:28 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0036.s: properly, without kin, i.e. (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble
G0036.o: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1085 (γένος);

G0037.d:
ἁγιάζω, Hellenistic form of ἁγίζω
(ἅγιος),
to make holy, consecrate, sanctify; [in LXX chiefly for קדשׁ pi., hi. ;]
__1. to dedicate, separate, set apart for God; of things: Mat.23:17,19, 2Ti.2:21; of persons: Christ, Jhn.10:36, 17:19.
__2. to purify, make conformable in character to such dedication: forensically, to free from guilt, 1Co.6:11, Eph.5:26, Heb.2:11, 10:10, 14, 29, 13:12; internally, by actual sanctification of life, Jhn.17:17, 19, Act.20:32, 26:18, Rom.15:16, 1Co.1:2, 7:14, 1Th.5:23, Rev.22:11; of a nonbeliever influenced by marriage with a Christian, 1Co.7:14.
__3. In the intermediate sense of ceremonial or…
G0037.s: to make holy, i.e. (ceremonially) purify or consecrate; (mentally) to venerate

G0038.d:
ἁγιασμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἁγιάζω), [in LXX: Eze.45:4 (מִקְדָּשׁ), Sir.7:31, etc. ;]
as an active verbal noun in -μός, it signifies properly the process τὸ ἁγιάζειν, rather than the resultant state, ἁγιωσύνη, hence,
__1. consecration;
__2. sanctification: so strictly in Rom.6:19,22 (but see Meyer), 1Co.1:30, 1Th.4:3,7, 2Th.2:13, Heb.12:14, 1Pe.1:2. Elsewhere it perhaps (Ellic.; but see Milligan, Th., 48) inclines to the resultant state: 1Th.4:4, 1Ti.2:15 (Cremer, 55, 602).
† (AS)
G0038.s: properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely (by Hebraism) a purifier

G0039G.d:
ἅγιος, -α, ον
(τό ἅγός, religious awe; ἅζω, to venerate), [in LXX chiefly for קֹ֫דֶשׁ ;]
primarily, dedicated to the gods, sacred (Hdt.; rare in Att., never in Hom., Hes. and Trag., who use ἁγνός), hence, holy, characteristic of God, separated to God, worthy of veneration.
__1. Its highest application is to God himself, in his purity, majesty, and glory: Luk.1:49, Jhn.17:11, Rev.4:8. Hence
__(a) of things and places which have a claim to reverence as sacred to God, e.g. the Temple: Mat.24:15, Heb.9:1;
__(b) of persons employed by him, as angels: 1Th.3:13; prophets, Luk.1:70; apostles, Eph.3:5.
__2. Applied to…

G0039H.d:
ἅγιος, -α, ον
(τό ἅγός, religious awe; ἅζω, to venerate), [in LXX chiefly for קֹ֫דֶשׁ ;]
primarily, dedicated to the gods, sacred (Hdt.; rare in Att., never in Hom., Hes. and Trag., who use ἁγνός), hence, holy, characteristic of God, separated to God, worthy of veneration.
__1. Its highest application is to God himself, in his purity, majesty, and glory: Luk.1:49, Jhn.17:11, Rev.4:8. Hence
__(a) of things and places which have a claim to reverence as sacred to God, e.g. the Temple: Mat.24:15, Heb.9:1;
__(b) of persons employed by him, as angels: 1Th.3:13; prophets, Luk.1:70; apostles, Eph.3:5.
__2. Applied to…

G0040G.d:
ἅγιος, -α, ον
(τό ἅγός, religious awe; ἅζω, to venerate), [in LXX chiefly for קֹ֫דֶשׁ ;]
primarily, dedicated to the gods, sacred (Hdt.; rare in Att., never in Hom., Hes. and Trag., who use ἁγνός), hence, holy, characteristic of God, separated to God, worthy of veneration.
__1. Its highest application is to God himself, in his purity, majesty, and glory: Luk.1:49, Jhn.17:11, Rev.4:8. Hence
__(a) of things and places which have a claim to reverence as sacred to God, e.g. the Temple: Mat.24:15, Heb.9:1;
__(b) of persons employed by him, as angels: 1Th.3:13; prophets, Luk.1:70; apostles, Eph.3:5.
__2. Applied to…
G0040G.s: sacred (physically, pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially, consecrated)

G0040H.d:
ἅγιος, -α, ον
(τό ἅγός, religious awe; ἅζω, to venerate), [in LXX chiefly for קֹ֫דֶשׁ ;]
primarily, dedicated to the gods, sacred (Hdt.; rare in Att., never in Hom., Hes. and Trag., who use ἁγνός), hence, holy, characteristic of God, separated to God, worthy of veneration.
__1. Its highest application is to God himself, in his purity, majesty, and glory: Luk.1:49, Jhn.17:11, Rev.4:8. Hence
__(a) of things and places which have a claim to reverence as sacred to God, e.g. the Temple: Mat.24:15, Heb.9:1;
__(b) of persons employed by him, as angels: 1Th.3:13; prophets, Luk.1:70; apostles, Eph.3:5.
__2. Applied to…
G0040H.s: sacred (physically, pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially, consecrated)

G0041.d:
ἁγιότης, -ητος, ἡ
(ἅγιος), [in LXX: 2Ma.15:2 * ;]
sanctity, holiness, regarded, properly, as an abstract quality (see next word, and cf. Lft. Notes, 49; MM, VGT, see word): 2Co.1:12, Heb.12:10.†
(AS)

G0042.d:
ἁγιωσύνη (cf. ἀγαθωσύνη), -ης, ἡ
(ἅγιος), [in LXX: Psa.29 (30):4 96(97):12 (קֹדֶשׁ), 95(96):6 (עֹז), 144(145):5 (הוֹד), 2Ma.3:12 * ;]
holiness, the state in man resulting from ἁγιασμός, which see: Rom.1:4, 2Co.7:1, 1Th.3:13 (Cremer, 52; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0043.d:
ἀγκάλη,-ης, ἡ
(ἄγκος, a bend), [in LXX for אַצִּיל, חֵיק ;]
the bent arm: Luk.2:28 (cf. ἐναγκαλίζομαι).†
(AS)

G0044.d:
ἄγκιστρον, -ου, τό
(ἄγκος, a bend), [in LXX חַכָּה, etc. ;]
a fish-hook: Mat.17:27.†
(AS)

G0045.d:
ἄγκυρα, -ας, ἡ (ἄγκος, a bend), [in Sm.: Jer.52:18 * ;]
an anchor: Act.27:29, 30 40 ; figuratively (MM, VGT, see word), Heb.6:19.†
(AS)

G0046.d:
ἄγναφος, -ον (= ἄγναπτος, γνάπτω, late form of κνάπτω, to card wool),
uncarded, undressed, i.e. new (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.92:6, Mrk.2:21.†
(AS)
G0046.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the same as G1102 (γναφεύς);

G0047.d:
ἁγνεία (WH, ἁγνία),
[in LXX for טָהֳרָה, נָזִיר, נֶזֶר, etc. ;]
purity: 1Ti.4:12, 5:2 (Cremer, 58. For exx. of ceremonial use in π., see MM, Exp., iv).†
(AS)

G0048.d:
ἁγνίζω (> ἁγνός),
[in LXX always ceremonially, chiefly for קָדַשׁ ;]
to purify, cleanse from defilement;
__(a) ceremonially: Jhn.11:55, Act.21:24, 26 24:18;
__(b) morally: Jas.4:8, 1Pe.1:22, 1Jn.3:3.
† SYN.: καθαρίζω, which see (and see: ἁγνός). (AS)
G0048.s: to make clean, i.e. (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or morally)

G0049.d:
ἁγνισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (> ἁγνίζω),
[in LXX: Num.6:5 (נֵזֶר) 8:7 19:17 (חַטָּאָה), etc. ;]
purification: in ceremonial sense, Act.21:26 (LXX).†
(AS)

G0050.d:
ἀγνοέω, -ῶ (> ἁγνίζω),
[in LXX for שָׁגָה, שָׁגַג, אָשַׁם, etc. ;]
__1. to be ignorant, not to know: absol., Ι Ti 1:13, Heb.5:2; with accusative, Act.13:27 17:23, Rom.10:3, 2Co.2:11; ἐν οἷς, 2Pe.2:12; before ὅτι, Rom.2:4 6:3 7:1, 1Co.14:38; οὐ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, a Pauline phrase: with accusative, Rom.11:25; before ὑπέρ, 2Co.1:8; περί, 1Co.12:1, 1Th.4:13. ὅτι, Rom.1:13, 1Co.10:1 (for similar usage in π., V. MM, VGT, see word). Pass.: 1Co.14:38, 2Co.6:9, Gal.1:22.
__2. not to understand: with accusative, Mrk.9:32, Luk.9:45.
† (AS)
G0050.s: not to know (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication, to ignore (through disinclination)
G0050.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3539 (νοιέω);
G0050.k: (be) ignorant(-ly), not know, not understand, unknown

G0051.d:
ἀγνόημα, -τός, τό
(ἀγνοέω), [in LXX: Gen.43:12 (מִשְׁגֶּה), Tob.3:3, Jdth.5:20, Sir.23:2 51:19, 1Ma.13:39 * ;]
a sin of ignorance (so in π.; see MM, VGT, see word): Heb.9:7.†
(AS)

G0052.d:
ἄγνοια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀγνοέω), [in LXX chiefly for אָשָׁם, שְׁגָגָה ;]
ignorance : Act.3:17 17:30, Eph.4:18 (with sense of wilful blindness; cf. MM, VGT, see word), 1Pe.1:14.†
(AS)

G0053.d:
ἁγνός, -ή, -όν
(ἅγος, see: ἅγιος), [in LXX chiefly for טָהוֹר (Pss, and Pr. only), also 2Ma.13:8, 4Ma.18:7, al. ;]
__1. free from ceremonial defilement, in a condition prepared for worship (for exx. of pagan usage, V. MM, VGT, see word).
__2. holy, sacred, venerable (II Mac, l.with).
__3. As in OT (cl.), pure, chaste, undefiled, guiltless;
__(a) of persons: 2Co.7:11 11:12, 1Ti.5:22, Tit.2:5, 1Jn.3:3;
__(b) of things: Php.4:8, Jas.3:17, 1Pe.3:2.
† SYN.: εἰλικρινής (which see), pure, primarily as winnowed, purged, first found in ethical sense in NT…
G0053.s: properly, clean, i.e. (figuratively) innocent, modest, perfect

G0056.d:
ἀγνωσία, -ας, ἡ
(γινώσκω), [in LXX: Job.35:16 (בִּבְלִי־דַּעַת), Wis.13:1, 3Ma.5:27 * ;]
ignorance (opposite to γνῶσις): 1Co.15:34, 1Pe.2:15 (see Hort in l.; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0056.o: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1108 (γνῶσις);

G0057.d:
ἄγνωστος, -ον
(γινώσκω), [in LXX: Wis.11:18 18:3, 2Ma.1:19 2:7 (Cremer, 157) * ;]
unknown: Act.17:23 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0057.o: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1110 (γνωστός);

G0058.d:
ἀγορά, -ας, ἡ (ἀγείρω, to bring together)
[in LXX for עִזָּבוֹן, שׁוּק ;]
__1. an assembly (Hom., Xen., al.).
__2. a place of assembly, a public place or forum, a market-place (Hom., Thuc, al.; LXX): Mat.11:16 20:2 23:7, Mrk.6:56 (cf . MM, VGT, see word, ἀγυιά) 7:4 (Bl., §46, 7) 12:38, Luk.7:32 (Bl., l.with) 11:43 20:46, Act.16:19 17:7 (Cremer, 59; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0058.s: probably akin to G1453 (ἐγείρω)); properly, the town-square (as a place of public resort); by implication, a market or thoroughfare

G0059.d:
ἀγοράζω
(ἀγορά), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבר, קנה ;]
__1. to frequent the ἀγορά (Hdt., al.).
__2. to buy in the market, purchase (Xen., al.; LXX; in π. very common in deeds of sale, see MM, VGT, see word): absol., Mat.21:12, Mrk.11:15; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.13:44, 46, al.; before παρά, with genitive of person(s), Rev.3:18 (LXX, Polyb.); ἐκ, Mat.27:7; with genitive pret., Mrk.6:37, al.; metaphorically, 1Co.6:20 7:23, 2Pe.2:1, Rev.5:9 14:3, 4.
(AS)
G0059.s: properly, to go to market, i.e. (by implication) to purchase; specially, to redeem

G0060.d:
ἀγοραῖος, -ον
(ἀγορά),
__1. frequenting the ἀγορά , a lounger in the ἀγορά (Xen., al.): Act.17:5.
__2. In late writers (Strab., al.), proper to the ἀγορά : ἀγοραῖοι (sc. ἥμεραι) ἀγονται (cf. Lat. conventus agere), court-days are kept, Act.19:38 (for exx. of both usages, see MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0060.s: relating to the market-place, i.e. forensic (times); by implication, vulgar

G0061.d:
ἄγρα, -ας, ἡ
(ἄγω),
__1. the chase, a hunting or catching: Luk.5:4.
__2. that which is taken, a catch: of fish, Luk.5:9.
† (AS)
G0061.s: (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish)

G0062.d:
ἀγραυλέω, -ῶ
(ἀγραυλος, dwelling in the field; ἀγρός, αὐλή),
to live in the fields: Luk.2:8.†
(AS)
G0062.o: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1121 (γράμμα);

G0063.o: from G68 (ἀγρός) and G832 (αὐλέω) (in the sense of G833 (αὐλή));

G0064.d:
ἀγρεύω (ἄγρα),
[in LXX: Job.10:16, Pro.5:22 6:25,26, Hos.5:2 (לקח ni., שׁחט, etc.)* ;]
to catch or take by hunting or fishing; metaphorically, Mrk.12:13.†
(AS)

G0065.d:
ἀγρι-έλαιος, -ον
__1. of the wild olive (Anth.).
__2. As subst., the wild olive: Rom.11:17, 24 (CGT, in 1.; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)

G0066.d:
ἄγριος, -α, -ον
(ἀγρός), [in LXX for שָׂדֶה, etc. ;]
__1. living in fields, wild: μέλι. Mat.3:4, Mrk.1:6.
__2. savage, fierce: Ju 13. (Cf. usage in π. of a malignant wound; MM, VGT, see word)
† (AS)
G0066.s: wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or figuratively (fierce)

G0067.d:
Ἀγρίππας, -α (Bl., §7, 2), ὁ
Agrippa (II): Act.25:13, 22, 23, 24, 26 26:1, 2, 19, 27, 28, 32. (For Agrippa I, see: Ἡρῴδης, 3.) †
(AS)
G0067.s: wild-horse tamer; Agrippas, one of the Herods

G0068.d:
ἀγρός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂדֶה ];
__1. a field: Mat.6:28, al.
__2. the country: Mrk.15:21, al.; pl., country places, farms: Mrk.5:14 6:36 56, Luk.8:34 9:12.
__3. = χωρίον a piece of ground: Mrk.10:29, Act.4:27, al. (On the occurrence of this word as compared with χώρα, χωρίον see MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)
G0068.s: a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet
G0068.k: country, farm, piece of ground, land

G0068G.d:
ἀγρός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂדֶה ];
__1. a field: Mat.6:28, al.
__2. the country: Mrk.15:21, al.; pl., country places, farms: Mrk.5:14 6:36 56, Luk.8:34 9:12.
__3. = χωρίον a piece of ground: Mrk.10:29, Act.4:27, al. (On the occurrence of this word as compared with χώρα, χωρίον see MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)
G0068G.s: a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet
G0068G.k: country, farm, piece of ground, land

G0068H.d:
ἀγρός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂדֶה ];
__1. a field: Mat.6:28, al.
__2. the country: Mrk.15:21, al.; pl., country places, farms: Mrk.5:14 6:36 56, Luk.8:34 9:12.
__3. = χωρίον a piece of ground: Mrk.10:29, Act.4:27, al. (On the occurrence of this word as compared with χώρα, χωρίον see MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)
G0068H.s: a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet
G0068H.k: country, farm, piece of ground, land

G0069.d:
ἀγρυπνέω, -ῶ (ἄγρυπνος, seeking sleep ; ἀγρεύω, ὕπνος),
[in LXX chiefly for שׁקד ;]
to be sleepless, wakeful (Theogn., Xen., al.); metaphorically (LXX) = cl. ἐγρήγορα, to be watchful, vigilant: Mrk.13:33, Luk.21:36, Eph.6:18, Heb.13:17.†
SYN.: γρηγορέω, which see; νήφω, associated with γ. in 1Pe.5:8, expressing a wariness which results from self-control, a condition of moral, not merely mental alertness (see M, Th., I, 5:6). (AS)
G0069.s: to be sleepless, i.e. keep awake
G0069.o: ultimately from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G5258 (ὕπνος);

G0070.d:
ἀγρυπνία, -ας, ἡ (see supr.),
[in LXX: Si .9, 2Ma.2:26 * ;]
sleeplessness, watching: 2Co.6:5 11:27. (Plat., Hdt.; for exx. in π., see MM, VGT, see word) †
(AS)

G0071.d:
ἄγω,
[in LXX for בּוא hi., לקח, נהג, etc. ;]
__1. to lead, bring, carry: with ace, before ἐπί, εἰς, ἕως, πρός and simple dative; metaphorically, to lead, guide, impel: Jhn.10:16 Rom.2:4, Heb.2:10, 2Ti.3:6, al.
__2. to spend or keep a day: Luk.24:21, Act.19:38
__3. Intrans., to go: subjunc., ἄγωμεν, Mat.2:46, al. (Cramer, 61; MM, VGT, see word).
(AS)
G0071.s: properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce
G0071.k: be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open

G0072.d:
ἀγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἄγω), [in LXX: Est.2:20 10:3, 2Ma.4:16 6:8 11:24, 3Ma.4:10 * ;]
__1. a carrying away.
__2. a leading, guiding; metaphorically, training; hence, from the expression ἀ. τοῦ βίου, absol., conduct, way of life: 2Ti.3:10 (Cremer, 61; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0072.s: a bringing up, i.e. mode of living

G0073.d:
ἀγών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(ἄγω), [in LXX: Isa.7:13 (לאה), Est.4:17, Wis.4:2 10:12, II Mac.6, 4Mac .5 * ;]
__1. a gathering, esp. for games.
__2. a place of assembly.
__3. a contest, struggle, trial; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word),
__(a) of the Christian life as a contest and struggle: Php.1:30, 1Th.2:2, 1Ti.6:12, 2Ti.4:7 Heb.12:1;
__(b) solicitude, anxiety: Col.2:1.
† (AS)
G0073.s: properly, a place of assembly (as if led), i.e. (by implication) a contest (held there); figuratively, an effort or anxiety

G0074.d:
ἀγωνία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀγών), [in LXX: 2Ma.3:14,16 15:19 * ;]
__1. a contest, wrestling (Eur., Xen.).
__2. Of the mind, great fear, agony, anguish (Dem., Arist.): Luk.22:44 (cf . Field, Notes, 77 f. ; Abbott, Essays, 101 f. ; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0074.s: a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively) anguish

G0075.d:
ἀγωνίζομαι
(ἀγών), [in LXX: Da TH 6:14 (שׂוּם בָּל), Sir.4:28, I, II, 4Mac .5 * ;]
__1. to contend for a prize: 1Co.9:25,
__2. to fight, struggle, strive: Jhn.18:36; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word). Col.1:29 4:12, 1Ti.4:10 6:12, 2Ti.4:7; with inf. (Field, Notes, 66), Luk.13:24 (Cremer, 609)
† (AS)
G0075.s: to struggle, literally (to compete for a prize), figuratively (to contend with an adversary), or genitive case (to endeavor to accomplish something)

G0076.d:
Ἀδάμ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָדָם),
Adam: Luk.3:38, Rom.5:14, 1Co.15:22,45, 1Ti.2:13,14 Ju 14. Christ ὁ ἔσχατος Ἀ., 1Co.15:45.†
(AS)
G0076.s: Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative)

G0079.d:
ἀδελφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀδελφός), [in LXX for אָהוֹת ;]
a sister: Mat.19:29, al.; metaphorically (MM, VGT, see word), of a member of the Christian community: Rom.16:1, 1Co.7:15 Jas.21:15, al.
(AS)

G0080.d:
ἀδελφός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀ- copul., δελφύς, womb),
in cl., a brother, born of the same parent or parents. [In LXX (Hort, Ja., 102f.), for אָח ;]
__1. lit. of a brother (Gen.4:2, al.).
__2. Of a neighbour (Lev.19:17).
__3. Of a member of the same nation (Exo.2:14, Deu.15:3). In NT in each of these senses (1. Mat.1:2, al.; 2. Mat.7:3; 3. Rom.9:3) and also,
__4. of a fellow-Christian: 1Co.1:1, Act.9:30. This usage finds illustration in π., where ἀ. is used of members of a pagan religious community (M, Th., I, 1:4; MM, VGT, see word). The ἀδελφοὶ τ. Κυρίου (Mat.12:46-49 13:55 28:10, Mrk.3:31-34, Luk.8:19-21, Jhn.2:12 7:3, 5 10…
G0080.s: a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like G1 (Α))
G0080.o: from G1 (Α) (as a connective particle) and (the womb);

G0081.d:
ἀδελφότης, -ητος, ἡ
(ἀδελφός), [in LXX: 1Ma.12:10,17, 4Mac .5 * ;]
__1. abstract, brotherhood, brotherly affection (LXX).
__2. Concrete, the brotherhood, the Christian community: 1Pe.2:17 5:9 (MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0081.s: brotherhood (properly, the feeling of brotherliness), i.e. the (Christian) fraternity

G0082.d:
ἄ-δηλος, -ον
(δῆλος), [in LXX: Ps 50 (51):6 (בַּטֻחוֹת) ;]
__1. unseen, unobserved, not manifest (Ps, l.with): Luk.11:44.
__2. uncertain, indistinct: 1Co.14:8.
† (AS)
G0082.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1212 (δῆλος);

G0085.d:
ἀδημονέω, -ῶ (on the derivation, see MM, VGT, see word), [in Aq.: Job.18:20; Sm.: Psa.60 (61):3 115:2 (116:11), Ecc.7:17(16), Eze.3:15 * ;]
to be troubled, distressed (MM, l.with): Mat.26:37, Mrk.14:33, Php.2:26.†
(AS)
G0085.o: from a derivative of (to be sated to loathing);
G0085.k: be full of heaviness, be very heavy

G0086.d:
ᾅδης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX ehiefly for שְׁאוֹל, also for דּוּמָה, מָוֶת, etc. ;]
__1. in Hom., Hades (Pluto), the god of the underworld.
__2. the abode of Hades, the underivorld; in NT, the abode of departed spirits, Hades: ἐν τ. ᾅ., Luk.16:23; εἰς ᾅ., Act.2:27,31; πύλαι ᾅδου, Mat.16:18; κλεῖς τοῦ ᾅ., Rev.1:18; metaphorically, ἕως ᾅ., Mat.11:23, Luk.10:15; personified, Rev.6:8 20:13,14 (Cremer, 67, 610; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0086.s: properly, unseen, i.e. "Hades" or the place (state) of departed souls
G0086.o: from G1 (Α) (as negative particle) and G1492 (εἴδω);

G0087.d:
ἀ-διά-κριτος, -ον
(διακρίνω), [in LXX: Pro.25:1 * ;]
__1. not to be parted, mixed, undistinguishable (cf. Pr, l.with, and see Lft., Ignat. Eph., §3).
__2. without uncertainty (Hort, in l., but see MM, VGT, see word): Jas.3:17.
† (AS)
G0087.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1252 (διακρίνω);

G0088.d:
ἀδιάλειπτος, -ον
(διαλείπω),
unremitting, incessant: Rom.9:2, 2Ti.1:3. (For exx., see MM, VGT, see word) †
(AS)
G0088.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G1223 (διά) and G3007 (λείπω);

G0089.d:
ἀδιαλείπτως (see supr.), adv.,
[in LXX: 1Ma.12:11, II Mac .4, 3Ma.6:33 * ;]
unremittingly, incessantly: Rom.1:9, 1Th.1:3 2:13 5:17.†
(AS)
G0089.s: uninterruptedly, i.e. without omission (on an appropriate occasion)

G0090.o: from a derivative of a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1311 (διαφθείρω);

G0091.d:
ἀδικέω, -ῶ
(ἄδικος), [in LXX for עשׁק, עוה, etc. ;]
__1. intrans., to be ἄδικος, do wrong, act wickedly or criminally: Act.25:11, 1Co.6:8, 2Co.7:12, Col.3:25, Rev.22:11; to do hurt, Rev.9:19.
__2. Trans.
__(a) to do some wrong: ὃ ἠδίκησεν, Col.3:25; to wrong some one, Mat.20:13, Act.7:26, 27 25:10, 2Co.7:2, Gal.4:12, Phm 18, 2Pe.2:13; pass., Act.7:24, 2Co.7:12; mid., 1Co.6:7 (suffer . . . to be wronged; WM, §38, 3; but see Bl., §54, 5; and cf. ἀποστερέω);
__(b) to injure, hurt: Luk.10:19 Rev.2:11 6:6 7:2, 3 9:4,10 11:5.
† (AS)
G0091.s: to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically)
G0091.k: hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong

G0092.d:
ἀδίκημα, -τος, τό
(ἀδικέω), [in LXX for עָוֹן, פֶּשַׁע, etc. ;]
a wrong, injury, misdeed (MM, VGT, see word): Act.18:14 24:20, Rev.18:5.†
(AS)
G0092.k: evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong

G0093.d:
ἀδικία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄδικος), [in LXX for עָוֹן, פֶּשַׁע, עָוֶל, etc. ;]
__1. injustice: Luk.18:6, Rom.9:14.
__2. unrighteousness, iniquity: Jhn.7:18, Act.8:23, Rom.1:18, 29 2:8 6:13, 2Ti.2:19, 1Jn.1:9 5:17; opposite to ἀλήθεια, 1Co.13:6, 2Th.2:12; to δικαιοσύνη ], Rom.3:5; ἀπάτη τῆς ἀ., 2Th.2:10; μισθὸς ἀδικίας, Act.1:18, 2Pe.2:13,15; ἐγράται τῆς ἀ., Luk.13:27; μαμωνᾶς τῆς ἀ., Luk.16:9; κόσμος τῆς ἀ., Jas.3:6; οἰκονόμος τῆς ἀ., Luk.16:8.
__3. = ἀδίκημα, an unrighteous act: ironically, a favour, 2Co.12:13; pl., Heb.8:12 (Cremer, 261; MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0093.s: (legal) injustice (properly, the quality, by implication, the act); morally, wrongfulness (of character, life or act)

G0094.d:
ἄδικος, -ον
(δίκη), [in LXX for שׁקר, עול, etc. ;]
__1. unjust: Rom.3:5, Heb.6:10.
__2. unrighteous, wicked: Luk.16:11 18:11, Act.24:15, 1Co.6:1,9 1Pe.3:18; opposite to δίκαιος, Mat.5:45; to εὐσεβής, 2Pe.2:9; to πιστός, Luk.16:10 (Cremer, 200).
† (AS)
G0094.s: unjust; by extension wicked; by implication, treacherous; specially, heathen
G0094.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1349 (δίκη);

G0095.d:
ἀδίκως, adv.
(ἄδικος), [in LXX for שׁקר, עול, etc. ;]
unjustly, undeservedly: 1Pe.2:19.†
(AS)

G0096.d:
ἀ-δόκιμος, -ον,
[in LXX: Pro.25:4, Isa.1:22 (סִיג) * ;]
__1. of things (prop. of metals: LXX, ll. with), not standing the test, rejected: γῆ, Heb.6:8.
__2. Of persons, rejected after testing, reprobate: Rom.1:28, 1Co.9:27, 2Co.13:5-7, 2Ti.3:8, Tit.1:16 (Cremer, 212).
† (AS)
G0096.s: unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally)
G0096.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1384 (δόκιμος);

G0097.d:
ἄδολος, -ον,
__1. guileless (Pind., Thuc).
__2. Of liquids (Æsch., Eur., and late prose writers), genuine, pure (in π. and in MGr. of wine, also of corn: MM, VGT, see word; Milligan, NTD, 77): of milk, metaphorically, 1Pe.2:2.
† SYN.: ἀκέραιος (which see), ἄκακος, ἁπλοῦς. (AS)

G0098.d:
Ἁδραμυντηνός (T, Rec. Ἀδραμυττηνός), -ή,-όν,
of Adramyttium, a seaport of Mysia: Act.27:2.†
(AS)

G0099.d:
Ἁδρίας (T, Rec. Ἀδρίας), -ου, ὁ,
the Adriatic sea, in later Greek usage extended to take in all the waters between Greece and Italy: Act.27:27.†
(AS)

G0101.d:
ἀδυνατέω, -ῶ
(ἀδύνατος), [in LXX: Deu.17:8, Zec.8:6 (פּלא ni.), Job.42:2 (בּצר ni.), al. ;]
__1. Abbott-Smith omits this number to be unable (cl., Philo; π., see MM, VGT, see word).
__2. In LXX and NT (Kennedy, Sources, 124; Hatch, Essays, 4; Field, Notes, 46 f.), to be impossible: Mat.17:20, Luk.1:37.
† (AS)

G0102.d:
ἀ-δύνατος, -ον,
[in LXX for אֶבְיוֹן, דַּל, etc. ;]
__1. of persons, unable, powerless: Act.14:8; figuratively Rom.15:1 (MM, VGT, see word).
__2. Of things, impossible: Mat.19:26, Mrk.10:27, Luk.18:27, Rom.8:3, Heb.6:4,18 10:4 11:6.
† (AS)
G0102.s: unable, i.e. weak (literally or figuratively); passively, impossible
G0102.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1415 (δυνατός);
G0102.k: could not do, impossible, impotent, not possible, weak

G0103.d:
ᾄδω (Attic form of Ion. and poët. ἀείδω),
[in LXX chiefly for שִׁיר ;]
to sing,
__(a) intrans., with dative (MM, VGT, see word), of praise to God: Eph.5:19, Col.3:16 ;
__(b) trans., with cogn. accusative: ᾠδὴν, Rev.5:9 14:3 15:3.
† (AS)

G0104.d:
ἀεί, adv.,
[in LXX: Isa.42:14 (מֵעוֹלָם) 51:13 (תָּמִיד), Ps 94(95):10, al. ;]
ever;
__1. of continuous time, unceasingly, perpetually: Act.7:51, 2 Co.4.11; 6:10, Tit.1:12, Heb.3:10.
__2. Of successive occurrences, on every occasion (MM, VGT, see word): 1Pe.3:15, 2Pe.1:12.
† (AS)
G0104.s: "ever," by qualification regularly; by implication, earnestly
G0104.o: from an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration);

G0105.d:
ἀετός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX for נֶשֶׁר ;]
an eagle: Rev.4:7 8:13 (Rec. ἀγγέλου) 12:14. Where carrion is referred to, ἀ. is probably a vulture (cf. Job.39:30, Pro.30:17): Mat.24:28, Luk.17:37 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0106.d:
ἄζυμος, -ον
(ζύμη), [in LXX for מָצָּה; τὰ ἄ. (sc. λάγανα, cakes) = הַמָצָּה ;]
unleavened: ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἄ. (הַג הַמָצָּה), the paschal feast (also called τὰ ἄ., Mrk.14:1), Luk.22:1; ἡμέρα τῶν ἄ., Mat.26:17, Mrk.14:12, Luk.22:7; ἡμέραι, Act.12:3 20:6. Fig., of Christians, free from corruption: 1Co.5:7; exhorted to keep festival, ἐν ἀζύμοις (sc. ἄρτοις, λάγανοις, or, indefinitely, "unleavened elements"), ib. 8 (Cremer, 724).†
(AS)
G0106.s: unleavened, i.e. (figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neutral plural) specially (by implication) the Passover week
G0106.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2219 (ζύμη);

G0108.s: Azotus (i.e. Ashdod), a place in Palestine

G0109.d:
ἀήρ, ἀέρος, ὁ,
[in LXX: 2Ki.22:12 (= Psa.17(18):11 שׁחק), Wi .8 ;]
in Hom., Hes., the lower air which surrounds the earth, as opposite to the purer αἰθήρ of the higher regions; generally, air (MM, VGT, see word): Act.22:23, 1Th.4:17, Rev.9:2 16:17; of the air as the realm of demons, Eph.2:2; ἀ. δέρειν, of striving to no purpose, 1Co.9:26; εἰς ἀ. λαλεῖν, of speaking without effect, not being understood, 1Co.14:9.†
(AS)
G0109.s: by analogy, to blow); "air" (as naturally circumambient)

G0110.d:
ἀθανασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀ-θάνατος, undying; V. MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Wis.3:4 4:1 8:13,17 15:3, 4Ma.14:5 16:13 * ;]
immortality: 1Co.15:53,54 1Ti.6:16 (cf. Cremer, 285 f.).†
(AS)
G0110.o: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2288 (θάνατος);

G0111.d:
ἀ-θέμιτος (late form of ἀθέμιστος, LS, MM, VGT, see word), -ον
(θέμις, custom, right), [in LXX: 2Ma.6:5 7:1 10:34, 3Ma.5:20 * ;]
__(a) of persons, lawless (III Mac, l.with);
__(b) of things, lawless, unlawful: Act.10:28, 1Pe.4:3.†
SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος. (AS)
G0111.s: from the base of G5087 (τίθημι)); illegal; by implication, flagitious
G0111.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (statute;

G0112.d:
ἄ-θεος, -ον,
__1. in cl.
__(a) slighting or denyiyig the gods (Plat.; cf. MM, VGT, see word);
__(b) godless, ungodly (Pind.);
__(with) abandoned by the gods (Soph.)
__2. In the NT (cf. Lft. on Ign. ad Trail, §3), of the heathen, without God, not knowing God (Cremer, 281): Eph.2:12.
† (AS)
G0112.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2316 (θεός);

G0113.d:
ἄθεσμος, -ον
(θεσμός, law, custom), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:12 6:26 * ;]
lawless, esp. of those who violate the law of nature and conscience (cf. MM, VGT, see word): 2Pe.2:7 3:17.†
SYN.: ἀθέμιτος, ἄνομος, κακός, πονηρός, φαῦλος (see Tr., Syn., §lxxiv; DCG, ii, 821b). (AS)
G0113.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι) (in the sense of enacting);

G0114.d:
ἀθετέω, -ῶ (τίθημι), [in LXX for seventeen different words, פּשׁע, מרד, בּגד, מעל, etc., often meaning, as 1Ki.13:3 (Heb., al.), to revolt; properly, to make ἄθετον , or do away with what has been laid down (see DCG, i, 453 f.)].
__1. to set aside, disregard (in Gramm., to reject as spurious): διαθήκην , Gal.3:16; ἐντολήν , Mrk.7:9; νόμον . Heb.10:28; πίστιν , 1Ti.5:12.
__2. to nullify, make void: Luk.7:30 (see Field, Notes, 59), 1Co.1:19, Gal.2:21.
__3. to reject: Mrk.6:26 (Field, op. cit., 30), Lk 10:16, Jhn.12:48, I Th 48, Ju 8 (for exx. in π., see MM, VGT, see word).…
G0114.s: to set aside, i.e. (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or violate
G0114.o: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);
G0114.k: cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject

G0115.d:
ἀθέτησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀθετέω), [in LXX, usually of unfaithful, rebellious action: 1Ki.24:12 (פֶּשַׁע), Jer.12:1 (בֶּגֶד), Da TH 9:7 (מַעַל), 2Ma.14:28 * ;]
a disannulling, setting aside: Heb.7:18 9:26 (for similar usage in π., see Deiss., BS, 228 f.; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0116.d:
Ἀθῆναι, -ῶν, αἱ (plural because consisting of several parts),
Athens: Act.17:15,16 18:1, 1Th.3:1.†
(AS)
G0116.o: plural of (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city);

G0117.d: Athenian, of or from Athens , (Iliad by Homer), etc (ML)
G0117.s: an Athenæan or inhabitant of Athenæ

G0118.d:
ἀθλέω, -ῶ (in cl. also ἀθλεύω, ἆθλος, a contest, in war or in sport),
to contend in games, wrestle, combat: 2Ti.2:5.†
(AS)
G0118.s: to contend in the competitive games
G0118.o: from (a contest in the public lists);

G0119.d:
ἄθλησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀθλέω),
a contest, combat, esp. of athletes; figuratively, a struggle: Heb.10:32 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0120.d:
ἀθυμέω, -ῶ (ἄ-θυμος, without heart),
[in LXX for חרה, etc. ;]
to be disheartened: Col.3:21.†
(AS)
G0120.o: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2372 (θυμός);

G0121.d:
ἀθῷος (Rec. wrongly, -ῶος; LS, see word; Mayser, 131), -ον
(θωή, a penalty), [in LXX chiefly for נקה ni., pi., נָקִי ;]
__1. unpunished (MM, VGT, see word).
__2. innocent: Mat.27:4 (WH, R, mg., δίκαιον) 27:24.
(AS)
G0121.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι) (meaning a penalty);

G0122.d:
αἴγειος (WH, -γιος), -α, -ον (αἶξ, a goat),
[in LXX for עֵז ;]
of a goat: Heb.11:37 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0123.d:
αἰγιαλός, -οῦ, ὁ (on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word),
[in LXX: Jdg.5:17 (חוֹף), Sir.24:14 * ;]
the sea-shore, beach (cf. Field, Notes, 146; DCG, i, 175 f.; MM, VGT, see word): Mat.13:2,48 Jhn.21:4, Act.21:5 27:39,40.†
(AS)
G0123.s: a beach (on which the waves dash)
G0123.o: from (to rush) and G251 (ἅλς) (in the sense of the sea;

G0124.s: an Ægyptian or inhabitant of Ægyptus

G0125.d:
Αἴγυπτος, ου, ἡ,
Egypt: Mat.2:13-15,19, Act.2:10 7:9-39, Heb.3:16 11:26,27; γῆ Αἴ., Act.7:40 13:17, Heb.8:9, Ju 5 (cf. Exo.5:12, al.); ἡ Αἴ., Act.7:11; figuratively, of Jerusalem as hostile to God, Rev.11:8.†
(AS)
G0125.s: Ægyptus, the land of the Nile

G0126.d:
ἀΐδιος, -ον
(ἀεί), [in LXX: Wis.7:26, 4Ma.10:15 * ;]
everlasting (frequently in Inscr.; MM, VGT, see word): Rom.1:20, Ju 6.†
SYN.: αἰώνιος, also frequently in Inscr. (Deiss., BS, 363 J. The etymological distinction between the meanings of the two words seems not to be retained in late Greek (see Thayer, see word, αἰώνιος; cf. Cremer, 79, 611). (AS)
G0126.s: everduring (forward and backward, or forward only)

G0127.d:
αἰδώς (-όος), -οῦς, ἡ,
[in LXX: 3Ma.1:19 4:5 * ;]
a sense of shame, modesty: 1Ti.2:9 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: αἰσχύνη (see Thayer, 14; Tr., Syn., §xix; Cremer, 611 f.; CGT on I Ti, l.with). (AS)
G0127.s: bashfulness, i.e. (towards men), modesty or (towards God) awe
G0127.o: perhaps from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1492 (εἴδω) (through the idea of downcast eyes);

G0128.d:
.*Αἰθίοψ, -οπος, ὁ
(αἴθω, to burn, ὤψ, face; i.e. swarthy), [in LXX for כּוּשׁ ;]
Ethiopian: Act.8:27.†
(AS)
G0128.o: from (to scorch) and (the face, from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι));

G0129G.d:
αἷμα, ατος, τό,
[in LXX for דָּם ;]
blood.
__1. In the ordinary sense: Mrk.5:25, Luk.8:43,44 22:44, Jhn.19:34, Act.15:20,29 21:25, Rev.8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13.
__2. In special senses:
__(a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): Jhn.1:13 (see MM, VGT, see word);
__(b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: Mat.16:17, 1Co.15:50, Gal.1:16, Eph.6:12, Heb.2:14;
__(with) of things in colour resembling blood: Act.2:19,20, Rev.6:12 14:18-20.
__(d) of bloodshed, a bloody death (cl.): Mat.23:30,35…
G0129G.s: blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred

G0129H.d:
αἷμα, ατος, τό,
[in LXX for דָּם ;]
blood.
__1. In the ordinary sense: Mrk.5:25, Luk.8:43,44 22:44, Jhn.19:34, Act.15:20,29 21:25, Rev.8:7,8 11:6 16:3,4,6 19:13.
__2. In special senses:
__(a) of generation, origin, kinship (cl.): Jhn.1:13 (see MM, VGT, see word);
__(b) as in OT (AR on Eph, l.with), in the phrase σάρξ καὶ αἷ. (αἷ. κ. σ.), to indicate human nature as opposite to God and created spirits: Mat.16:17, 1Co.15:50, Gal.1:16, Eph.6:12, Heb.2:14;
__(with) of things in colour resembling blood: Act.2:19,20, Rev.6:12 14:18-20.
__(d) of bloodshed, a bloody death (cl.): Mat.23:30,35…
G0129H.s: blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred

G0130.d:
αἱματεκχυσία, -ας, ἡ
(αἷμα, ἐκ, χέω),
shedding of blood (Eccl.; Cremer, 71): Heb.9:22.†
(AS)
G0130.o: from G129 (αἷμα) and a derivative of G1632 (ἐκχέω);

G0131.d:
αἱμορροέω,
(αἷμα, ῥέω), [in LXX: Lev.15:33 (דָּוֶה) * ;]
to lose blood, suffer from a flow of blood (Hipp.): Mat.9:20.†
(AS)
G0131.s: to flow blood, i.e. have a hæmorrhage
G0131.k: diseased with an issue of blood

G0133.d:
αἴνεσις, -εως, ἡ
(αἰνέω), [in LXX chiefly for תּוֹדָה, תְּהִלָּה ;]
praise (Eccl.): θυσία αἰνέσεως (Lev.7:12, זֶבַח תּוֹדָה), Heb.13:15.†
(AS)
G0133.s: a praising (the act), i.e. (specially) a thank(-offering)

G0134.d:
αἰνέω, -ῶ (αἶνος), poët., Ion. and late prose (MM, VGT, see word) for cl. ἐπαινέω,
[in LXX chiefly for הלל, ידה ;]
to praise: with accusative, τ. θεόν, Luk.2:13,20 19:37 24:53, Act.2:47 3:8,9, Rom.15:11; with dative, τ. Θεῷ (Jer.20:13, al. for הִלֵּל לְ; see Field, Notes, 245), Rev.19:5.†
SYN.: ἐξομολογέω, εὐλογέω, εὐχαριστέω, μακαρίζω (see DCG, i, 211). (AS)

G0135.d:
αἴνιγμα, -ατος, τό
(αἰνίσσομαι, to speak in riddles; αἰνός = δεινός, dread, strange), [in LXX for חִידָה, Num.12:8 and always exc. Deu.28:37 (שַׁמָּה) ;]
a dark saying, riddle: 1Co.13:12 (cf. Nu, l.with).†
(AS)
G0135.o: from a derivative of G136 (αἶνος) (in its primary sense);

G0136.d:
αἶνος, ου, ὁ,
[in LXX for הלל pi, עֹז ;]
poët, and Ion.,
__1. = μῦθος, a tale (Horn., al.).
__2. = Att. ἔπαινος, praise (Horn., al.): Mat.21:16 (LXX), Luk.18:43.
__3. In π., a decree (MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0136.s: properly, a story, but used in the sense of G1868 (ἔπαινος); praise (of God)

G0137.o: of Hebrew origin (a derivative of G5869, place of springs);

G0138.d:
αἱρέω,
[in LXX for אמר hi., בּחר, etc. ;]
to take; Mid., -ομαι (M, Pr., 158 f.; MM, VGT, see word), to choose: Php.1:22, 2Th.2:13, Heb.11:25. (Cf. ἀν-, ἀφ-, δι-, ἐξ-, καθ-, περι-, προ-αιρέω.) †
(AS)
G0138.s: to take for oneself, i.e. to prefer

G0139.d:
αἵρεσις, -εως, ἡ
(αἱρέω, -ομαι), [in LXX for נְדָבָה,]
__1. capture.
__2. choosing, choice (see MM, VGT, see word).
__3. that which is chosen, hence, opinion; esp. a peculiar opinion, heresy: 1Co.11:19, Gal.5:20, 2Pe.2:1 R, txt.
__4. In late writers (MM, VGT), of a set of persons professing particular principles or opinions, a school, sect, party, faction: Act.5:17 15:5 24:5,14 26:5 28:22, I Co, Ga, II Pe, l.with, R, mg. (Cremer, 614).
† (AS)
G0139.s: properly, a choice, i.e. (specially) a party or (abstractly) disunion
G0139.k: heresy (which is the Greek word itself), sect

G0140.d:
αἱρετίζω,
[in LXX chiefly for בּחר (see Cremer, 615) ;] = αἱρέομαι (Hipp., Inscr.),
to choose: Mat.12:18 (LXX, ἀντιλήμψομαι).†
(AS)

G0141.d:
αἱρετικός, -ή, όν
(αἱρέομαι),
__1. capable of choosing (Plat.).
__2. causing division, heretical, factious (Cremer, 614): as subst., Tit.3:10.
† (AS)

G0142.d:
αἴρω,
[in LXX chiefly for נשׂא, also for לקח, etc. ;]
__1. to raise, take up, lift or draw up: Jhn.8:59 11:41, Act.27:17, al.
__2. to bear, carry: Mat.4:6 16:24, al.
__3. to bear or take away, carry off, remove: Mat.21:21, Jhn.19:31, 1Co.5:12 6:15 (see Lft., Notes, 216), al.; of the taking away sin by Christ, Jhn.1:29, 1Jn.3:5. (Cf. ἀπ᾽, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, μετ-, συν-, ὑπερ-αίρω). For exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)
G0142.s: to lift up; by implication, to take up or away; figuratively, to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind), specially, to sail away (i.e. weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare H05375) to expiate sin
G0142.k: away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up)

G0143.d:
αἰσθάνομαι,
[in LXX for בּין, חפז, ידע ;]
to perceive: withaccusative of thing(s) (Bl., §36, 5; MM, VGT, see word), Luk.9:45 (Cremer, 619 f.).†
(AS)

G0144.d:
αἴσθησις, -εως, ἡ
(αἰσθάνομαι), [in LXX chiefly for דַּעַת ;]
perception (MM, VGT, see word): Php.1:9.†
SYN.: ἐπίγνωσις, which see (cf. Cremer, 620). (AS)

G0145.d:
αἰσθητήριον, -ου, τό
(αἰσθάνομαι), [in LXX: Jer.4:19 (קִיר), 4Ma.2:22 * ;]
sense, organ of perception: Heb.5:14 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0145.s: properly, an organ of perception, i.e. (figuratively) judgment

G0146.d:
αἰσχροκερδής, -ες
(αἰσχρός, κέρδος),
greedy of base gains: 1Ti.3:3,8 Abbot-Smith omits 1Ti.3:3, Tit.1:7.†
(AS)

G0148.d:
αἰσχρολογία, -ας, ἡ
(αἰσχρός, λέγω),
abusive language, abuse (Lft., ICC, in l.; MM, VGT, see word): Col.3:8.†
(AS)

G0149.d:
αἰσχρός, -ά, όν
(αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX: Gen.41:3 ff. (רַע, רֹעַ), Jdth.12:12, al. ;]
base, shameful: 1Co.11:6 14:35, Eph.5:12, Tit.1:11 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0150.d:
αἰσχρός, -ά, όν
(αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX: Gen.41:3 ff. (רַע, רֹעַ), Jdth.12:12, al. ;]
base, shameful: 1Co.11:6 14:35, Eph.5:12, Tit.1:11 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0152.d:
αἰσχύνη, -ης, ἡ
(αἶσχος, shame, disgrace), [in LXX chiefly for בּשֶׁת ;]
shame (MM, VGT, see word): subjectively, Luk.14:19, 2Co.4:2; objectively, Php.3:19, Heb.12:2; as something to be ashamed of, Rev.3:18; pl. (Bl., §32, 6), shameful deeds, Ju 13.†
SYN.: αἰδώς, which see (AS)

G0153.d:
αἰσχύνω
(αἶσχος, shame), [in LXX chiefly for בּוּשׁ ;]
__1. to disfigure (Hom.).
__2. to dishonour (Pro.29:15).
__3. to make ashamed (Sir.13:7). Pass., to be put to shame, be ashamed: 2Co.10:8; Php.1:20, 1Pe.4:16, 1Jn.2:28; with inf. (M, Pr., 205), Luk.16:3 (cf. ἐπ- (-ομαι), κατ- αἰσχύνω).
† (AS)

G0154.d:
αἰτέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for שׁאל ;]
to ask, request: absol., Mat.7:7, Jas.1:6; with accusative of person(s), Mat.5:42, Luk.6:30; with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, Mat.20:20, 1Jn.5:15; id. before παρά, Act.3:2, Jas.1:5; with dupl. accusative Mat.7:9, Mrk.6:22, Jhn.16:23. Mid. (on the distinction bet. mid. and act., see M, Pr., 160): absol., Mrk.15:8, Jhn.16:26, Jas.4:3; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.14:7, Mrk.6:24, al.; with accusative of person(s), Mat.27:20, Luk.23:25; with accusative of thing(s), before παρά, Act.9:2; with accusative and inf., Luk.23:23. with inf. Act.7:46, Eph.3:13 (cf. ἀπ-, ἐξ-, ἐπ-, παρ-, προσ- αιτέω).
SYN.: ἐρωτάω,…
G0154.k: ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require

G0155.d:
αἴτημα, -ατος, τό
(αἰτέω), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁאֵלָה ;]
that which has been asked for, a petition, request: Luk.23:24, Php.4:6, Jhn.5:15.†
SYN.: see: δέησις. (AS)
G0155.s: a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking

G0156.d:
αἰτία, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX: Gen.4:13 (עָוֹן), Pro.28:17 (עָשַׁק), and frequently in Wi, II, III Mac ;]
__1. cause, reason, occasion, case: Mat.19:3, Luk.8:47, Act.10:21 22:24 28:20, 2Ti.1:6,12, Tit.1:13, Heb.2:11 ; εἰ οὕτως ἐστιν ἡ αἰ. (cf. Lat. si ita res se habet, and see MM. VGT, see word), Mat.19:10.
__2. In forensic sense,
__(a) accusation: Act.25:18,27;

G0156.s: a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved)

G0157.d:
αἰτίωμα (Rec. αἰτίαμα, the usual form; see MM, VGT, see word), -τος, τό
(αἰτιάομαι, αἰτία),
a charge, accusation: Act.25:7.†
(AS)

G0158.d:
αἴτιον, -ου, τό, see: αἴτιος.

__1. causative of, responsible for; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the cause, author: Heb.5:9; τὸ αἰ., the cause, Act.19:40.

G0159.d:
αἴτιος, -α, ὁ

__2. blameworthy, culpable; as subst., ὁ αἰ., the culprit, the accused (Lat. reus); τὸ αἰ. (= αἰτία, 3), the crime, Luk.23:4,14,22.
† (AS)

G0160.d:
αἰφνίδιος (in Lk, l.with, ἐφν- WH; see M, Pr., 35), -ον

(AS)
G0160.o: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5316 (φαίνω) (compare G1810 (ἐξαίφνης)) (meaning non-apparent);

G0161.d:
αἰχμαλωσία -ας, ἡ
(αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שְׁבִי, גּוֹלָה ;]
captivity (Diod., al.): Rev.13:10; pl., abstr. for concr., = αἰχμάλωτοι, Eph.4:8 (LXX).†
(AS)

G0162.d:
αἰχμαλωτεύω
(αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבה ;] = αἰχμαλωτίζω, which see,
to lead captive: Eph.4:8 (LXX).†
(AS)

G0163.d:
αἰχμαλωτίζω
(αἰχμάλωτος), [in LXX chiefly for שׁבה ;] in late writers = cl. αἰχμάλωτον ποιῶ (ἄγω),
to take or lead captive: before εἰς, Luk.21:24 (cf. Tob.1:10); metaphorically, Rom.7:23, 2Co.10:5, 2Ti.3:6.†
(AS)
G0163.k: lead away captive, bring into captivity

G0164.d:
αἰχμάλωτος, -ον
(αἰχμή, a spear, ἁλίσκομαι, to be taken), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁבָה, גּוֹלָה ;]
captive: Luk.4:18 (LXX).†
(AS)
G0164.s: properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive
G0164.o: from (a spear) and a derivative of the same as G259 (ἅλωσις);

G0165G.d:
αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for עַד ,עוֹלָם ;]
__1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT);
__(a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), Luk.1:70;
__(b) of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, Mat.21:19; id., with neg., never, Jhn.4:14; more strongly, εἰς τὸν αἰ. τοῦ αἰ., Heb.1:8 (LXX); εἰς τοὺς αἰ., Mat.6:13; εἰς τοὺς αἰ. τῶν αἰ. (cf. Isa.45:17, עַד־עוֹלְמֵי עַד), Rom.16:27, LT; cf. also Eph.3:21,…
G0165G.s: properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future)
G0165G.k: age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more), (n-)ever, (beginning of the , while the) world (began, without end)

G0165H.d:
αἰών, -ῶνος, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for עַד ,עוֹלָם ;]
__1. in cl., like Lat. aevum (LS, MM, VGT, see word), a space of time, as, a lifetime, generation, period of history, an indefinitely long period; in NT of an indefinitely long period, an age, eternity, usually with prep. (MM, VGT);
__(a) of the past: ἀπ᾽ αἰ. (cf. Heb. מֵעוֹלָם), Luk.1:70;
__(b) of the future: εἰς τ. αἰ. (cf. לְעוֹלָם), forever, Mat.21:19; id., with neg., never, Jhn.4:14; more strongly, εἰς τὸν αἰ. τοῦ αἰ., Heb.1:8 (LXX); εἰς τοὺς αἰ., Mat.6:13; εἰς τοὺς αἰ. τῶν αἰ. (cf. Isa.45:17, עַד־עוֹלְמֵי עַד), Rom.16:27, LT; cf. also Eph.3:21,…
G0165H.s: properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future)
G0165H.k: age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more), (n-)ever, (beginning of the , while the) world (began, without end)

G0166.d:
αἰώνιος, -ον (as usual in Attic), also -α, -ον. 2Th.2:16, Heb.9:12;
(αἰών), [in LXX chiefly for עוֹלָם ;]
age-long, eternal,
__(a) of that which is without either beginning or end: Rom.16:26, Heb.9:14;
__(b) of that which is without beginning: Rom.16:25, 2Ti.1:9, Tit.1:2;
__(with) of that which is without end (MM, VGT, see word): σκηναί, Luk.16:9 οἰκία, 2Co.5:1; διαθήκη, Heb.13:20; εὐαγγέλιον, Rev.14:6; παράκλησις, 2Th.2:16; λύτρωσις, Heb.9:12; κληρονομία, ib. 15; κόλασις, Mat.25:46; κρίμα, Heb.6:2; κρίσις, Mrk.3:29; ὄλεθρον, 2Th.1:9; πῦρ, Mat.18:8; frequently with ζωή, which see
SYN.: ἀΐδιος, which see (AS)
G0166.s: perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well)

G0167.d:
ἀκαθαρσία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀκάθαρτος), [in LXX chiefly for טֻמְאָה, טָמֵא ;]
uncleanness, impurity,
__(a) physical (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.23:27;
__(b) moral: Rom.1:24 6:19, 2Co.12:21, Gal.5:19, Eph.4:19 5:3, Col.3:5, 1Th.2:3 4:7.
† (AS)

G0169.d:
ἀκάθαρτος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., καθαίρω), [in LXX chiefly for טָמֵא ;]
unclean, impure;
__(a) physically (LS, MM, VGT, see word);
__(b) ceremonially: Act.10:14,28 11:8, 1Co.7:14, 2Co.6:17, Rev.18:2;
__(with) morally: Eph.5:5, Rev.17:4; with πνεῦμα, as always in Gosp., Mat.10:1 12:43, Mrk.1:23,26,27 3:11,30 5:2,8,13 6:7 7:25 9:25, Luk.4:33,36 6:18 8:29 9:42 11:24, Act.5:16 8:7, Rev.16:13 (cf. Cremer, 320).
† (AS)
G0169.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2508 (καθαίρω) (meaning cleansed);

G0170.d:
ἀκαιρέομαι, -οῦμαι
(ἄκαιρος, unseasonable),
to have no opportunity (opposite to εὐκαιρέω): Php.4:10.†
(AS)
G0170.s: to be inopportune (for oneself), i.e. to fail of a proper occasion
G0170.o: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2540 (καιρός) (meaning unseasonable);

G0171.d:
ἀκαίρως, adv.
(ἄκαιρος, unseasonable), [in LXX: Si 35 (32):4 * ;]
out of season, unseasonably: opposite to εὐκαίρως (which see), 2Ti.4:2 (cf. Cremer, 740; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0171.o: adverb from the same as G170 (ἀκαιρέομαι);

G0172.d:
ἄκακος, -ον,
[in LXX for פְּתִי, תָּם, etc. ;]
__(a) as in cl. (Æsch., Plat., al.), of persons, simple, guileless: Rom.16:18, Heb.7:26 (cf. Cremer, 327);
__(b) of things, undamaged (? MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0172.s: not bad, i.e. (objectively) innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting
G0172.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2556 (κακός);

G0173.d:
ἄκανθα, -ης, ἡ
(ἀκή, a point), [in LXX chiefly for קוֹץ, also for סִיר, שַׁיִת, etc. ;]
a prickly plant, thorn, brier; in NT always pl.: Mat.7:16 13:7,22 27:29, Mrk.4:7,18, Luk.6:44 8:7,14, Jhn.19:2, Heb.6:8 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0173.o: probably from the same as G188 (ἀκμήν);

G0174.d:
ἀκάνθινος, -ον
(ἄκανθα), [in LXX: Isa.34:13 (סיר) * ;]
__1. of thorns: Mrk.15:17, Jhn.19:5.

G0175.d:
ἄ-καρπος, -ον,

unfruitful, barren: figuratively, Mat.13:22, Mrk.4:19, 1Co.14:14, Eph.5:11, Tit.3:14, 2Pe.1:8, Ju 12.†
(AS)
G0175.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2590 (καρπός);

G0176.d:
ἀ-κατά-γνωστος, -ον
(καταγινώσκω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:47 ;]

G0177.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G2596 (κατά) and G2572 (καλύπτω);

ἀ-κατά-κριτος, -ον

G0178.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2632 (κατακρίνω);

ἀκατάπαυστος, -ον

(AS)
G0180.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2664 (καταπαύω);

ἀκαταστασία, -ας, ἡ (ἀκατάστατος),

ἀκατάσχετος, -ον

G0189.d:
ἀκοή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀκούω), [in LXX: Exo.15:26, al. for שׁמע, its parts and derivatives, exc. Deu.11:22 (שׁמר) ;]
__1. hearing, the sense of hearing: 1Co.12:17, 2Pe.2:8; "Hebraic dative," ἀκοῇ ακούειν (frequently in LXX; V. M, Pr., 14, 75), Mat.13:14, Act.28:26.

__(a) a message, teaching: Jhn.12:38 and Rom.16:16,17" (LXX), Gal.3:2,5 R, mg.; λόγος ἀκοῆς, 1Th.2:13, Heb.4:2;
__(b) a report, rumour: with genitive, of person(s), Mat.4:24, 14:1,…

G0189.k: audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor

ἀκολουθέω, -ῶ

SYN.: (cl.) ἕπομαι, not in NT (see Cremer, 80; MM, VGT, see word). (AS)

ἀκούω,
[in LXX chiefly for שׁמע ]
to hear, listen, attend, perceive by hearing, comprehend by hearing.
__1. Intrans.: Mrk.4:3 7:37, Jas.2:5, Rev.2:7, al.; τ. ὠσίν, Mat.13:15 (LXX); with cogn. dative, ακοῇ ἀ. (see: ἀκοή), Mat.13:14, Act.28:26" (LXX) ; ὁ ἔχων ὦτα (οὖς) ἀκούειν, ἀκουσάτω, Mat.11:15, Mrk.4:23, Rev.2:7, al.
__2. Trans., prop. with accusative of thing(s), of thing heard, genitive of person(s), from whom heard (LS, see word): Act.1:4; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.12:19, Jhn.3:8 (Abbott, JG, 76), Act.22:9, al.; with dupl. accusative, Jhn.12:18, 1Co.11:18; with genitive of thing(s), Jhn.7:40 (Abbott, JV, 116); τ. φωνῆς (cf.…
G0191.k: give (in the) audience (of), come (to the ears), (shall) hear(-er, -ken), be noised, be reported, understand

G0192.d:
ἀκρασία, -ας, ἡ

(AS)

G0193.d:
ἀκρατής, -ές
(κράτος), [in LXX: Pro.27:20 * ;]
__(a) powerless, impotent;
__(b) in moral sense, lacking self-control, incontinent: 2Ti.3:3.†
(AS)
G0193.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2904 (κράτος);

G0194.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2767 (κεράννυμι);

G0195.d:
ἀκρίβεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Dan LXX TH 7:16 (יַצִּיב), Wis.12:21, Sir.16:25 42:4 * ;]
exactness, precision (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word): Act.22:3.†
(AS)

G0196.d:
ἀκριβής, -ές
[in LXX: Dan LXX 2:45 6:12 (יַצִּיב) Dan.4:25, Est.4:5, Sir.18:29 19:25 31:24 32:3 * ;]
exact, precise, careful, of things and persons: superl., Act.26:5.†
(AS)
G0196.o: superlative of (a derivative of the same as G206 (ἄκρον));

G0197.d:
ἀκριβῶς
adv. (ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Deu.19:18 (יָטַב), Da TH 7:19 (יְצֵב), Eze.39:14, Wis.19:18, Sir.18:29 ;]

(AS)
G0197.o: neuter of the comparative of the same as G196 (ἀκριβέστατος);

G0198.d:
ἀκριβόω, -ῶ
(ἀκριβής), [in Aq.: Isa.30:8 49:16 * ;]
to enquire with exactness, learn carefully: Mat.2:7, 16 (for similar ex., see MM, VGT, sv.).†
(AS)

G0199.d:
ἀκριβῶς
adv. (ἀκριβής), [in LXX: Deu.19:18 (יָטַב), Da TH 7:19 (יְצֵב), Eze.39:14, Wis.19:18, Sir.18:29 ;]
with exactness, carefully: Mat.2:8, Luk.1:3, Act.18:25, Eph.5:15, 1Th.5:2 (M, Th., in l). Compar., ἀκριβέστερον (Milligan, NTD, 111; MM, VGT, see word), Act.18:26 23:15, 20 24:22.†
(AS)
G0199.o: adverb from the same as G196 (ἀκριβέστατος);

G0200.d:
ἀκρίς, -ίδος, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אַרְבֶּה, also for חָגָב, etc. ;]
a locust: Mat.3:4, Mrk.1:6, Rev.9:3, 7.†
(AS)
G0200.s: a locust (as pointed, or as lighting on the top of vegetation)
G0200.o: apparently from the same as G206 (ἄκρον);

G0201.d:
ἀκροατήριον, -ου, τό
(ἀκροάομαι, to listen)
a place of audience: Act.25:23 (Plut.).†
(AS)

G0202.d:
ἀκροατής, οῦ, ὁ (see supr.)
[in LXX: Isa.3:3 (לַחַשׁ), Sir.3:29 ;]
a hearer: Rom.2:13, Jas.1:22, 23, 25.†
(AS)
G0202.s: apparently an intensive of G191 (ἀκούω)); a hearer (merely)

G0203.d:
ἀκροβυστία, -ας, ή

ἀκρο-γωνιαῖος, -αία, -αῖον

G0206.d:
ἄκρος, -α, -ον

highest, extreme; as subst., τὸ ἄ., the top, extremity: Mrk.13:27, Luk.16:24, Heb.11:21; pl. (cf. MM, VGT, see word), Mat.24:31.†
(AS)
G0206.o: neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of G188 (ἀκμήν);
G0206.k: one end… other, tip, top, uttermost participle

G0207.d:
Ἀκύλας, -ου (and -α; MM, VGT, see word), ὁ (Lat.),
Aquila: Act.18:2, 18 18:26, Rom.16:3, 1Co.16:19, 2Ti.4:19.†
(AS)

G0208.d:
ἀκυρόω, -ῶ
(κῦρος, authority), [in LXX: 1Es.6:32 Est.6:1-34, 2Ma.6:1-31 * ;]
to revoke, invalidate (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.15:6, Mrk.7:13, Gal.3:17 (Plut.).†
(AS)
G0208.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2964 (κυρόω);

G0209.d:
ἀκωλύτως
adv. (κωλύω), [in Sm.: Job.34:31 * ;]
without hindrance (so frequently in legal documents; MM, VGT, see word): Act.28:31.†
(AS)
G0209.s: in an unhindered manner, i.e. freely
G0209.o: adverb from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2967 (κωλύω);

G0210.d:
ἀκων (Attic contr. for ἀέκων), -ουα, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἅκων, willing), [in LXX: Job.14:17, 2Ma.11:12 * ;]
unwilling: 1Co.9:17.†
(AS)
G0210.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1635 (ἑκών);

G0211.d:
ἀλάβαστρον, -ου, τό (also -ος, ὁ, ἡ; colloq. and κοινή for ἀλάβαστος),
[in LXX: 4Ki.21:13 (צַלַּחַת)* ;]
a box of alabaster (ἀλαβαστίτης) for ointment: Mat.26:7, Mrk.14:3, Luk.7:37 (see DCG, i, 41b; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0211.s: properly, an "alabaster" box, i.e. (by extension) a perfume vase (of any material)
G0211.o: neuter of (of uncertain derivation), the name of a stone;

G0212.d:
ἀλαζονία(Rec. -εία, the earlier form), -ας, ἡ
(ἀλαζών), [in LXX: Wis.5:8 17:7, 2; 4Ma.5:1-38 * ;]
the character of an ἀλαζών, boastfulness, vainglory, vaunting: Jas.4:16 (Mayor, in l), 1Jn.2:16.†
(AS)

G0213.d:
ἀλαζών, -όνος, ὁ, ἡ
(ἄλη, wandering) [in LXX: Job.28:8 (שַׁחַץ) Hab.2:5 (יָהִיר), Pro.21:24 (לוּץ)* ;]
prop, a vagabond, hence, an impostor, a boaster: Rom.1:30, 2Ti.3:2.†
SYN.: ὐβριστής, ὑπερήφανος (see Tr., Syn., § xxix; Lft., Notes, 256) (AS)

G0214.d:
ἀλαλάζω
(onomat. from the battle-cry ἀλαλά), [in LXX chiefly for רוּעַ hi., יָלַל ;]
prop, to raise a war-cry, shout with triumph or joy; rarely of grief, to wail: Mrk.5:38 (cf. Jer.4:8); of a cymbal, ἀλαλάζον (RV. clanging), 1Co.13:1 (cf. ὀλολύζω).†
(AS)
G0214.s: to vociferate, i.e. (by implication) to wail; figuratively, to clang

G0215.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2980 (λαλέω);

G0216.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2980 (λαλέω);

G0217.d:
ἅλας (T, ἅλα), -ατος, τό, late form of cl. ἅλς, -ος, ὁ (MM, VGT, see word),
[in LXX chiefly for מְלַח ;]
salt, lit, and figuratively: Mat.5:13, Mrk.9:50 Luk.14:34; like cl. ἅλες, wit, of wisdom and grace in speech: Col.4:6.†
(AS)

G0218.d:
ἀλείφω
(cf. λίπος, oil), [in LXX: Gen.31:13, Exo.40:15, Num.3:3 (מָשַׁח), Eze.13:10 ff. (טוּחַ), Rut.3:3, 2Ki.12:20 14:2, 4Ki.4:2, 2Ch.28:15, Mic.6:15, Dan LXX TH Dan.10:3 (סוּךְ), Est.2:12, Jdth.16:8 * ;]
to anoint, festally or in homage: with accusative of thing(s) or of person(s), Mat.6:17, Jhn.12:3, Mrk.16:1; before dative, ἐλαίῳ, Mrk.6:13, Jas.5:14; μύρῳ, Luk.7:38, 46, Jhn.11:2.†
SYN.: χρίω, μυρίζω (against the distinction made bet. ἀ. and χ. in Tr., Syn., § 38, see MM, VGT, see word, ἀ.) (AS)
G0218.o: from G1 (Α) (as particle of union) and the base of G3045 (λιπαρός);

G0219.d:
ἀλεκτοροφωνία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀλέκτωρ, φωνή),
cock-crowing, i.e. the third watch in the night: Mrk.13:35.†
(AS)

G0220.d:
ἀλέκτωρ, -ορος, ὁ
(poët. form of ἀλεκτρυών; see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Pro.30:31) (זַרְזִיר; BDB, Lex., 267)* ;]
a cock: Mat.26:34, Mrk.14:30, 68 14:72 Luk.22:34, 60-61, Jhn.13:38 18:27.†
(AS)

G0221.s: an Alexandreian or inhabitant of Alexandria

G0223G.d:
Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ,
Alexander
__1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21
__2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Act.4:6.

__4. A coppersmith: 1Ti.1:20.

G0223G.o: from the same as (the first part of) G220 (ἀλέκτωρ) and G435 (ἀνήρ);

G0223H.d:
Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ,
Alexander
__1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21
__2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Act.4:6.
__3. A certain Jew: Act.19:33.
__4. A coppersmith: 1Ti.1:20.

G0223H.s: man-defender; Alexander, the name of three Israelites and one other man
G0223H.o: from the same as (the first part of) G220 (ἀλέκτωρ) and G435 (ἀνήρ);

G0223I.d:
Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ,
Alexander
__1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21
__2. A kinsman of the High Priest: Act.4:6.

Ἀλέξανδρος, -ου, ὁ,
Alexander
__1. Son of Simon of Cyrene: Mrk.15:21

__3. A certain Jew: Act.19:33.
__4. A coppersmith: 1Ti.1:20.

G0223J.o: from the same as (the first part of) G220 (ἀλέκτωρ) and G435 (ἀνήρ);

G0224.d:
ἄλευρον, -ου, τό
(ἀλεύω, to grind), [in LXX for קֶמַח, Num.5:15, al. ;]
real: Mat.13:33, Luk.13:21.†
(AS)

G0225.d:
ἀλήθεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἀληθής), [in LXX chiefly for אֱמֶת (on which, see Cremer, 627f.), אֱמוּנָה ;]
truth (see DB, iv, 818f.).
__1. Objectively, "the reality lying at the basis of an appearance; the manifested, veritable essence of a matter" (Cremer, 86): Rom.9:1, al.; of religious truth, Rom.1:25, al.; esp. of Christian doctrine, Gal.2:5, al.; ἀ. θεοῦ, Rom.15:8.
__2. Subjectively, truthfulness, truth, not merely verbal (cl.), but sincerity and integrity of character: Jhn.8:44, 3Jo.3.
__3. In phrases (MM, VGT, see word): ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας, Mrk.12:14, al.; ἀ. λέγειν (εἰπεῖν, λαλεῖν), Rom.9:1, 2Co.12:6, Eph.4:25, al.; ἀ. ποιεῖν,…

G0226.d:
ἀληθεύω
(ἀληθής), [in LXX: Gen.20:16 (יָכַח) Gen.42:16 (אֶמֶת), Pro.21:3 (מִשְׁפָּט), Isa.44:26 (שָׁלַם), Sir.34:4 * ;]
to speak the truth (R, mg., deal truly; Field, Notes, 192): Gal.4:16, Eph.4:15.†
(AS)
G0226.s: to be true (in doctrine and profession)

G0227.d:
ἀληθής, -ές
(λήθω = λανθάνω, hence primarily, unconcealed, manifest; hence, actual, real), [in LXX for אֶמֶת, etc. ;]
__(a) of things, true, conforming to reality: Jhn.4:18 5:31-32 6:55 (= ἀληθινός, which see) Jhn.8:13-14, 17 10:41 19:35 21:24, Act.12:9, Php.4:8, Tit.1:13, 1Pe.5:12, 2Pe.2:22, 1Jn.2:6, 3Jn.12;
__(b) of persons, truthful: Mat.22:16, Mrk.12:14, Jhn.3:33 7:18 8:26, Rom.3:4, 2Co.6:8.†
SYN.: ἀληθινός, real, genuine, ideal, as opposite to spurious or imperfect ἀληθής, true to fact, as opposite to false, lying, denotes the actuality of a thing: ἀληθινός, its relation to the corresponding con­ception. (Cf. Tr., Syn., § viii;…
G0227.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2990 (λανθάνω);

G0228.d:
ἀληθινός, -ή, -όν
(ἀληθής), [in LXX for אֶמֶת ;]
true, in the sense of real, ideal, genuine: Luk.16:11 Jhn.1:9 4:23, 37 6:32 7:28 8:16 15:1 17:3 19:35, 1Th.1:9, Heb.8:2 9:24 10:22, 1Jn.2:8 Jn 5:20, Rev.3:7, 14 6:10 15:3 16:7 19:2; = ἀληθής, Rev.19:9 21:5 22:6 (MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: ἀληθής, q.v (AS)

G0229.d:
ἀλήθω
(κοινή form of the Attic ἀλέω), [in LXX for טָחַן ;]
to grind: Mat.24:41, Luk.17:35.†
(AS)

G0230.d:
ἀληθῶς
adv. (ἀληθής). [in LXX (Jer.28:6, Psa.58:1, al.) chiefly for אָמֵן and cogn. forms ;]
truly, surely: Mat.14:33 26:73 Mrk.14:70 15:39, Luk.9:27 12:44 21:3, Jhn.1:48 4:42 6:14 7:26, 40 8:31 17:8 Act.12:11, 1Th.2:13, 1Jn.2:5.†
(AS)
G0230.k: indeed, surely, of a surety, truly, of a (in) truth, verily, very

G0231.d:
ἁλεεύς (Rec. ἁλιεύς, the older form; WH, App., 151, -έως, ὁ
(ἅλς, the sea) [in LXX for דָּג, דַּוָּג ;]
a fisherman: Mat.4:18, 19, Mrk.1:16, 17, Luk.5:2
(AS)
G0231.s: a sailor (as engaged on the salt water), i.e. (by implication) a fisher

G0232.d:
ἁλιεύω
(ἁλιεύς), [in LXX: Jer.16:16 (דִּיג)* ;]
to fish: Jhn.21:3 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0232.s: to be a fisher, i.e. (by implication) to fish

G0233.d:
ἁλίζω
(ἅλς), [in LXX for מָלַח ;]
to salt, season with salt: Mat.5:13, Mrk.9:49.†
(AS)

G0235.d:
ἀλλά (ἀλλ᾽ usually bef. α and υ, often bef. ε and η, rarely bef. ο and ω, never bef. ι; Tdf., Pr., 93 f.; WH, App., 146),
adversative particle,
stronger than δέ; prop. neuter pl. of ἄλλος, used adverbially, with changed accent; hence prop. otherwise, on the other hand (cf. Rom.3:31);
__1. opposing a previous negation, but: οὐ (μὴ) . . . ἀ., Mat.5:15, 17 Mrk.5:39, Jhn.7:16, al.; rhetorically subordinating but not entirely negativing what precedes, οὐ . . . ἀ., not so much . . . as, Mrk.9:37, Mat.10:20, Jhn.12:44, al.; with ellipse of the negation, Mat.11:7-9, Act.19:2, 1Co.3:6 6:11 7:7, 2Co.7:1, Gal.2:3, al.; in opposition…
G0235.s: properly, other things, i.e. (adverbially) contrariwise (in many relations)
G0235.k: and, but (even), howbeit, indeed, nay, nevertheless, no, notwithstanding, save, therefore, yea, yet

G0236.d:
ἀλλάσσω
(ἄλλος), [in LXX chiefly for חָלַף, מוּר hi., etc. ;]
__1. to change: Act.6:14, Gal.4:20.
__2. to transform: 1Co.15:51-52, Heb.1:12.
__3. to exchange: with accusative, before ἐν (= בְּ, Psa.106:20) instead of simple genitive (Bl., § 36, 8), Rom.1:23
(cf. ἀπ-, δι-, κατ-, ἀπο-κατ-, μετ-, συν-αλλάσσω; see MM, VGT, see word).† (AS)

G0237.d:
ἀλλαχόθεν
adv. (ἀλλος), [in LXX: 4Ma.1:7 * ;] = ἀλλοθεν (seeMM, VGT, see word)
from another place: Jhn.10:1.†
(AS)

G0238.k: be an allegory (the Greek word itself)

G0239.d:
ἁλληλουιά
(Rec. ἀλληλούϊα; Heb. הָלַל יָהּ, praise the Lord), [in LXX in the titles of certain Psa (104 (105), al.), and at the end of Psa.150:1-6; also Tob.13:18, 3Ma.7:13 ;]
hallelujah, alleluia: Rev.19:1, 3-4 19:6.†
(AS)
G0239.s: praise ye Jah!, an adoring exclamation
G0239.o: of Hebrew origin (imperative of H01984 and H03050);

G0240.d:
ἀλλήλων (genitive pl.), dative -οις, -αις, accusative -ους, -ας, -α (no nom.), recipr. pron.
(ἄλλος),
of one another, mutually: Mat.25:32, Mrk.4:41, Jhn.13:22, al.
(AS)
G0240.k: each other, mutual, one another, (the other), (them-, your-)selves, (selves) together (sometimes with G3326 (μετά) or G4314 (πρός))

G0241.d:
ἀλλογενής, -ές
(ἄλλος, γένος), [in LXX chiefly for זוּר, נֵכָר ;]
of another race, a foreigner ( = ἀλλόφυλος; Cremer, 150; MM, VGT, see word): Luk.17:18.†
(AS)

G0242.d:
ἅλλομαι
[in LXX for צָלַח, דָּלַג pi., etc. ;]
to leap: Act.3:8 14:10; of water, to spring up, Jhn.4:14 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0242.o: middle voice of apparently a primary verb;

G0243.d:
ἄλλος, -η, -ο, (cf. Lat. alius, Eng. else),
[in LXX for אַחֵר ,אֶחָד, etc. ;]
other, another: absol., Mat.20:3, al.; ἄ. δέ, 1Co.3:10 12:8; pl., Mrk.6:15; attached to a noun, Mat.2:12 4:21, al.; with art., ὁ ἄ., the other, Mat.5:39, Jhn.19:32 (Bl., §47, 8); οἱ ἄ., the others, the rest, Jhn.20:25, 1Co.14:29; ἄ. πρὸς ἄλλον = πρὸς ἀλλήλους (BL, §48, 10), Act.2:12; ἄλλ᾽ (i.e. ἄλλο) ἤ (Bl., §77, 13), Luk.12:51; before πλήν, Mrk.12:32; εἰ μή, Jhn.6:22; παρά with accusative, 1Co.3:11.
SYN.: ἕτερος, which see ἄ. denotes numerical, ἕ. qualitative difference (Cremer, 89). ἄ. generally "denotes simply distinction of individuals, ἕ. involves the…

G0244.d:
ἀλλοτρι-επίσκοπος (Rec. ἀλλοτριοεπ-), -ου, ὁ
one who meddles in things alien to his calling: 1Pe.4:15 (see ICC, in l; Deiss., BS, 224-4; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0244.s: overseeing others' affairs, i.e. a meddler (specially, in Gentile customs)

G0245.d:
ἀλλότριος, -α, -ον
(ἄλλος), [in LXX for זוּר, נֵכָר, אַחֵר ;]
__1. be-longing to another, not one's own (opposite to ἴδιος): Luk.16:12, Rom.14:4 15:20 (Field, Notes, 165 f.), 2Co.10:15-16, 1Ti.5:22, Heb.9:25.
__2. foreign, strange, alien (opposite to οἰκεῖος; see MM, VGT, see word): Mat.17:25-26, Jhn.10:5, Act.7:6, Heb.11:9, 34.†
(AS)
G0245.s: another's, i.e. not one's own; by extension foreign, not akin, hostile

G0246.d:
ἀλλόφυλος, -ον
(ἄλλος, φῦλον, a tribe), [in LXX chiefly for פְּלֶשֶׁת ;]
foreign, of another race (MM, VGT, see word); as opposite to a Jew, a Gentile: Act.10:28.†
(AS)

G0248.d:
ἀλοάω, -ῶ
(ἅλως, see: ἅλων; and cf. MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX chiefly for דּוּשׁ ;]
to thresh: 1Co.9:9 9:13; 1Ti.5:18.†
(AS)

G0249.d:
ἄ-λογος, -ον
[in LXX: Exo.6:12 (שָׂפָה עָרֵל), Num.6:12 (נָפַל), Job.11:12, Wis.11:15-16, 4Ma.3:1-21 * ;]
__1. without reason, irrational: ζῷα, 2Pe.2:12, Ju 10.
__2. contrary to reason: Act.25:27 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0249.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3056 (λόγος);

G0250.d:
ἀλόη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Sng.4:14 א (אֲהָלִים)* ;]
the aloe, aloes (the powder of a fragrant wood): Jhn.19:39.†
(AS)

G0251.d:
ἅλς, ἁλός, ὁ
variant for ἅλας (which see): Mrk.9:49, Rec. WH, mg., R, mg.†
(AS)

G0253.o: comparative of a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3077 (λύπη);

G0254.d:
ἅλυσις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: Wis.17:17 * ;]
a chain, bond: Mrk.5:3-4, Luk.8:29, Act.12:6-7 21:33 28:20, Eph.6:20, 2Ti.1:16, Rev.20:1.†
(AS)

G0255.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the base of G3081 (λυσιτελεῖ);

G0257.d:
ἅλων, -ωνος
(for Attic ἅλως, -ω, see MM, VGT, see word), ἡ, [in LXX chiefly for גֹּרֶן ;]
a threshing floor: Mat.3:12, Luk.3:17 (here prob. by meton. = the grain on the threshing floor).†
(AS)
G0257.s: a threshing-floor (as rolled hard), i.e. (figuratively) the grain (and chaff, as just threshed)
G0257.o: probably from the base of G1507 (εἱλίσσω);

G0258.d:
ἀλώπηξ, -εκος, ἡ
[in LXX for שׁוּעָל ;]
a fox: Mat.8:20, Luk.9:58; metaphorically, of Herod, Luk.13:32.†
(AS)
G0258.s: a fox, i.e. (figuratively) a cunning person

G0259.d:
ἅλωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἁλίσκομαι), [in LXX: Jer.50:46 (תָּפַשׂ ni.)* ;]
a taking, capture: 2Pe.2:12.†
(AS)
G0259.o: from a collateral form of G138 (αἱρέομαι);

G0260.d:
ἅμα
adv.,
at once (Lat. simul): Act.24:26 27:40, Rom.3:12 (one and all = יַחַד, Psa.14:3), Col.4:3, 1Ti.5:13, Phm 22; before σύν, 1Th.4:17 5:10; as prep. with dative, together with: Mat.13:29 (see MM, VGT, see word); also, with adv., ἅ. πρωΐ (cl., ἅ. ἕω, etc.), early in the morning: Mat.20:1.†
(AS)
G0260.s: properly, at the "same" time, but freely used as a preposition or adverb denoting close association

G0261.d:
ἀμαθής, -ές
(μανθάνω), [in Sm.: Psa.49:11 * ;]
unlearned, ignorant: 2Pe.3:16 (on the rareness of this word, see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0261.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3129 (μανθάνω);

G0263.d:
ἀμάραντος, -ον
(μαραίνομαι), [in LXX: Wis.6:12 (σοφία)* ;]
un­fading (whence ὁ ἀ., the amaranth, an unfading flower): 1Pe.1:4 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0263.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3133 (μαραίνω);

G0264.d:
ἁμαρτάνω
(present formed from aor. ἁμαρτεῖν), [in LXX for חָטָא, also for אָשַׁם, רָשַׁע, etc. ;]
__1. to miss the mark (Hom., Æsch., al.), hence metaphorically (Hom., al.), to err, do wrong
__2. In LXX and NT, to violate God's law, to sin (for non-Christian exx., see MM, VGT, see word): absol., Mat.18:25 27:4, Luk.17:3, Jhn.5:14 8:11 9:2-3 Rom.2:12 3:23 5:12, 14 5:16 6:15, 1Co.7:28 7:36 15:34, Eph.4:26, 1Ti.5:20, Tit.3:11, Heb.3:17 10:26, 1Pe.2:20, 2Pe.2:4 2:4 1Jn.1:10 Jn 2:1 Jn 3:6-9 Jn 5:18; with cogn. accusative, ἁ. ἁμαρτίαν (cf. Exo.32:30, חֲטָאָה חָטָא), 1Jn.5:16; before εἰς, Mat.18:21, Luk.15:18, 21 17:4, Act.25:8 (καίσαρα). 1Co.6:18 8:12 (Field,…
G0264.s: properly, to miss the mark (and so not share in the prize), i.e. (figuratively) to err, especially (morally) to sin
G0264.o: perhaps from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the base of G3313 (μέρος);
G0264.k: for your faults, offend, sin, trespass

G0265.d:
ἁμάρτημα, -τος, τό
(ἁμαρτεῖν, see supr.), [in LXX for חַטָּאָה, עָוֺן etc. ;]
an act of disobedience to divine law (Lft., Notes, 273), a sinful deed, a sin: Mrk.3:28-29, Rom.3:25, 1Co.6:18, 2Pe.1:9, WH, mg.; αἰώνιωv ἀ. (DCG, i, 788a), Mrk.3:29 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: ἀγνόημα, ἁμαρτία, ἀνομία, ἀσέβεια, ἥττημα, παράβασις, παρακοή, παρανομία, παράπτωμα (ν. Cremer, 100; Tr., Syn., § lxvi; DB, iv, 532; DCG, l.with; Westc, Eph., 165 f.) (AS)

G0266.d:
ἁμαρτία, -ας, ἡ
(ἁμαρτάνω, which see), [in LXX chiefly for חַטָּאת and cogn. forms, also for פֶּשַׁע ,עָוֹן, etc. ;]
prop. a missing the mark; in cl. (see reff. to CR in MM, VGT, see word);
__(a) guilt, sin (Plat., Arist., al.);
__(b) more freq., from Æsch. down, a fault, failure. In NT (as LXX) always in ethical sense;
__1. as a principle and quality of action, = τὸ ἁμαρτάνειν, a sinning, sin: Rom.5:12, 13 20; ὑφ᾽ ἁμαρτίαν εἶναι, Rom.3:9; ἐπιμένειν, Rom.6:1; ἀποθνήσκειν, νεκρὸν εἶναι τῇ ἁ., Rom.6:2, 11; τὴν ἀ. γινώσκειν, Rom.7:7; σῶμα τῆς ἁ., Rom.6:6; ἀπάτη τῆς ἁ., Heb.3:13; personified as a ruling principle, ἁ.…

G0267.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a form of G3144 (μάρτυς);

G0268.d:
ἁμαρτωλός, -όν
(ἁμαρτάνω), [in LXX chiefly for רָשָׁע ;]
sinful, a sinner: of all men, 1Ti.1:15; of those especially wicked, 1Ti.1:9, 1Pe.4:18; p1., Mat.9:10-13 11:19 26:45, al. (see MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 102, 634)
(AS)

G0269.d:
ἄμαχος, -ον
(μάχη);
__1. invincible (frequently in cl.).
__2. abstaining from fighting, non-combatant (Xen.). Metaphorical (cf. MM, VGT, see word), not contentious: 1Ti.3:3, Tit.3:2.†
(AS)
G0269.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3163 (μάχη);

G0270.s: properly, to collect, i.e. (by implication) reap

G0271.d:
ἀμέθυστος, -ου, ἡ
(accusative to Plut., ἀ- μεθύω, being regarded as an antidote against drunkenness) [in LXX: Exo.28:19 36:19 39:12 Eze.28:13 * ;]
amethyst, a purple quartz: Rev.21:20.†
(AS)
G0271.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3184 (μεθύω);

G0272.d:
ἀμελέω, -ῶ
(μέλει), [in LXX: Jer.4:17 (מָרָה) Jer.31:32 (בַּעַל), Wis.3:10, 2Ma.4:14 * ;]
__(a) absol., to be careless, not to care: Mat.22:5;
__(b) with genitive, to be careless of, to neglect: 1Ti.4:14, Heb.2:3 8:9 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0272.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3199 (μέλω);
G0272.k: make light of, neglect, be negligent, no regard

G0273.d:
ἄ-μεμπτος, -ον
(μέμφομσι), [in LXX chiefly for תָּם ;]
blameless, free from fault (in π. of a marriage-contract; M, Th., I, 3:13; cf. MM, VGT, see word): Luk.1:6, Php.2:15 3:6, 1Th.3:13 (WH, mg., -ως) Heb.8:7.†
SYN.: ἄμωμος, ἀνέγκλητος, ἀνεπίλημπτος, which see (Tr., Syn., § ciii) (AS)
G0273.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3201 (μέμφομαι);

G0274.d:
ἀ-μέμπτως,
adv. (ἄμεμπτος), [in LXX: Est.3:13 * ;]
blamelessly (Lft., Notes, 28, 89; MM, VGT, see word -ος): 1Th.2:10 3:13 WH mg., 5:23.†
(AS)

G0275.d:
ἀμέριμνος, -ον
(μέριμνα), [in LXX: Wis.6:15 7:23 * ;]
free from anxiety or care: Mat.28:14, 1Co.7:32 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0275.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3308 (μέριμνα);

G0276.d:
ἀ-μετάθετος, -ον
(μετατίθημι), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:1 3Mac 5:12 * ;]
immutable: Heb.6:18; as subat., τὸ ἀ., immutability, Heb.6:17 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0276.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3346 (μετατίθημι);

G0277.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3334 (μετακινέω);

G0278.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3338 (μεταμέλλομαι);
G0278.k: without repentance, not to be repented of

G0279.d:
ἀμετανόητος, -ον
(μετανοέω)
__1. impenitent: Rom.2:5
__2. = ἀμεταμέλητος (π., Philo, al.; see Deiss., BS, 257; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0279.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3340 (μετανοέω);

G0280.d:
ἄμετρος, -ον
(μέτρον),
without measure: adverbially, εἰς τὰ ἄ., excessively, 2Co.10:13 10:15†
(AS)
G0280.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3358 (μέτρον);

G0281.d:
ἀμήν, indecl. (Heb. אָמֵן, verbal adj. fr. אמן, to prop. ni., be firm),
[in LXX: 1Ch.16:36, I Est.9:46, Neh.5:13 8:6, Tob.8:8 14:15, 3Ma.7:23, 4Ma.18:24 (elsewhere ''א is rendered ἀληθινός, Isa.65:16; ἀληθῶς, Je 35 (28):6; γένοιτο, Num.5:22, Deu.27:15ff., 3Ki.1:36, Psa.40 (41):13 71 (72):19 105 (106):48, Jer.11:5)*.]
__1. As adj. (cf. Is, l.with), ὁ ἀ., Rev.3:14.
__2. As adv.,
__(a) in solemn assent to the statements or prayers of another (Nu, Ne, etc., ll. with): ὁ ἀ., 1Co.14:16;
__(b) similarly, at the end of one's own prayer or ascription of praise: Rom.1:25 15:33, Gal.1:5, 1Ti.1:17;
__(with) in the Gospels,…
G0281.s: properly, firm, i.e. (figuratively) trustworthy; adverbially, surely (often as interjection, so be it)

G0282.d:
ἀμήτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ἡ
(μήτηρ), without a mother (frequently in Gk. writers of the gods): ἀπάτωρ ἀ.
of one without recorded genealogy, Heb.7:3 (cf. MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)
G0282.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3384 (μήτηρ);

G0283.d:
ἀ-μίαντος, -ον
(μιαίνω), [in LXX: Wis.3:13 4:2 8:20, 2Ma.14:36 2Mac 15:34 * ;]
undefiled, free from contamination (in π., of αἰθήρ; MM, VGT, see word): Heb.7:26 13:4, 1Pe.1:4, Jas.1:27.†
SYN.: ἄμωμος, ἄσπιλος (Cremer, 784) (AS)
G0283.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3392 (μιαίνω);

G0284.d:
Ἀμιναδάβ, ὁ indecl. (Heb עַמִּינָדָב),
Amminadab: Mat.1:4, Luk.3:33 (WH om.).†
(AS)

G0285.d:
ἄμμος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for חוֹל ;]
sand, sandy ground: Mat.7:26, Rom.9:27, Heb.11:12, Rev.18:1, Rev.20:8.†
(AS)

G0286.d:
ἀμνός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for כֶּבֶשׂ ;]
