a lamb: figuratively, of Christ (DCG, ii, 620b), Jhn.1:29, 36, Act.8:32" (LXX), 1Pe.1:19 (cf. ἀρνίον; Cremer, 102, 635).†
(AS)

G0287.d:
ἀμοιβή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀμείβομαι, to repay); [in Aq., Sm.: Pro.12:14, al. ;]
requital, recompense: 1Ti.5:4 (for illustration from τ.. see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0288.d:
ἄμπελος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX for גֶּפֶן ;]
vine: Mat.26:29, Mrk.14:25, Luk.22:18 Jas.3:12; figuratively, of Christ, Jhn.15:1, 4-5; of his enemies (on the usage here, see MM, VGT, see word): Rev.14:18-19.†
(AS)
G0288.s: a vine (as coiling about a support)
G0288.o: probably from the base of G297 (ἀμφότερος) and that of G257 (ἅλων);

G0289.d:
ἀμπελουργός, -οῦ, ὁ, ἡ
[in LXX for כֹּרֵם ;]
a vine dresser: Luk.13:7.†
(AS)

G0290.d:
ἀμπελών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(ἄμπελος), [in LXX for כֶּרֶם ;]
a vineyard: Mat.20:1 ff. Mat.21:28 ff, Luk.13:6 20:9 ff., 1Co.9:7. Æschin., 49, 13; Diod., al.; see MM, VGT, see word; LS, see word ἀμπελουργεῖον.)
(AS)

G0291.d:
Ἀμπλιᾶτος (T, -ίατος; Rec. Ἀμπλιᾶς; see MM, VGT, 5.see), -ου, ὁ
Ampliatus: Rom.1:6 8:8.†
(AS)

G0292.d:
ἀμύνω
[in LXX (mid.): Jos.10:13 (נָקַם), נָקַם), Psa.118:10-12 מוּל hi.), Isa.59:16 (יָשַׁע hi.), Wis.11:3, al. ;]
to ward off, etc. Mid.
__(a) to defend oneself against;
__(b) to requite;
__(with) = act., to defend, assist (Isa, l.with): with accusative of person(s), Act.7:24 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0292.s: to ward off (for oneself), i.e. protect
G0292.o: middle voice of a primary verb;

G0293.d:
ἀμφίβληστρον, -ου, τό
(ἀμφιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for חֵרֶם ;]
something thrown around, as a garment; spec., a casting-net: Mat.4:18.†
(AS)
G0293.s: a (fishing) net (as thrown about the fish)
G0293.o: from a compound of the base of G297 (ἀμφότερος) and G906 (βάλλω);

G0294.d:
ἀμφιέννυμι
(ἕννυμι, to clothe),
to clothe: Mat.6:30 11:8, Luk.7:25 (cf. ἀμφιάζω).†
(AS)
G0294.o: from the base of G297 (ἀμφότερος) and (to invest);

G0295.d:
Ἀμφίπολις, -εως, ἡ
Amphipolis, in Macedonia, so called because the river Strymon flowed around it: Act.17:1.†
(AS)
G0295.s: a city surrounded by a river; Amphipolis, a place in Macedonia
G0295.o: from the base of G297 (ἀμφότερος) and G4172 (πόλις);

G0296.d:
ἄμφοδον, -ου, το
(ἀμφί ὁδός), [in LXX for אַרְמוֹן (Jer.17:27 30:10 49:27)* ;]
prop., a road around anything (RV, the open street): Mrk.11:4, Act.19:28, WH, mg.†
(AS)
G0296.o: from the base of G297 (ἀμφότερος) and G3598 (ὁδός);

G0297.d:
ἀμφότεροι, -αι, -α
(replaces ἄμφω in κοινή, V. M, Pr., 57; used of more than two, Pr., 80; MM, VGT, see word), both of two: Mat.9:17, al.
(AS)

G0298.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3469 (μωμάομαι);

G0299.d:
ἄ-μωμος, -ον
(μῶμος, which see), [in LXX chiefly for תָּמִים ];
of sacrificial victims, without blemish: of Christ, Heb.9:14, 1Pe.1:19; etbically, unblemished, faultless: Eph.1:4 5:27, Php.2:15, Col.1:22, Ju 24, Rev.14:5 (Cremer, 425, 788; MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: ἀμίαντος, ἄσπιλος (AS)
G0299.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3470 (μῶμος);
G0299.k: without blame (blemish, fault, spot), faultless, unblamable

G0300.d:
Ἀμών, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹן),
Amon, King of Judah: Mat.1:10 (Rec.).†
(AS)

G0301G.d:
Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, Isa.1:1; עָמוֹס, Amo.1:1; אָמוֹן, 4Ki.21:18 ff. B)
__1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: Mat.1:10.
__2. Amos: Luk.3:25.†
(AS)

G0301H.d:
Ἀμώς, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָמוֹץ, Isa.1:1; עָמוֹס, Amo.1:1; אָמוֹן, 4Ki.21:18 ff. B)
__1. as in 2Ki, Lc. B (Α. Ἀμμών; Jos., Ἀμμών, "Αμωσσς), Amon: Mat.1:10.
__2. Amos: Luk.3:25.†
(AS)

G0302.d:
ἄν,
conditional particle,
which cannot usually be separately translated in English, its force depending on the constructions which contain it (see further, LS, see word; WM, §xlii; M, Pr., 165 ff.; MM, VGT, see word).
__1. In apodosis,
__(i) with indic, imperfect or aor., expressing what would be or would have been if (εἰ with impf., aor. or plpf.) some condition were or had been fulfilled: Luk.7:39 17:6, Jhn.5:46, Gal.1:10, Mat.12:7 24:43, 1Co.2:8, Act.18:14, 1Jn.2:19, al. The protasis is sometimes understood (as also in cl.): Mat.25:27, Luk.19:23. In hypothetical sentences, expressing unreality, ἄν (as often in late writers, more rarely in…
G0302.o: a primary particle, denoting a supposition, wish, possibility or uncertainty

G0303.d:
ἀνά
prep. (the rarest in NT; M, Pr., 98; MM, VGT, see word), prop.,
upwards, up, always with accusative
__1. In phrases: ἀ. μέσον, among, between, with genitive, Mat.13:1-58 25:1-46, Mrk.7:31, 1Co.6:5 (M, Pr., 99), Rev.7:17 [so in LXX for בְּתוׄך׃]; ἀ. μέρος, in turn, 1Co.14:27 (both found in Polyb.; cf. MGr. ἀνάμεσα).
__2. Distrib., apiece, by: Mat.20:9-10, Luk.9:3 (WH om.), Luk.9:14 Luk.10:1, Jhn.2:6, Rev.4:8.
__3. Adverbially ("a vulgarism," B1., § 51, 5; cf. Deiss., BS, 139 f.), ἀ. εἷς ἕκαστος, Rev.21:21.
As prefix, ἀ. signifies
__(a) up: ἀναβαίνειν;
__(b) to: ἀναγγέλλειν;
…
G0303.s: properly, up; but (by extension) used (distributively) severally, or (locally) at (etc.)
G0303.k: and, apiece, by, each, every (man), in, through

G0304.d:
ἀνα-βαθμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX for מַעֲלָה: מַעֲלָה: 3Ki.10:19-20, 4Ki.9:13 20:9 ff, 2Ch.9:18-19, Isa.38:8, Eze.40:6, 49; ᾠδὴ τῶν ἀ., tit. Psa.120:1-7 121:1-8 122:1-9 123:1-4 124:1-8 125:1-5 126:1-6 127:1-5 128:1-6 129:1-8 130:1-8 131:1-3 132:1-18 133:1-3 134:1-3)* ;]
__1. a going up, an ascent (Pss, ll. with ?).
__2. a step (LXX); p1., a flight of stairs: Act.21:35, 40. (On the formation -θμός, see MM, VGT, see word)†
(AS)

G0305.d:
ἀναβαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה ;]
to go up, ascend,
__(a) of persons: ἐπί συκομωρέαν, Luk.19:4; εἰς τ. πλοῖον, Mrk.6:51; εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα, Mat.20:17; εἰς τ. ἱερόν, with inf. (M, Pr., 205), Luk.18:10; with mention of place of departure, Mat.3:16 (ἀπό), Act.8:39 (ἐκ);
__(b) of things, to rise, spring up, come up: a fish, Mat.17:27; smoke, Rev.8:4; plants growing, Mat.13:7; metaphorically, of things coming up in one's mind (as Heb. לֵב אֵל עָלָה; 4Ki.12:4, al.), Luk.24:38, 1Co.2:9; of prayers, Act.10:4; messages, Act.21:31 (for late exx., see MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)
G0305.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G939 (βάσις);
G0305.k: arise, ascend (up), climb (go, grow, rise, spring) up, come (up)

G0306.d:
ἀνα-βάλλω
[in LXX: Psa.78:21 89:38 (עָבַר), 1Ki.28:14, Psa.104:2 (עָטָה) ;]
to defer, put off (MM, VGT, see word): mid., Act.24:22.†
(AS)
G0306.o: middle voice from G303 (ἀνά) and G906 (βάλλω);

G0307.d:
ἀνα-βιβάζω
(causal of ἀναβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for רָכַב hi., etc. ;]
to make go up, draw up, as a ship (Xen.): σαγήνην, Mat.13:48 (metaphorically, MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0307.s: to cause to go up, i.e. haul (a net)
G0307.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of the base of G939 (βάσις);

G0308.d:
ἀνα-βλέπω
[in LXX chiefly for נָשָׂא ;]
__1. to look up: Mrk.8:24, al.; before εἰς, Mat.14:19, al. (Xen., Plat.).
__2. to recover sight (Plat., Aristoph.; cf. MM, VGT, see word): Mat.11:5, Jhn.9:11, al
(AS)
G0308.s: to look up; by implication, to recover sight

G0309.d:
ἀνά-βλεψις, -εως, ή
(ἀναβλέπω), [in LXX: Isa.61:1 (פְּקַח־קוֹחַ)* ;]
recovery of sight: Luk.4:18 (Lxx).†
(AS)

G0310.d:
ἀνα-βοάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for צָעַק, זָעַק, קָרָא, etc. ;]
to cry out: Mat.27:46 (WH, ἐβόησεν; see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0311.d:
ἀναβολή, - ῆς, ἡ
(ά αβάλλω), [in LXX for בּנף, etc. ;]
delay: Act.25:17 (for exx. of other meanings, see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0312.d:
ἀν-αγγέλλω
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi ;]
__1. to bring back word, report (Æsch., Thuc., al.): Jhn.5:15 (WH, εἶπεν), Act.14:27 15:4, 2Co.7:7
__2. Later, = ἀπαγγέλλω (MM, VGT, see word), to announce, declare (LXX; Cremer, 24): Mat.28:11 (WH, ἀπ-), Jhn.4:25 16:13-15, Act.19:18 20:20, 27 Rom.15:21, 1Pe.1:12, 1Jn.1:5.†
(AS)
G0312.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);
G0312.k: declare, rehearse, report, show, speak, tell

G0313.d:
ἀνα-γεννάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sir prol.17 א* (ΑΒאc παρα-)* ;]
to beget again: metaphorically, of spiritual birth, 1Pe.1:3 1:23 (cf. Cremer, 147; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0314.d:
ἀνα-γινώσκω
(Attic ἀναγιγν-), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
__1. to know certainly, know again, recognize.
__2. Of written characters, to read: Mat.24:15, Mrk.13:14, Act.15:31 23:34, Eph.3:4; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.22:31, Mrk.12:10 Luk.6:3, Jhn.19:20, Act.8:30, 32, 2Co.1:13, Rev.1:3; with accusative of person(s), Ἠσαίαν τ. προφήτην, Act.8:28, 30; before ἐν, Mat.12:5 21:42, Mrk.12:26 (so. ἐν τ. νόμῳ), Luk.10:26; before ὅτι, Mat.19:4 21:16; τί ἐποίησε, Mat.12:3, Mrk.2:25; pass. 2Co.3:2; of reading aloud (MM, VGT, see word), Luk.4:16, Act.13:27 15:21, 2Co.3:15, Col.4:16, 1Th.5:27 (M, Th., in l).†
(AS)
G0314.s: to know again, i.e. (by extension) to read

G0315.d:
ἀναγκάζω
(ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: Pro.6:7 (שֹׁטֵר), I Est.3:24, 1Ma.2:25, al. ;]
to necessitate, compel by force or persuasion, constrain: with accusative, 2Co.12:11; id. with inf., Mat.14:22, Mrk.6:45, Luk.14:23, Act.26:11 (on the imperfect here, see Field, Notes, 141; M, Pr., 128 f., 247), Gal.2:14 6:12; pass., C. inf., Act.28:19, Gal.2:3 (for exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0316.d:
ἀναγκαῖος, -αῖα, -αῖον
(ἀνάγκη), [in LXX: Est.8:13, Wis.16:3, Sir prol.22, 2Ma.4:23 2Mac 9:21, 4Ma.1:2 * ;]
__1. necessary: Act.13:46, 1Co.12:22, 2Co.9:5, Php.2:25, Tit.3:14, Heb.8:3; comp. -αιότερον, Php.1:24.
__2. Of persons connected by bonds of nature or friendship, near, intimate (Field, Notes, 118; ΜΜ, VGT, see word): ἀ. φίλοι, Act.10:24.†
(AS)

G0317.d:
ἀναγκαστῶς
adv.,
necessarily or by constraint: opposite to ἑκουσίως, 1Pe.5:2 (rare).†
(AS)
G0317.o: adverb from a derivative of G315 (ἀναγκάζω);

G0318.d:
ἀνάγκη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for מָצוֹק, צַר ;]
__1. necessity: ἔχειν ἀ-, with inf., to be compelled, Luk.14:18 23:17 (Rec., R, mg.), 1Co.7:37, Ju 3, Heb.7:27; ἐξ ἀ., κατ᾽ ἀ., of necessity, 2Co.9:7, Heb.7:12, Phm 14; ἀ. μοι ἐπίκειται, n. is laid on me, 1Co.9:16; with inf. (= ἀναγκαῖον ἐστι), Mat.18:7, Rom.13:5, Heb.9:16, 23
__2. force, violence, hence pain, distress (Diod., al.; LXX; see M, Th., 41; MM, VGT, see word; cf. θλίψις): Luk.21:23, 1Co.7:26, 1Th.3:7; pl. (see B1., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), ἐν ἀ., 2Co.6:4 12:10.†
(AS)
G0318.s: constraint (literally or figuratively); by implication, distress
G0318.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη);
G0318.k: distress, must needs, (of) necessity(-sary), needeth, needful

G0319.d:
ἀνα-γνωρίζω
[in LXX: Gen.45:1 (יָדַע hith.)* ;]
to recognize: Act.7:13 (WH, txt., ἐγνωρίσθη).†
(AS)
G0319.o: middle voice from G303 (ἀνά) and G1107 (γνωρίζω);

G0320.d:
ἀνά-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: Neh.8:8 (מִקְרָא), I Est.9:48, Sir prol. 9, 13 * ;]
__1. recognition (Hdt.).
__2. reading (Plat., al.): of the public reading of Scripture (Milligan, NTD, 173, 210 f.): Act.13:15, 2Co.3:14, 1Ti.4:13 (Cremer, 158; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0321.d:
ἀν-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi. ;]
to lead or bring up: before είς, with accusative loc., Mat.4:1, Luk.2:22 4:5 (WH om. είς, κ.τ.λ.), Act.9:39 16:34; of raising the dead (cl.), ἐκ νεκρῶν, Rom.10:7, Heb.13:20; to produce and set before, τ. λαῷ, Act.12:4 (MM, VGT, see word); in sacrificial sense (MM, 1 with), to offer, θυσίαν, Act.7:41. Mid., in nautical sense (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.), to put to sea: Luk.8:22, Act.13:13 16:11 18:21 20:3, 13 21:1-2 27:2, 4 27:12, 21 28:10-11 (cf.ἐπ-ανάγω).†
(AS)
G0321.s: to lead up; by extension to bring out; specially, to sail away
G0321.k: bring (again, forth, up again), depart, launch (forth), lead (up), loose, offer, sail, set forth, take up

G0322.d:
ἀνα-δείκνυμι
[in LXX: Hab.3:2 (יָדַע), Dan LXX 1:11 (מָנָה), Dan.1:20 (מָצָא), 1Esdra.6.2, 3Mac.9 * ;]
__1. to lift up and show, show forth, declare (cf. 2Ma.2:8, see MM, VGT, see word): Act.1:24.
__2. to consecrate, set apart, (Strab., Plut., Anth.): Luk.10:1.†
(AS)
G0322.s: to exhibit, i.e. (by implication) to indicate, appoint

G0323.d:
ἀνά-δειξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναδείκνυμι), [in LXX: Sir.43:6 * ;]
a sheaving forth, announcement: Luk.1:80.†
(AS)

G0324.d:
ἀνα-δέχομαι
[in LXX: 2Ma.6:19 2Mac 8:36 * ;]
__1. to assume, undertake (in π. frequently as legal term: MM, VGT, see word): ἐπαγγελίας, Heb.11:17.
__2. = cl. ὑποδέχομαι, to receive: of guests, Act.28:7.†
(AS)

G0325.d:
ἀνα-δίδωμι
[in LXX: Sir.1:22, 2Ma.13:15 * ;]
__1. to give forth, send up, as of plants (Hdt., al.).
__2. to give up, yield, hand over (MM, VGT, see word): Act.23:33.†
(AS)

G0326.d:
ἀνα-ζάω, -ῶ
[in Al.: Gen.45:27 * ;]
to live again, regain life (cf. cl. ἀναβιόω; Cremer, 722; and for other exx., v MM, VGT, see word): metaphorically of moral revival, Luk.15:24 (WH, mg., ἔζησεν); of sin, Rom.7:9.†
(AS)

G0327.d:
ἀνα-ζητέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Job.3:4 (דָּרַשׁ), Job.10:6 (בָּקַשׁ pi.), 2Ma.13:21 * ;]
to look for or seek carefully ("specially of searching for human beings, with an implication of difficulty": MM, VGT, see word): Luk.2:44-45 Act.11:25.†
(AS)

G0328.d:
ἀνα-ζώννυμι
[in LXX: Jdg.18:16, Pro.31:17 (חָגַר)* ;]
to gird up: figuratively, τ. ὀσφύας τ. διανοίας, 1Pe.1:13.†
(AS)

G0329.d:
ἀνα-ζωπυργέω, -ῶ
(ζωός, πῦρ), [in LXX: 1Ma.13:7 * ;]
to kindle afresh: metaphorically, 2Ti.1:6 (for vernac. exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0329.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and a compound of the base of G2226 (ζῶον) and G4442 (πῦρ);

G0330.d:
ἀνα-θάλλω
(θάλλω, to flourish), [in LXX: Psa.28:7 (עָלַז), Eze.17:24 (פָּרַח hi.), Hos.8:9, Wis.4:4, Sir.5:1-15 * ;]
to revive: Php.4:10 (of MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0331.d:
ἀνάθεμα, -τος, τό
(ἀνατίθημι),
Hellenistic for Attic ἀνάθημα (Bl., § 27, 2);
__1. prop. = τὸ ἀνατιθέμένον, that which is laid by to be kept, a votive offering (as ἀνάθημα in 2Ma.2:13, Luk.21:5—where LT read -θεμα, see M, Pr., 46).
__2. [As equiv. in LXX for חֵרֶם,] devoted, a thing devoted to God (see Driver, De., 98 f., and cf. Lev.27:28-29), hence;
__(a) of the sentence pronounced (Deu.13:15), a curse: Act.23:14;
__(b) of the object on which the curse is laid, accursed (Deu.7:26): Rom.9:3, 1Co.12:3 16:22, Gal.1:8-9 (see ICC on Ro.; Lft., Ga., ll. with; Cremer, 547; Tr., Syn., § v; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0331.s: a (religious) ban or (concretely) excommunicated (thing or person)

G0332.d:
ἀνα-θεματίζω
(ἀνίθεμα), [in LXX chiefly for חָרַם hi. (Num.21:2, 1Ki.15:3, al.), 1Ma.5:5 ;]
to devote to destruction, declare or invoke ana­thema: absol., Mrk.14:71; ἐαντόν, to bind oneself under a curse: Act.23:12, 14 23:21 (cf. καταναθεματίζω, and on the occurrence of the word in π., see Deiss., LAE, 92 f.; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0332.s: to declare or vow under penalty of execration
G0332.k: (bind under a) curse, bind with an oath

G0333.d:
ἀνα-θεωρέω, -ῶ
to observe carefully, consider well: Act.17:23, Heb.13:7 (Diod., al.).†
(AS)
G0333.s: to look again (i.e. attentively) at (literally or figuratively)

G0334.d:
ἀνάθημα, -τος, τό
(cf. ἀνάθημα, and see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX often as seel. for ἀνάθεμα (חָרַם), and in Num.21:3, Jdg.1:17 for חׇרְמָה, but prop. in 3Ma.3:17, al. ;]
a gift set up in a temple, a votive offering: Luk.21:5 (LT, -θεμα).†
(AS)
G0334.o: from G394 (ἀνατίθεμαι) (like G331 (ἀνάθεμα), but in a good sense);

G0335.d:
ἀναιδία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ
(αἰδώς), [in LXX: Sir.25:22 * ;]
shamelessness, importunity: Luk.11:8 (for exx. from π., see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0335.o: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle (compare G427 (ἄνευ))) and G127 (αἰδώς);

G0336.d:
ἀν-αίρεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναιρέω), [in LXX: Num.11:15 (הָרַג), Jdg.15:17 (רָמָה), Jdth.15:4, 2Ma.5:13 * ;]
__1. a taking up or away (Thuc.).
__2. a destroying, slaying, murder (Field, Notes, 116; MM, VGT, see word): Act.8:1.†
(AS)

G0337.d:
ἀν-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for הָרַג hi., מוּת hi., נָכָה hi., etc. ;]
__1. to take up: mid., Act.7:21.
__2. to take away, make an end of, destroy (for late exx. of various senses, see MM, VGT, see word);
__(a) of things (as frequently in cl. of laws, etc.): Heb.10:9;
__(b) of persons, to kill: Mat.2:16, Luk.22:2 23:32, Act.2:23 5:33, 36 7:28 9:23-24, 29 10:39 12:2 13:28 16:27 22:20 23:15, 21 23:27 25:3 26:10, 2Th.2:8, WH, txt., R, txt.†
(AS)
G0337.s: to take up, i.e. adopt; by implication, to take away (violently), i.e. abolish, murder
G0337.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and (the active of) G138 (αἱρέομαι);
G0337.k: put to death, kill, slay, take away, take up

G0338.d:
ἀν-αίτιος, -ον
(αἰτία), [in LXX: Deu.19:10, 13 21:8-9 (נָקִי), Dan LXX TH Sus1:62, always of αἷμα (of. MM, VGT, see word)* ;]
guiltless, innocent: Mat.12:5, 7.†
(AS)
G0338.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G159 (αἴτιος) (in the sense of G156 (αἰτία));

G0339.d:
ἀνα-καθ-ίζω
(see: καθίζω);
__1. trans., to set up.
__2. Intrans., to sit up: Luk.7:15 (WH, mg., ἐκάθισεν), Act.9:40 (frequently in medical writings: MM, VGT, see word).
† (AS)
G0339.s: properly, to set up, i.e. (reflexively) to sit up

G0340.d:
ἀνα-καινίζω
(καινός), [in LXX: 2Ch.15:8, Psa.103:5 104:30, La 5:21 (חָדַשׁ pi., hith)., Psa.39:2 (עָכַר ni.), 1Ma.6:9 * ;]
to renew: Heb.6:6 (Isocr., Plut.).†
(AS)
G0340.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of G2537 (καινός);

G0341.d:
ἀνα-καινόω, -ῶ
= ἀνακαινίζω (cf. MM, VGT, see word),
to make new: 2Co.4:16, Col.3:10 (see Cremer, 323).†
(AS)
G0341.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of G2537 (καινός);

G0342.d:
ἀνακαίνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνακαινόω),
renewal: Rom.12:2, Tit.3:5 (Cremer, 324; MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: παλινγενεσία, in NT, new birth, of which ἀ. is the conse­quent renewal or renovation, in which man as well as God takes part (see Tr., Syn., § xviii) (AS)

G0343.d:
ἀνα-καλύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּלָה ni., pi. ;]
to unveil: metaphorically of removing hindrance to perception of spiritual things, 2Co.3:14 3:18.†
(AS)
G0343.o: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and G2572 (καλύπτω);

G0344.d:
ἀνα-κάμπτω
[in LXX: 1Ch.19:5, Jer.3:1, al. (שׁוּב), Jer.15:5 (סוּר) ;]
__1. trans., to bend or turn back.
__2. Intrans., to return: Mat.2:12, Act.18:21, Heb.11:15; metaphorically (cf. MM, VGT, see word), Luk.10:6.†
(AS)

G0345.d:
ἀνά-κειμαι
[in LXX: I Est.4:10, Tob.9:6 א * ;]
__1. in cl., as pass. of ἀνατίθημ, to be laid up, laid: Mrk.5:40 Rec.
__2. In late writers (cf. MM, VGT, see word) = κεῖσθαι, κατακεῖσθαι, to recline at table: Mat.26:20; part. ἀνακείμενος, Mat.9:10 22:10-11 26:7, Mrk.6:26 14:18 16:14, Luk.22:27, Jhn.6:11 12:2 13:23, 28.†
SYN.: ἀνακλίνω, ἀναπίπτω, the latter denoting an act rather than a state and thus in Jhn.13:25 differing from ἀνάκειμαι (see. Jhn.13:23) by indicating a change of position. (AS)
G0345.s: to recline (as a corpse or at a meal)
G0345.k: guest, lean, lie, sit (down, at meat), at the table

G0346.d:
ἀνα-κεφαλαιόω, ῶ
(see: κεφαλαιόω) [in Th., Al.: Psa.72:20 * ;]
to sum up, gather up, present as a whole: mid., Rom.13:9, Eph.1:10 (on WH. see Lft., Notes, 321 L; AR, in l; Cremer, 354, 748).†
(AS)
G0346.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and G2775 (κεφαλαιόω) (in its original sense);
G0346.k: briefly comprehend, gather together in one

G0347.d:
ἀνα-κλίνω
[in LXX: 3Ma.5:16 * ;]
to lay upon, lean against, hence,
__(a) to lay down: Luk.2:7;
__(b) to make to recline: Mrk.6:39, WH, mg., Luk.12:37. Pass., to lie back, recline: Mat.8:11 14:19, Luk.13:29.†
SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀναπίπτω (AS)

G0348.d:
1. to drive back , (Odyssey by Homer)
2. to beat back an assailant, (Thucydides)
3. to stop:—; Pass. to be stopped, stop short , τινός from a thing, (Lucian) (ML)

G0349.d:
ἀνα-κράζω
[in LXX for קָרָא, etc. ;]
to cry out, shout: Mrk.1:23 6:49, Luk.4:33 8:28 23:18.†
(AS)

G0350.d:
ἀνα-κρίνω
[in LXX: 1Ki.20:12 (חָקַר), Dan LXX Su 1:13, LXX, TH Su 1:48, 51 * ;]
to examine, investigate, question (Lft., Notes, 181 f.): Act.17:11, 1Co.2:14-15 4:3-4 9:3 10:25 10:27 14:24; in forensic sense (MM, VGT, see word; esp. of examination by torture; see Field, Notes, 120 f.), Luk.23:14, Act.4:9 12:19 24:8 28:18.†
SYN.: see: ἐξετάζω (AS)
G0350.s: properly, to scrutinize, i.e. (by implication) investigate, interrogate, determine
G0350.k: ask, question, discern, examine, judge, search

G0351.d:
ἀνά-κρισις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: 3Ma.7:5 * ;]
an examination: spec. of legal preliminary investigation, Act.25:26 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0352.d:
άνα-κύπτω
[in LXX: Job.10:15 (נָשָׂא רֹאשׁ), Dan LXX, Su 1:35 * ;]
to lift oneself up;
__(a) bodily; Luk.13:11, Jhn.8:7, 10;
__(b) mentally, to be elated: Luk.21:28 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0352.s: to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated
G0352.o: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and G2955 (κύπτω);

G0353.d:
ἀνα-λαμβάνω
[in LXX chiefly for נָשָׂא, also for לָקַח, etc. ;]
__1. to take up, raise: Mrk.16:19, Act.1:2, 11 1:22 10:16, 1Ti.3:16.
__2. to take up, take to oneself: Act.7:43 20:13-14 23:31, Eph.6:13, 16, 2Ti.4:11 (for late exx., v MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0354.d:
ἀνά-λημψις, -εως, ἡ
(κοινή form of ἀνάληψις; see Th., Gr., 108 f.),
a taking up: Luk.9:51 (MM, VGT, see word).†
ἀνά-ληψις, -εως, ἡ, Rec. for ἀνάλημψις, which see
(AS)

G0355.d:
ἀν-αλίσκω
(on the etymology, see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל also for כָּלָה, etc. ;]
__1. to expend.
__2. to consume, destroy: Luk.9:54, Gal.5:15, 2Th.2:8, Rec. WH, mg.†
(AS)
G0355.s: properly, to use up, i.e. destroy
G0355.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and a form of the alternate of G138 (αἱρέομαι);

G0356.d:
ἀναλογία, -ας, ἡ
(λόγος), [in Al.: Lev.27:1-34"18 * ;]
proportion (MM, VGT, see word): Rom.12:6 (cf. Cremer, 397).†
(AS)
G0356.o: from a compound of G303 (ἀνά) and G3056 (λόγος);

G0357.d:
ἀνα-λογίζομαι
[in LXX: Wis.17:13 א, 2Ma.12:43 A, 3Ma.7:7 * ;]
to consider: Heb.12:3 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0358.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G251 (ἅλς);

G0359.d:
ἀνά-λυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναλύω),
a loosing, e.g. of a vessel from its moorings, hence, departure: from life, 2Ti.4:6.†
(AS)

G0360.d:
ἀνα-λύω
[in LXX: I Est.3:3, Tob.2:9, Jdth.13:1, Sir.3:15, Wis.3:1-19 2:1-24,3 Mac.10 * ;]
__1. to unloose.
__2. to unloose for departure, depart (MM, VGT, see word): from life, Php.1:23
__3. to return, Luk.12:36.†
(AS)
G0360.s: to break up, i.e. depart (literally or figuratively)

G0361.d:
ἀναμάρτητος, -ον
(ἁμαρτεῖν), [in LXX: Deu.29:19 (18) 2Ma.8:4 2Mac 12:42 * ;]
__1. without missing, unerring (Xen.).
__2. In moral sense, faultless (Plat.), without sin: Jhn.8:7 (see Cremer, 102, 634; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0361.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G264 (ἁμαρτάνω);

G0362.d:
ἀνα-μένω
[in LXX for קָוָה pi. ;]
to await "one whose coming is expected, perhaps with the added idea of patience and confidence" with accusative, 1Th.1:10 (see M, Th., in l; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0363.d:
ἀνα-μιμνήσκω
[in LXX for זָכַר hi. ;]
to remind, call to one's remembrance: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co.4:17; with inf., 2Ti.1:6. Pass., to remember, call to mind: Mrk.11:21 14:72, 2Co.7:15, Heb.10:32.†
(AS)
G0363.k: call to mind, (bring to , call to, put in), remember(-brance)

G0364.d:
ἀνάμνησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναμιμνήσκω), [in LXX: Psa.38:1-22 70:1-5 title. (זָכַר hi.), Lev.24:7 (אַזְכָּרָה), Num.10:10 (זִכְרוֹן), Wis.16:6 * ;]
remembrance: εἰς τ. ἐμὴν ἀ., Luk.22:19 (WH om.), 1Co.11:24-25; ἀ. ἁμαρτιῶν, Heb.10:3 (see Abbott, Essays, 122 ff.; DCG, ii, 74a).†
SYN.: ὑπόμνησις (see Tr., Syn., § cvii). (AS)

G0365.d:
ἀνα-νεόω, -ῶ
(νέος), [in LXX: Job.33:24, Est.3:13, 1; Ezr.3.1-13, 4Ma.8:1-29 * ;]
to renew: pass., Eph.4:23 (see Cremer, 428; MM, VGT, see word)†
(AS)
G0365.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of G3501 (νέος);

G0366.s: to become sober again, i.e. (figuratively) regain (one's) senses

G0367G.d:
Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה),
Ananias;
__1. of Jerusalem: Act.5:1, 3 5:5.
__2. Of Damascus: Act.9:10-13, 17 22:12.
__3. High Priest: Act.23:2 24:1.†
(AS)
G0367G.s: Ananias, the name of three Israelites

G0367H.d:
Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה),
Ananias;
__1. of Jerusalem: Act.5:1, 3 5:5.
__2. Of Damascus: Act.9:10-13, 17 22:12.
__3. High Priest: Act.23:2 24:1.†
(AS)
G0367H.s: Ananias, the name of three Israelites

G0367I.d:
Ἀνανίας (WH, Ἁναν-), -α, ὁ (Heb. חֲנַנְיָה),
Ananias;
__1. of Jerusalem: Act.5:1, 3 5:5.
__2. Of Damascus: Act.9:10-13, 17 22:12.
__3. High Priest: Act.23:2 24:1.†
(AS)
G0367I.s: Ananias, the name of three Israelites

G0368.d:
ἀν-αντί-ρητος
(Τ, -ρρητος, -ον (ῥητός, spoken), [in Sm.: Job.11:2 33:13 * ;]
not to be contradicted, undeniable: Act.19:36 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0368.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G4483 (ῥέω);

G0370.d:
ἀν-άξιος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἄξιος), [in LXX: Jer.15:19 א2 (זָלַל), Est.8:13, Sir.25:8 * ;]
unworthy: with genitive, 1Co.6:2 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0370.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G514 (ἄξιος);

G0371.d:
ἀναξίως
(see supr.), adv., [in LXX: 2Ma.14:42 * ;]
in an unworthy manner: 1Co.11:27.†
(AS)

G0372.d:
ἀνά-παυσις, -εως, ή
(ἀνάπαύω) [in LXX chiefly for נוּחַ and its derivatives, שַׁבָּת and its cognates (Ex, Le) ;]
cessation, rest, refreshment: Mat.11:26 12:43, Luk.11:24, Rev.4:8 14:11.†
SYN.: ἄνεσις (lit, the relaxation of the strings of a lyre), prop. signifies the rest or ease which comes from the relaxation of unfavour­able conditions, as, e.g. affliction: ἀνάπ., the rest which comes from the temporary cessation of labour (see Tr., Stn., § xl; Cremer, 827; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)

G0373.d:
ἀνα-παύω,
[in LXX for fourteen different words, chiefly נוּחַ, also רָבַץ, שָׁאַן, etc. ;]
to give intermission from labour, to give rest, refresh: Mat.11:28, 1Co.16:18, Phm 20; pass., Phm 7, 2Co.7:13. Mid., to take rest, enjoy rest: Mat.26:45, Mrk.6:31 14:41, Luk.12:19, Rev.6:11 14:13; as in Heb. ofIs 11:2 (עַל נוּחַ), τὸ πνεῦμα ἐφ᾽ ὑᾶμς ἀ., 1Pe.4:14. (In π. this word is used as a technical agricultural term; see MM, VGT, see word; and cf. Le 2634 f.; Cremer, 826.)†
(AS)
G0373.s: (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh

G0374.d:
ἀνα-πείθω
[in LXX: Jer.29:8 (נָשָׁא hi.), 1Ma.1:11 * ;]
to per­suade, incite: Act.18:13 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0375.d:
ἀνα-πέμπω
__1. to send up,
__(a) to a higher place (Æsch., Plat., al.);
__(b) to a higher authority (Deiss., BS, 229; MM, VGT, see word; cf. also Field, Notes, 140): Luk.23:7, 15, Act.25:21.
__2. to send back (Pind.): Luk.23:11, Phm 11.†
(AS)

G0376.d:
ἀνά-πηρος (WH, -ειρος; see Field, Notes, 67), -ον (πηρός, maimed)
[in LXX: Tob.14:2 א, 2Ma.8:24 * ;]
maimed, crippled: Luk.14:13, 21.†
(AS)
G0376.o: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of intensity) and (maimed);

G0377.d:
ἀνα-πίπτω
[in LXX: Gen.49:9 (כָּרַע) Tob.2:1 7:8, Jdth.12:10, Sir.25:18 32:2, Da TH Sus 1:37 * ;]
__1. (cl.) to fall back.
__2. In late writers = ἀνα-κλίνομαι, to recline for a repast (MM, VGT, see word): at table, Luk.11:37 14:10 17:7 22:14, Jhn.13:12 21:20; on the ground, Mat.15:35 Mrk.6:40 8:6 Jhn.6:10; to lean back, Jhn.13:25 (T, ἐπιπεσών; see: ἀνάκειμαι, ad fin.).†
SYN.: ἀνάκειμαι (which see), ἀνακλίνομαι (AS)
G0377.s: to fall back, i.e. lie down, lean back

G0378.d:
ἀνα-πληρόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for מָלֵא, Lev.12:6, al.; also שָׁלַם (Gen.15:16, 3Ki.7:51, Isa.60:20), etc. ;]
__1. to fill up, make full (in π. of com­pleting contracts and making up rent; cf. MM, VGT, see word): τόπον, take one's place (cf. Heb. מָקוֹם שָׁלַם), 1Co.14:16; άμαρτίας, complete the number, 1Th.2:16; τ. νόμον, observe perfectly, Gal.6:2; pass., προφητεία, fulfilled, Mat.13:14.
__2. to supply: τό ὑστέρημα, 1Co.16:17, Php.2:30 (Cremer, 838).†
(AS)
G0378.s: to complete; by implication, to occupy, supply; figuratively, to accomplish (by coincidence ot obedience)

G0379.d:
ἀναπολόγητος, -ον
(ἀπολογεόμαι),
without excuse, inexcusable (in Polyb., al., as a forensic term; see Lft., Notes, 252): Rom.1:20 2:1.†
(AS)
G0379.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G626 (ἀπολογέομαι);

G0380.d:
ἀνα-πτύσσω
[in LXX for פָּרַשׂ,etc. ;]
to unroll: τ. βιβλίον, Luk.4:17 (WH, R, ἀνοίξας).†
(AS)
G0380.o: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and G4428 (πτύσσω);

G0381.d:
ἀν-άπτω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא ;]
to kindle: Luk.12:49, Jas.3:5 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0382.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G705 (ἀριθμέω);

G0383.d:
ἀνα-σείω
[in Aq.: 1Ki.26:19, Job.2:3; Aq., Sm.: Isa.36:18 * ;]
__1. to shake out, shake back, move to and fro (Thuc., a1.).
__2. In late writers (Diod., al.; see MM, VGT, see word), to stir up; metaphorically, to excite: τ. ὄχλον, Mrk.15:11; τ. λαόν, Luk.23:5.†
(AS)

G0384.d:
ἀνα-σκευάζω
(σκεῦος, a vessel),
prop, to pack up baggage, hence, to dismantle, ravage, destroy; metaphorically, to unsettle, subvert (MM, VGT, see word): ψυχάς, Act.15:24.†
(AS)
G0384.s: properly, to pack up (baggage), i.e. (by implication, and figuratively) to upset
G0384.o: from G303 (ἀνά) (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of G4632 (σκεῦος);

G0385.d:
ἀνα-σπάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for לָקַח, עָלָה hi. ;]
to draw up: Luk.14:5, Act.11:10 (in π. of pulling up barley; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0386.d:
ἀνά-στασις, -εως, ή
(ἀνίστημι), [in LXX: Zep.3:8 (קוּם), La 3:63 (קִימָה), קִימָה), Psa.66:1-20 title., Dan LXX 11:20, 2Ma.7:14 2Mac 12:43 * ;]
__1. a raising up, awakening, rising (in Inscr. of the erection of a monument, see MM, VGT, see word): Luk.2:34.
__2. a rising from the dead (see DCG, ii, 605b);
__(a) of Christ: Act.1:22 2:31 4:33 Rom.6:5, Php.3:10, 1Pe.3:21; ἐξ ἀ. νεκρῶν, Rom.1:4 (ICC, in l); ἐκ νεκρῶν, 1Pe.1:3;
__(b) of persons in OT hist. (e.g. 3Ki.17:17 ff.): Heb.11:35;
__(with) of the general resurrection: Mat.22:23, 28 22:30 Mrk.12:18, 23 Luk.20:27, 33 20:36, Jhn.11:24, Act.17:18 23:8 24:15,…
G0386.s: a standing up again, i.e. (literally) a resurrection from death (individual, genitive case or by implication, (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth)
G0386.k: raised to life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising again

G0387.d:
ἀνα-στατόω, ῶ
(ἀνάστατος, driven from home; ἀνίστημι), [in LXX: Dan.7:23 (דּוּשׁ;* also in Aq., and in π. (see Deiss., LAE, 80 f.; MM, VGT, see word),]
to stir up, excite, unsettle: with accusative;
__(a) to tumult and sedition: Act.17:6 21:38;
__(b) by false teaching: Gal.5:12 (see Milligan, NTD, 73 f.).†
(AS)
G0387.s: properly, to drive out of home, i.e. (by implication) to disturb (literally or figuratively)
G0387.o: from a derivative of G450 (ἀνίστημι) (in the sense of removal);
G0387.k: trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar

G0388.d:
ἀνα-σταυρόω
__1. to impale (Hdt.).
__2. to raise on a cross, crucify (Polyb., al.).
__3. to crucify again: Heb.6:6 (see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G0389.d:
ἀνα-στενάζω
[in LXX: La 1:4 (אָנַח ni.), Sir.25:17), Da TH Sus 1:22, 2Ma.6:30 * ;]
to sigh deeply: Mrk.8:12.†
(AS)

G0390.d:
ἀνα-στρέφω
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּב ;]
__1. to overturn: Jhn.2:15.
__2. to turn back, return: Act.5:22 15:16.
__3. to turn hither and thither; pass., to turn oneself about, sojourn, dwell: Mat.17:22 Rec.; metaphorically (like Heb. הָלַךְ, in κοινή writers and in π.; see Deiss., LAE, 315; BS, 88, 194; MM, VGT, see word), to conduct oneself, behave, live: 2Co.1:12, Eph.2:3, 1Ti.3:15, Heb.10:33 13:18, 1Pe.1:17, 2Pe.2:18.
† SYN.: περιπατέω (Hellenistic), πολιτεύω (AS)
G0390.s: to overturn; also to return; by implication, to busy oneself, i.e. remain, live
G0390.k: abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used

G0391.d:
ἀνα-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀναστρέφομαι) [in LXX: Tob.4:14, 2Ma.5:8 2Mac 6:23 * ;]
__1. a turning down or back, a wheeling about (Soph., Thuc., al.).
__2. In late writers (Polyb., al.; see: ἀναστρέφω, and cf. Hort on Jas.3:13; MM, VGT, see word), manner of life, behaviour, conduct: Gal.1:13, Eph.4:22, 1Ti.4:12, Heb.13:7, Jas.3:13, 1Pe.1:15 1:18 2:12 3:1-2 3:16, 2Pe.2:7 3:11.†
(AS)

G0392.d:
ἀνα-τάσσομαι
[in LXX only as seel. (Ald.) in Ecc.2:20 ;]
to arrange in order, bring together from memory (Blass., Phil. Gosp., 14 ff.; MM, VGT, see word): Luk.1:1.†
(AS)
G0392.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and the middle voice of G5021 (τάσσω);

G0393.d:
ἀνα-τέλλω
[in LXX for צָמַח, פָּרַח, זָרַח, etc. ;]
__1. trans., to cause to rise: Mat.5:45.
__2. Intrans., to rise: φῶς, Mat.4:16 (= Isa.9:1); ὁ ἥλιος, Mat.13:6, Mrk.4:6 16:2, Jas.1:11; νεφέλη, Luk.12:54; φωσφόρος, 2Pe.1:19; ὁ Κύριος, prob. with ref. to metaphorically of sun or star, Heb.7:14 (cf. ἐξ-ανατέλλω).†
(AS)
G0393.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G5056 (τέλος);
G0393.k: (a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up

G0394.d:
ἀνα-τίθημι
[in LXX chiefly for חָרַם (Cremer, 546) ;]
to lay upon, set up, etc. Mid. -εμαι, in late writers (Plut., al.; see also MM, VGT, see word), to set forth, declare: Act.25:14, Gal.2:2.†
(AS)
G0394.s: to set forth (for oneself), i.e propound
G0394.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and the middle voice of G5087 (τίθημι);

G0395.d:
ἀνατολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀνατέλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְרָח קָדִים ;]
__1. a rising: of light, Luk.1:78.
__2. the sun-rising, the east (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.2:2, 9, Rev.21:13; ἀ. ἡλίου, Rev.7:2 16:12 (WΗ, p1.); pl., Mat.2:1 8:11 24:27, Luk.13:29.†
(AS)
G0395.s: a rising of light, i.e. dawn (figuratively); by implication, the east (also in plural)

G0396.d:
ἀνα-τρέπω
[in LXX for דָּחָה, הָדַף, etc. ;]
to overturn, destroy: Jhn.2:15 WH, txt.; metaphorically, to subvert (MM, VGT, see word): 2Ti.2:18, Tit.1:11.†
(AS)
G0396.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);

G0397.d:
ἀνα-τρέφω
[in LXX: Wis.7:4 B, 4Ma.10:2 4Mac 11:15 א* ;]
to nurse up, nourish, educate, bring up: Luk.4:16, WΗ, mg., Act.7:20-21 22:3.†
(AS)

G0398.d:
ἀνα-φαίνομαι
[in LXX for צָדַק hi., גָּלַשׁ ;]
to bring to light, make to appear: ἀναφάναντες τ. Κύπρον, i.e. having sighted C.: Act.21:3 WH; pass., to appear, be made manifest: Luk.19:11
(AS)
G0398.s: to show, i.e. (reflexively) appear, or (passively) to have pointed out

G0399.d:
ἀνα-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for עָלָה hi., also for קָטַר hi., etc. ;]
__1. to carry or lead up: with accusative of person(s), Mat.17:1, Mrk.9:2; pass., Luk.24:51 (WH, rejects, R, mg. omits); ἀ. τ. ἁμαρτίας ἐπί τ. ξύλον (see Deiss., 135, 88 f.; ICC, in l; MM, VGT, see word): 1Pe.2:24.
__2. In LXX and NT, to bring to the altar, to offer (see Hort on 1Pe, l.with): θυσίας, etc., Heb.7:27 13:15, 1Pe.2:5; ἐπί τ. θυσιαστήριον, Jas.2:21 (see Mayor, in l).
__3. to bear, sustain (cf. Num.14:33, Isa.53:12): Heb.9:28.†
(AS)

G0400.d:
ἀνα-φωνέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for שָׁמַע hi., זָכַר hi. ;]
to cry out, exclaim: Luk.1:42 (Arist., al.).†
(AS)

G0401.d:
ἀνά-χυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀναχέω, to pour out),
a pouring out, overflowing, excess: metaphorically, 1Pe.4:4 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0401.o: from a comparative of G303 (ἀνά) and (to pour);

G0402.d:
ἀνα-χωρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for בָּרַח, נוּם, etc. ;]
__1. to go back.
__2. to withdraw: Mat.9:24; frequently in sense of avoiding danger (MM, VGT, see word), Mat.2:12 (but see Thayer), Mat.2:13-14, 22 4:12 12:15 14:13 15:21 27:5, Mrk.3:7, Jhn.6:15, Act.23:19 26:31.†
(AS)
G0402.k: depart, give place, go (turn) aside, withdraw self

G0403.s: properly, a recovery of breath, i.e. (figuratively) revival

G0404.d:
ἀνα-ψύχω
[in LXX for נָפַשׁ ni., חָיָה, etc. (frequently in sense of revive, refresh oneself) ;]
to refresh: with accusative of person(s), 2Ti.1:16 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 588).†
(AS)
G0404.s: properly, to cool off, i.e. (figuratively) relieve

G0405.d:
ἀνδραποδιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀνδράποδον, a slave, captured in war)
a slave-dealer, kidnapper: 1Ti.1:10 (see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0405.s: an enslaver (as bringing men to his feet)
G0405.o: from a derivative of a compound of G435 (ἀνήρ) and G4228 (πούς);

G0407.d:
ἀνδρίζω
[in LXX for חָזַק אָמַץ (Jos.1:6 ff., 1Ch.22:19, al.; in 2Ki.10:12, Psa.27:14 31:24 combined with κρατιοῦσθαι, as in 1Co, l.with) ;]
to make a man of. Mid., to play the man (cf. MM, VGT, see word): 1Co.16:13.†
(AS)

G0408.s: man of victory; Andronicos, an Israelite

G0409.d:
ἀνδρο-φόνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: 2Ma.9:28 * ;]
a man-slayer: 1Ti.1:9 (cf. φονεύς, and see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0410.d:
ἀν-έγκλητος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἐγκαλέω), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:31 * ;]
not to be called to account, unreprovable: 1Co.1:8, Col.1:22, 1Ti.3:10, Tit.1:6-7.†
SYN.: ἄμεμπτος, ἀνεπίλημπτος (see Tr., Syn., § ciii; Cremer, 742; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
G0410.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1458 (ἐγκαλέω);

G0411.s: not expounded in full, i.e. indescribable
G0411.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1555 (ἐκδιηγέομαι);

G0412.s: not spoken out, i.e. (by implication) unutterable
G0412.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1583 (ἐκλαλέω);

G0413.s: not left out, i.e. (by implication) inexhaustible
G0413.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1587 (ἐκλείπω);

G0414.d:
αν-εκτός, -όν
(also in late Gk. -ή, -όν; ἀνέχομαι),
tolerable: compar., -ότερος, Mat.10:15 11:22, 24, Luk.10:12, 14 †
(AS)
G0414.o: comparative of a derivative of G430 (ἀνέχομαι);

G0415.d:
ἀν-ελεήμων, -ον
(-ἀ, ἐλεήμων), [in LXX for אַכְזָר ;]
without mercy: Rom.1:13.†
(AS)
G0415.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G1655 (ἐλεήμων);

G0416.d:
ἀνεμίζω = Attic ἀνεμόω
(ἄνεμος);
pass.,
to be driven by the wind: Jas.1:6.†
(AS)

G0417.d:
ἄνεμος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for רוּחַ ;]
wind: Mat.11:7 14:24, 30 14:32, Mrk.4:37, 39 4:41 6:48, 51, Luk.7:24 8:23-24, Jhn.6:13, Act.27:7, 14-15, Jas.3:4, Rev.6:13 7:1; pl., Mat.7:25, 27 8:26-27, Luk.8:25, Act.27:4, Ju 12; οἱ τέσσαρες ἄ. τῆς γῆς, Rev.7:1; hence the four quarters of the heavens (see Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, see word), Mat.24:31, Mrk.13:27; metaphorically, of variable teaching, Eph 414.†
SYN.: πνεῦμα, πνοή (and cf. θύελλα, λαῖλαψ). (AS)
G0417.s: wind; (plural) by implication, (the four) quarters (of the earth)

G0418.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as G1735 (ἐνδέχεται);

G0419.d:
ἀνεξεραύνητος
(Rec. -εύνητος, as in Attic; M, Pr., 46), -ον (ερευνάω), [in Sm. (-ευ-): Pr., 25:3 * ;]
unsearchable: Rom.11:33.†
(AS)
G0419.s: not searched out, i.e. (by implication) inscrutable
G0419.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1830 (ἐξερευνάω);

G0420.d:
ἀνεξί-κακος, -ον
(fut., ἀνέξομαι, κακός)
patiently forbearing (cf. ἀνεξικακία, Wis.2:19; and see MM, VGT, see word): 2Ti.2:24.†
(AS)

G0421.d:
ἀνεξιχνίαστος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ἐξιχνιάζω, to track out; ἴχνος) [in LXX: Job.5:9 9:10 34:24 (חֵקֶר אַיִן)* ;]
that cannot be traced out: Rom.11:33, Eph.3:8 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0421.s: not tracked out, i.e. (by implication) untraceable
G0421.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of G2487 (ἴχνος);

G0422.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G153 (αἰσχύνομαι);

G0423.d:
ἀν-επί-λημπτος (Rec. -λμπτος; Bl., § 6, 8), -ον
(ἀ- ἐπιλαμβάνω)
without reproach: 1Ti.3:2 5:7 6:14.†
SYN.: ἀμεμπτος, ἀνέγκλητος. It is stronger than these, for it implies not only that the man is of good report, but that he is deservedly so (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
G0423.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1949 (ἐπιλαμβάνομαι);

G0424.d:
ἀν-έρχομαι
[in LXX: 3Ki.13:12 (הָלַךְ)* ;]
to go up: Jhn.6:3, Gal.1:17-18 (cf. ἐπανέρχ-; and on its use of "going up " to the capital, MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0425.d:
ἄνεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνίημι), [in LXX: 2Es.4.22 (שָׁלוּ), 2Ch.23:15, I Est.4:62, Wis.13:13, Sir.15:20 26:10 * ;]
a loosening, relaxation: Act.24:23 (RV, indulgence; cf. MM, VGT, see word); by St. Paul, opposite to θλίψις, expressed or understood, relief: 2Co.2:12 7:5 8:13, 2Th.1:7.†
SYN.: ἀνάπαυσις (which see).† (AS)

G0426.d:
ἀν-ετάζω
(ἀνά, ἐτάζω, to examine; see MM, VGT, see word), [in LXX: Jdg.6:29 (דָּרַשׁ), Est.2:23 (בָּקַשׁ), Da TH Su 1:14 * ;]
to examine judicially: Act.22:24, 29..†
(AS)

G0427.d:
ἄνευ
prep. with genitive (rarer than χωρίς, which see; cf. Ellic. on Eph.2:12; MM, VGT, 42),
without: Mat.10:29, 1Pe.3:1 4:9.†
(AS)

G0428.d:
ἀν-εύ-θετος, -ον
(see MM, VGT, see word)
not well placed, not fit: Act.27:12.†
(AS)
G0428.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2111 (εὔθετος);

G0429.d:
ἀν-ευρίσκω
(ἀνά, εὑρίσκω), [in LXX: 4Ma.3:14 * ;]
to find out by search, discover (see Field, Notes, 47 f.): Luk.2:16, Act.21:4.†
(AS)

G0430.d:
ἀν-έχω
[in LXX chiefly for אָפַק hithp. ;]
to hold up; in NT always mid., to bear with, endure: in cl. most frequently with accusative, but in NT with genitive of person(s), Mat.17:17, Mrk.9:19, Luk.9:41, 2Co.11:1 11:19, Eph.4:2, Col.3:13; before μικρόν τι, with genitive of person(s) and with genitive of thing(s), 2Co.11:1; with dative of thing(s), 2Th.1:4 (v M, Th., in l); before εἴ τις, 2Co.11:20; absol., 1Co.4:12, 2Co.11:4; to bear with = to listen to, with genitive of person(s), Act.18:14; with genitive of thing(s), 2Ti.4:3, Heb.13:22 (cf. προσανέχω and MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0430.s: to hold oneself up against, i.e. (figuratively) put up with
G0430.o: middle voice from G303 (ἀνά) and G2192 (ἔχω);

G0431.d:
ἀνεψιός, -οῦ, ὁ
(cf. Lat. nepos), [in LXX: Num.36:11 ( בֵּן דּוֹד), Tob.7:2 9:6 א * ;]
a cousin: Col.4:10 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0431.o: from G1 (Α) (as a particle of union) and an obsolete (a brood);

G0432.d: anise, dill , (Aristophanes Comicus); ionic ἄννησον or ἄνησον (Herdotus Historicus); aeolic ἄννητον, or ἄνητον, (Sapho). (ML)

G0433.d:
ἀν-ήκω
(ἀνά, ἥκω), [in LXX: Jos.23:14 (בּוֹא), 1Ki.27:8, Sir. prol.10, 1, 2 Mac6* ;]
prop., to have come up to; in later writers, impers. it is due, it is befitting: in ethical sense (MM, VGT, see word), Eph.5:4, Col.3:18; τὸ ἀνῆκον, Phm 8.†
(AS)
G0433.s: to attain to, i.e. (figuratively) be proper

G0434.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and (lame);

G0435G.d:
ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, frequently אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc. ;]
a man, Lat. vir.
__1. As opposite to a woman, Act.8:12, 1Ti.2:12; as a husband, Mat.1:16, Jhn.4:16, Rom.7:2, Tit.1:6.
__2. As opposite to a boy or infant, 1Co.13:11, Eph.4:13, Jas.3:2.
__3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, Luk.5:8; ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, Act.1:16; and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, Act.22:3; ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35.
__4. In general, a man, a male person: = τις, Luk.8:41, Act.6:11.
SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, which see (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
G0435G.s: a man (properly as an individual male)

G0435H.d:
ἀνήρ, ἀνδρός, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ, frequently אֱנוֹשׁ, also אָדָם, etc. ;]
a man, Lat. vir.
__1. As opposite to a woman, Act.8:12, 1Ti.2:12; as a husband, Mat.1:16, Jhn.4:16, Rom.7:2, Tit.1:6.
__2. As opposite to a boy or infant, 1Co.13:11, Eph.4:13, Jas.3:2.
__3. In appos. with a noun or adj., as ἀ. ἁμαρτωλός, Luk.5:8; ἀ. προφήτης, 24:19; frequently in terms of address, as ἀ. ἀδελφοί, Act.1:16; and esp. with gentilic names, as ἀ. Ἰουδαῖος, Act.22:3; ἀ. Ἐφέσιοι, 19:35.
__4. In general, a man, a male person: = τις, Luk.8:41, Act.6:11.
SYN.: ἄνθρωπος, which see (cf. MM, VGT, see word). (AS)
G0435H.s: a man (properly as an individual male)

G0436.d:
ἀνθ-ίοτημι
(ἀντί, ἵστημι), [in LXX for עָמַד, יָצַב, etc. ;]
__1. in pres., impf., fut. and 1 aor. act., causal, to set against.
__2. In mid, and pass., also pf. and 2 aor. act., to withstand, resist, oppose: with dative, Mat.5:39, Luk.21:15, Act.6:10 13:8, Rom.9:19 13:2, Gal.2:11, Eph.6:13, 2Ti.3:8 4:15, Jas.4:7, 1Pe.5:9.†
(AS)

G0437.d:
ἀνθ-ομολογέομαι, -οῦμαι
(ἀντί, ὁμολογέομαι) [in LXX: Psa.79:13 (יָדָה), Dan LXX 4:34 (שְׁבַח), I Est.8:91, Sir.20:2, 3Ma.6:33 * ;]
__1. to make a mutual agreement (Dem., Polyb.).
__2. to acknowledge fully, confess (Diod., Polyb., cf. 1Esdras, l.with).
__3. C. dative of person(s), to declare one's praises, speak fully in prayer or thanksgiving, give thanks to (cf. Ps, l.with): Luk.2:38 (Cremer, 771; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0437.s: to confess in turn, i.e. respond in praise
G0437.o: from G473 (ἀντί) and the middle voice of G3670 (ὁμολογέω);

G0438.d:
ἄνθος, -εος, τό
[in LXX for צִיץ, etc. ;]
a flower: Jas.1:10-11. 1Pe.1:24" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G0439.d:
ἀνθρακιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(ἄνθραξ), [in LXX: Sir.11:32, 4Ma.9:20 * ;]
a heap of burning coals: Jhn.18:18 21:9.†
(AS)

G0440.d:
ἄνθραξ, -ακος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for גֶּחֶל ;]
coal, charcoal: . ἄ. πυρός, a burning coal, Rom.12:20.†
(AS)

G0441.d:
ἀνθρωπ-άρεσκος, -ον
(ἄνθρωπος, ἄρεσκος, pleasing), [in LXX: Psa.53:5 * ;]
studying to please men: Eph.6:6, Col.3:22 (Cremer, 642; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0442.d:
ἀνθρώπινος, -η, ον
(ἄνθρωπος), [in LXX for אָדָם, אֱנוֹשׁ ;]
human, belonging to man: χεῖρες, Act.17:25; σοφία, 1Co.2:13; φύσις, Jas.3:7; κτίσις, 1Pe.2:13 (MM, VGT, see word); ἀ. ἡμέρα, opposite to ἡ ἡμ. (1Co.3:13, God's Judgment-Day), human judgment, 1Co.4:3 (see Lft., Notes, 198); πειρασμὸς ἀ., temptation such as man can bear (AV, such as is common to man, see Field, Notes, 175), 1Co.10:13; ἀνθρώπινον λέγω, I speak in human fashion, with words not properly weighed, Rom.6:19 (see Field, Notes, 156).†
(AS)
G0442.k: human, common to man, man(-kind), (man-)kind, men's, after the manner of men

G0443.d:
ἀνθρωποκτόνος, -ον
(κτείνω, to kill)
a murderer, manslayer (Eur.; see MM, VGT, see word): Jhn.8:44, 1Jn.3:16.†
SYN.: φονεύς, ἀνδροφόνος (see Tr., Syn, § 83) (AS)

G0444.d:
ἄνθρωπος, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for אִישׁ ,אָדָם, also for אֱנוֹשׁ, etc. ;]
man:
__1. generically, a human being, male or female (Lat. homo): Jhn.16:21; with art., Mat.4:4 12:35, Mrk.2:27, Jhn.2:25, Rom.7:1, al; disting. from God, Mat.19:6, Jhn.10:33, Col.3:23, al.; from animals, etc., Mat.4:19, Luk.5:10, Rev.9:4, al.; implying human frailty and imperfection, 1Co.3:4; σοφία ἀνθρώπων, 1Co.2:5; ἀνθρώπων ἐπιθυμίαι, 1Pe.4:2; κατὰ ἄνθρωπον περιπατεῖν, 1Co.3:3; κατὰ ἄ. λέγειν (λαλεῖν), Rom.3:5, 1Co.9:8; κατὰ ἄ- λέγειν, Gal.3:15 (cf. 1Co.15:32, Gal.1:11); by meton., of man's nature or condition, ὁ ἔσω (ἔξω) ἄ., Rom.7:22, Eph.3:16, 2Co.4:16 (cf. 1Pe.3:4); ὁ…
G0444.s: from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι)); man-faced, i.e. a human being

G0445.d:
ἀνθ-υπατεύω
(see next word),
to be proconsul: Act.18:12 Rec. (see: ἀνθύπατος).†
(AS)

G0446.d:
ἀνθύπατος -ου, ὁ
(ἀντί, ὕπατος, altern. for ὑπέρτατος),
supreme, a consul, one acting in place of a consul, a proconsul, the administrator of a senatorial province (cf. ἡγεμών, and see MM, VGT, 44): Act.13:7-8, 12 18:12 19:38.†
(AS)
G0446.s: instead of the highest officer, i.e. (specially) a Roman proconsul
G0446.o: from G473 (ἀντί) and a superlative of G5228 (ὑπέρ);

G0447.d:
ἀν-ίημι
(ἀνά, ἵημι), [in LXX for רָפָה, נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
__1. to send up, produce, to send back.
__2. to let go, leave without support: Heb.13:5 (cf. Deu.31:6; Hom., Iliad., ii, 71).
__3. to relax, loosen (see Field, Notes, 124 f.): Act.16:26 27:40; hence, metaphorically, to give up, desist from: Eph.6:9.†
(AS)
G0447.s: to let up, i.e. (literally) slacken or (figuratively) desert, desist from

G0448.d:
ἀν-έλεος, -ον (Attic ἀνηλεής, ἀνελεήμων; MM, VGT, see word),
merciless: Jas.2:13.†
(AS)
G0448.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G2436 (ἵλεως);

G0449.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3538 (νίπτω);

G0450.d:
ἀνίστημι (ἀνά, ἵστημι),
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
__1. causal, in fut. and 1 aor. act., with accusative, to raise up: Act.9:41; from death, Jhn.6:39, Act.2:32; to raise up, cause to be born or appear: Mat.22:24, Act.3:22, 26.
__2. Intrans., in mid. and 2 aor act.;
__(a) to rise: from lying, Mrk.1:35; from sitting, Luk.4:16; to leave a place, Mat.9:9; pleonastically, as Heb. קוּם, before verbs of going, Mrk.10:1, al. (see Dalman, Words, 23; M, Pr., 14); of the dead, Mat.17:23, Mrk.8:31; before ἐκ νεκρῶν, Mat.17:9, Mrk.9:9;
__(b) to arise, appear: Act.5:36, Rom.15:12 (cf. ἐπ-, ἐξ- ἀνίστημι, and see Cremer, 306, 738;…
G0450.s: to stand up (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)
G0450.k: arise, lift up, raise up (again), rise (again), stand up(-right)

G0452.d:
Ἄννας, -α (FlJ, Ἄνανος, -ου), ὁ (Heb. חָנַן),
Annas, the high priest: Luk.3:2, Jhn.18:13-24, Act.4:6.†
(AS)

G0453.d:
ἀ-νόητος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., νοητός; νοέω), [in LXX: Pro.17:28 (אֱוִיל), Sir.42:8, al. ;]
__1. not thought on, not understood (Hom., Plat.).
__2. not understanding, foolish (Hdt., al., LXX): Luk.24:25, Rom.1:14, Gal.3:1, 3, 1Ti.6:9, Tit.3:3 (Cremer, 438, 790; MM, VGT, see word).†
SYN.: ἀσύνετος (see Tr., Syn., § LXXv) (AS)
G0453.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3539 (νοιέω);

G0454.d:
ἀνοια, -ας, ἡ
(ἄ-νοος, without understanding), [in LXX: Pro.14:8, 2215 (אִוֶּלֶת), Wis.15:18, al. ;]
folly, foolishness: 2Ti.3:9; expressed in violent rage (cf. Plat., Tim., 86B): Luk.6:11.†
(AS)
G0454.o: from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3563 (νοῦς);

G0455.d:
ἀν-οίγω
(ἀνά, οἴγω = οἴγνυμι) [in LXX chiefly for פָּתַח ;]
to open;
__1. trans., with accusative; a door or gate, Act.5:19 12:14, Rev.4:1; pass., Act.12:10 16:26-27; metaphorically of opportunity or welcome, Act.14:27, Col.4:3, Rev.3:20; pass., 1Co.16:9, 2Co.2:12, Rev.3:8; absol. (sc. θύραν), Act.5:23 12:16; with dative of person(s), Luk.12:36, Jhn.10:3; metaphorically, Mat.7:7-8 25:11, Luk.11:9-10 13:25, Rev.3:7; θησαυρούς (Sir.43:14), Mat.2:11; τ. μνημεῖα, Mat.27:52; τάφος, Rom.3:13; τ. φρέαρ, Rev.9:2; of heaven, Mat.3:16, Luk.3:21, Act.10:11, Rev.11:19 15:5 19:11; σφραγῖδα, Rev.5:9 6:1 ff. Rev.8:1; βιβλίον, βιβλαρίδιον, Luk.4:17, Rev.5:2-5 10:2, 8 20:12; τ.…
G0455.s: to open up (literally or figuratively, in various applications)

G0456.d:
ἀν-οικο-δομέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for בָּנָה, גָּדַר ;]
to build. again, rebuild (MM, VGT, see word): Act.15:16.†
(AS)

G0457.d:
ἄνοιξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀνοίγω),
an opening (in MGr., springtime): ἐν ἀ., as often as I open, Eph.6:19.†
(AS)

G0458.d:
ἀνομία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄνομος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, פֶּשַׁע, תּוֹעֵבַה, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;]
lawlessness, iniquity: Mat.7:23 13:41 23:28 24:12, Rom.6:19, 2Co.6:14, 2Th.2:3 2:7, Tit.2:14, Heb.1:9, 1Jn.3:4; in pl. (as LXX, Psa.31:1, al.; see 131., § 32, 6; Swete, Mk., 153), of acts or manifestations of lawlessness: Rom.4:7 (LXX), Heb.10:17.†
SYN.: see: ἁμάρτημα, ἄνομος (AS)
G0458.s: illegality, i.e. violation of law or (genitive case) wickedness
G0458.k: iniquity, X transgress(-ion of) the law, unrighteousness

G0459.d:
ἄ-νομος, -ον
(ἀ. neg., νόμος), [in LXX for עָוֺן, פָּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;]
__1. lawless, wicked: Mrk.15:28, Luk.22:37, Act.2:23, 1Ti.1:9, 2Pe.2:8; ὁ ἄ., 2Th.2:8 (= ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῆς ἀνομίας, 2Th.2:3).
__2. without law (= οἱ μὴ ὑπὸ νόμον, Rom.2:14): 1Co.9:21 (MM, VGT, see word).
† SYN.: see: ἄθεσμος (AS)
G0459.s: lawless, i.e. (negatively) not subject to (the Jewish) law; (by implication, a Gentile), or (positively) wicked
G0459.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3551 (νόμος);
G0459.k: without law, lawless, transgressor, unlawful, wicked

G0460.d:
ἀνόμως,
adv. [in LXX: 2Mac 817* ;]
__1. lawlessly (2Mac, l.with).
__2. = χωρὶς νόμου, without law: Rom.2:12.†
(AS)
G0460.s: lawlessly, i.e. (specially) not amenable to (the Jewish) law

G0461.d:
ἀν-ορθόω, -ῶ
(ἀνά, ὀρθόω, to set straight, set up), [in LXX chiefly for כּוּן hi. ;]
to set upright or straight again, restore: of persons, Luk.13:13, Heb.12:12; of things, σκηνήν, Act.15:16 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 807).†
(AS)
G0461.o: from G303 (ἀνά) and a derivative of the base of G3717 (ὀρθός);

G0462.d:
ἀν-όσιος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ὅσιος), [in LXX: Eze.22:9 (זִמָּה, Wis.12:4, 2Ma.7:34 2Mac 8:32, 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 5:7, 4Ma.12:11 * ;]
unholy, profane (Cremer, 464): 1Ti.1:9, 2Ti.3:2 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0462.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3741 (ὅσιος);

G0463.d:
ἀνοχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀνέχω, -ομαι), [in LXX: 1Ma.12:25 (RV, respite)* ;]
__1. in cl., a holding back, delaying (MM, VGT, see word).
__2. forbearance, delay of punishment: Rom.2:4 3:26.†
SYN.: μακροθυμία, ὑπομονή. ἀ., forbearance, is the result and expression of μ., which involves the idea of tolerance, long-suffering, as God with sinners. ὑ. expresses patience with respect to things, as μ. with persons; it is active as well as passive, denotes not merely endurance but perseverance (see Tr., Syn., § liii; Lft., Notes, 259, 273; DB, ii, 47). (AS)

G0464.d:
ἀντ-αγωνίζομαι depon.,
[in LXX: 4Ma.17:14 * ;]
to struggle against: before πρός, with accusative, Heb.12:4.†
(AS)

G0465.d:
ἀντ-άλλαγμα, -τος, τό
(ἀντί, ἄλλαγμα; ἀλλάσσω) [in LXX chiefly for מְחִיר ;]
an exchange, the price received as an equivalent for an article of commerce: Mat.16:26, Mrk.8:37 (cf. Sir.26:14; and see Swete, Mk., l.with; Cremer, 90).†
(AS)
G0465.o: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G236 (ἀλλάσσω);

G0466.d:
ἀντ-ανα-πληρόω, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ἀναπληρόω),
to fill up in turn: Col.1:24 (see Lft., in l; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0467.d:
ἀντ-απο-δίδωμι
(ἀντί ἀποδίδωμι), [in LXX for שָׁלַם pi., גָּמַל, שׁוּב hi., etc. ;]
to give back as an equivalent, recompense, requital (the ἀντί ex­pressing the idea of full, complete return; see Lft., Notes, 46);
__(a) in favourable sense: Luk.14:14, Rom.11:35, 1Th.3:9;
__(b) in unfavourable sense: Rom.12:19, 2Th.1:6, Heb.10:30.†
(AS)

G0468.d:
ἀντ-από-δομα, -τος, τό
(ἀνταποδίδωμι) [in LXX chiefly for גְּמוּל ;] ( = cl. -δοσις, which see)
requital;
__(a) in favourable sense: Luk.14:12;
__(b) in unfavourable sense: Rom.11:9.†
(AS)

G0469.d:
ἀντ-από-δοσις, -εως, ἡ
(see supr.), [in LXX chiefly for גְּמוּל, שִׁלּוּם ;]
recompense: Col.3:24 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0470.d:
ἀντ-απο-κρίνομαι
(ἀντί, ἀποκρίνω), [in LXX: Jdg.5:29, Job.16:9 (8) Job.32:12 (עָנָה)* ;]
to answer again, reply against: before πρός, with accusative of thing(s), Luk.14:6; with dative of person(s), Rom.9:20.†
(AS)

G0471.d:
ἀντ-εῖπον
(άντί, εἶτον), [in LXX for H7725 hi., דָבַר pi., עָנָה, etc. ;]
__2 2 aor., without present in use, to speak against, gainsay: Luk.21:15, Act.4:14.†
(AS)

G0472.d:
ἀντ-ὲχω
(ἀντί, ἔχω), [in LXX for חָזַק hi., etc. ;]
__1. trans., to hold against.
__2. Intrans., to withstand. Mid. 1. in cl., to hold out against.
__3. (cf. MM, VGT, see word), to hold firmly to, cleave to: with genitive (see Bl., § 36, 2), Mat.6:24, Luk.16:13, 1Th.5:14 (see M, Th., in l), Tit.1:9.†
(AS)
G0472.s: to hold oneself opposite to, i.e. (by implication) adhere to; by extension to care for
G0472.o: from G473 (ἀντί) and the middle voice of G2192 (ἔχω);

G0473.d:
ἀντί
(the ι is elided only in ἀνθ᾽ ὧν), prep. with genitive (cf. MM, VGT, see word);
__1. prop, in local sense, over against, opposite, hence
__2. instead of, in place of, for (Hom., etc.): Mat.5:38 17:27, Luk.11:11, 1Co.11:15, Heb.12:2; with artic. inf. (cl.), Jas.4:15; of succession, Mat.2:22; χάριν ἀ. χάριτος, Jhn.1:16 (M, Pr., 100); of price in exchange, Heb.12:16; λύτρον ἀ. πολλῶν, Mat.20:28, Mrk.10:45 (M, Pr., 105); of requital, Rom.12:17, 1Th.5:16, 1Pe.3:9 (cf. Wis.11:15); ἀνθ᾽ ὧν, because, Luk.1:20 19:44, Act.12:23, 2Th.2:10 (cl., LXX for אֲשֶׁר תַּחַת); id. therefore (cl., LXX), Luk.12:3; ἀ. τούτου (LXX for כֵּן נַעֲרָה)Eph.5:31. As…
G0473.s: opposite, i.e. instead or because of (rarely in addition to)

G0474.d:
ἀντι-βάλλω
[in LXX: 2Ma.11:13 * ;]
to throw in turn, exchange: metaphorically, λόγους (cf. Lat. conferre sermons; see Field, Notes, 81), Luk.24:17.†
(AS)

G0475.d:
ἀντι-δια-τίθημι
in mid, to place oneself in opposition, oppose: 2Ti.2:25 (EV; but see Field, Notes, 215 f.; cf. MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)
G0475.s: to set oneself opposite, i.e. be disputatious

G0476.d:
ἀντίδικος, -ον
(δίκη), [in LXX for רִיב ;]
as subst., an opponent in a lawsuit, adversary: Mat.5:25, Luk.12:58 18:3, 1Pe.5:8 (Cremer, 696; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0476.s: an opponent (in a lawsuit); specially, Satan (as the arch-enemy)

G0477.o: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G5087 (τίθημι);

G0478.d:
ἀντι-καθ-ίστημι
[in LXX: Deu.31:21 (עָנָה), Jos.5:7, Mic.2:8 (קוּם) * ;]
__1. causal in Pres. imperfect fut. and 1 aor.; to replace, oppose.
__2. Intrans. in pass. and 2 aor. act.;
__(a) to supersede;
__(b) to resist: Heb.12:4.†
(AS)
G0478.s: to set down (troops) against, i.e. withstand

G0480.d:
ἀντί-κειμαι
[in LXX for אָיַב, צוּר, שָׂטַן, etc. ;]
__1. to lie opposite to.
__2. to oppose, withstand, resist: with dative, Luk.13:17 21:15, Gal.5:17, 1Ti.1:10; as participial subst. (ὁ) ἀντικείμενος, 1Co.16:9, Php.1:28, 2Th.2:4, 1Ti.5:14 (Cremer, 746).†
(AS)
G0480.s: to lie opposite, i.e. be adverse (figuratively, repugnant) to

G0481.d:
ἄντικρυς
(Tr. -ύς, Rec. ἀντικρύ), adv. (ἀντί) [in LXX: Neh.12:8 (נֶגֶד), 3Ma.5:16 * ;]
in cl., outright; in κοινή (= cl. καταντικρύ), over against: Act.20:15 (see Bl., § 5, 4; 40, 7; Rutherford, NPhr., 500 f.; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0482.d:
ἀντι-λαμβάνω
[frequently in LXX for חָזַק hi., סָמַךְ, etc ;]
to take instead of or in turn. Mid., with genitive, to take hold of;
__(a) of persons, to help (see MM, VGT, see word): Luk.1:54, Act.20:35;
__(b) of things, to partake of: 1Ti.6:2 (see Field, Notes, 210; Cremer, 386; and cf. συν-αντιλαμβάνω).†
(AS)
G0482.s: to take hold of in turn, i.e. succor; also to participate
G0482.o: from G473 (ἀντί) and the middle voice of G2983 (λαμβάνω);

G0483.d:
ἀντι-λέγω
[in LXX: Hos.4:4 (רִיב hi.), Isa.50:5 (סוּג ni.) Isa.22:22 65:2, Sir.4:25, 3Ma.2:28, 4Ma.4:7 4Mac 8:2 * ;]
cοntradict, oppose, resist (see Field, Notes, 106; MM, VGT, see word); absol.: Act.28:19, Rom.10:21, Tit.1:9 2:9; with dative, Jhn.19:12, Act.13:45; with accusative and inf., Luk.20:27 T; pass., Luk.2:34, Act.28:22.†
(AS)
G0483.k: answer again, contradict, deny, gainsay(-er), speak against

G0484.d:
ἀντί-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις; see MM, VGT see word; M, Pr., 56), -εως, ἡ
(ἀντιλαμβάνομαι) [in LXX for עֹז, זְרוֹעַ, etc., frequently in Psa.2:1-12,3Mac.; frequently also in π. in petitions to the Ptolemies in sense of βοήθεια (see Deiss., LAE, 107; BS, 92, 223) ;]
__1. cl. a laying hold of, an exchange.
__2. Hellenistic (LXX, π.) help: pl. of ministrations of deacons; 1Co.12:28 (DB, ii, 347 f.; Cremer, 386).†
(AS)

G0485.d:
ἀντιλογία, -ας ἡ
(ἀντιλέγω), [in LXX chiefly for רִיב ;]
gain-saying, strife (the latter sense being found in π.; see MM, VGT, see word; cf. Field, Notes, 106): Heb.6:16 7:7 12:3, Ju 11.†
(AS)

G0486.d: to rail at or abuse in turn , (New Testament); Mid., with accusative rei, (Lucian) (ML)

G0487.d:
ἀντί-λυτρον, -ου, τό
[in Al.: Psa.49:9 * ;]
a ransom: 1Ti.2:6 (see CGT, in l; and cf. λύτρον).†
(AS)

G0488.d:
ἀντι-μετρέω, -ῶ
to measure in return: Luk.6:38 (WH, mg., μετρέω).†
(AS)

G0489.d:
ἀντιμισθία, -ας, ἡ
(ἀντίμισθος, for a reward)
a reward, requital: in good sense, 2Co.6:13; in bad sense, Rom.1:27 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0489.o: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G3408 (μισθός);

G0491.d:
Ἀντιοχεύς, -έως, ὁ
a citizen of Antioch, an Antiochian: Act.6:5.†
(AS)
G0491.s: an Antiochian or inhabitant of Antiochia

G0492.d:
ἀντι-παρ-έρχομαι
[in LXX: Wis.16:10 * ;]
to pass by opposite to: Luk.10:31-32 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0492.k: pass by on the other side

G0493.d:
Ἀντίπας (T, Ἀντείπας), -α (in some MSS. it appears to be indecl.; but see M, Pro.12:1-28; it is abbrev. from Ἀντίπατρος), ὁ,
Antipas: Rev.2:13.†
(AS)
G0493.o: contracted for a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and a derivative of G3962 (πατήρ);

G0494.d:
Ἀντιπατρίς, -ίδος, ἡ
Antipatris, bet. Joppa and Caesarea: Act.23:31.†
(AS)

G0495.d:
ἀντί-περα (Rec. ἀντιπέραν, LTr. ἀντιπέρα) adv., = cl. ἀντιπέρας (MM, VGT, 49),
on the opposite side: with genitive, Luk.8:26.†
(AS)

G0496.d:
ἀντι-πίπτω
[in LXX: Exo.26:5 (קָבַל), Exo.26:17 (שׁוּב), Num.27:14 (מְרִיבָה) Job.23:13 (שָׁלַב hi.) * ;]
__1. to fall against or upon (Arist., Polyb.).
__2. to strive against, resist (Arist.): with dative, Act.7:51
(AS)
G0496.o: from G473 (ἀντί) and G4098 (πίπτω) (including its alternate);

G0497.d:
ἀντι-στρατεύομαι
to make war against: with dative, Rom.7:23.†
(AS)

G0498.d:
ἀντι-τάσσω (Att..., -ττω)
[in LXX for לוּץ hi., נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
to range on battle against; mid., to set oneself against, resist: absol., Act.18:6; with dative, Rom.13:2, Jas.4:6 5:6, 1Pe.5:5 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0498.s: to range oneself against, i.e. oppose
G0498.o: from G473 (ἀντί) and the middle voice of G5021 (τάσσω);

G0499.d:
ἀντί-τυπος, -ον
(see: τύπος), [in LXX: Est.3:13 A * ;]
__1. active striking back; metaphorically, resisting, adverse.
__2. Pass. struck back; metaphorically, corres­ponding to (MM, VGT, see word);
__(a) as impression of a seal or copy of an archetype (τύπος) (RV, Like in pattern), Heb.9:24;
__(b) as the reality (of which τύπος is the copy or adumbration) (RV, after a true likeness), 1Pe.3:21 (Cramer, 357).†
(AS)
G0499.o: neuter of a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G5179 (τύπος);

G0500.d:
άντι-χριατος, -ον, ό
Antichrist, "one who assuming the guise of Christ opposes Christ" (Westc., Epp. Jo., 70): 1Jn.2:18 Jn 2:22 Jn 4:3, 1Jn.1:7 pl. 1Jn.2:18 (cf. ψευδόχριστος, and see MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0501.d:
ἀντλέω, -ῶ
(ἄντλος, bilge-water in a hold), [in LXX for שָׁאַב, etc. ;]
__1. prop., to bale out.
__2. Generally, to draw water: absol., Jhn.2:8 4:15; ὕδωρ, Jhn.2:9 4:7 (on its use of the water made wine, see DCG, ii, 815a; MM, VGT, see word; Field, Notes, 84 f.).†
(AS)
G0501.s: to bale up (properly, bilge water), i.e. dip water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.)

G0502.d:
ἄντλημα, -τος, τό
(ἀντλέω),
__(a) prop., what is drawn (Diosc.);
__(b) a vessel to draw with, a bucket (Plut.; see Abbott, Essays, 88): Jhn.4:11.†
(AS)

G0503.d:
ἀντοφθαλμέω, -ῶ
(ἀντί, ὀφθαλμός), [in LXX: Wis.12:14 * ;]
to look in the face, look straight at (Polyb.). Metaphorical, to face, withstand (Wis, l.with, Polyb.): with dative, ἀ. τ. ἀνέμῳ, as nautical term, to beat up against the wind (see DB, ext., 366 f.; MM, VGT, see word): Act.27:15.†
(AS)
G0503.o: from a compound of G473 (ἀντί) and G3788 (ὀφθαλμός);

G0504.d:
ἄνυδρος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ὕδωρ) [in LXX for צִיָּה, יְשִׁימוֹן (γῆ ἄ), etc. ;]
waterless: τόποι, Mat.12:43, Luk.11:24; πηγαί, 2Pe.2:17; νεφέλαι, Ju 12 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0504.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5204 (ὕδωρ);

G0505.d:
ἀν-υπόκριτος, -ον
(ά- neg., ὑποκρίνομαι) [in LXX: Wis.5:18 18:16 * ;]
unfeigned: Rom.12:9, 2Co.6:6, 1Ti.1:5, 2Ti.1:5, Jas.3:17, 1Pe.1:22 (Cremer, 380; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0505.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5271 (ὑποκρίνομαι);

G0506.d:
ἀνυπότακτος, -ον
(ά- neg., ὑποτάσσω) [in Sm.: 1Ki.2:12 10:27 (for LXX, λοιμός, בֵּן בְּלִיַּעַל)* ;]
of things, not subject to rule: Heb.2:8; of persons, unruly: 1Ti.1:9, Tit.1:6, 10 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0506.s: unsubdued, i.e. insubordinate (in fact or temper)
G0506.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5293 (ὑποτάσσω);
G0506.k: disobedient, that is not put under, unruly

G0507.d:
ἄνω
adv (ἀνά),
__(a) up, upwards: Jhn.11:41, Heb.12:15;
__(b) above (opposite to κάτω): Act_2:19; with art. ἡ, Gal.4:26, Php.3:14; τά, Jhn.8:23, Col.3:1-2; ἕως ἄ. (up to the brim), Jhn.2:7 (Cremer, 106; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0508.d:
ἀνάγαιον (Rec. ἀνώγεον; on the form, see Rutherford, NPhr., 357 f.; MM, VGT, see word), -ου, τό
(ἀνά, γῆ),
an upper room: Mrk.14:15, Luk.22:12.†
SYN.: ὑπερῷον (AS)
G0508.s: above the ground, i.e. (properly) the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story

G0509.d:
ἄνωθεν
adv (ἄνω),
__(a) from above: ἀπὸ ἄ., Mat.27:51, Mrk.15:38; ἐκ τῶν ἄ., Jhn.19:28; meaning, from heaven: Jhn.3:31 19:11, Jas.1:17 3:15, 17 .
__(b) from the first, from the beginning: Luk.1:3, Act.26:5; whence
__(with) anew, again: Jhn.3:3, 7, (so most, but see Meyer, in l; cf. Field, Notes, 86 f.); πάλιν ἄ., Gal.4:9 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0509.s: from above; by analogy, from the first; by implication, anew
G0509.k: from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top

G0511.d:
ἀνώτερος, α, -ον
[in LXX: Neh.3:25 (עֶלְיוֹן), Eze.41:7 (מַעַל), Tob.8:3 * ;]
only in neut., as adv. (cf. ἐξώτερος),
__(a) of motion, higher: Luk.14:10;
__(b) of rest, above, before: Heb.10:8.†
(AS)
G0511.s: upper, i.e. (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book

G0512.d:
ἀν-ωφελής, -ές
(ἀ- neg., ὄφελος), [in LXX: Isa.44:10 (יָעַל בִּלְתִּי) Jer.2:8 (יָעַל לֹא), Pro.28:3, Wis.1:11 * ;]
unprofitable: Tit.3:9; neut. as subst., unprofitableness: Heb.7:18.†
(AS)
G0512.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and the base of G5624 (ὠφέλιμος);

G0513.d:
αξίνη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for גַּרְזֶן, קַרְדֹּם ;]
an axe: Mat.3:10, Luk.3:9.†
(AS)

G0514.d:
ἄξιος, -α, -ον
(ἄγω, in sense, to weigh), [in LXX for בֵּן (Deu.25:2), מָלֵא, שָׁוָה; frequently in Wis, 2Mac ;]
__1. Part One
__(a) of weight, worth (often with genitive, cf. Pr 315, 811), before πρός: Rom.8:18 (see Field, Notes, 157);
__(b) befitting, meet: with genitive, Mat.3:8, Luk.3:8 23:41, Act.26:20, 1Co.16:4 (see M, Pr., 216); absol., 2Th.1:3;
__(with) of persons, worthy;
__2. Part Two
__α in good sense: with genitive of thing(s), Mat.10:10, Luk.7:4 10:7, Act.13:46, 1Ti.1:15 4:9 5:18 6:1; with aor. inf. (see M, Pr., 203): Luk.15:19, 21, Act_13:25, Rev.4:11 5:2, 4 5:9, 12; before ἵνα:…
G0514.s: deserving, comparable or suitable (as if drawing praise)

G0515.d:
ἀξιόω, -ῶ
(ἄξιος), [in LXX chiefly for בְּעָא, בָּקַשׁ; frequently in Wis.1:1-16, 2 Mac ;]
__(a) to deem worthy: with accusative and inf. (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. κατ-αξιόω), Luk.7:7; id. and genitive of thing(s), 2Th.1:11; pass. with genitive of thing(s), 1Ti.5:17, Heb.3:3 10:29
__(b) to think fit: with inf. (see M, Pr., 205), Act.15:38 28:22.†
(AS)

G0516.d:
ἀξίως,
adv. [in LXX: Wis.7:15 16:1, Sir.14:11 * ;]
worthily: Rom.16:2, Eph.4:1, Php.1:27; with genitive (frequently in Inscr.; Deiss., BS, 248; MM, VGT, 51), ἀ. τ. Κυρίου, Col.1:10; τ. θεοῦ 1Th.2:12, 3Jn.6.†
(AS)
G0516.k: as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily(-thy)

G0517.d:
ἀόρατος, -ον
(ὁράω), [in LXX: Gen.1:2 (תֹּהוּ), Isa.45:3 (מִסְתָּר), 2Ma.9:5 * ;]
unseen, invisible: Rom.1:20, Col.1:15-16, 1Ti.1:17, Heb.11:27.†
(AS)
G0517.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3707 (ὁρατός);

G0518.d:
ἀπ-αγγέλλω
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַד hi. ;]
of a messenger, speaker, or writer, to report, announce, declare: with accusative of thing(s), Act.4:23, al.; with dative of person(s), Mat.2:8, al.; before ὃτι, Luk.18:37; πῶς, Luk.8:36; περί, Luk.7:18 13:1, Act.28:21, 1Th.1:9; λέγων, Act.22:26; with accusative and inf., Act.12:14; before εἰς, Mrk.5:14, Luk.8:34 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 25)
(AS)
G0518.o: from G575 (ἀπό) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);
G0518.k: bring word (again), declare, report, shew (again), tell

G0519.d:
ἀπ-άγχω
(ἄγχω, to press, strangle), [in LXX: 2Ki.17:23 (חָנַק), Tob.3:10 * ;]
to strangle; mid., to hang oneself (or, to choke; see M, Pr., 155): Mat.27:5.†
(AS)
G0519.s: akin to the base of G43 (ἀγκάλη)); to strangle oneself off (i.e. to death)

G0520.d:
ἀπ-άγω
[in LXX for נָהַג, הָלַךְ hi., etc. ;]
to lead away: Luk.13:15, Act.23:17 24:7 (R, mg.), 1Co.12:2; esp. of leading to trial (so as law term in Attic), prison and death (MM, VGT, see word): Mat.26:57 27:2, 31, Mrk.14:44, 53 15:16, Luk.21:12 22:66 23:26, Act.12:19; of the direction of a way: Mat.7:13-14 (cf. συν-απ-άγω).†
(AS)
G0520.k: bring, carry away, lead (away), put to death, take away

G0521.d:
ἀ-παίδευτος, -ον
(παιδεύω), [in LXX for כְּסִיל, etc., chiefly in Wis. lit. ;]
uninstructed, ignorant: 2Ti.2:23.†
(AS)
G0521.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3811 (παιδεύω);

G0522.d:
ἀπ-αίρω
[in LXX chiefly for נָסַע ;]
to lift off, hence, to take away; pass.: Mat.9:15, Mrk.2:20, Luk.5:35.†
(AS)

G0523.d:
ἀπ-αιτέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Deu.15:2-3, al. (נָגַשׂ), Sir.20:15, Wis.15:8, al. ;]
to ask back, demand back: Luk.6:30 12:20 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0524.d:
ἀπ-αλγέω, -ῶ
__1. prop., to cease to feel pain for (Thuc., ii, 61).
__2. In late Gk.
__(a) to despair (Polyb., i, 35, 5);
__(b) to become callous, reckless (Polyb., xvi, 12, 7; MM, VGT, see word): Eph.4:19.†
(AS)
G0524.s: to grieve out, i.e. become apathetic

G0525.d:
ἀπ-αλλάσσω
[in LXX for סוּר hi., etc. ;]
to remove, release: Heb.2:15; pass., to depart: Act.19:12; in legal sense (MM, VGT, see word), before ἀπό, with genitive of person(s), to be quit of: Luk.12:58 (Cremer, 90, 632).†
(AS)
G0525.s: to change away, i.e. release, (reflexively) remove

G0526.d:
ἀπ-αλλοτριόω, -ῶ
[in LXX for זוּר, H5110 etc. ;]
to alienate, estrange; pass.: Eph.2:12 4:18, Col.1:21 (MM, VGT, see word; Cremer, 95, 633).†
(AS)
G0526.s: to estrange away, i.e. (passively and figuratively) to be non-participant
G0526.o: from G575 (ἀπό) and a derivative of G245 (ἀλλότριος);

G0528.d:
ἀπαντάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for פָּגַע ;]
__1. to go to meet.
__2. to meet; with dative: Mrk.14:13, Luk.17:12 (WH, mg., ὑπ-; in Rec. frequently as see1. for ὑπ-, which see).†
(AS)
G0528.o: from G575 (ἀπό) and a derivative of G473 (ἀντί);

G0529.d:
ἀπάντησις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπαντάω), [in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
usually with seel., ὑπ-; a meeting; εἰς ἀ., with genitive or dative, to meet: Mat.25:6 27:32 (WH, txt., omits), Act.28:15, 1Th.4:17 (see M, Th., in l; M, Pr., 14, 242; MM, VGT, see word; Lft., Notes, 69).†
(AS)

G0530.d:
ἅπαξ
adv., [in LXX for אֶחָד, פַּעַם ;]
__(a) once: 2Co.11:25, Heb_9:26-27; ἔτι ἅ., Heb.12:26-27; ἅ. τ. ἐνιαυτοῦ, Heb.9:7; καί ἅ. κ. δίς, twice: Php.4:16, 1Th.2:18;
__(b) once for all: Heb.6:4 9:28 10:2, 1Pe.3:18, Ju 3 5 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0530.s: one (or a single) time (numerically or conclusively)

G0531.d:
ἀ-παρά-βατος, -ον
(παραβαίνω),
inviolable, and so unchangeable: Heb.7:24 (see Westc., in l; Cremer, 653; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0531.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3845 (παραβαίνω);

G0532.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3903 (παρασκευάζω);

G0533.d:
ἀπ-αρνέομαι (-οῦμαι) depon.,
[in LXX: Isa.31:7 (מָאַס) * ;]
to deny, i.e. to refuse to recognize, to ignore: with accusative, of oneself (DCG, ii, 598 f.), Mat.16:24, Mrk.8:34 (MM, VGT, see word), Luk.9:23 (WH, mg., txt., ἀρν-) of Peter's denials of Christ, Mat.26:34-35, 75, Mrk.14:30-31, 72, Luk.22:34, 61; pass., Luk.12:9 (Cremer, 111).†
(AS)
G0533.s: to deny utterly, i.e. disown, abstain

G0534.d:
ἀπάρτι
(WH, ἀπ᾽ ἄρτι; cl., ἀπαρτί, ν. MM, VGT, see word); adv., [not in LXX, where עַתָּה is rendered by ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ;]
from now, henceforth: Jhn.13:19 14:7, Rev.14:13.†
(AS)

G0535.d:
ἀπαρτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀπαρτίζω, to finish),
completion: Luk.14:28 (cf. MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0536.d:
ἀπ-αρχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἀπάρχομαι, to make a beginning in sacrifice, offer first fruits) [in LXX chiefly for תְּרוּמָה, רֵאשִׁית ;]
__1. the beginning of a sacrifice.
__2. first fruits: τοῦ φυράματος (cf. Num.15:20), Rom.11:16. Metaphorical, ἀ. τοῦ πνεύματος: Rom.8:23; of Christians: Rom.16:5, 1, 1Co.16:15, 2Th.2:13 (WH, mg., R, mg., txt., ἀπ᾽ ἀρχῆς; see Lft., Notes, 119 f.), Jas.1:18, Rev.14:4; of Christ: 1Co.15:20 15:23 (Cremer, 117; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0536.s: a beginning of sacrifice, i.e. the (Jewish) first-fruit (figuratively)
G0536.o: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G756 (ἄρχομαι);

G0537.d:
ἅπας, -ασα, -αν
(strengthened form of πᾶς, see: ἅ-),
all, the whole, altogether: bef. subst. with art., as Luk.3:21; or after, as Mrk.16:15]; absol., in masc., as Luk.5:26; in neut., as Act.2:44; ἅ. οὗτοι, Act.2:7 (LT); ἅ. ὑμεῖς, Gal.3:28 (TTr.). Most frequently in Lk, Ac (see MM, VGT, see word)
(AS)
G0537.o: from G1 (Α) (as a particle of union) and G3956 (πᾶς);

G0538.d:
ἀπατάω, -ῶ
(ἀπάτη), [in LXX for פָּתָה, נָשָׁא hi., etc. ;]
to deceive: with accusative, Jas.1:26; with accusative of person(s), dative of thing(s), Eph.5:6; pass., 1Ti.2:14 (on its infrequency in late writers, see MM, VGT, see word; cf. ἐξαπατάω).†
(AS)

G0539.d:
ἀπάτη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Ecc.9:6 א (no Heb. equiv.), Jdth.9:3, 10 9:13 16:8, 4Ma.18:8 * ;]
deceit, deceitfulness: Col.2:8; τοῦ πλούτου, Mat.13:22, Mrk.4:19 (MM, VGT, see word); τῆς ἀδικίας, 2Th.2:10; τῆς ἁμαρτίας, Heb.3:13; αἱ ἐπιθυμίαι τῆς ἀ., Eph.4:22. pl., ἀπά ται (see M, Th., i.e.; NTD, 75; MM, l.with): 2Pe.2:13 (WH, mg., R., txt., ἐν ἀγάπαις).†
(AS)

G0540.d:
ἀπάτωρ, -ορος, ὁ, ὴ
(ἀ- neg., πατήρ)
__1. fatherless.
__2. without father (MM, VGT, see word), i.e., with no recorded genealogy: Heb.7:3.†
(AS)
G0540.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3962 (πατήρ);

G0541.d:
ἀπ-αύγασμα, -τος, τό
(αὐγή, brightness, whence ἀπαυγάζω, to radiate or reflect) [in LXX: Wis.7:26 * ;]
of light beaming from a luminous body, radiance, effulgence: Heb.1:3.†
(AS)
G0541.o: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G826 (αὐγάζω);

G0542.d:
ἀπ-εῖδον (WH, ἀφ-, ν. Bl., § 4, 3), 2 aor. without present in use (cf. εἶδον), serving as aor. to ἀφοράω, q.v
(AS)
G0542.o: from G575 (ἀπό) and the same as G1492 (εἴδω);

G0543.d:
ἀπείθεια
(WH, -θία, exc. Heb.11:1-40. with), -ας, ἡ (ἀπειθής), [in LXX 4Ma.8:9 4Mac 8:18 4Mac 12:4 * ;]
disobedience (MM, VGT, see word): Rom.11:30, 32, Heb.4:6, 11; υἱοὶ τῆς ἀ. (genitive of definition, see M, Pr., 73 f.), Eph.2:2 5:6, Col.3:6 (T, WH R, mg., omit).†
(AS)

G0544.d:
ἀπειθέω, -ῶ
(ἀπειθής), [in LXX for מָרָה, סָרַר, etc. ;]
as in cl. (MM, VGT, see word); to disobey, be disobedient: absol., Act.14:2 19:9, Rom.10:21 11:31 15:31, Heb.3:18 11:31, 1Pe.3:20; with dative, Jhn.3:36, Rom.2:8 11:30, 1Pe.2:8 3:1 4:17 (Cremer, 475).†
(AS)
G0544.k: not believe, disobedient, obey not, unbelieving

G0545.d:
ἀπειθής, -ές
(πείθομαι), [in LXX for מַרְאָה, מְרִיא, סָרַר ;]
disobedient: absol., Luk.1:17, Tit.1:16 3:3; with dative, Act.26:19, Rom.1:30, 2Ti.3:2.†
(AS)
G0545.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3982 (πείθω);

G0546.d:
ἀπειλέω, -ῶ (ἀπειλή)
[in LXX: Nam.1:4 (גָּעַר), Isa.66:14 (זָעַם), Sir.19:17, al. ;]
to threaten: 1Pe.2:23; mid., Act.4:17 (see MM, VGT, see word, and cf. προσαπειλέω).†
(AS)
G0546.s: to menace; by implication, to forbid

G0547.d:
ἀπειλή, -ῆ, ἡ
[in LXX for גְּעָרָה, etc. ;]
threatening, threat: Act.4:29 9:1, Eph.6:9.†
(AS)

G0548.d:
ἄπ-ειμι
(εἰμί, sum) [in LXX for כָּחַד ni., נָדַח ni. ;]
to be absent: 1Co.5:3, 2Co.10:1 10:11 13:2 13:10 Php.1:27, Col.2:5.†
(AS)

G0550.d:
ἀπ-εῖπον, 2 aor. without present in use
[in LXX for מָאַס, אָמַר, etc. ;]
__1. to tell out.
__2. to forbid (3Ki.11:2).
__3. to renounce: 1 aor. mid. (WH, App., 164; MM, VGT, see word), 2Co.4:2.†
(AS)
G0550.s: to say off for oneself, i.e. disown
G0550.o: reflexive past of a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G2036 (ἔπω);

G0551.d:
απείραστος, -ον
(πειράζω for cl. ἀπείρητος, πειράω),
untempted, untried, without experience: Jas.1:13 (see Hort, in l; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0551.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3987 (πειράω);

G0552.d:
ἄπειρος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., πεῖρα, trial), [in LXX: Num.14:23, Zec.11:15 (אֱוִלִי) Jer.2:6 (עֲרָבָה) * ;]
without experience of: with genitive of thing(s), Heb.5:13 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)
G0552.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3984 (πεῖρα);

G0553.d:
ἀπ-εκ-δέχομαι depon.,
to await or expect eagerly (Lft., Notes, 149; MM, VGT, see word): absol., 1Pe.3:20; C. accusative of thing(s), Rom.8:19, 23 8:25, 1Co.1:7, Gal.5:5; with accusative of person(s), Php.3:20, Heb.9:28.†
(AS)

G0554.d:
ἀπ-εκ-δύω
to strip off clothes or arms; mid., to strip off from oneself: Col.3:9; to strip, despoil (mid, for act., ICC, in l; but cf. Lft., Ellic.), Col.2:15.†
(AS)
G0554.s: to divest wholly oneself, or (for oneself) despoil
G0554.o: middle voice from G575 (ἀπό) and G1562 (ἐκδύω);

G0555.d:
ἀπ-έκ-δυσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἀπεκδύω)
a putting or stripping off: Col.2:11 (MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

G0556.d:
ἀπ-ελαύνω
[in LXX for נָצַל, שָׁלַח ;]
to drive away: Act.18:16 (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0557.d:
ἀπ-ελεγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἀπελέγχω, to convict, refute),
refutation, disrepute: ἐλθεῖν εἰς ἀ., Act.19:27 (not elsewhere; see MM, see word).†
(AS)
G0557.o: from a compound of G575 (ἀπό) and G1651 (ἐλέγχω);

G0558.d:
ἀπ-ελεύθερος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ
a freedman: τ. κυρίου (MM, see word), 1Co.7:22.†
(AS)
G0558.s: one freed away, i.e. a freedman

G0560.d:
ἀπ-ελπίζω
[in LXX: Isa.29:19 (אֶבְיוֹן), Jdth.9:11, Est.4:17, Sir.22:21 27:21, 2Ma.9:18 * ;]
__1. to give up in despair, despair of (Polyb., Diod., LXX).
__2. to hope to receive from or in return (Field, Notes, 59; Cremer, 712; Soph., Lex., see word): with accusative (M; Pr., 65; MM, see word), Luk.6:35.†
(AS)
G0560.s: to hope out, i.e. fully expect

G0561.d:
ἀπ-έναντι
adv. with genitive (Hellenistic, common in LXX);
__1. over against (MM, see word): Mat.27:61, Mrk.12:41, WH, mg.
__2. before, in the presence of: Mat.27:24 (WH, mg.), Act.3:16, Rom.3:18.
__3. against: Act.17:7.†
(AS)
G0561.s: from in front, i.e. opposite, before or against
G0561.k: before, contrary, over against, in the presence of

G0562.d:
ἀπέραντος, -ον
(περαίνω, to complete, finish) [in LXX: Job.36:26 (חֵקֶר אַיִן) 3Mac.20 * ;]
endless, interminable: 1Ti.1:4.†
(AS)
G0562.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of G4008 (πέραν);

G0563.d:
ἀπεριστπάστως
adv. (περισπάω the adj. occurs in Wis.16:11 Sir.41:1);
without distraction: 1Co.7:35.†
(AS)
G0563.o: adverb from a compound of G1 (Α) (as a negative participle) and a presumed derivative of G4049 (περισπάω);

G0564.d:
ἀ-περί-τμητος, -ον
(περιτέμνω), [in LXX chiefly for עָרֵל ;]
uncir­cumcised; metaphorically (τ.) καρδίαις (cf. Jer.9:26, al.): Act.7:51 (ἄσημος, found in π., appears to have been the word used by Greek-speaking Egyptians: see Deiss., BS, 153; cf. also Cremer, 885; MM, see word)†
(AS)
G0564.o: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4059 (περιτέμνω);

G0565.d:
ἀπέρχομαι,
[in LXX chiefly for הלךְ ;]
__1. to go away, depart (also, in late writers, with "perfective" force, to arrive at a destination, the thought being carried on to the goal; M, Pr., 111f., 247; MM, see word);
__(a) absol.: Mat.13:25, al.; ptcp., ἀπελθών, used pleonastically with other verbs as in Heb. (Dalman, Words, 21), Mat.13:28, al.;
__(b) with mention of place or person: εἰς, Mat.14:15; ἐπί, Luk.24:24; πρός, Rev.10:9; ἀπό, Luk.1:38; ἐξω, Act.4:15; ἐκεῖ, Mat.2:22.
__2. As in LXX, before ὀπίσω, with genitive (Heb. הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי), to go after, follow: Mrk.1:20, Jhn.12:19; metaphorically, Mrk.1:42,…
G0565.s: to go off (i.e. depart), aside (i.e. apart) or behind (i.e. follow), literally or figuratively
G0565.k: come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out, … ways), pass away, be past

G0566.d:
to receive (in full); to be distant; (middle) to abstain, avoid
trans. to have in full what is due or is sought, Mt. 6:2, 5, 16; Lk. 6:24; Phil. 4:18; to have altogether, Phlm. 15; hence, it is enough, Mk. 14:41; intransitive to be distant, Lk. 7:6; to be estranged, Mt. 15:8; Mk. 7:6, middle to abstain from, Acts 14:20
G0566.o: third person singular present indicative active of G568 (ἀπέχω) used impersonally;

G0567.d: refrain, receive/be far, keep away from
G0567.s: to hold oneself off, i.e. refrain

G0568.d:
ἀπ-έχω
[in LXX chiefly for רָחַק ;]
__1. trans.,
__(a) to hold back, keep off;
__(b) to have in full, to have received (on the " punctiliar " force of the compound, see M, Pr., 109, 247): with accusative, Mat.6:2, 5 6:16, Luk.6:24, Php.4:18, Phm 15 (for illustr. from π., where it is used in receipts, see Deiss., BS, 229; LAE, 110 f.; MM, see word); impers., ἀπέχει (Field, Notes, 39), it is enough: Mrk.14:41.
__2. Intrans., to be away, distant: absol., Luk.15:20; before ἀπό, Mat.14:24 15:8, Mrk.7:6, Luk.7:6 15:20 24:13. Mid., to abstain: with genitive, Act.15:29, 1Ti.4:3, 1Pe.2:11; before ἀπό, Act.15:20,…
G0568.s: (actively) to have out, i.e. receive in full; (intransitively) to keep (oneself) away, i.e. be distant (literally or figuratively)

G0569.d:
ἀπιστέω, -ῶ
(ἄπιστος), [in LXX: Wis.1:2 10:7 12:17 18:13, Sir.1:27, 2Ma.8:13 * ;]
__1. to disbelieve, be faithless: Mrk.16:11, 16, Luk.24:11, 41, Act.28:24, 1Pe.2:7; so prob. also Rom.3:3, 2Ti.2:13 (ICC, CGT, in ll; MM, see word).
__2. = ἀπειθέω (Hdt.; on this sense in Ro, 2Ti, ll. with, see Vaughan on Ro, l.with; Lft., Notes, 265; Thayer, see word).†
(AS)
G0569.s: to be unbelieving, i.e. (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey

G0570.d:
ἀπιστία, -ας, ἡ
(ἄπιστος), [in LXX: Wis.14:25, 4Ma.12:4 * ;]
want of faith, unbelief: Mat.13:58, Mrk.6:6 9:24 16:14, Rom.3:3 (but see: ἀπιστέω) Rom.4:20 11:20, 23, 1Ti.1:13, Heb.3:12, 19 (DCG, ii, 775a; Cremer, 492).†
(AS)
G0570.s: faithlessness, i.e. (negatively) disbelief (lack of Christian faith), or (positively) unfaithfulness (disobedience)

G0571.d:
ἄ-πιστος, -ον
