within: with genitive, ἐ. ὑμῶν, within you (i.e. in your hearts, R, txt.), or among you (R, mg.), Luk.17:21 (cf. Field, Notes, 71; Thayer, see word; ICC, Lk, l.with; Dalman, Words, 145 ff.); τὸ ἐ., Mat.23:26.†
(AS)

G1788.d:
ἐν-τρέπω
[in LXX for כָּנַע ni., כָּלַם ni., etc. ;]
to turn about; metaphorically, put to shame: with accusative, 1Co.4:14; pass., 2Th.3:14, Tit.2:8; mid., to reverence: with accusative of person(s) (cl. with genitive), Mat.21:37, Mrk.12:6, Luk.18:2, 4 20:13, Heb.12:9 (cf. MM, Exp., iii, xiii).†
(AS)
G1788.s: to invert, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) in a good sense, to respect; or in a bad one, to confound
G1788.o: from G1722 (ἐν) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);

G1789.d:
ἐν-τρέφω
to train up, nurture; pass., metaphorically, τοῖς λόγοις τ. πίστεως, 1Ti.4:6.†
(AS)

G1790.d:
ἔν-τρομος, -ον
[in LXX: Da TH Dan.10:11 (רָעַד hi.); ἔ. γίγνεσθαι, Psa.18:7 77:18 (רַעַשׁ), Wis.17:10, 1Ma.13:2 * ;]
trembling with fear (Pint.): Act.7:32 16:29, Heb.12:21 (ἔκτρ-, WH, mg.).†
(AS)

G1791.d:
ἐν-τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Job.20:3, Psa.35:26 44:15 69:7, 19 71:13 109:29 (כְּלִמָּה)* ;]
__1. with genitive of person(s), respect, reverence (Soph., Polyb., al.).
__2. Absol., shame (Hipp.): 1Co.6:5 15:34.†
(AS)

G1792.d:
ἐν-τρυφάω, ῶ
[in LXX: Isa.55:2 57:4 (עָנַג hith.), Hab.1:10 (קָלַס hith.), 4Ma.8:8, etc. ;]
to revel in: ἐν-τ. ἀπάταις, 2Pe.2:13 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G1793.d:
ἐν-τυγχάνω
[in LXX: Da TH Dan.6:12-13 (קֶרֶב) Wis.8:20 16:28, 2Ma.2:25 2Mac 4:36 2Mac 6:12 2Mac 15:39, 3Ma.6:37; before κατά, 1Ma.8:32 1Mac 10:61-64 1Mac 11:25 * ;]
__1. to fall in with.
__2. to meet with in order to converse.
__3. to petition, make petition: with dative of person(s), before ὑπέρ with genitive of person(s), Act.25:24 (cf. Field, Notes, 140), Heb.7:25, Rom.8:27, 34 (θεῷ, not expressed); before κατά, against: Rom.11:2 (cf. ἔντευξις, ὑπερ-εντυγχάνω).†
(AS)
G1793.s: to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) confer with; by extension to entreat (in favor or against)

G1794.d:
ἐν-τυλίσσω
to wrap up (LS), roll or coil about (DCG, ii, 227, 507a): with accusative and dative, Mat.27:59 (iv, Tr. [WH], cf. similar sentence in π.; MM, Exp., xiii), Luk.23:53; pass., Jhn.20:7.†
(AS)
G1794.s: probably akin to G1507 (εἱλίσσω)); to entwine, i.e. wind up in

G1795.d:
ἐν-τυπόω, -ῶ
(τύπος), [in LXX for פִּתּוּחַ, Exo.39:30) A * ;]
to imprint, engrave: pass. ptcp., with dative, 2Co.3:7.†
(AS)
G1795.o: from G1722 (ἐν) and a derivative of G5179 (τύπος);

G1796.d:
ἐν-υβρίζω
[in OT (Al.), Lev.24:11 * ;]
to insult, mock at: Heb.10:29.†
(AS)

G1797.d:
ἐνυπνιάζω
(ἐνύπνιον), [in LXX, as in NT, -ομαι, depon., chiefly for חָלַם ;]
to dream: ἐνυπνίοις ἐ., Act.2:17 (LXX); present ptcp., Ju 8.†
(AS)

G1798.d:
ἐνύπνιον, -ου, τό
(ὕπνος), [in LXX chiefly for חֲלוֹם ;]
a dream: pl., Act.2:17.†
(AS)
G1798.s: something seen in sleep, i.e. a dream (vision in a dream)

G1799.d:
ἐνώπιος, -ον
(ὤψ), [in LXX for פָּנִים, etc. ;]
face to face, in sight (Theocr.; ἄρτοι ἐ., Exo.25:29): neut., ἐνώπιον, in vernacular, with force of prep. with genitive [in LXX for פָּנִים, עַיִן, etc., cf. Dalman, Words, 31 f., 209 f., and Deiss., BS., 213], in NT, most frequently in Lk, Ac, Re, never in Mt, Mk, before, in the presence of: Luk.1:19 Luk.4:7, Act.4:10 Act.6:5, Rev.1:4 2:14, al.; esp. ἐ. Κυρίου (θεοῦ), in the sight of God, or with God as witness or as judge, Rom.14:22, 1Co.1:29, 1Ti.2:3, Jas.4:10, 1Pe.3:4, al.
(AS)
G1799.s: in the face of (literally or figuratively)
G1799.o: neuter of a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);
G1799.k: before, in the presence (sight) of, to

G1801.d:
ἐνωτίζομαι
(οὖς),
depon. mid.,
[in LXX chiefly for אָזַן hi. ;]
to give ear to, hearken to: with accusative, Act.2:14.†
Also used for יָחַל שָׁמַע
(AS)
G1801.s: to take in one's ear, i.e. to listen
G1801.o: middle voice from a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and G3775 (οὖς);

G1802.d:
Ἐνώχ (Heb. חֲנוֹךְ), ὁ,
Enoch (Gen.5:18): Luk.3:37, Heb.11:5, Ju 14.†
(AS)

G1803.d:
ἕξ, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
six: Mat.17:1, Luk.13:14, al.
(AS)

G1804.d:
ἐξ-αγγέλλω
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
to tell out, proclaim: 1Pe.2:9 [Mrk.16:1-20, "shorter conclusion"] (Cremer, 29).†
(AS)
G1804.o: from G1537 (ἐκ) and the base of G32 (ἄγγελος);

G1805.d:
ἐξ-αγοράζω
[in LXX: καιρόν ὑμεῖς ἐξαγοράζετε (זְבַן), Dan LXX TH Dan.2:8 * ;]
__1. to redeem, ransom (esp. of slaves): metaphorically, Gal.3:13 4:5.
__2. to buy up; mid., to buy up for oneself: τ. καιρόν, Eph.5:16, Col.4:5 (Cremer, 60).†
(AS)
G1805.s: to buy up, i.e. ransom; figuratively, to rescue from loss (improve opportunity)

G1806.d:
ἐξ-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצָא hi. ;]
to lead out: with accusative, Mrk.15:20, Jhn.10:3, Act.5:19 7:36 16:37-39; before ἔξω, Luk.24:50; ἐκ, Act.7:40 12:17 13:17, Heb.8:9; εἰς, Act.21:38.†
(AS)

G1807.d:
ἐξ-αιρέω -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָצַל hi. ;]
to take out: with accusative, ὀφθαλμόν, Mat.5:29 18:9; mid.
__(a) to take out for oneself, choose: Act.26:17 (Thayer, see word; Page, Ac., l.with, but see infr.);
__(b) to deliver: Act.7:10, 34" (LXX) Act.12:11 Act.23:27 Act.26:17 (EV, but see supr.), Gal.1:4.†
(AS)
G1807.s: actively, to tear out; middle voice, to select; figuratively, to release

G1808.d:
ἐξ-αίρω
[in LXX for נָסַע, יָרַשׁ hi., כָּרַת ni., מוּת, בָּעַר pi., etc. ;]
to lift up, lift off the earth, remove: 1Co.5:13 (LXX)†
(AS)

G1809.d:
ἐξ-αιτέω, -ῶ
to ask from; mid., to ask for oneself, demand: aor., ἐξῃτήσατο, with accusative (obtained you by asking, R, mg.), Luk.22:31 (see Field, Notes, 76; Cremer, 73).†
(AS)
G1809.o: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G154 (αἰτέω);

G1810.d:
ἐξ-αίφνης (WH, ἐξέφνης, exc. Act.22:6; see App., p. 151, and cf. M, Pr., 35), adv.
(ἄφνω), [in LXX chiefly for פִּתְאוֹם ;]
suddenly Mrk.13:36, Luk.2:13 9:39, Act.9:3 22:6.†
(AS)
G1810.o: from G1537 (ἐκ) and the base of G160 (αἰφνίδιος);

G1811.d:
ἐξ-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX Amo.2:4, Jer.2:2 (אַחַר הָלַךְ), Isa.56:11 (פָּנָה), Job.31:9 (פָּתָה ni.), Sir.5:2, Dan LXX TH Dan.3:1-30 :(41) * ;]
to follow, follow up (in various senses): metaphorically, 2Pe.1:16 2:2 2:15 †
(AS)
G1811.s: to follow out, i.e. (figuratively) to imitate, obey, yield to

G1812.o: plural ordinal from G1803 (ἕξ) and G1540 (ἑκατόν);

G1813.d:
ἐξ-αλείφω
[in LXX for טוּחַ, Lev.14:42, al.; metaphorically, מָחָה, שָׁחַת, etc. ;]
__1. to plaster, wash over (LXX).
__2. to wipe off, wipe out: δάκρυον, Rev.7:17 21:4; metaphorically, χειρόγραφον, Col.2:14; τ. ὄνομα, before ἐκ, Rev.3:5 (MM, Exp., xiii); pass., ἀμαρτίαι (ἐξαλιφθῆναι, WH), Act.3:19 (cf. Psa.51:11 Psa.109:13, Isa.43:25, Sir.46:20 (ἁμ. ἀπαλ-), 3Ma.2:19).†
(AS)
G1813.s: to smear out, i.e. obliterate (erase tears, figuratively, pardon sin)

G1814.d:
ἐξ-άλλομαι
[in LXX for קָלַל (Hab.1:8), etc. ;]
to leap up: Act.3:8.†
(AS)

G1815.d:
ἐξ-ανάστασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐξανίστημι),
a rising again: ἐκ τ. νεκρῶν, Php.3:11 (Cremer, 308).†
(AS)

G1816.d:
ἐξ-ανα-τέλλω
[in LXX: Gen.2:9, Psa.104:14 Psa.132:17 Psa.147:8 (צָמַח hi.); Psa.112:4 (זָרַח) * ;]
__1. trans., to cause to spring up (LXX).
__2. Intrans. (as ἀνατέλλω, Gen.3:18), to spring up: Mat.13:5, Mrk.4:5.†
(AS)
G1816.s: to start up out of the ground, i.e. germinate

G1817.d:
ἐξ-ανίσημι
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
__1. trans., to raise up: σπέρμα (cf. Gen.38:8), Mrk.12:19, Luk.20:28.
__2. In 2 aor. act., intrans., to rise: Act.15:5.†
(AS)
G1817.s: objectively, to produce, i.e. (figuratively) beget; subjectively, to arise, i.e. (figuratively) object

G1818.d:
ἐξ -απατάω, -ῶ strengthened form of ἀπατάω,
[in LXX: Exo.8:29 (הָתַל hi.), Da TH Sus 5:6* ;]
to deceive: with accusative, Rom.7:11 Rom.16:18, 1Co.3:18, 2Co.11:3, 2Th.2:3; pass., 1Ti.2:14.†
(AS)

G1819.d:
ἐξάπινα = ἐξαπίνης, ἐξαίφνης (which see),
[in LXX for פִּתְאוֹם, etc. ;]
suddenly: Mrk.9:8.†
(AS)
G1819.o: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of the same as G160 (αἰφνίδιος);

G1820.d:
ἐξ-απορέω, -ῶ
[in LXX, pass., for פּוּן, Psa.88:15 * ;]
so in NT, depon. pass., to be utterly at a loss, be in despair: absol. (as Ps, l.with), 2Co.4:8; τοῦ ζῆν, 2Co.1:8.†
(AS)
G1820.s: to be utterly at a loss, i.e. despond
G1820.o: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G639 (ἀπορέω);

G1821.d:
ἐξ-απο-στέλλω
[in LXX freq., chiefly for שָׁלַח pi. ;]
__1. to send forth: with accusative of person(s), Act.7:12 12:11, Gal.4:4; τ. ἐπαγγελίαν, Luk.24:49; τ. πνεῦμα, Gal.4:6; [τ. κήρυγμα, Mrk.16:1-20, "shorter conclusion," WH ;] before εἰς, Act.22:21; pass., ὁ λόγος, Act.13:26.
__2. to send away: with accusative of person(s), before εἰς, Act.9:30; before ἕως, Act.11:22; with inf., Act.17:14; κενόν, Luk.1:53 20:10-11.†
(AS)
G1821.s: to send away forth, i.e. (on a mission) to despatch, or (peremptorily) to dismiss

G1822.d:
ἐξ-αρτίζω
(ἄρτιος), [in LXX. Exo.28:7 (חָבַר pu.) * ;]
__1. to com­plete, finish: τ. ἡμέρας, Act.21:5.
__2. to furnish, supply: pass., 2Ti.3:17 (for exx., see MM, Exp., xiii; Cremer, 651).†
(AS)
G1822.s: to finish out (time); figuratively, to equip fully (a teacher)
G1822.o: from G1537 (ἐκ) and a derivative of G739 (ἄρτιος);

G1823.d:
ἐξ-αστράπτω
[in LXX: Num.3:3 (בָּרָק), Eze.1:4 (לָקַח hithp.) 17 Dan LXX 106 (קָלַל)* ;]
to flash like lightning, gleam, be radiant: ἱματισμός, Luk.9:29.†
(AS)
G1823.s: to lighten forth, i.e. (figuratively) to be radiant (of very white garments)

G1824.d:
ἐξ-αυτῆς
(a κοινή word, = ἐξ αὐτῆς τ. ὥρας)
at once, forthwith: Mrk.6:25, Act.10:33 Act.11:11 Act.21:32 Act.23:30, Php.2:23.†
(AS)
G1824.o: from G1537 (ἐκ) and the genitive case singular feminine of G846 (αὐτός) (G5610 (ὥρα) being understood);
G1824.k: by and by, immediately, presently, straightway

G1825.d:
ἐξ-εγείρω
[in LXX for עוּר ni., hi., etc. ;]
to raise up: Rom.9:17 (cf. ICC, in l); from the dead, 1Co.6:14.†
(AS)
G1825.s: to rouse fully, i.e. (figuratively) to resuscitate (from death), release (from infliction)

G1826.d:
ἔξ-ειμι
(εἶμι),
to go forth: Act.13:42 Act.17:15 Act.20:7; before ἐπί, with accusative, Act.27:43.†
(AS)
G1826.s: to issue, i.e. leave (a place), escape (to the shore)

G1827.d:
ἐξ-ελίγχω
[in LXX Pro.30:6, Mic.4:3, Isa.2:4 (יָכַח hi.), Wis.12:17, 4Ma.2:12 * ;]
to convict: Ju 15, Rec. (for ἐλέγχω, WH, which see).†
(AS)
G1827.s: to convict fully, i.e. (by implication) to punish

G1828.d:
ἐξ-έλκω
[in LXX: Gen.37:28 (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;]
to draw out or away: metaphorically, ὑπὸ τ. ἐπιθυμίας, Jas.1:14 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)
G1828.s: to drag forth, i.e. (figuratively) to entice (to sin)

G1829.o: from a comparative of G1537 (ἐκ) and a presumed (to spue);

G1830.d:
ἐξ-εραυνάω
(Rec. ἐξερευνάω), -ῶ, [in LXX for חָקַר, נָצַר, etc. ;]
to search out, search carefully: before περί, 1Pe.1:10.†
(AS)

G1831.d:
ἐξέρχομαι,
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for יצא, also for עלה ,בּוֹא, etc. ;] depon.,
to go, or come out of: Mat.10:11, Mrk.1:35, Jhn.13:30, al.; with inf., Mat.11:8, Mrk.3:21, Luk.7:25, 26 Act.20:8; id. before ἐπί, Mat.26:55, al.; εἰς, Mrk.1:38; ἵνα, Rev.6:2; ἐ. before ἐκ (cl. with genitive loc.), Mrk.5:2, Jhn.4:30, al.; ἔξω, with genitive, Mat.21:17, Mrk.14:68, Act.16:13, Heb.13:13; ἀπό, Mrk.11:12, Luk.9:5, Php.4:15; ἐκεῖθεν, Mat.15:21, Mrk.6:1, Luk.9:4, al.; of demons expelled, before ἐκ (ἀπό), with genitive of person(s), Mrk.1:25, 26 5:8, Luk.4:35, al.; of prisoners released, Mat.5:26, Act.16:40; ptcp., ἐξελθών, with indic., of verb of departure (cf.…
G1831.k: come (forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad

G1832.d:
ἔξ-εστι
(εἰμί),
impers. verb.,
it is permitted, lawful: Mrk.2:24, Act.8:37 (R, mg.), 1Co.10:23; with inf., Mat.12:2, 10 12 14:4 15:26 19:3 22:17 27:6, Mrk.3:4 12:14, Luk.6:2, 9 14:3, Jhn.5:10; before accusative, Mrk.2:26, Luk.6:4 20:22; with dative of person(s) and inf., Mat.20:15, Mrk.6:18 10:2, Jhn.18:31, Act.16:21 21:37 22:25 (inf. understood), 1Co.6:12; ἐξόν (sc. ἐστί), Act.2:29, 2Co.12:4; ἐξὸν ἦν, Mat.12:4.†
(AS)
G1832.s: so also neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of G1510 (εἰμί) expressed); impersonally, it is right (through the figurative idea of being out in public)
G1832.o: third person singular present indicative of a compound of G1537 (ἐκ) and G1510 (εἰμί);

G1833.d:
ἐξ-ετάζω
(ἐτάζω (rare), to examine), [in LXX: Deu.13:14-15 Deu.19:18, 1Ch.28:9 A (דָּרַשׁ), דָּרַשׁ), Psa.11:5-6 (בָּחַן), Wis.6:3, Sir.3:21, al. ;]
to examine closely, inquire carefully (of ): before περί (with ἀκριβῶς), Mat.2:8; before τίς, Mat.10:11; with accusative of person(s), Jhn.21:12.†
SYN.: ἀνακρίνω, ἐραυνάω (see DCG, ii, 594b) (AS)
G1833.s: to test thoroughly (by questions), i.e. ascertain or interrogate

G1834.d:
ἐξ-ηγέομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX chiefly for סָפַר pi. ;]
to lead, show the way; metaphorically, to unfold, narrate, declare: with accusative of thing(s), Luk.24:35 Act.21:19; with dative of person(s), Act.10:8; θεόν (understood), Jhn.1:18; before ὅσα, Act.15:12; καθώς, Act.15:14.†
(AS)
G1834.s: to consider out (aloud), i.e. rehearse, unfold

G1835.d:
ἑξήκοντα, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
sixty: Mat.13:8, 23, Mrk.4:8, 20, Luk.24:13, 1Ti.5:9, Rev.11:3 Rev.12:6 Rev.13:18.†
(AS)

G1836.d:
ἑξῆς
adv. (ἔχω),
in order, successively, next: τῇ ἑ. ἡμέρᾳ, Luk.9:37; ἐν τῷ ἑ. (sc. χρόνῳ), soon after, Luk.7:11; τῇ ἑ. (sc. ἡμέρα), Act.21:1 Act.25:17 Act.27:18.†
(AS)
G1836.o: from G2192 (ἔχω) (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining);

G1837.d:
ἐξ-ηχέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Jol.3:14 (הָמוֹן), Sir.40:13, 3Ma.3:2 * ;]
to sound forth (as a trumpet, or thunder; see M, Th., l.with): pass., 1Th.1:8.†
(AS)
G1837.s: to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be generally reported)
G1837.o: middle voice from G1537 (ἐκ) and G2278 (ἠχέω);

G1838.d:
ἐξις, -εως, ἡ
(ἔχω), [in LXX, cf. Sir, prol.9 ;]
habit, use, experience: Heb.5:14.†
(AS)

G1839.d:
ἐξ-ίστημι (also in Hellenistic -ιστάνω, Act 8:9),
[in LXX for H2730, etc. (29 words in all) ;],
__1. causal in Pres., impf., fut., 1 aor., to put out of its place; metaphorically, ἐ. τινά φρενῶν (Eur.), to drive one out of his senses, hence, absol., to confound, amaze: with accusative of person(s), Luk.24:22, Act.8:9, 11.
__2. Intr. in pass. and mid., also in 2 aor., pf., plpf. act., before ἐκ or with genitive, to stand aside from, retire from; esp. τ. φρενῶν, to lose one's senses (Eur.), hence, absol.;
__(a) to be beside oneself, be mad: Mrk.3:21, 2Co.5:13 (opposite to σωφρονεῖν);
__(b) to be amazed, confounded: Mat.12:23,…
G1839.s: to put (stand) out of wits, i.e. astound, or (reflexively) become astounded, insane
G1839.k: amaze, be (make) astonished, be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder

G1840.d:
ἐξ-ισχύω
[in LXX: Sir.7:6 * ;]
to have strength enough, to be quite able: with inf., Eph.3:18.†
(AS)
G1840.s: to have full strength, i.e. be entirely competent

G1841.d:
ἔξ-οδος, -ου, ὁ
(ὁδός), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹצָא also חוּץ, etc. ;]
a going out, departure: Heb.11:22; of death, Luk.9:31, 2Pe.1:15.†
(AS)

G1842.d:
έξ-ολεθρεύω
(so best MSS. and WH; also read -οθρεύω), [in LXX frequently (rare in Gk. writers) for כָּרַת ni., hi., etc. ;]
to destroy utterly: before ἐκ τ. λαοῦ, Act.3:23 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1843.d:
ἐξ-ομολογέω, -ῶ and depon. mid., -έομαι, -οῦμαι
[as always in LXX chiefly for יָדָה hi. ;]
__1. act. = cl. ὁμολογέω, to profess or agree to do (Field, Notes, 75): Luk.22:6.
__2. With ellipsis, otherwise, else: Rom.11:6, 22, Heb.9:26; ἐ. ἄρα, 1Co.5:10 7:14; introducing a question, Rom.3:6, 1Co.14:16 15:29, Heb.10:2 (cf. 4Ma.1:33 4Mac 2:7 4Mac 2:10 4Mac 4:24-26).†
(AS)
G1893.s: thereupon, i.e. since (of time or cause)
G1893.k: because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when

G1894.d:
ἐπει-δή
conj.;
__1. of time, when now, after that: Luk.7:1 (WH, txt.).
__2. Of cause, seeing that, forasmuch as: Luk.11:6, Act.13:46 (WH, txt., RV) Act.14:12 15:24, 1Co.1:21-22 14:16 15:21, Php.2:26.†
(AS)
G1894.s: since now, i.e. (of time) when, or (of cause) whereas
G1894.k: after that, because, for (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since

G1895.d:
ἐπει-δή-περ
conj.,
forasmuch as ("a stately compound," frequently in cl. and suitable for the formal introduction of Lk): Luk.1:1.†
(AS)

G1896.d:
ἐπ-εῖδον 2 aor. without Pres. in use;
[in LXX chiefly for רָאָה ;] to regard with attention, look upon (in cl., of the gods)
__1. with a view to bless: with inf., Luk.1:25 (cf. DB, 136b).
__2. To punish: before ἐπί, Act.4:29.†
(AS)
G1896.o: and other moods and persons of the same tense; from G1909 (ἐπί) and G1492 (εἴδω);

G1898.d:
ἐπ-εισ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
a bringing in besides or in addition (Hipp., FlJ, al.): Heb.7:19 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)
G1898.o: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G1521 (εἰσάγω);

G1899.d:
ἐπειτα, adv. of sequence
[in LXX: Num.19:10 A, Isa.16:2, 4Ma.6:3 * ;]
thereupon, thereafter, then: Luk.16:7, Gal.1:21, Jas.4:14; before μετὰ τοῦτο, Jhn.11:7; μετὰ ἔτη τρία, Gal.1:18; διὰ δεκατεσσάρων ἐτῶν, Gal.2:1; πρῶτον . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:46, 1Th.4:17, Heb.7:2; πρότεφον . . . ἔ, Heb.7:27; ἀπαρχὴ . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:23; εἶτα . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:5-6 (WH, txt.); . . . ἔ., 1Co.15:5-7 (WH, mg.); τρίτον . . . ἔ. (his), 1Co.12:28.†
(AS)

G1900.d:
ἐπ-έκεινα
adv. (= ἐπ᾽ ἐκεῖνα), [in LXX: Lev.22:27, Num.32:19, al. (הָלְאָה), etc. ;]
beyond; with genitive, Act.7:43 (LXX) †
(AS)
G1900.s: upon those parts of, i.e. on the further side of
G1900.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and (the accusative case plural neuter of) G1565 (ἐκεῖνος);

G1901.d:
ἐπ-εκ-τείνω
to extend: mid., to stretch forward: with dative, Php.3:13.†
(AS)
G1901.o: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G1614 (ἐκτείνω);

G1902.d:
ἐπ-εν-δύω
= -δύνω (Hdt.),
to put on over; pass. (Plut., al.), to have on over, be clothed upon: 2Co.5:2-4.†
(AS)
G1902.o: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G1746 (ἐνδύω);

G1903.d:
ἐπενδύτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἐπενδύω), [in LXX for מְעִיל Lev.8:7 A (Aq. ἐπένδυμα), 3Ki.18:4 A, 4Ki.13:18 * ;]
an outer tunic (RV, coat): Jhn.21:7 .†
(AS)

G1904.d:
ἐπ-έρχομαι,
[in LXX for בּוֹא, עָבַר, etc. ;]
__1. to come to, arrive, come on: before ἀπό, with genitive loc., Act.14:19 (ἐπῆλθαν; cf. M, Pr., 65; Deiss., BS, 191); of time, Eph.2:7.
__2. to come upon (as in Hom.): of calamities, Luk.21:26, Act.8:24 13:40, Jas.5:1; of an enemy, Luk.11:22; of the Holy Spirit, Luk.1:35, Act.1:8, [in LXX: γίγνομαι ἐπί, Jdg.14:6, 3Ki.11:6, al.].†
(AS)
G1904.s: to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence

G1905.d:
ἐπ-ερωτάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל, also for דָּרַשׁ, etc. ;]
__1. to in­quire of, consult, question: with accusative of person(s), Mrk.12:34, Luk.2:46, al.; with dupl. accusative, Mrk.7:17 11:29, Luk.20:40, al.; with accusative of person(s), before λέγων, Mat.12:18, Mrk.9:11; εἰ, Mrk.8:23, Luk.23:6, al.; ἐ. θεόν, Rom.10:20 (LXX).
__2. In late Gk., to beg of, demand of: with accusative of person(s) and inf., Mat.16:1 (cf. ἐρωτάω; and see Cromer, 716)
(AS)
G1905.s: to ask for, i.e. inquire, seek

G1906.d:
ἐπ-ερώτημα, -τος, τό
[in LXX: Da TH Dan.4:14 (שְׁאֵלָא), Sir.33:3 * ;]
__1. a question, au inquiry (Hdt., Thuc.).
__2. a demand: 1Pe.3:21 (see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G1907.d:
ἐπ-έχω
[in LXX for חָדַל, etc.; also Sir.8:1 34:2, 2Ma.5:25 2Mac 9:25, al. ;]
__1. to hold upon.
__2. Like παρέχω (as in Hom., al.), to hold out, offer: λόγον ζωῆς, Php.2:16.
__3. to hold or direct towards, Sc.νοῦν;
__(a) absol., to intend, purpose;
__(b) to observe, give attention to (see MM, Exp., xiv): before πῶς, Luk.14:7; with dative of person(s), Act.3:5, 1Ti.4:16.
__4. to stay, wait: Act.19:22 (in legal phrase, MM, Exp., l.with).†
(AS)
G1907.s: to hold upon, i.e. (by implication) to retain; (by extension) to detain; (with implication, of G3563 (νοῦς)) to pay attention to
G1907.k: give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay

G1908.d:
ἐπηρεάζω
(ἐπήρεια, spiteful abuse),
to revile: with accusative of person(s), Luk.6:28; with accusative of thing(s) (but see ICC, in l), 1Pe.3:16.†
(AS)
G1908.o: from a comparative of G1909 (ἐπί) and (probably) (threats);

G1909.d:
ἐπί (before a smooth breathing ἐπ᾽, before a rough breathing ἐφ᾽),
prep. with genitive, dative, accusative (accusative most frequently in NT),
with primary sense of superposition, on, upon.
__I. C. genitive,
__1. of place, answering the question, where?
__(a) of the place on which, on, upon: ἐπὶ (τ.) γῆς, Mat.6:10, 19, al.; τ. κεφαλῆς, 1Co.11:10; τ. νεφελῶν, Mat.24:3o, al.; like ἐν, in constr. praegn. after verbs of motion: βάλλειν, Mrk.4:26; σπείρειν, ib. 31; ἔρχεσθαι, Heb.6:7, al.; figuratively, ἐπ᾽ ἀληθείας (MM, see word ἀ.); of the subject of thought or speech, Gal.3:16; of power or authority, over, πάντων, Rom.9:5: τ. γάζης,…
G1909.s: properly, meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc.
G1909.k: about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, X have charge of, (be-, (where-))fore, in (a place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-)on (behalf of), over, (by, for) the space of, through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), with

G1910.d:
ἐπι-βαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב ;]
__1. to get up on, mount: before ἐπί, with accusative, Mat.21:5 (LXX); to embark in (a boat), go aboard: with dative, Act.27:2; before εἰς, Act.21:6 (Rec.); absol., Act.21:2.
__2. to go up to, go on to, enter: before εἰς, Act.20:18 21:4; with dative, Act.25:1.†
(AS)
G1910.s: to walk upon, i.e. mount, ascend, embark, arrive
G1910.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G939 (βάσις);
G1910.k: come (into), enter into, go abroad, sit upon, take ship

G1911.d:
ἐπι-βάλλω
[in LXX for שָׁלַח, שִׁית, etc. ;]
__1. trans., to cast, lay or put upon: with accusative and dative, Mrk.11:7, 1Co.7:35; with accusative, before ἐπί with accusative, Rev.18:10, WH, mg.; τ. Χεῖρα (-ας) ἐπί (B1., § 37, 7), of seizing a prisoner, Mat.26:50, Luk.20:19 21:12, Jhn.7:30, Act.5:18 21:27; with dative (Polyb.), Mrk.14:46 Act.4:3; with inf., Act.12:1; τὴν χ. ἐπ᾽ ἄροτρον, Luk.9:62; ἐπίβλημα ἐπὶ ἱμάτιον, Luk.5:36; ἐπὶ ἱματίῳ, Mat.9:16.
__2. Intrans.,
__(a) to throw oneself or rush upon: τ. κύματα εἰς τ. πλοῖον, Mrk.4:37; metaphorically, to put one's mind upon (but see Field, Notes, 41 ff.), ἐπιβαλὼν ἔκλαιεν, when he thought…
G1911.s: to throw upon (literal or figurative, transitive or reflexive; usually with more or less force); specially (with G1438 (ἑαυτοῦ) implied) to reflect; impersonally, to belong to
G1911.k: beat into, cast (up-)on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on

G1912.d:
ἐπι-βαρέω, -ῶ
to put a burden on, be burdensome: figuratively, absol., 2Co.2:6; with accusative of person(s), 1Th.2:9, 2Th.3:8 (cf. M, Th., I, 29).†
(AS)
G1912.s: to be heavy upon, i.e. (pecuniarily) to be expensive to; figuratively, to be severe towards

G1913.d:
ἐπι-βιβάζω
[in LXX chiefly for רָכַב hi. ;]
to place upon: with accusative of person(s), Luk.10:34 19:35, Act.23:24.†
(AS)
G1913.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a reduplicated derivative of the base of G939 (βάσις) (compare G307 (ἀναβιβάζω));

G1914.d:
ἐπι-βλέπω
[in LXX for נָבַט hi., פָּנָה, רָאָה, etc. ;]
to look upon. In NT, as in LXX (1Ki.1:11 9:1, Psa.25:16; Tob.3:3, al.), to look on with favour: before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Luk.1:48 9:38, Jas.2:3.†
(AS)
G1914.s: to gaze at (with favor, pity or partiality)
G1914.k: look upon, regard, have respect to

G1915.d:
ἐπί-βλημα, -τος, τό
[in LXX: Isa.3:22 * ;]
__1. that which is thrown over, a cover.
__2. a tapestry, hanging (Is, l.with).
__3. that which is put on;
__(a) embroidery;
__(b) a patch: Mat.9:16, Mrk.2:21, Luk.5:36.†
(AS)

G1916.d:
ἐπι-βοάω, -ῶ
to cry out: Act.25:24 (Rec., for βοάω, which see).†
(AS)

G1917.d:
ἐπι-βουλή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Est.2:22, I Est.5:73, 2Ma.5:7, al. ;]
a plan against, a plot: Act.9:24 20:3, 19 23:30.†
(AS)
G1917.s: a plan against someone, i.e. a plot
G1917.o: from a presumed compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G1014 (βούλομαι);

G1918.d:
ἐπι-γαμβρεύω
(γαμβρός, a connection by marriage) [in LXX: Gen.34:9, 1Ki.18:21 ff., 2Ch.18:1, Est.9:14 (חָתַן hithp.), Gen.38:8 R (יָבַם pi.), 1Ma.10:54-56 * ;]
__1. to enter into affinity with: with dative (LXX, H. with, exc. Gen.38:8).
__2. to marry (as deceased husband's next of kin, cf. Gen.38:8): with accusative, Mat.22:24.†
(AS)
G1918.s: to form affinity with, i.e. (specially) in a levirate way
G1918.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G1062 (γάμος);

G1919.d:
ἐπί-γειος, -ον
(ἐπί, γῆ),
of the earth, earthly: τὰ ἐ., Jhn.3:12 Php.2:10 3:19 (anarth.); σώματα, 1Co.15:40; οἰκία, 2Co.5:1; σοφία, Jas.3:15 (Cremer, 153).†
(AS)

G1920.d:
ἐπι-γίνομαι (see: γίνομαι)
[in LXX: Ep. Jer.47:1-7, 3Ma.2:6 * ;]
to arrive, arise, come on: Act.28:13.†
(AS)
G1920.s: to arrive upon, i.e. spring up (as a wind)

G1921.d:
ἐπι-γινώσκω
[in LXX chiefly for נָכַר: hi., also for יָדַע, etc. ;]
"directive" of γινώσκω (AR, Eph., 249), as in cl.;
__1. to observe, perceive, discern, recognize;
__(a) absol.: Act.25:10, 1Co.13:12; before ὅτι, Luk.1:22; τ. πνεύματι, before ὅτι, Mrk.2:8;
__(b) with accusative of thing(s): Luk.1:4 5:22, Act.12:14 27:39, Rom.1:32, 2Co.1:13, Col.1:6, 1Ti.4:3; ἐν ἐαυτῷ, Mrk.5:30; before ὅτι, 1Co.14:37;
__(with) with accusative of person(s): Mat.11:27 14:36 17:12, Mrk.6:33 (T, αὐτούς, but LTr., WH, R, omit the prop., and LTr., WH, txt., read ἔγνωσαν), Mrk.6:54 Luk.24:16, 31, 1Co.16:18, 2Co.1:14; before ἀπό, with genitive of thing(s),…
G1921.s: to know upon some mark, i.e. recognize; by implication, to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge

G1922.d:
ἐπί-γνωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιγινώσκω, which see), [in LXX: 3Ki.7:14 (B. γν-), Pro.2:5, Hos.4:1, 6 6:6 (דַּעַת), Jdth.9:14, 2Ma.9:11 * ;]
acquaintance, discernment, recognition (Plut., al.): Php.1:9, Col.3:10; with genitive of thing(s), Col.1:9 2:2, Phm 6; τ. ἀληθείας, 1Ti.2:4, 2Ti.2:25 3:7, Tit.1:1, Heb.10:26; τ. ἁμαρτίας, Rom.3:20; with genitive of person(s), of God: Eph.1:17, Col.1:10, 2Pe.1:2-3; of Christ: Eph.4:13, 2Pe.1:8 2:20; of God and Christ: 2Pe.1:2; κατ ̓ ἐ., Rom.10:2; ἔχειν ἐν ἐ., Rom.1:28 (see AR, Eph., 248 ff.; and for a somewhat different view, Thayer, see word; Lft. on Col, 1:9; Tr., Syn., LXXv; Cremer, 159 f.; cf. αἴσθησις).†
(AS)
G1922.s: recognition, i.e. (by implication) full discernment, acknowledgement

G1924.d:
ἐπι-γράφω
[in LXX for כָּתַב, Num.17:2; fig., Jer.31:33, al. ;]
to write upon, inscribe: Mrk.15:26, Act.17:23, Rev.21:12; figuratively, Heb.8:10 (LXX) Heb.10:16.†
(AS)

G1925.d:
ἐπι-δείκνυμι
[in LXX: Pro.12:17 (פּוּחַ hi.), Isa.37:26 (בּוֹא hi.), Esp. Jer.59, 2Ma.15:32, al ;]
__1. to show, exhibit, display: with accusative and dative, Mat.16:1 22:19 24:1, Luk.17:14. Mid., to display for oneself or as one's own (but cf. El., § 55, 1): Act.9:39.
__2. to show, point out, prove: with accusative, Heb.6:17; with accusative and inf., Act.18:28 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G1926.d:
ἐπι-δέχομαι
[in LXX: Jdth.13:13 B2, 1Ma.10:1 1Mac 14:23, Sir.51:26, al. ;]
__1. in cl., of things, to allow of, admit of (Dem., Arist., al.). In late writers,
__2. to accept besides (Polyb.), to accept (in π. of the terms of a lease; see ICC, on 3Jo, l.with): III Jn 9.
__3. (a) to receive besides (Menand.);
__(b) to receive hospitably (1Mac, Sir, ll with): III Jn 10†
(AS)
G1926.s: to admit (as a guest or (figuratively) teacher)

G1927.d:
ἐπι-δημέω, -ῶ
(δῆμος);
__1. to be at home (Thuc., Plat., al.),
__2. to stay in a place, sojourn (Plat., Xen., al.; and see MM, Exp., xiv): Act.2:10 17:21; before ἐν, Act.18:27 (WH, mg.).†
(AS)
G1927.s: to make oneself at home, i.e. (by extension) to reside (in a foreign country)
G1927.o: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G1218 (δῆμος);

G1928.d:
ἐπι-δια-τάσσομαι
to add provisions to a document: Gal.3:15 (cf. ἐπιδιαθήκη, a second will, F1J, BJ, ii, 2, 3; the word is used of wills in π., cf. Deiss., LAE, 87).†
(AS)
G1928.s: to appoint besides, i.e. supplement (as a codicil)
G1928.o: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G1299 (διατάσσω);

G1929.d:
ἐπι-δίδωμι
[in LXX for נָתַן, etc. ;]
__1. to give over, to hand: with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Mat.7:9, 19, Luk.11:11-12 24:30, 42, Act.15:30; pass. with dative of person(s), Luk.4:17.
__2. to give in, give way: absol., Act.27:15.†
(AS)
G1929.s: to give over (by hand or surrender)
G1929.k: deliver unto, give, let (+ (her drive)), offer

G1930.d:
ἐπι-δι-ορθόω
to set in order further: Tit.1:5 (Inscr.; Cremer, 8O8).†
(AS)
G1930.s: to straighten further, i.e. (figuratively) arrange additionally
G1930.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G3717 (ὀρθός);

G1931.d:
ἐπι-δύω
[in LXX: Deu.24:15, Jos.8:29, Jer.15:9 (בּוֹא)* ;]
to go down, set (of the sun): Eph.4:26.†
(AS)

G1932.d:
ἐπιεικία (Rec. -είκεια), -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιεικής), [in LXX: Wis.2:19 12:18 Bar.2:27, from LXX Bar.4:24, TH (3:42), 2Ma.2:22 2Mac 10:4, 3Ma.3:15 3Mac 7:6 * ;]
fairness, moderation, gentleness ("sweet reasonableness," Matthew Arnold): Act.24:4; with πραΰτης, 2Co.10:1.†
SYN.: πραΰτης (see Tr., Syn., § xliii) (AS)

G1933.d:
ἐπιεικής, -ές
(εἰκός, likely), [in LXX: Psa.86:5 (סַלָּח), Est.8:13 * ;]
__1. seemly, fitting (Hom.).
__2. equitable, fair, moderate: 1Ti.3:3, Tit.3:2, 1Pe.2:18, Jas.3:17; τὸ ἐ. (Thuc., i, 76), Php.4:5 (cf. Mayor, Ja, l.with, and see: ἐπιεικία).†
ἐπιείκεια see: ἐπιεικία
ἐπιεικία (Rec. -είκεια), -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιεικής), [in LXX: Wis.2:19 12:18 Bar.2:27, from LXX Bar.4:24, TH (3:42), 2Ma.2:22 2Mac 10:4, 3Ma.3:15 3Mac 7:6 * ;]
fairness, moderation, gentleness ("sweet reasonableness," Matthew Arnold): Act.24:4; with πραΰτης, 2Co.10:1.†
SYN.: πραΰτης (see Tr., Syn., § xliii) (AS)

G1934.d:
ἐπι-ζητέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּרַשׁ, 4Ki.8:8, Isa.62:12, al.; also for בָּקַשׁ, 3Ki.20:1, Ecc.7:28), Hos.3:5; פָּקַד, 4Ki.3:8 ;]
"directive" of ζητέω (MM, Exp., xiv),
to inquire for, seek after, wish for: with accusative of thing(s), Mat.6:32 12:39 16:4, Luk.12:30, Act.19:39, Rom.11:7, Php.4:17, Heb.11:14 13:14; with accusative of person(s), Luk.4:42, Act.12:19; with inf., Act.13:7.†
(AS)
G1934.s: to search (inquire) for; intensively, to demand, to crave

G1936.d:
ἐπί-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιτίθημι), [in LXX: 2Ch.25:27 (קֶשֶׁר), Ez 23:11 (עֲגָבָה) 2Ma.4:41 2Mac 5:5 2Mac 14:15 * ;]
__1. a laying on: χειρῶν, Act.8:18, 1Ti.4:14, 2Ti.1:6, Heb.6:2 (cf. Westc., He., l.with; CGT on 1Ti, l.with).
__2. an attack, assault (2Mac, ll.with).†
(AS)

G1937.d:
ἐπιθυμέω, -ῶ
(θυμός), [in LXX chiefly for אָוָה pi., hithp.; also for חָמַד, etc. ;]
to set one's heart upon, desire, lust after, covet: absol., Jas.4:2, Rom.7:7 13:9" (LXX), 1Co.10:6 (of. 4Ma.2:6); before κατά (against, in opposition to), Gal.5:17; prop. (as in cl.) with genitive, Act.20:33, 1Ti.3:1; in late Gk. also with accusative (M, Pr., 65), Mat.5:28 (Rec. αὐτῆς; T omits; cf. Exo.20:17, Mic.2:2, Wis.16:3, al.); with inf., Mat.13:17, Luk.15:16 16:21 17:22, 1Pe.1:12, Rev.9:6; with accusative and inf., Heb.6:11; as in Hebrew, ἐπιθυμία ἐπεθύμησα, Luk.22:15.†
SYN.: ὀρέγω (cf. Field, Notes, 204), θέλω (DCG. i, 453) (AS)
G1937.s: to set the heart upon, i.e. long for (rightfully or otherwise)

G1938.d:
ἐπιθυμητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐπιθυμέω) [in LXX: Num.11:34 (אָוָה hithp.); εἶναι ἐ., Pro.1:22 (חָמַד)* ;]
one longing for, lustful after: κακῶν, 1Co.10:6.†
(AS)

G1939.d:
ἐπιθυμία, -ας, ἡ
(έπιθυμέω), [in LXX chiefly for תַּאֲוָה, אָוָה; also for חֶמֶד, etc. ;]
desire, longing: Luk.22:15 (see: ἐπιθυμέω), Php.1:23, 1Th.2:17, Rev.18:14; p1., Mrk.4:19; esp. with ref. to forbidden things, desire, lust (Vg., concupiscentia): Rom.7:7-8, Jas.1:14-15, 2Pe.1:4; pl., Gal.5:24, 1Ti.6:9, 2Ti.2:22 4:3, 1Pe.1:14 4:2; πάθος ἐπιθυμίας, 1Th.4:5; ἐ. κακή, Col.3:5; with genitive, μιασμοῦ, 2Pe.2:10 (see Mayor, in l); τ. καρδιῶν, Rom.1:24; τ. κόσμου (aroused by the world), 1Jn.2:17; τ. σώματος, Rom.6:12; τ. ἀπάτης, Eph.4:22 (see ICC, in l); τ. σαρκός, 1Jn.2:16, 2Pe.2:18 (without art.), Gal.5:16; τ. ὀφθαλμῶν, 1Jn.2:16; σαρκικαὶ ἐ., 1Pe.2:11…
G1939.s: a longing (especially for what is forbidden)

G1940.d:
ἐπι-καθ-ίζω
[in LXX for רָכַב, etc. ;]
to sit upon: Mat.21:7.†
(AS)

G1941.d:
ἐπι-καλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
__1. to call, name, surname: with accusative (cl.), Mat.10:25; pass., Act.1:23 4:36 10:5, 18 10:22 11:13 12:12, 25, Heb.11:16; τ. ὄνομα, before ἐπί (denoting possession, as Heb. עַל. . שֻׁם קָרָא), Act.15:17 (LXX), Jas.2:7 (see. CB on Amo.9:12).
__2. Mid. (so also act.; cl., LXX), to call upon, invoke, appeal to (θεόν, θεούς, Hdt., Xen., al.; cf. Deiss., LAE, 426): Καίσαρα (Σεβαστόν, Act.25:25), Act.25:11-12, 21 26:32 28:19; sc. τ. Κύριον Ἰησοῦν, Act.7:59; μάρτυρα (cl.) τ. θεόν, 2Co.1:23; πατέρα, 1Pe.1:17; τ. κύριον, Rom.10:12, 2Ti.2:22; τ. ὄνομα κυρίου (μου, σου; like Heb. יְהוָֹה שֻׁם…
G1941.s: to entitle; by implication, to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.)
G1941.o: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2564 (καλέω);

G1942.d:
ἐπι-κάλυμμα, -τος, τό
(ἐπικαλύπτω), [in LXX: Exo.26:14 39:34, (מְכַסֶּה), 4Ki.17:19 (מָסָךְ), Job.19:29 (aliter in Heb.)* ;]
a cover, veil: metaphorically, τ. κακίας, 1Pe.2:16.†
(AS)

G1943.d:
ἐπι-καλύπτω
[in LXX for כָּסָה, etc. ;]
to cover over, cover up: metaphorically, Rom.4:7 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1944.d:
ἐπι-κατ-άρατος, -ον
(ἐπικαταράομαι, to imprecate curses on), [in LXX for אָרַר, also Wis.3:12 14:8, 4Ma.2:19 ;]
accursed: Gal.3:10 (LXX) Gal.3:13 (LXX κεκαταραμένος) (Cremer, 109).†
(AS)
G1944.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G2672 (καταράομαι);

G1945.d:
ἐπι-κείμαι
[in LXX: Exo.39:31 (נָתַן), Job.19:3 (הָכַר hi.) Job.21:27 (חָמַס), 1Ma.6:57, 2Ma.1:21, 3Ma.1:22 * ;]
to be placed, lie on: Jhn.21:9; before ἐπί, with dative, Jhn.11:38; figuratively, Heb.9:10; ἀνάγκη, 1Co.9:16; χειμῶν, to threaten, come on: Act.27:20; of persons, to press upon: Luk.5:1 23:23.†
(AS)
G1945.k: impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-)on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon

G1946.d:
Ἐπικούριος (Rec. -ειος), -ου, ὁ
an Epicurean, a follower of Epicurus: Act.17:18.†
(AS)
G1946.s: an Epicurean or follower of Epicurus

G1947.d:
ἐπικουρία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπικουρέω to be an ἐπίκουρος, an ally) [in LXX: Wis.13:18 * ;]
aid, assistance: Act.26:22.†
(AS)
G1947.o: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and a (prolonged) form of the base of G2877 (κοράσιον) (in the sense of servant);

G1948.d:
ἐπι-κρίνω
[in LXX: 2Ma.4:47, 3Ma.4:2 * ;]
to decree, give sentence: with accusative and inf., Luk.23:24.†
(AS)

G1949.d:
ἐπι-λαμβάνω
[in LXX for חָזַק hi., אָחַז, etc. ;]
always mid. in LXX and NT (see Cremer, 758), to lap hold of: with genitive of person(s), Mat.14:31, Act.17:19 21:30, 33; with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), Luk.9:47 14:4 23:26 (WH, but see Bl., 1015), Act.9:27 16:9 18:17; with genitive of thing(s), Mrk.8:23, Act.23:10, Heb.8:9" (LXX) ; with genitive of person(s) and of thing(s), Luk.20:20, 26; τ. αἰωνίου (ὄντως) ζωῆς, 1Ti.6:12 6:19. Metaphorical (as in Sir.4:11), Heb.2:16 (see Westc., in l).†
(AS)
G1949.s: to seize (for help, injury, attainment, or any other purpose; literally or figuratively)
G1949.o: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2983 (λαμβάνω);
G1949.k: catch, lay hold (up-)on, take (by, hold of, on)

G1950.d:
ἐπι-λανθάνομαι
(alternative mid, form of ἐπιλήθω, to cause to forget) [in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַח ;]
to forget, neglect: with inf., Mat.16:5, Mrk.8:14; with genitive, Heb.6:10 13:2, 16; with accusative (as occasionally in cl.; MM, Exp., xiv), Php.3:13; ὁποῖος ἦν, Jas.1:24; pass. ptcp. (cf. Isa.23:16, Sir.3:14 23:14, Wis.2:4), Luk.12:6.†
(AS)
G1950.s: to lose out of mind; by implication, to neglect
G1950.o: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G2990 (λανθάνω);

G1951.d:
ἐπι-λέγω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּחַר ;]
__1. to say in addition (Hdt.).
__2. to call by name, to call: Jhn.5:2.
__3. to choose; mid., to choose for oneself: Act.15:40.†
(AS)
G1951.o: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and G3004 (λέγω);

G1952.d:
ἐπι-λείπω
[in LXX: Ob 5 א1 R (שָׁאַר hi.) * ;]
to fail: with accusative of person(s), Heb.11:32.†
(AS)
G1952.s: to leave upon, i.e. (figuratively) to be insufficient for

G1953.d:
ἐπι-λησμονή, -ις, ή
(επιλήθω), [in LXX: Sir.11:27 * ;]
forgetful­ness: ἀκροατὴς ἐ. (genitive of qual.), Jas.1:25.†
(AS)

G1954.d:
ἐπί-λοιπος, -ον
(λοιπός), [in LXX for יָתַר, שָׁאַר ;]
still left, remaining: χρόνος, 1Pe.4:2.†
(AS)

G1955.d:
ἐπί-λυσις -εως, ἡ
(ἐπιλύω), [in Aq.: Gen.40:8; Sm.: Hos.3:4 * ;]
__1. release.
__2. solution, interpretation: 2Pe.1:20.†
(AS)

G1956.d:
ἐπι-λύω
[in Aq.: Gen.40:8 41:8, 12; Th.: Hos.3:4 * ;]
__1. to loose, release.
__2. to solve, settle, explain: Mrk.4:34, Act.19:39.†
(AS)
G1956.s: to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain, decide

G1957.d:
ἐπι-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ
to bear witness to: with accusative and inf., 1Pe.5:12,†
(AS)

G1958.d:
ἐπιμέλεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιμελέομαι), [in LXX: Pro.3:8 (שִׁקּוּי), Wis.13:13, Est.6:10, 1Ma.16:14, al. ;]
attention, care: Act.27:3 (see Field, Notes, 143).†
(AS)

G1959.d:
ἐπι-μελεομαι, -οῦμαι
[in LXX: Gen.44:21 (עַיִן שׂוּם) I Est.6:27, Pro.27:25, Sir.30:25, 1Ma.11:37 * ;]
to take care of: with genitive, Luk.10:34-35, 1Ti.3:5.†
(AS)
G1959.o: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and the same as G3199 (μέλω);

G1960.o: adverb from a derivative of G1959 (ἐπιμελέομαι);

G1961.d:
ἐπι-μένω
[in LXX: Exo.12:39 (מָהַהּ hith.)* ;]
to stay on, tarry or abide still: before έν, 1Co.16:8; αὐτοῦ, there, Act.15:34 (WH, txt., RV, txt., omit) Act.21:4; with dative, τ. σαρκί, Php.1:24; before παρά, with dative of person(s), Act.28:14; πρός, with accusative of person(s), 1Co.16:7, Gal.1:18; with accusative temp., Act.10:48 21:4, 10 28:12, 14, 1Co.16:7. Metaphorical, to continue in a pursuit or state: with dative, τ. ἀμαρτίᾳ, Rom.6:1; τ. ὰπιστίᾳ, Rom.11:23; τ. πίστει, Col.1:23; αὐτοῖς (see CGT, in l), 1Ti.4:16; τ. χρηστότητι, Rom.11:22; with ptcp. (cf. Bl., § 73, 4; 76, 2), Jhn.8:7, Act.12:16.†
(AS)
G1961.s: to stay over, i.e. remain (figuratively, persevere)

G1962.d:
ἐπι-νεύω
[in LXX: Pro.26:24 (נָכַר ni.), 1Ma.6:57, 2Ma.4:10 2Mac 11:15 2Mac 14:20 * ;]
to nod in command or approval, to nod approval, consent: Act.18:20.†
(AS)
G1962.s: to nod at, i.e. (by implication) to assent

G1963.d:
ἐπίνοια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπινοέω, to contrive) [in LXX: Jer.20:10, Wis.6:16 9:14 14:12 15:4, Sir.40:2, 2Ma.12:45, 4Ma.17:2 * ;]
a thought, design: Act.8:22.†
(AS)
G1963.s: attention of the mind, i.e. (by implication) purpose

G1964.d:
ἐπιορκέω, -ῶ
(ἐπίορκος), [in LXX: I Est.1:48, Wis.14:28 * ;]
to swear falsely, forswear oneself: Mat.5:33.†
(AS)

G1965.d:
ἐπί-ορκος, -ον
[in LXX: Zec.5:3 (שָׁבַע ni.) * ;]
__1. of oaths, sworn falsely.
__2. Of persons, perjured; as subst., a perjurer, false swearer: 1Ti.1:10.†
(AS)

G1966.d:
ἔπ-ειμι
[in LXX: Exo.8:22 (עָמַד), Sir.42:19, etc. ;]
__1. to come upon, approach
__2. Of time, to come on or after; mostly as ptcp., ἐπιών, -οῦσα, όν, next, following: τῇ- ἔ. (sc.ἡμέρᾳ, as frequently in late Gk.), Act.16:11 20:15 21:18; ἡμέρᾳ (as usual in cl.), Act.7:26; νυκτί, Act.23:11.†
(AS)
G1966.s: supervening, i.e. (G2250 (ἡμέρα) or G3571 (νύξ) being expressed or implied) the ensuing day or night
G1966.o: feminine singular participle of a comparative of G1909 (ἐπί) and (to go);

G1967.d:
ἐπιούσιος, -ον
(cf. περιούσιος, [in LXX for סְגֻלָּה, etc.]),
found only in the phrase ἄρτος ἐ., EV, daily; R, mg., for the coming day: Mat.6:11, Luk.11:3. (Several derivations find support, each pointing to a different meaning.
__1. ἐπιοῦσα (sc. ἡμέρα) (or, ἐπὶ τὴν ἰοῦσαν (sc. ήμέραν), Zorell, see word), hence, for the morrow or for the coming day (R, mg.).
__2. (a) ἐπί + οὐσία, hence, for subsistence, needful (Am. R, mg.);
__(b) ἐπί + εἶναι in fern. ptcp. form, hence, pertaining to (the day). For renderings of versions and views of various writers, see reff. in DB, ext., 36 f.; DCG, ii, 58 f., 62a; ICC on Lk, l.with The EV,…
G1967.s: tomorrow's; but more probably from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of the present participle feminine of G1510 (εἰμί); for subsistence, i.e. needful
G1967.o: perhaps from the same as G1966 (ἐπιοῦσα);

G1968.d:
ἐπι-πίπτω
[in LXX chiefly for נָפַל ;]
to fall upon (Field, Notes, 25): with dative of person(s), Mrk.3:10 (see Swete, in l), Act.20:10; before ἐπὶ τ. τράχηλον (as Gen.46:29, Tob.11:8, 3Ma.5:49, al.), Luk.15:20, Act.20:37. Metaphorical, φόβος, Luk.1:12, Act.19:17, Rev.11:11; ὀνειδισμοί, Rom.15:3 (LXX); of the Holy Spirit: before ἐπί, with dative, Act.8:16; ἐπί, with accusative, Act.10:44 11:15; absol., Act.23:7.†
(AS)
G1968.s: to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or less violence; literally or figuratively)
G1968.k: fall into (on, upon) lie on, press upon

G1969.d:
ἐπι-πλήσσω
__1. to strike at, to punish.
__2. to rebuke, reprove: 1Ti.5:1.†
(AS)
G1969.s: to chastise, i.e. (with words) to upbraid

G1970.d: - to throttle upon, i.e. (figuratively) overgrowhoke, stifle

G1971.d:
ἐπι-ποθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for יָאַב, אָרַג, כָּסַף hi., etc. ;]
to long for, desire: with inf., Rom.1:11, 2Co.5:2, 1Th.3:6, 2Ti.1:4, Php.2:26 (WH, [txt.]); with accusative of thing(s), 1Pe.2:2; with accusative of person(s), 2Co.9:14, Php.1:8 2:26 (WH, mg); absol., Jas.4:5 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)
G1971.s: to dote upon, i.e. intensely crave possession (lawfully or wrongfully)

G1973.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of the latter part of G1971 (ἐπιποθέω);

G1975.d:
ἐπι-πορεύομαι
[in LXX: Lev.26:33 (אָחַר), Eze.39:14 (עָבַר), Ep. Jer.6:2, 2Ma.2:28, 3Ma.1:4 * ;]
to travel, journey to: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Luk.8:4.†
(AS)
G1975.s: to journey further, i.e. travel on (reach)

G1976.d:
ἐπι-ράπτω (Rec. -ρράπτω),
to sew upon: before ἐπί, with accusative, Mrk.2:21.†
(AS)
G1976.s: to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the needle
G1976.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G4476 (ῥαφίς);

G1977.d:
ἐπι-ρίπτω
(Rec. -ρρίπτω, as in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַךְ hi. ;]
__1. to cast at.
__2. to cast or place upon: with accusative before ἐπί, with accusative, Luk.19:35; metaphorically, τ. μέριμναν, 1Pe.5:7 (LXX).†
(AS)

G1978.d:
ἐπίσημος, -ον
(σῆμα, a mark), [in LXX: Gen.30:42 (קָשַׁר), Est.5:4 8:13, 1Ma.11:37 1Mac 14:48, 2Ma.15:36, 3Ma.6:1 * ;]
__1. bearing a mark; of money, stamped, coined.
__2. Metaphorical,
__(a) in good sense, notable, illustrious: Rom.16:7;
__(b) in bad sense, notorious: Mat.27:16.†
(AS)
G1978.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and some form of the base of G4591 (σημαίνω);

G1979.d:
ἐπισιτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ἐπισιτίζομαι, to supply with provisions), [in LXX: Gen.42:25, al. (צֵידָה), Jdth.2:18 4:5 ;]
__1. a foraging.
__2. provisions, food: Luk.9:12.†
(AS)
G1979.o: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G4621 (σῖτος);

G1980.d:
ἐπι-σκέπτομαι
(late form of ἐπισκοπέω, which see), [in LXX very freq., chiefly for פָּקַד ;]
__1. to inspect, examine.
__2. (a) to visit: with accusative, Act.7:23 15:36 (cf. Jdg.15:1); especially, the sick and afflicted (as in MGr. and sometimes in cl.), Mat.25:36, 43, Jas.1:27 (cf. Sir.7:35);
__(b) in LXX and NT (as פָּקַד in Gen.21:1, Exo.4:31, Psa.8:5, al.), to visit with help, to care for: Luk.1:68, 78 7:16, Act.15:14, Heb.2:6;
__(with) to visit with punishment (Jer.9:25, Psa.89:33, al.; cf. MM, Exp., xiv; Cremer, 863).†
(AS)
G1980.s: to inspect, i.e. (by implication) to select; by extension, to go to see, relieve
G1980.o: middle voice from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G4649 (σκοπός);

G1981.d:
ἐπι-σκηνόω, -ῶ
to tent upon, spread a tabernacle over: metaphorically, before ἐπ᾽ ἐμέ (RV, rest upon, cover), 2Co.12:9.†
(AS)
G1981.s: to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with

G1982.d:
ἐπι-σκιάζω
[in LXX: Exo.40:35 (שָׁכַן), Psa.91:4 140:7 (סָכַךְ), Pro.18:11 * ;]
to throw a shadow upon, overshadow: with dative, Act.5:15; of a shining (Mt, l.with, and cf. Exo.40:29, 35, 2Ma.2:8) cloud, with dative, Mrk.9:7; with accusative, Mat.17:5, Luk.9:34; metaphorically (cf. Pss, Pr, ll.with), of the Holy Spirit, Luk.1:35.†
(AS)
G1982.s: to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest with preternatural influence
G1982.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G4639 (σκιά);

G1983.d:
ἐπι-σκοπέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for פָּקַד ni., etc. ;]
__1. to look upon, observe, examine: before μή, Heb.12:16.
__2. As ἐπισκέπτομαι in LXX, NT, to visit, care for: 1Pe.5:2 (R, txt.; WH cm.; Cremer, 527).†
(AS)
G1983.s: to oversee; by implication, to beware

G1984.d:
ἐπι-σκοπή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiey for פָּקַד פְּקֻדָּה ;]
__1. a visiting, visitation (εἰς ἐ. τοῦ παιδός, Lucian, dial. deor., 20, 6); as in LXX (after Heb.), of God's visitation in mercy, or in judgment (Lev.19:20 Job.10:12, Jer.6:15, Wis.2:20, al.): Luk.19:44, 1Pe.2:12 (see Hort, in l).
__2. office, charge, esp. office of an ἐπίσκοιος (which see): Act.1:20 (LXX), 1Ti.3:1 (Cremer, 527 f., 864; DCG, ii, 809b).†
(AS)
G1984.s: inspection (for relief); by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian "episcopate"
G1984.k: the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation

G1985.d:
ἐπί-σκοπος, -ου, ὁ
(σκοπός, a watcher), [in LXX for פָּקַד, its parts and derivatives, Num.4:16 31:14, Jdg.9:28, 4Ki.11:15 11:18, 2Ch.34:12 34:17, Neh.11:9, 14 11:22; אֵל, Job.20:29; נָגַשׂ:, Isa.60:17; Wis.1:6, 1Ma.1:51 * ;]
a superintendent, guardian, overseer (cl.; for exx. see LS, see word): Act.20:28, 1Pe.2:25 (ICC, in l); as technical term for a religious office (Deiss., BS, 230 f.), in later Paul. epp. of the head of a church (Vg. episcopus), a bishop: Php.1:1, 1Ti.3:2, Tit.1:7 (see reff. see word ἐπισκοπή).†
(AS)
G1985.s: a superintendent, i.e. Christian officer in genitive case charge of a (or the) church (literally or figuratively)
G1985.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and G4649 (σκοπός) (in the sense of G1983 (ἐπισκοπέω));

G1986.d:
ἐπι-σπάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Isa.5:18 (מָשַׁךְ), etc. ;]
to draw on: mid., in peculiar sense of effacing signs of Judaism (cf. 1Ma.1:15, FlJ, Ant., xii, 5, i; see Thayer, see word), to become as uncircumcised: 1Co.7:18.†
(AS)
G1986.s: to draw over, i.e. (with G203 (ἀκροβυστία) implied) efface the mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin)

G1987.d:
ἐπίσταμαι
(prob. an old mid, of ἐφίστημι, which see), [in LXX chiefly for יָדַע ;]
to know, know of, understand: with accusative of person(s), Act.19:15; with ptcp., Act.24:10; with accusative of thing(s), Mrk.14:68, Act.18:25, 1Ti.6:4, Jas.4:14, Ju 10; before περί, Act.26:26; ὅτι, Act.15:7 19:25 22:19; ὡς, Act.10:28; πῶς, Act.20:18; ποῦ, Heb.11:8.†
SYN: γινώσκω (which see), οἶδα
(AS)
G1987.s: to put the mind upon, i.e. comprehend, or be acquainted with
G1987.o: apparently a middle voice of G2186 (ἐφίστημι) (with G3563 (νοῦς) implied);

G1988.d:
ἐπιστάτης, -ου, ό
(ἐφίστημι), [in LXX: 4Ki.25:19, Jer.29:26 52:25 (פָּקִיד), 2Ch.31:12 (נָגִיד), 2Ma.5:22, etc. ;]
a chief, commander, master: Luk.5:5 8:24, 45 9:33, 49 17:13 (cf. Dalman, Words, 336 ff.).†
(AS)
G1988.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a presumed derivative of G2476 (ἵστημι);

G1989.d:
ἐπι-στέλλω
[in LXX: 3Ki.5:8 Neh.6:19 (שָׁלַח), Jdth.15:4, 1Ma.10:25 1Mac 12:7 1Mac 13:18 (in each case with seel. ἀποσ-) * ;]
__1. to send to.
__2. to send a message by letter, to write word (MM, Exp., xiv): with dative of person(s), Act.21:25, Heb.13:22; before τοῦ, with inf., Act.15:20.†
(AS)
G1989.s: to enjoin (by writing), i.e. (genitive case) to communicate by letter (for any purpose)

G1990.d:
ἐπιστήμων, -ον, genitive, -ονoς
(ἐπίσταμαι) [in LXX: Deu.1:13 4:6, Isa.5:21 (בִּין ni.), I Est.8:44, Sir.10:25 21:15, etc. ;]
knowing, skilled: Jas.3:13.†
(AS)

G1991.d:
ἐπι-στηρίζω
[in LXX for סָמַךְ, etc. ;]
to make stronger, confirm: with accusative, Act.14:22 15:32, 41.†
(AS)

G1992.d:
ἐπι-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιατέλλω), [in LXX for אִגֶּרֶת, etc.; frequently in Mac ;]
__1. a message.
__2. a letter, an epistle: Act.9:2, 1Co.5:9, al.; pl., Act.22:5, 1Co.16:3, al.; ἐ. σνστατικαί, 2Co.3:1 (cf. Milligan, NTD, 254 f.). (On the NT ἐπιστολαί, cf. Milligan, Th., 121 ff.; NTD, 85 ff.; Deiss., BS, 3 ff.; St. Paul, 8 ff.)
(AS)

G1993.d:
ἐπι-στομίζω
(στόμα),
to bridle; metaphorically, to stop the mouth, to silence: Tit.1:11.†
(AS)
G1993.s: to put something over the mouth, i.e. (figuratively) to silence

G1994.d:
ἐπι-στρέφω
[very frequently in LXX, chiefly for שׁוּב, in its various senses, also for פָּנָה, etc. ;]
__1. trans., to turn about, round or towards, hence metaphorically, to turn, cause to return (to God, virtue, etc.): Luk.1:16-17 (cf. Mal.3:24), Jas.5:19-20.
__2. Intrans.,
__(a) to turn, turn oneself around: Act.16:18; with inf., Rev.1:12; before πρός, Act.9:40; so also pass. (cl.), Mrk.5:30 8:33, Jhn.21:20; metaphorically, of turning to God (see Field, Notes, 246 ff.), ἐπὶ τ. κύριον (θεόν), Act.9:35 11:21 14:15 15:19 26:20; πρὸς τ. θεόν, 1Th.1:9, 2Co.3:16; ἀπὸ σκότους εἰς φῶς, Act.26:18; pass., 1Pe.2:25;
__(b) to return (as in…

G1995.d:
ἐπι-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιστρέφω) [in LXX: Eze.47:7 (שׁוּב), Sir.18:21 49:2, etc. ;]
a turning about; metaphorically, conversion (Field, Notes, 246): Act.15:3.†
(AS)

G1996.d:
ἐπι-συν-άγω
[in LXX for אָסַף, קָבַץ, etc. (Cremer, 65) ;]
__1. to gather together: Mat.23:37 24:31, Mrk.13:27, Luk.13:34; pass., Mrk.1:33, Luk.12:1 17:37, (cf. Psa.102:23 106:47, 2Ma.1:27, al.).
__2. to gather together against (Mic.4:11, Zec.12:3, 1Ma.3:58, al.).†
(AS)
G1996.s: to collect upon the same place

G1997.d:
ἐπι-συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπισυνάγω), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:7 * ;]
a gathering together, assembly: Heb.10:25; before ἐπί, 2Th.2:1 (cf. 2Mac, l.with).†
(AS)
G1997.s: a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for worship)

G1998.d:
ἐπι-συν-τρέχω
to run together again: Mrk.9:25 (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)
G1998.s: to hasten together upon one place (or a particular occasion)

G1999.d:
ἐπι-σύστασις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐπισυνίστημι) [in LXX: Num.16:40 (עֵדָה) Num.26:9 (נָצָה hi.), I Est.5:73 A* ;]
a gathering, a riotous throng: Rec. (for ἐπίστασις, which see), Act.24:12, 2Co.11:28.†
(AS)
G1999.s: a conspiracy, i.e. concourse (riotous or friendly)
G1999.o: from the middle voice of a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G4921 (συνιστάω);
G1999.k: that which cometh upon, + raising up

G2000.d:
ἐπισφαλής, -ές
(σφάλλω, to cause to full), [in LXX: Wis.9:14 (cf. -ῶς, Wis.4:4) * ;]
__1. prone to fall (Plat.).
__2. dangerous (Hipp., Plut., al.): Act.27:9.†
(AS)
G2000.o: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and (to trip);

G2001.d:
ἐπ-ισχύω
[in LXX: Sir.29:1, 1Ma.6:6 * ;]
__1. to make stronger (Sir, l.with).
__2. to grow stronger; metaphorically, be more urgent: Luk.23:5.†
(AS)
G2001.s: to avail further, i.e. (figuratively) insist stoutly

G2002.d:
ἐπι-σωρεύω
[in Sm.: Job.14:17, Sng.2:4 * ;]
to heap together; metaphorically, διδασκάλους, 2Ti.4:3.†
(AS)
G2002.s: to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek additionally

G2003.d:
ἐπι-ταγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιτάσσω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 3:16 (פִּתְגָּם), I Est.1:18, Wis.14:16 18:16 19:6, 3Ma.7:20 * ;]
= cl., ἐπίταγμα,
a command, Rom.16:26, 1Co.7:6 7:25, 2Co.8:8, 1Ti.1:1, Tit.1:3 (for use in Inscr. of divine commands, see MM, Exp., xiv); μετὰ πάσης ἐ, with all authority: Tit.2:15.†
(AS)
G2003.s: an injunction or decree; by implication, authoritativeness

G2004.d:
ἐπι-τάσσω
[in LXX for אָמַר, צָוָה, etc. ;]
to command, charge: with accusative of thing(s), Luk.14:22; with dative of person(s), Mrk.1:27 9:25, Luk.4:36 8:25; id. with accusative of thing(s), Phm 8; id. with inf., Mrk.6:39, Luk.8:31, Act.23:2; id. with imperat., Mrk.9:25; with accusative and inf., Mrk.6:27.†
SYN.: κελεύω (AS)

G2005.d:
ἐπι-τελέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for כָּלָה, עָשָׂה, etc. ;]
to complete, accomplish, execute: with accusative of thing(s), Rom.15:28, 2Co.7:1 8:6 8:11, Php.1:6, Heb.8:5; of religious services (cf. Hdt., ii, 37, al.), Heb.9:6; art. inf., 2Co.8:11. Mid.,
__(a) to complete for oneself, make an end (R, mg.; pass., R, txt; cf. Meyer, in l): Gal.3:3;
__(b) to pay in full, pay the tax, be subject to: with accusative (cf. Xen., Mem., iv, 8, 8), 1Pe.5:9 (pass., RV, etc.; cf. Thayer, see word; ICC, in 1).†
(AS)
G2005.s: to fulfill further (or completely), i.e. execute; by implication, to terminate, undergo

G2006.d:
ἐπιτήδειος, -α, -ον
[in LXX: 1Ch.28:2, Wis.4:5, 1Ma.4:46, al. ;]
__1. suitable, convenient,
__2. useful, necessary: τὰ ἐ., necessaries, Jas.2:16,†
(AS)

G2007.d:
ἐπι-τίθημι
[in LXX for נָתַן, שָׁוָה, etc. ;]
__1. to lay, set or place upon: with accusative of thing(s), before ἐπί, with accusative of thing(s), Mat.23:4, Luk.15:5, Jhn.9:6 (WH, txt. Jhn.9:15), Act.15:10 28:3; ἐπί, with genitive of thing(s), Mat.27:29; ἐν, ib.; with dative of person(s), σταυρόν, Luk.23:26; στέφανον, Jhn.19:2; ὄνομα, Mrk.3:16-17; πληγάς, Luk.10:30, Act.16:23; ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Rev.22:18; of the laying on of hands, τ. χεῖρα (-ας), before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), Mat.9:18, Mrk.16:13, Act.8:17 9:17; with dative of person(s), Mat.19:13, 15, Mrk.5:23 6:5 7:32 8:23, Luk.4:40 13:13, Act.6:6 8:19 9:12 13:3 19:6 28:8, 1Ti.5:22.…
G2007.s: to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense)
G2007.k: add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, X wound

G2008.d:
ἐπι-τιμάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for גָּעַר, Gen.37:10, Psa.9:5, Zec.3:2; Sir.11:7, al. ;]
__1. to honour.
__2. to raise in price
__3. to mete out due measure;
__(a) to award;
__(b) to censure, rebuke, admonish: absol., 2Ti.4:2; with dative, Mat.8:26 17:13 19:13, Mrk.4:39 8:32 10:13, Luk.4:39, 41 8:24 9:21, 42 9:55 17:3 18:15 19:39, Ju 9; before ἵνα, Mat.12:16 16:20 20:31, Mrk.3:12 8:30 10:48, Luk.18:39; before λέγων, λέγει, etc., Mat.16:22, Mrk.1:25 8:33 9:25, Luk.4:35 23:40.†
SYN.: ἐλέγχω, q.v (AS)
G2008.s: to tax upon, i.e. censure or admonish; by implication, forbid

G2009.d:
ἐπιτιμία, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιτιμάω), [in LXX: Wis_3:10 * ;]
__1. citizenship, franchise.
__2. As in Inscr. (LS, see word), LXX, l.with (= cl. τὸ ἐπιτίμιον), punishment, penalty: 2Co.2:6.†
(AS)
G2009.s: properly, esteem, i.e. citizenship; used (in the sense of G2008 (ἐπιτιμάω)) of a penalty
G2009.o: from a compound of G1909 (ἐπί) and G5092 (τιμή);

G2010.d:
ἐπι-τρέπω
[in LXX (usually with seel. ἐπιστρ-): Gen.39:6 (עָזַב), etc. ;]
__1. to turn to, commit, entrust.
__2. to yield, permit: 1Co.16:7, Heb.6:3; with dative of person(s), Mrk.5:13, Jhn.19:38; id. with inf. (cf. M, Pr., 205), Mat.8:21 19:8, Luk.8:32 9:52, 61 Act.21:39-40 27:3, 1Ti.2:12; with inf., Mrk.10:4. Pass., with dative and inf., Act.26:1 28:16, 1Co.14:34.†
(AS)
G2010.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);
G2010.k: give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer

G2011.d:
ἐπι-τροπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX: 2Ma.13:14 * ;]
power to decide, authority: Act.26:12.†
(AS)

G2012.d:
ἐπίτροπος, -ου, ὁ
(ἐπιτρέπω), [in LXX: 2Ma.11:1 2Mac 13:2 2Mac 14:2 * ;]
__1. an administrator, a steward: Mat.20:3, Luk.8:3.
__2. a guardian (with genitive of person(s), 2Mac, ll. with): Gal.4:2.†
(AS)
G2012.s: a commissioner, i.e. domestic manager, guardian
G2012.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and G5158 (τρόπος) (in the sense of G2011 (ἐπιτροπή));

G2013.d:
ἐπι-τυγχάνω
[in LXX: Gen.39:2 (צָלַח hi.), Pro.12:27 (חָרַךְ)* ;]
__1. to light upon.
__2. to obtain, attain to: Jas.4:2, with genitive of thing(s) (as in cl.), Heb.6:15 11:33; with accusative (late Gk.), Rom.11:7 (Rec. τούτου).†
(AS)
G2013.s: to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to attain

G2014.d:
ἐπι-φαίνω
[in LXX for עוּר hi., etc. ;]
__1. to show forth.
__2. (= pass. in cl.) to appear: Act.27:20; with dative of person(s), Luk.1:79; metaphorically, Tit.3:4; with dative, Tit.2:11 (Cremer, 567).†
(AS)
G2014.s: to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or (figuratively) known

G2015.d:
ἐπιφάνεια, -ας, ἡ
(ἐπιφανής), [in LXX: 2Ki.7:23 (יָרֵא), Est.5:1, Amo.5:22, 2Ma.2:21 2Mac 3:24 2Mac 5:4 2Mac 12:22 2Mac 14:16 2Mac 15:27, 3Ma.2:9 3Mac 5:8 3Mac 5:51,* ;] (in late Gk. and Inscr., frequently of deities, see MM, Exp., xiv)
a manifestation, appear­ance: 2Th.2:8, 1Ti.6:14, 2Ti.1:10 4:1 4:8, Tit.2:13 (cf. M, Th., 148 f.).†
(AS)
G2015.s: a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future)

G2016.d:
ἐπιφανής, -ές
(ἐπιφαίνω), [in LXX (see Thayer, see word) for יָרֵא, etc., Jdg.13:6, Jol.2:11, 31 al.; 2Ma.6:23, 3Ma.5:35, al. ;]
renowned, illustrious, notable: Act.2:20 (LXX) (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G2017.d:
ἐπι-φαύσκω
(variant form of ἐπιφώσκω, which see), [in LXX: Job.25:5 (אהל hi.) Job.31:26 41:18 (הָלַל hi.) * ;]
to shine forth: figuratively, with dative, Eph.5:14 (on seel. -ψαύσει, see ICC, Westc., AR, in l).†
(AS)

G2018.d:
ἐπι-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁלַח ;]
__1. to bring upon or against: κρίσιν, Ju 9.
__2. to impose, inflict: Rom.3:5.†
(AS)
G2018.s: to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce

G2019.d:
ἐπι-φωνέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: I Est.9:47 AR, 2Ma.1:23, 3Ma.7:13 * ;]
to call out, shout: with accusative of thing(s), Act.21:34; with dative of person(s), Act.22:24; before λέγοντες, Luk.23:21; prat. rect., Act.12:22.†
(AS)
G2019.s: to call at something, i.e. exclaim

G2020.d:
ἐπι-φώσκω
[in LXX for הָלַל hi., Job.41:18 A (Βא, ἐπιφαύσκ-) * ;]
__1. to let shine.
__2. to dawn (cf. MM, Exp., xiv): Luk.23:54; before εἰς, Mat_28:1.†
(AS)
G2020.k: begin to dawn, X draw on

G2021.d:
ἐπιχειρέω, -ῶ
(χεῖρ), [in LXX for חָשַׁב, Exo.9:25; גָּמַל, 2Ch.20:11, al. ;]
__1. to pat one's hand to.
__2. to take in hand, attempt: with inf., Luk.1:1, Act.9:29 19:13.†
(AS)
G2021.s: to put the hand upon, i.e. undertake

G2022.d:
ἐπι-χέω
[in LXX chiefly for יָצַק. Gen.28:18, al. ;]
to pour upon: Luk.10:34.†
(AS)

G2023.d:
ἐπι-χορηγέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sir.25:22, 2Ma.4:9 A * ;]
to supply, provide: with accusative of thing(s), 2Pe.1:5; id. with dative of person(s), 2Co.9:10, Gal.3:5; pass., Col.2:19, 2Pe.1:11 (cf. χορηγέω, and see MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)
G2023.s: to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply, (figuratively) aid or contribute

G2025.d:
ἐπι-χρίω
[in Sm.: Eze.13:10 22:28 * ;]
to spread on, anoint: with accusative, Jhn.9:11; id. before hi-I, with accusative, Jhn.9:6 (cf. MM, Exp., xiv).†
(AS)

G2026.d:
ἐπ-οικοδομέω, -ῶ
in NT, always metaphorically, of the spiritual life regarded as a building (Cremer, 449);
__1. to build upon: 1Co.3:10 3:12 3:14; pass., Eph.2:20.
__2. to build up: Col.2:7, 1Pe.2:5 (T, οἰκοδ- WH, Rec.), Ju 20.†
(AS)
G2026.s: to build upon, i.e. (figuratively) to rear up

G2027.d:
ἐπι-κέλλω
of a ship, to run ashore: with accusative, Act.27:41.†
(AS)
G2027.s: to drive upon the shore, i.e. to beach a vessel

G2028.d:
ἐπ-ονομάζω
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to name, call by a name, surname: pass., Rom.2:17.†
(AS)

G2029.d:
ἐπ-οπτεύω
[in Sm.: Psa.10:14 33:13 * ;]
to watch (in Hom., as an overseer; cf Ps, ll. with), look upon: 1Pe.2:12 3:2.†
(AS)
G2029.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);

G2030.d:
ἐπόπτης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX (of God): Est.5:1, 2Ma.3:39 2Mac 7:35, 3Ma.2:21 * ;]
__1. an overseer (LXX, ll. with).
__2. a spectator: 2Pe.1:16 (of ἐ. as applied to God, see parallels in Inscr., MM, Exp., xiv; of the use of this term in the mysteries, see Mayor on 2Pe, l.with; Thayer, see word).†
(AS)
G2030.o: from G1909 (ἐπί) and a presumed derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);

G2031.d:
ἔπος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX: Zec.7:3, Sir.44:5 * ;]
a word: ὡς ἔ. εἰπεῖν (cl.), so to speak: Heb.7:9.†
SYN.: λόγος, reasoned speech; ῥῆμα, mere articulated utterance; ἔ., the articulated expression of a thought (AS)

G2032.d:
ἐπουράνιος, -ον
(οὐρανός), [in LXX: Psa.68:14 (שַׁדַּי), DA TH Dan.4:23 A (שָׁמַיִם) 2Ma.3:39, 3Ma.6:28 3Mac 7:6, 4Ma.4:11 AR, 4Ma.11:3 א* ;]
in or of heaven, heavenly (in Hom., of the Gods): οἱ ἐ., opposite to ἐπίγειοι and καταχθόνιοι, Php.2:10; to χοϊκός, 1Co.15:48-49; σώματα (see Lft., Col., 376), 1Co.15:40; βασιλεία, 2Ti.4:18; παπρίς, Heb.11:16; Ἱερουσαλήμ, Heb.12:22; κλῆσις (cf. Lft. on Php.3:14), Heb.3:1; τὰ ἐ., Heb.8:5 9:23; opposite to ἐπίγειος, Jhn.3:12; id., of the heavenly regions, Eph.1:3, 20 2:6 3:10 6:12; ἡ δωρεὰ ἡ ἐ., Heb.6:4 (Cremer, 468).†
(AS)

G2033.d:
ἐπτά, οἱ, αἱ, τά
indecl.,
seven: Mat.12:45 18:22 (cf. ἑβδομηκοντάκις), Mrk.8:5, al.; οἱ ἐ, Act.21:8
(AS)

G2036.d:
εἶπον, 2 aorist of obsolete present ἔπω (cf. Veitch), used as aorist of λέγω, which see
(AS)
G2036.s: to speak or say (by word or writing)
G2036.o: a primary verb (used only in the definite past tense, the others being borrowed from G2046 (ἐρέω), G4483 (ῥέω), and G5346 (φημί));
G2036.k: answer, bid, bring word, call, command, grant, say (on), speak, tell

G2037.d:
Ἐραστος, -ου, ὁ
Erastus;
__1. a companion of St. Paul, Act.19:22, and prob. 2Ti.4:20.
__2. The treasurer of Corinth, Rom.16:23.†
(AS)

G2038.d:
ἐργάζομαι
(ἔργον), [in LXX for עָבַד, פָּעַל, עָשָׂה, etc. ;]
__1. intrans.,
__(a) to work, labour: Mat.21:28, Luk.13:14, Jhn.5:17 9:4 b, Act.18:3, 1Co.9:6, 2Th.3:10-12; τ. χερσίν, 1Co.4:12, 1Th.4:11; νυκτὸς κ. ἡαέρας, 1Th.2:9, 2Th.3:8; of working for pay, Mat.21:28; for reward, Rom.4:4-5;
__(b) to work at a trade or business, to trade: before Iv (Dem.), Mat.25:16.
__2. Trans.,
__(a) to work, work out, do, produce, perform: with accusative, 2Co.7:10, Col.3:23, 2Th.3:11, Jas.1:20, 2Jn.8, before εἰς, III Jn 5; ἔργον, Act.13:41 (LXX); id. before εἰς, Mat.26:10; ἐν, Mrk.14:6; ἔργα, Jhn.3:21; τὰ ἔ. τ. θεοῦ, Jhn.6:28 9:4; τὸ ἔ. κυρίου,…
G2038.s: to toil (as a task, occupation, etc.), (by implication) effect, be engaged in or with, etc.
G2038.k: commit, do, labor for, minister about, trade (by), work

G2039.d:
ἐργασία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔργον), [in LXX for מְלָאכָה, עֲבֹדָה, etc. ;]
__1. work, business: Act.16:16, 19 19:24-25; δὸς ἐ. (Lat. da operam), Luk.12:58.
__2. working, performance: Eph.4:19.†
(AS)

G2040.d:
ἐργάτης, -ου, ὁ
(ἐργάζομαι, which see), [in LXX: Wis.17:17, Sir.19:1 40:18, 1Ma.3:6 * ;]
__1. prop., a field labourer, husbandman: Mat.9:37-38 20:1-2, 8, Luk.10:2, Jas.5:4 (cf. Wis, l.with).
__2. Generally, a workman, labourer: Mat.10:10, Luk.10:7, Act.19:25 (opposite to τεχνίτης), 1Ti.5:18; of Christian teachers, 2Co.11:13, Php.3:2, 2Ti.2:15.
__3. a worker, doer: τ. ἀδικίας, Luk.13:27 (cf. 1Mac, l.with).†
(AS)

G2041.d:
ἔργον, -ου, τό (originally Ϝέργον, work), [very frequently in LXX, chiefly for מַשֶׂה, מְלָאכָה, also for עֲבֹדָה, פֹּעַל, etc. ;]
__1. work, task, employment: Mrk.13:34, Jhn.4:34 17:4, Act.13:2, Php.1:22 2:30, 1Th.5:13, al.; of an enterprise or undertaking (Deu.15:10, Wis.2:12), Act.5:38.
__2. a deed, action: Tit.1:16, Jas.1:25 . listing, from λόγος, Luk.24:19, Rom.15:18, 2Th.2:17, 1Jn.3:18; ἐν λόγοις κ. ἔ., Act.7:22; of acts of God, Jhn.9:3, Act.13:41" (LXX), Heb.4:10, Rev.15:3; of Christ, Mat.11:2; esp. in Jo, e.g. 5:20, 36 7:3 10:38 14:11, 12 15:24; in ethical sense, of human actions (AR, Eph., 190), bad or good, Mat.23:3, Luk.11:48,…
G2041.s: toil (as an effort or occupation); by implication, an act

G2042.d:
ἐρεθίζω
[in LXX: Dan LXX 11:10, 25 (גָּרָה hithp.), 1Ma.15:40, 2Ma.14:17, etc. ;]
__1. to stir up, provoke (as in cl.): Col.3:21.
__2. In good sense (cf. ἐρεθισμός, excitement, in MGr.), to stir up, stimulate: 2Co.9:2.†
(AS)
G2042.o: from a presumed prolonged form of G2054 (ἔρις);

G2043.d:
ἐρείδω
(chiefly in poets and late prose for ἐρυγγάνω), [in LXX for תָּמַךְ (Pro.4:4 5:5 11:16, al.), etc. ;]
to prop, fix firmly: act., as mid., ἐρείσασα, of a ship driving ashore (RV, struck), Act.27:41.†
(AS)

G2044.d:
ἐρεύγομαι
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַג, Hos.11:10, Amo.3:4, 8 al.; also for נָבַע, Psa.19:2, etc. ;]
__1. to spit or spue out.
__2. Prop., of oxen (Hom.), to bellow, roar; whence, as in LXX, to speak aloud, utter: Mat.13:35 (LXX). (For other examples of softened force of words in late Gk., cf. σκύλλω, τρώγω, χορτάζω.) †
(AS)
G2044.s: to belch, i.e. (figuratively) to speak out

G2045.d:
ἐραυνάω, -ῶ late form of ἐρευνάω (Rec., ll. with; cf. Bl., § 6, 1; M, Pr., 46),
[in LXX, ἐρευν- (exc. 1Ch.19:3 A), for חָפַשׂ pi., חָקַר, etc. ;]
to search, examine: Jhn.7:52; with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.5:39, Rom.8:27, 1Co.2:10, Rev.2:23; before orat. obliq., 1Pe.1:11.†
SYN.: see: ἐξετάζω (AS)
G2045.o: apparently from G2046 (ἐρέω) (through the idea of inquiry);

G2046.d:
λέγω,
[in LXX very freq., chiefly for אמר; λέγει for נְאֻם, Gen.22:16, al. ;]
__1. in Hom., to pick out, gather, reckon, recount.
__2. In Hdt. and Att., to say, speak, affirm, declare: absol., Act.13:15, 24:10; before orat. dir., Mat.9:34, Mrk.3:11, Jhn.1:29, al.; before ὅτι recit., Mrk.3:21, Luk.1:24, Jhn.6:14, al.; accusative and inf., Luk.11:18, Jhn.12:29, al.; after another verb of speaking, προσφωνεῖν κ. λέγειν, Mat.11:17, al.; ἀπεκρίθη (ἐλάλησεν) λέγων (καὶ λέγει; Dalman, Words, 24 ff.), Mat.25:9, Mrk.3:33, 7:28, Luk.24:6, 7, al.; of unspoken thought, λ. ἐν ἑαυτῷ, Mat.3:9, Luk.3:8, al.; of writing, 2Co.8:8, Php.4:11, al.; λέγει ἡ γραφή,…
G2046.s: an alternate for G2036 (ἔπω) in certain tenses; to utter, i.e. speak or say
G2046.o: probably a fuller form of G4483 (ῥέω);

G2047.d:
ἐρημία, -ας, ἡ
(ἔρημος), [in LXX: Isa.60:20, Eze.35:4 (חָרַב, חׇרְבָּה), Eze.35:9 (שְׁמָמָה), Wis.17:17, Sir.47:17, Bar.4:33, 4Ma.18:8 * ;]
a solitude, wilderness: Mat.15:33, Mrk.8:4, 2Co.11:26, Heb.11:38.†
(AS)

G2048.d:
ἔρημος
(in older Gk. ἔρῆμος), -ον [in LXX chiefly for מִדְבָּר ;]
solitary, lonely, desolate, deserted:
__(a) of persons, γυνή, Gal.4:27 (LXX);
__(b) of places, Mat.14:13, 15 23:38 (WH, om.), Mrk.1:36 6:32, Luk.4:42 9:12, al.; as subst., ἡ ἔ. (sc. χώρα; as in Hdt., ii, 32, al.), the desert, Mat.3:1, 3, Mrk.1:3-4, Jhn.3:14, al.; pl., αἱ ἔ., desert places, Luk.1:80 5:16 8:29
(AS)
G2048.o: of uncertain affinity; lonesome, i.e. (by implication) waste (usually as a noun, G5561 (χώρα) being implied)

G2049.d:
ἐρημόω, -ῶ
(ἔρημος), [in LXX for חָרַב hi., שָׁמֵם ni., etc. ;]
to desolate, lay waste: Mat.12:25, Luk.11:17, Rev.17:16 18:16, 19.†
(AS)
G2049.k: (bring to, make) desolate(-ion), come to nought

G2050.d:
ἐρήμωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ἐρημόω), [in LXX for שָׁמֵם, שָׁמֵם, Lev.26:34-35, Psa.73:10, Dan.9:27 11:31 12:11, al.; חׇרְבָּה, Jer.7:34 22:5, al. ;]
a making desolate, laying waste: Luk.21:20; βδέλυγμα ἐρημώσεως (Da, ll. with, 1Ma.1:54), Mat.24:15" (LXX), Mrk.13:14.†
(AS)

G2051.d:
ἐρίζω
(ἔρις), [in LXX for מָרָה, etc. ;]
to wrangle, strive: Mat.12:19 (LXX, κεκράζεται).†
(AS)

G2052.d:
ἐριθία
(T, cl., -εία), -ας, ἡ, [in Sm.: Eze.23:11 * ;] (on the origin and history of the word, see Hort, Ja., 81 fly.; Ellic. on Gal.5:20; Cremer, 262)
ambition, self-seeking, rivalry: Jas.3:14, 16; κατ᾽ ἐριθίαν, Php.2:3; οἱ ἐξ ἐ., Rom.2:8, Php.1:17; pl. (Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220; Swete, Mk., 153), 2Co.12:20, Gal.5:20.†
(AS)
G2052.o: perhaps as the same as G2042 (ἐρεθίζω);

G2053.d:
ἔριον, -ου, τό
[in LXX for צֶמֶר, Lev.13:47, Isa.1:18, al. ;]
wool: Heb.9:19, Rev.1:14.†
(AS)

G2054.d:
ἔρις, -ιδος accusative, ἔριν (on the declension, see B1., § 8, 3; WH, App., 157), ἡ,
[in LXX: Psa.139:20, Sir.28:11 40:5, 9 * ;]
strife, wrangling, contention: Rom.1:29 13:13, 1Co.3:3, 2Co.12:20, Gal.5:20, Php.1:15, 1Ti.6:4, Tit.3:9; pl. (see: ἐριθία), Rom.13:13, WH, mg., 1Co.1:11, Ga, l.with, WH, mg.†
(AS)

G2055.d:
ἐρίφιον, -ου, τό
(dim, of ἔριφος, which see) [in LXX: Tob.2:13 * ;]
Mat.25:33, Luk.15:29 (ἔριφον, WH, txt.).†
(AS)
G2055.s: a kidling, i.e. (genitive case) goat (symbolically, wicked person)

G2056.d:
ἔριφος, -ου
[in LXX chiefly for גְּדִי ;]
a kid: Mat.25:32, Luk.15:29, WH, txt.†
(AS)
G2056.o: perhaps from the same as G2053 (ἔριον) (through the idea of hairiness);

G2057.d:
Ἑρμᾶς, -ᾶ, accusative, -ᾶν (Doric form of Ἑρμῆς),
Hermas, a Christian: Rom.16:14.†
(AS)

G2058.d:
ἑρμηνεία, see: ἑρμηνία.
ἑρμηνία (T, cl., -εία), -ας, ἡ,
(ἑρμηνεύω), [in LXX (-εία), Sir, prol. 14 Sir.47:17, from LXX Sir.5:1 * ;]
interpretation: 1Co.12:10 14:26.†
(AS)

G2059.d:
ἑρμηνεύω
[in LXX: Est.4:7 (תִּרְגַּם), Est.10:3 Job.42:17β* ;]
__1. to explain.
__2. to interpret: Luk.24:27 (WH, mg.), Jhn.1:39, 43 9:7, Heb.7:2.†
(AS)
G2059.o: from a presumed derivative of G2060 (Ἑρμῆς) (as the god of language);

G2060G.d:
Ἑρμῆς, -οῦ
accusative, Ἑρμῆν, ὁ,
Hermes;
__(a) the Greek god (Lat. Mercurius): Act.14:12;
__(b) a Christian: Rom.16:14.† (see)
(AS)
G2060G.s: Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian

G2060H.d:
Ἑρμῆς, -οῦ
accusative, Ἑρμῆν, ὁ,
Hermes;
__(a) the Greek god (Lat. Mercurius): Act.14:12;
__(b) a Christian: Rom.16:14.† (see)
(AS)
G2060H.s: Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian

G2061.s: born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate Christian

G2062.d:
ἑρπετόν, -οῦ, τό
(ἕρπω, to crawl), [in LXX chiefly for רֶמֶשׂ, שֶׁרֶץ ;]
a creeping thing, reptile: Act.10:12 11:6, Rom.1:23, Jas.3:7.†
(AS)
G2062.s: a reptile, i.e. (by Hebraism (compare H07431)) a small animal
G2062.o: neuter of a derivative of (to creep);

G2063.d:
ἐρυθρός, -ά, -όν
[in LXX for אֱדֹם, Isa.63:2; ἐ. θάλασσα for סוּף -יָם Exo.10:19, al. ;]
red: ἡ ἐ. θάλασσα, the Red Sea, Act.7:36, Heb.11:29.†
(AS)
G2063.o: of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with G2281 (θάλασσα)) the Red Sea

G2064.d:
ἔρχομαι,
[in LXX very frequently for בּוֹא, also for הלךְ ni., אתה, etc., 34 words in all ;]
__1. to come;
__(a) of persons, either as arriving or returning from elsewhere: Mat.8:9, Mrk.6:31, Luk.7:8, Jhn.4:27, Rom.9:9, al.; before ἀπό, Mrk.5:35 7:1, Jhn.3:2, al.; ἐκ, Luk.5:17, Jhn.3:31, al.; εἰς, Mrk.1:29, al.; διά before εἰς, Mrk.7:31; ἐν (Cremer, 263f., but see: ἐν), Rom.15:29, 1Co.4:21; ἐπί, with accusative, Mrk.6:53 11:13, Jhn.19:33, al.; κατά, with accusative, Luk.10:33 Act.16:7; παρά, with genitive, Luk.8:49; with accusative, Mat.15:29, Mrk.9:14, al.; with dative comm., incomm. (M, Pr., 75, 245), Mat.21:5, Rev.2:5, 16; with adverbs: πόθεν,…
G2064.s: to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
G2064.o: middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred (middle voice) , or (active) , which do not otherwise occur);
G2064.k: accompany, appear, bring, come, enter, fall out, go, grow, X light, X next, pass, resort, be set

G2065.d:
ἐρωτάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁאַל ;]
__1. to ask, question (cl.): absol., Luk.19:31 22:68, Jhn.8:7 with accusative of person(s), Jhn.9:21 16:19, 30 8:21; before λέγων, Mat.16:13, Luk.23:3, Jhn.1:19, 21 5:12 9:19 16:5; with dupl. accusative (WM, § 32, 4a), Mat.21:24, Mrk.4:10, Luk.20:3, Jhn.16:23 (M, Pr., 66„); with accusative of person(s), before περί, Luk.9:45, Jhn.18:19.
__2. In late Gk. (Milligan, NTD, 51; not, as Cremer, 716, Thayer, see word, a "Hebraism"), = αἰτέω (which see), to ask, request: with accusative of person(s), Jhn.14:16; before imperat., Luk.14:18-19 Php.4:3; λέγων, Mat.15:23, Jhn.12:21; before ἵνα (M, Pr.,…
G2065.s: to interrogate; by implication, to request

G2066.d:
ἐσθής, -ῆτος, ἡ
(ἕννυμι, to clothe; hence, ἐσθής, Lk, ll with, Elz.) [in LXX: 1Es.8:71 Est.8:73, 2Ma.8:35 2Mac 11:8 * ;]
clothing, raiment: Luk.23:11 24:4, Act.10:30 12:21, Jas.2:2-3.†
(AS)

G2068.d:
ἐσθίω, and (poet, and late prose) ἔσθω,
[in LXX chiefly for אכל ;]
to eat;
__(a) absol.: Mat.14:20, 21 Mrk.6:31, Jhn.4:31, al.; ἐν τ. φαγεῖν (on this aor. form, see M, Pr., 111), 1Co.11:21; διδόναι φαγεῖν, with dative of person(s), Mrk.5:43, al.; ἐ. καὶ πίνειν, Mat.6:25, 31 Luk.10:7, al.; of ordinary use of food and drink, 1Co.9:4 11:22; of partaking of food at table, Mrk.2:16, Luk.5:30, al.; opposite to fasting, Mat.11:18, Luk.5:33, al.; of revelling, Mat.24:49, Luk.12:45 .
__(b) with accusative of thing(s): Mat.6:25, Mrk.1:6, Jhn.6:31, Rom.14:2, al.; ἄρτον (Heb. אָכַל לֶחֶם), Mat.15:2, Mrk.3:20, al.; τὸν ἑαυτοῦ ἄ., 2Th.3:12; ἄ. before παρά, genitive…
G2068.s: used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by G5315 (φάγω); to eat (usually literal)

G2069.d:
Ἐσλεί (Rec. 'Ἐσλί, see WH, Notes, 155), ὁ,
Esli, an ancestor of Jesus: Luk.3:25.†
(AS)

G2070.d:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
__I. As substantive verb.
__1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.
__2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
__3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al.…
G2070.o: first person plural indicative of G1510 (εἰμί);
G2070.k: are, be, have our being, X have hope, + (the gospel) was (preached unto) us

G2071.d:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
__I. As substantive verb.
__1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.
__2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
__3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al.…
G2071.k: shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to pass), X may have, X fall, what would follow, X live long, X sojourn

G2072.d:
ἔσ-οπτρον, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Wis.7:26, Sir.12:11 * ;]
a mirror: 1Co.13:12, Jas.1:23.†
(AS)
G2072.o: from G1519 (εἰς) and a presumed derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι);

G2073.d:
ἑσπέρα, -ας, ἡ
(prop, fem, of ἕσπερος), [in LXX chiefly for עָרַב ;]
__(a) (sc. ὥρα), evening: Luk.24:29, Act.4:3 20:15 28:23;
__(b) (so. χώρα), the west.†
(AS)
G2073.o: feminine of an adjective hesperos (evening); the eve (G5610 (ὥρα) being implied)

G2074.d:
Ἑσρώμ
(Ἑσρών, Lk, l.with; Rec. Ἑσρ-), ὁ (Heb. חֶצְרוֹן, Gen.46:12, Num.26:21, 1Ch.25:1-31, al.), [in LXX both forms, ut supr. (cf. ICC, on Mt, l.with; WH, § 408) ;]
Esrom (AV), Hezron (RV), an ancestor of Jesus: Mat.13:1-58, Luk.3:35.†
(AS)

G2075.d:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
__I. As substantive verb.
__1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.
__2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al.
__3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al.…
G2075.o: second person plural present indicative of G1510 (εἰμί);

G2076.d:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
__I. As substantive verb.
__1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.

G2076.s: he (she or it) is; also (with neuter plural) they are
G2076.o: third person singular present indicative of G1510 (εἰμί);
G2076.k: are, be(-long), call, X can(-not), come, consisteth, X dure for a while, + follow, X have, (that) is (to say), make, meaneth, X must needs, + profit, + remaineth, + wrestle

G2077.d:
εἰμί,
with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be.
__I. As substantive verb.
__1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28.
