(= cl. παραπέτασμα) [in LXX chiefly for פֹּרֶכֶת (the veil of the Holy of Holies), Exo.26:31, Lev.21:23, al.; also for מָסָךְ (the outer veil), Exo.35:12, Num_3:26, al. (elsewhere κάλυμμα) ;]
in NT always the inner veil or curtain of the Temple (or Tabernacle): Mat.27:51, Mrk.15:38, Luk.23:45, Heb.6:19 9:3; figuratively, ἡ σὰρξ αὐτοῦ Heb.10:20.†
(AS)
G2665.s: something spread thoroughly, i.e. (specially) the door screen (to the Most Holy Place) in the Jewish Temple
G2665.o: from a compound of G2596 (κατά) and a congener of G4072 (πέτομαι);

G2666.d:
κατα-πίνω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּלַע ;]
__1. to drink down, swallow: Mat.23:24, Rev.12:16.
__2. to devour: 1Pe.5:8. Metaphorical, to swallow up, consume: pass., 1Co.15:54 (LXX), 2Co.2:7 5:4, Heb.11:29.†
(AS)
G2666.s: to drink down, i.e. gulp entire (literally or figuratively)

G2667.d:
κατα-πίπτω
[in LXX: Psa.145:14 (נָפַל), etc. ;]
to fall down: Act.28:6; before εἰς, Act.26:14; ἐπί with accusative, Luk.8:6.†
(AS)

G2668.d:
κατα-πλέω, -ῶ
to sail down, sail to land, put in: εἰς τ. χώραν, Luk.8:26.†
(AS)
G2668.s: to sail down upon a place, i.e. to land at

G2669.d:
κατα-πονέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:2 (A), 3Ma.2:2 3Mac 2:13 * ;]
to wear down, oppress, treat hardly: pass., Act.7:24, 2Pe.2:7.†
(AS)
G2669.s: to labor down, i.e. wear with toil (figuratively, harass)
G2669.o: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G4192 (πόνος);

G2670.d:
κατα-πονίζω
[in LXX for טָבַע pu., Exo.15:4 A, בָּלַע pi., שָׁטַף, Psa.55:9 69:2, al. ;]
to throw into the sea, sink or drown therein: Mat.14:30; pass., Mat.18:6.†
(AS)
G2670.o: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of the same as G4195 (Πόντος);

G2671.d:
κατ-άρα, -ας, -ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for קְלָלָה ;]
a curse: Gal.3:10, 13 Heb.6:8, 2Pe.2:14; opposite to εὐλογία, Jas.3:10; concrete, of Christ, Gal.3:13 (see Lft. in l).†
(AS)

G2672.d:
κατ-αράομαι, -ώμαι depon.
(κατάρα), [in LXX chiefly for קָלַל pi. ;]
to curse: with accusative, Mrk.11:21; opposite to εὐλογέω, Luk.6:26, Rom.12:14, Jas.3:9; pass. pf. ptcp., accursed, under a curse (see M, Pr., 221): Mat.25:41.†
(AS)
G2672.s: to execrate; by analogy, to doom

G2673.d:
κατ-αργέω, -ῶ
(κατά, causative, ἀργός = ἀ-εργός), [in LXX: 2Es.4.21; 2Es.4.23; 2Es.5.5; 2Es.6.8 (בְּטֵל)* ;]
to make idle or inactive (χέρας, Eur., Phœn., 753): of soil occupied by an unfruitful tree, Luk.13:7. Metaphorical (Inscr.), to render inoperative or invalid, to abrogate, abolish: Rom.3:3, 31, 1Co.1:28 6:13 13:11 15:24, Gal.3:17, Eph.2:15, 2Th.2:8, 2Ti.1:10, Heb.2:14; pass., Rom.4:14 6:6, 1Co.2:6 13:8 13:10 15:26, 2Co.3:7 3:11-14 Gal.5:11; before ἀπό (of persons), to be separated, discharged or loosed from, Rom.7:2, 6, Gal.5:4.†
(AS)
G2673.s: to be (render) entirely idle (useless), literally or figuratively
G2673.k: abolish, cease, cumber, deliver, destroy, do away, become (make) of no (none, without) effect, fail, loose, bring (come) to nought, put away (down), vanish away, make void

G2674.d:
κατ-αριθμέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ch.31:19 (יָחַשׂ hith.), al. ;]
to number or count among: before ἐν, Act.1:1.†
(AS)

G2675.d:
κατ-αρτίζω
[in LXX chiefly in Ps (Psa.8:2 al.; כּוּן, etc.) and Ezra (כְּלַל) ;]
to render ἄρτιος, i.e. fit, complete;
__(a) to mend, repair: Mat.4:21, Mrk.1:19;
__(b) to furnish completely, complete, equip, prepare: pass., Luk.6:40, Rom.9:22, Heb.11:3; mid., Mat.21:16 (LXX), Heb.10:5 (LXX);
__(with) in ethical sense, to prepare, complete, perfect: Gal.6:1 (EV, restore), 1Pe.5:10; pass., 1Co.1:10 (Field, Notes, 167), 2Co.13:11, Heb.13:21 (cf. προ-καταρτίζω).†
(AS)
G2675.s: to complete thoroughly, i.e. repair (literally or figuratively) or adjust
G2675.o: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G739 (ἄρτιος);
G2675.k: fit, frame, mend, (make) perfect(-ly join together), prepare, restore

G2676.d:
κατ-άρτισις, -εως, ἡ
(καταρτίζω),
a strengthening, making fit: in ethical sense, 2Co.13:9.†
(AS)

G2677.d:
καταρτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in Sm.: Isa.38:12 * ;]
= κατάρτισις (but see ICC, Eph. l.with): Eph.4:12.†
(AS)

G2678.d:
κατα-σείω
[in LXX: Da TH Bel 1:14 AR, 1Ma.6:38 * ;]
__1. to shake down.
__2. Of the hand, to shake or wave as a signal: τ. χεῖρα, Act.19:33; τ. χειρί, Act.13:16; id. with dative of person(s), Act.21:40; before inf., Act.12:17.†
(AS)
G2678.s: to sway downward, i.e. make a signal

G2679.d:
κατα-σκάπτω
[in LXX for נָתַץ, הָרַס, etc. ;]
to dig down: Rom.11:3 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2680.d:
κατα-σκευάζω
[in LXX: Isa.40:19, 28, (בָּרָא), etc. ;]
to prepare, make ready: τ. ὁδόν, Mat.11:10, Mrk.1:2, Luk.7:27; οἶκον, Heb.3:3-4; σκηνήν, Heb.9:2, 6; κιβωτόν, Heb.11:7, 1Pe.3:20; pass. pf. ptcp., λαον κ., Luk.1:17.†
(AS)
G2680.s: to prepare thoroughly (properly, by external equipment; whereas G2090 (ἑτοιμάζω) refers rather to internal fitness); by implication, to construct, create
G2680.o: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G4632 (σκεῦος);

G2681.d:
κατα-σκηνόω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for סָכַךְ ;]
to pitch one's tent, lodge, dwell: before ἐν, Mat.13:32, Luk.13:19; ὑπό, with accusative, Mrk.4:32; ἐπ᾽ ἐλπιδι, Act.2:26 (LXX).†
(AS)
G2681.s: to camp down, i.e. haunt; figuratively, to remain

G2682.d:
κατα-σκήνωσις, εως, ἡ
[in LXX: 1Ch.28:2 (בָּנָה), Eze.37:27 (מִשְׁכָּן) Tob.1:4, Wis.9:8, 2Ma.14:35 (R)* ;]
__1. prop., an encamping, taking up one's quarters (Polyb., al., see LS; and cf. LXX, ll. with).
__2. a lodging, abode: of birds, Mat.8:20, Luk.9:58.†
(AS)

G2683.o: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G4639 (σκιά);

G2684.d:
κατα-σκοπέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 4Ki.10:3, 1Ch.19:3 (רָגַל pi.), 1Ma.5:38 (A)* ;]
to view closely, inspect, spy out: with accusative, Gal.2:4.†
(AS)
G2684.s: to be a sentinel, i.e. to inspect insidiously

G2685.d:
κατά-σκοπος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for רָגַל pi. ;]
a spy: Heb.11:31.†
(AS)
G2685.o: from G2596 (κατά) (intensive) and G4649 (σκοπός) (in the sense of a watcher);

G2686.d:
κατα-σοφίζομαι
[in LXX: Exo.1:10 (חָכָם hith.), Jdth.5:11 10:19 * ;]
to deal craftily with, outwit: Act.7:19 (LXX) †
(AS)
G2686.s: to be crafty against, i.e. circumvent
G2686.o: middle voice from G2596 (κατά) and G4679 (σοφίζω);

G2687.d:
κατα-στέλλω
[in LXX: 2Ma.4:31, 3Ma.6:1 * ;]
__1. to let down, lower.
__2. to keep down, restrain: with accusative, Act.19:35-36 †
(AS)

G2688.d:
κατά-στημα, -τος, τό
(καθίστημι), in LXX: 3Ma.5:45 (-εμα, A) * ;]
__1. condition, of health, etc.
__2. demeanour: Tit.2:3 (for exx. see Field, Notes, 220).†
(AS)
G2688.s: properly, a position or condition, i.e. (subjectively) demeanor

G2689.d:
κατα-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταστέλλω), [in LXX: Isa.61:3 (מַעֲטֶה)* ;]
__1. a letting down, checking.
__2. steadiness, quietness in demeanour.
__3. LXX and NT (cf. Plut., ii, 65 D; -ίζω = vestire), a garment, dress, attire: 1Ti.2:9 (but see Ellic., in l).†
(AS)

G2690.d:
κατα-στρέφω
[in LXX for הָפַךְ, etc., Gen.19:21, Jer.20:16, al. ;]
__1. to turn down, turn over; as, the soil.
__2. to overturn, overthrow: Mat.21:12, Mrk.11:15; pass. pf. ptcp., Act.15:16 (LXX).†
(AS)
G2690.s: to turn upside down, i.e. upset

G2692.d:
κατα-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(καταστρέφω), [in LXX: Job.21:17, Pro.1:27 (אֵיד), al. ;]
__1. overthrow: 2Pe.2:6 (WH, om.).
__2. Metaphorical, subversion, upsetting (cf. καθαίρεσις, 2Co.13:10): 2Ti.2:14.†
(AS)
G2692.s: an overturn ("catastrophe"), i.e. demolition; figuratively, apostasy

G2693.d:
κατα-στρώννυμι
[in LXX: Num.14:16 (שָׁחַט), Job.12:23 (שָׁטַח), שָׁטַח), Jdt.4.1-15; Jdt.2.1-28 Mac.4 ;]
__1. to strew or spread over.
__2. to lay low, overthrow: 1Co.10:5.†
(AS)
G2693.s: to strew down, i.e. (by implication) to prostrate (slay)

G2694.d:
κατα-σύρω
[in LXX: Jer.49:10 (חָשַׂף), Dan LXX, Dan.11:10, 26 (שָׁטַף) * ;]
__1. to pull down.
__2. to drag away: with accusative of person(s), Luk.12:58.†
(AS)
G2694.s: to drag down, i.e. arrest judicially

G2695.d:
κατα-σφάζω
[in LXX: Zec.11:5 (הָרַג), Eze.16:40 (בָּתַק pi.), 2Ma.8:1-36 ;]
to kill off, slay: with accusative, Luk.19:27.†
(AS)

G2696.d:
κατα-σφραγίζω
[in LXX: Job.9:7 37:7 (חָתַם), Wis.2:5 * ;]
to seal up, secure with a seal: Rev.5:1.†
(AS)

G2697.d:
κατά-σχεσις, -εως, ἡ
(κατέχω), [in LXX nearly always for אֲחֻזָּה ]
__1. a holding back.
__2. LXX and NT, a holding fast, possession: Act.7:5, 45.†
(AS)

G2698.d:
κατα-τίθημι
[in LXX: 1Ch.21:27 שׁוּב hi.), Psa.41:8 (יָצַק), 1Ma.10:23, al. ;]
to lay down, deposit, lay by: Mrk.15:46, T; mid., to lay up for oneself: χάριν (Hdt., al., see LS, see word), with dative of person(s), Act.24:27 25:9.†
(AS)
G2698.s: to place down, i.e. deposit (literally or figuratively)

G2699.d:
κατα-τομή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in Sm.: Jer.31:37 (κατατέμνω is used in LXX of forbidden mutilations: Lev.21:5, al.) ;]
__1. incision.
__2. excision, concision, mutilation: in sarcasm, by paronomasia, in contrast to (true) περιτομή (v3), of Judaizing Christians, Php.3:2 (see Lft., in l; Cremer, 883).†
(AS)
G2699.o: from a compound of G2596 (κατά) and (to cut);

G2700.d:
κατα-τοξεύω
[in LXX: Exo.19:13 (יָרָה), al. ;]
to strike down with an arrow, shoot dead: Heb.12:20 (LXX) (Rec.; WH, R, om.).†
(AS)
G2700.s: to shoot down with an arrow or other missile
G2700.o: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G5115 (τόξον);

G2701.d:
κατα-τρέχω
[in LXX: Lev.26:37, Jdg.1:6 (רָדַף), al. ;]
to run down: before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), Act.21:32.†
(AS)
G2701.s: to run down, i.e. hasten from a tower

G2702.d:
κατα-φέρω
[in LXX for יָרַד hi., etc. ;]
to bring down: αἰτιώματα, Act.25:7; ψῆφον, to cast a ballot, Act.26:10; pass., to be borne down: ὕπνῳ, ἀπὸ τ. ὕ., Act.20:9.†
(AS)
G2702.s: to bear down, i.e. (figuratively) overcome (with drowsiness); specially, to cast a vote
G2702.o: from G2596 (κατά) and G5342 (φέρω) (including its alternate);

G2703.d:
κατα-φεύγω
[in LXX for נוּס, etc. ;]
to flee for refuge: before εἰς, Act.14:6; metaphorically, with inf., Heb.6:18.†
(AS)

G2704.d:
κατα-φθείρω
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַת hi., Gen.6:12, al. ;]
__1 1 to destroy entirely.
__2. In moral sense (as LXX), to deprave, corrupt: pass. pf. ptcp., before τ. νο ν, 2Ti.3:8.†
(AS)
G2704.s: to spoil entirely, i.e. (literally) to destroy; or (figuratively) to deprave;

G2705.d:
κατα-φιλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for נָשַׁק ;]
to kiss fervently, kiss affectionately: Mat.26:49, Mrk.14:45, Luk.7:38, 45 15:20, Act.20:37.†
(AS)

G2706.d:
κατα-φρονέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for בָּגַד, בּוּז, etc. ;]
to think little of, despise: with genitive, Mat.6:24 18:10, Luk.16:13, Rom.2:4, 1Co.11:22, 1Ti.4:12 6:2, Heb.12:2, 2Pe.2:10.†
(AS)

G2707.d:
κατα-φρονητής, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for בָּגַד, בֹּגְדוֹת, Hab.1:5 2:5, Zep.3:4 * ;]
a despiser: Act.13:41.†
(AS)

G2708.d:
κατα-χέω
[in LXX for יָצַק, נָטָה, עָטָה hi. ;]
to pour down upon: with genitive (cl.), Mrk.14:3; before ἐπί, with genitive, Mat.26:7.†
(AS)

G2709.d:
κατα-χθόνιος, -ον
(χθών, the earth),
subterranean, under the earth (in cl., of the infernal gods): of the departed in Hades, opposite to ἐπουράνιος, ἐπίγειος, Php.2:10.†
(AS)
G2709.s: subterranean, i.e. infernal (belonging to the world of departed spirits)

G2710.d:
κατα-χράομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX: Ep. Je.28, 3Ma.4:5 3Mac 5:22 * ;]
to make full use of, use to the uttermost, use up: 1Co.7:31; with dative, 1Co.9:18 (for other senses, see LS, see word)..†
(AS)

G2711.d:
κατα-ψύχω
[in LXX: Gen.18:4 (שָׁעַן ni.)* ;]
to cool: with accusative, Luk.16:24.†
(AS)

G2713.d:
κατέναντι
adv., [in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶד, פָּנִים, Gen.7:1, etc. ;]
over against, opposite, before: ἡ, κ. κώμη, Luk.19:30; as prep., with genitive, Mat.21:2 27:24 (ἀπ-, WH, mg.), Mrk.11:2 12:41 (ἀπ-, WH, mg.) Mrk.13:3; metaphorically, before, before θεοῦ, Rom.4:17, 2Co.2:17 12:19.†
(AS)

G2714.d:
κατενώπιον
adv. (= Hom., κατένωπα), [in LXX: Psa.44:15, al. ;]
over against, before: with genitive, τ. δόξης, Ju 24; metaphorically (cf. κατέναντι, and see Lft., Col., l.with), τ. θεοῦ, Eph.1:4, Col.1:22.†
(AS)
G2714.k: before (the presence of), in the sight of

G2715.d:
κατ-εξουσιάζω
to exercise authority over: with genitive of person(s), Mat.20:25, Mrk.10:42.†
SYN: (κατακυριεύω) (see Swete, Mk., l.with)
(AS)

G2716.d:
κατ-εργάζομαι
(emphatic form of ἐργάζομαι), [in LXX for פָּעַל, etc. (9 exx., each for a different Heb. word) ;]
to effect by labour, achieve, work out, bring about: with accusative, Rom.4:15 5:3 7:8, 15-20, 2Co.7:10, Eph.6:13, Jas.1:3; pass., 2Co.12:12; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), Rom.7:13, 2Co.4:17 7:11 9:11; id. before διά, with genitive of person(s), Rom.15:18; τ. σωτηρίαν, Php.2:12; with accusative of person(s) before εἰς, 2Co.5:5 (RV, wrought); of evil deeds, Rom.1:27 2:9, 1Co.5:3, 1Pe.4:3.†
(AS)
G2716.s: to work fully, i.e. accomplish; by implication, to finish, fashion

G2718.d:
κατ-έρχομαι
[in LXX: Tob.1:22, א Tob.2:1, Est.3:13, Wis.11:22, 2Ma.11:29 * ;]
to come down, go down: before εἰς, Luk.4:31, Act.8:5 13:4 15:30 19:1, Τ; ἀπό, Luk.9:37, Act.15:1 18:5 21:10; ἀπό and εἰς, Act.11:27 12:10; of coming to port by ship, Act.18:22 21:3 27:5; before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Act.9:32; metaphorically, of gifts from God, Jas.3:15.†
(AS)
G2718.s: to come (or go) down (literally or figuratively)
G2718.o: from G2596 (κατά) and G2064 (ἔρχομαι) (including its alternate);
G2718.k: come (down), depart, descend, go down, land

G2719.d:
κατ-εσθίω
("perfective" comp. of ἐσθίω, which see, and cf. M, Pr., 111) [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל ;]
to eat up, devour: with accusative, of seed, Mat.13:4, Mrk.4:4, Luk.8:5; τέκνον, Rev.12:4; βιβλαρίδιον, Rev.10:9-10; metaphorically, οἰκίας, Mat.23:13, Mrk.12:40, Luk.20:47; τ. βίον, Luk.15:30; with accusative of person(s), Jhn.2:17 (LXX), 2Co.11:20, Gal.5:15, Rev.11:5 20:9.†
(AS)
G2719.s: to eat down, i.e. devour (literally or figuratively)
G2719.o: from G2596 (κατά) and G2068 (ἐσθίω) (including its alternate);

G2720.d:
κατ-ευθύνω
[in LXX for כּוּן ni., hi., etc. ;]
to make or keep straight, direct, guide: metaphorically, τ. ὁδόν, 1Th.3:11; τ. πόδας εἰς ὁδὸν εἰρήνης, Luk.1:79; τ. καρδίας εἰς τ. ἀγάπην, 2Th.3:5.†
(AS)

G2721.s: to stand over against, i.e. rush upon (assault)

G2722.d:
κατ-έχω
[in LXX for אָחַז, חָזַק hi., etc. ;]
__1. perfective of ἔχω (M, Pr., 116; M, Th., 155),
__(a) to possess, hold fast: Luk.8:15, Jhn.5:4, Rom.1:18 (Lft., Notes, 251), 1Co.7:30 11:2, 2Co.6:10, 1Th.5:21, Heb.3:6, 14 10:23;
__(b) to lay hold of, get possession of: Luk.14:9.
__2. to hold back, detain, restrain (M, Th., 156 f.): with accusative before τοῦ μή with inf., Luk.4:42; before πρός, with accusative, Phm 13; absol., τὸ κατέχον (ὁ κ.), 2Th.2:6-7.
__3. Intrans., as nautical term, to put in, make for (LS, see word): Act.27:40.†
(AS)
G2722.s: to hold down (fast), in various applications (literally or figuratively)
G2722.k: have, hold (fast), keep (in memory), let, X make toward, possess, retain, seize on, stay, take, withhold

G2723.d:
κατηγορέω, -ῶ
(κατά, ἀγορεύω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:5, (9), 1Ma.7:6 1Mac 7:25, 2Ma.4:47 2Mac 10:13 2Mac 10:21, 4Ma.9:14 * ;]
to make accusation, accuse,
__(a) in general: absol., Rom.2:15; with genitive of person(s) (cl., WM, 254), Jhn.5:45; irreg. with accusative of person(s), Rev.12:10;
__(b) before a judge: absol., Act.24:2, 19; with genitive of person(s), Mat.12:10, Mrk.3:2, Luk.6:7 11:54 (WH, txt., R, om.), Luk.23:2, 10, Jhn.8:6 Act.25:5 28:19; id. with accusative of thing(s) (cl., but see WM, l.with), Mrk.15:3-4; with genitive of thing(s) (Dem.), Act.24:8 25:11; before περί, with genitive of thing(s) (Thuc., viii, 85), Act.24:13; with…
G2723.s: to be a plaintiff, i.e. to charge with some offence

G2724.d:
κατηγορία, -ας, ἡ
(κατήγορος),
an accusation, charge: with genitive of person(s), Jhn.18:29; before κατά, with id., 1Ti.5:19; with genitive of thing(s), Tit.1:6.†
(AS)

G2725.d:
κατήγορος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Pro.18:17 (רִיב), 2Ma.4:5 * ;]
an accuser: Act.23:30, 35 24:8 (WH, R, txt. om.) Act.25:16, 18.†
(AS)
G2725.s: against one in the assembly, i.e. a complainant at law; specially, Satan

G2726.o: from a compound of G2596 (κατά) and perhaps a derivative of the base of G5316 (φαίνω) (meaning downcast in look);

G2727.d:
κατ-ηχέω, -ῶ
__1. to resound.
__2. to teach by word of mouth, instruct, inform (see 131., Phil. Gosp., 20, 31): Gal.6:6; with accusative of person(s), 1Co.14:19; pass. with accusative of thing(s), Luk.1:4 (ICC, in l), Act.18:25 21:24 (cf. Lk, l.with), Gal.6:6; before κ, with genitive of thing(s), Rom.2:18; περί, with genitive of person(s), Act.21:21.†
(AS)
G2727.s: to sound down into the ears, i.e. (by implication) to indoctrinate ("catechize") or (genitive case) to apprise of

G2728.d:
κατ-ιόω, -ῶ
(intensive of ἰόω; ἰός) [in LXX: Sir.12:11 * ;]
to rust over; pass., become rusted over: Jas.5:3.†
(AS)
G2728.o: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G2447 (ἰός);

G2729.d:
κατ-ισχύω
[in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;]
to overpower, prevail against, prevail: absol., Luk.23:23; with inf., Luk.21:36; with genitive, Mat.16:18.†
(AS)

G2730.d:
κατ-οικέω, -ῶ
[in LXX very frequently and nearly always for יָשַׁב ;]
__1. trans., to inhabit, dwell in: with accusative, Luk.13:4, Act.1:10 2:9, 14 4:16 9:32, 35 19:10, 17. Rev.17:2; of God, Mat.23:21.
__2. Intrans., to settle, dwell: Act.22:12; before ἐν (cl.), Act.1:20 (LXX) Act.2:5 7:2, 4 7:48 9:22 11:29 13:27 17:24, Heb.11:9, Rev.13:12; before εἰς (B1., § 39, 3; M, Pr., 62 f., 234 f.), Mat.2:23 4:13, Act.7:4; ἐπὶ τ. γῆς (Num.13:33, al.), Rev.3:10 6:10 8:13 11:10 13:8, 14 17:8; ἐπὶ παντὸς προσώπου τ. γ., Act.17:26; ὅπου, Rev.2:13; ἐκεῖ (of demons), Mat.12:45, Luk.11:26. Metaphorical, of divine indwelling: ὁ Χριστός, Eph.3:17; τ. πνεῦμα,…
G2730.s: to house permanently, i.e. reside (literally or figuratively)

G2731.d:
κατ-οίκησις, -εως, ἡ
(κατοικέω), [in LXX for יָשַׁב, Gen.10:30, al. ;]
dwelling: Mrk.5:3.†
(AS)
G2731.s: residence (properly, the act; but by implication, concretely, the mansion)

G2732.d:
κατ-οικητήριον, -ου, τό
(κατοικέω), [in LXX for מוֹשָׁב, מָעוֹן, etc. ;]
a habitation, dwelling-place: Eph.2:22, Rev.18:2.†
(AS)

G2733.d:
κατ-οικία, -ας, ἡ
(κατοικέω), [in LXX chiefly for מוֹשָׁב, Exo.35:3, al. ;]
__1. a dwelling: Act.17:26.
__2. a settlement (Polyb.).†
(AS)
G2733.s: residence (properly, the condition; but by implication, the abode itself)

G2734.d:
κατοπτρίζω
(κάτοπτρον, a mirror),
to show as in a mirror. Mid., to see oneself mirrored (see MM, Exp., xv); with accusative of thing(s) (R, txt., but see mg.), to reflect as a mirror: 2Co.3:18 (cf. Abbott, Essays, 94).†
(AS)
G2734.s: to mirror oneself, i.e. to see reflected (figuratively)
G2734.o: middle voice from a compound of G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι) (compare G2072 (ἔσοπτρον));

G2735.d:
κατόρθωμα, -τος, τό
Rec, for διόρθωμα (which see), Act.24:3.†
(AS)
G2735.s: something made fully upright, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (specially, good public administration)
G2735.o: from a compound of G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G3717 (ὀρθός) (compare G1357 (διόρθωσις));

G2736.d:
κάτω
adv. (κατά), [in LXX for מַטָּה, תַּחַת and cogn. forms ;]
__1. down, downwards (with verbs of motion), Mat.4:6, Luk.4:9, Jhn.8:6, 8, Act.20:9.
__2. below, beneath: Mrk.14:66, Act.2:19" (LXX) ; ἕως κ. (Eze.1:27, al.), Mat.27:51, Mrk.15:38. τὰ κ. (opposite to τ. ἄνω), Jhn.8:23. Compar. κατωτέρω: ἀπὸ διετοῦς καὶ κ. (cf. 1Ch.27:21), Mat.2:16.†
(AS)

G2737.d:
κατώτερος, -έρα, -ερον
(κάτω), [in LXX for תַּחְתּוֹן, תַּחְתִּי ;]
lower; τὰ. κ. τῆς γῆς (see AR, Eph., l.with; for rendering this lower earth, see ICC, Eph, l.with), the lower parts of the earth (cf. Psa.139:15; cf. also MGr., ἡ κάτου γῆ, the underworld, Thumb, MGV, 334): Eph.4:9.†
(AS)

G2738.d:
καῦμα, -τος, τό
(καίω), [in LXX for חֹם, חֹרֶב, etc. ;]
heat: Rev.7:16 16:9.†
(AS)
G2738.s: properly, a burn (concretely), but used (abstractly) of a glow

G2739.d:
καυματίζω
(καῦμα),
to burn or scorch up: with accusative before ἐν πυρί, Rev.16:8. Pass., Mat.13:14, Mrk.4:6; before καῦμα μέγα, Rev.16:9.†
(AS)

G2740.d:
καῦσις, -εως, ἡ
(καίω), [in LXX for בָּעַר pi., etc. ;]
burning: Heb.6:8.†
(AS)

G2741.d:
καυσόω, -ῶ
(καῦσος, burning heat, fever),
only in pass.,
__1. to burn with fever (Galen., al.).
__2. In NT, to burn with great heat: 2Pe.3:10 3:12 (V. Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G2742.d:
καύσων, -ωνος, ὁ
(καίω), [in LXX: Gen.31:40 א (חֹרֶב), Isa.49:10 (שָׁרָב), Job.27:21, Hos.12:1, (2), Hos.13:15, Jon.4.8, Jer.18:17, Eze.17:10 19:12 (קָדִים); Jer.51:1, From Theodotion Dan.3:67) Jdth.8:3, Sir.18:16 34:16 43:22 * ;]
__1. burning heat (Ge, Isa (?), Jth, ll.with, Sir.18:16): Mat.20:12, Luk.12:55 (Jas.1:11, AV).
__2. a hot wind from the east (Heb. קָדִים, see LXX, ll.with), the modern sirocco (see CGT on Amo.4:9): Jas.1:11 (RV, the scorching wind; cf. R, mg., the hot wind, Mt, Lk, ll.with).†
(AS)

G2743.d:
καυστηριάζω (Rec. καυτηρ-, and so usually in Gk. writers, see Soph., Lex., see word)
to mark by branding, brand (AV, scar, but see CGT, in l): metaphorically, pass. pf. ptcp., 1Ti.4:2 (cf. καυτήριον, 4Ma.15:22 *).†
(AS)
G2743.s: to brand ("cauterize"), i.e. (by implication) to render unsensitive (figuratively)

G2744.d:
καυχάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX for הָלַל hith., etc. ;]
to boast or glory (in LXX, of joyous exultation, and so in the NT quotations, infr.; cf. DB, ii, 790b; Hort on Jas.1:9): absol., 1Co.1:31 (LXX) 1Co.4:7 13:3, 2Co.10:13 10:17" (LXX) 2Co.11:16 11:18 12:1 12:6, Eph.2:9, Jas.4:16; with accusative of thing(s), 2Co.9:2 11:30; before ἐν (LXX), Rom.2:23 5:3, 1Co.3:21, 2Co.5:12 10:15 11:12 12:5 12:9, Gal.6:13-14 Jas.1:9; ἐν (τ.) θεῷ, Rom.2:17 5:11; ἐν κυρίῳ, 1Co.1:31 (LXX) 2Co.10:17 (LXX); ἐν Χ. Ἰησοῦ, Php.3:3; before ἐπί with dative, Rom.5:2; περί, with genitive, 2Co.10:8; εἰς, 2Co.10:16; ὑπέρ, with genitive of person(s), 2Co.7:14 12:5; ἐνώπιον τ. θεοῦ, 1Co.1:29 (cf. ἐν,…
G2744.s: to vaunt (in a good or a bad sense)
G2744.o: from some (obsolete) base akin to that of (to boast) and G2172 (εὔχομαι);

G2745.d:
καύχημα, -τος, τό
(καυχάομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּהִלָּה, תִּפְאָרָה ;]
__1. a boast (Pind.): 2Co.5:12 9:3 (Thayer, see word; e. contra, 2, Ellic., Lft., on Gal.6:4; Lft., Notes, 204, 277).
__2. ground or matter of glorying: Rom.4:2, 1Co.5:6 9:15-16, 2Co.1:14, Gal.6:4, Php.1:26 2:16, Heb.3:6 (cf. καύχησις).†
(AS)
G2745.s: a boast (properly, the object; by implication, the act) in a good or a bad sense

G2746.d:
καύχησις, -εως, ἡ
(καυχάομαι), [in LXX for תִּפְאָרָה (1Ch.29:13, Eze.16:12, al) ;]
a boasting, glorying: Rom.3:27, 2Co.11:10 11:17, Jas.4:16; before ὑπέρ, 2Co.7:4 8:24; ἐτί, with genitive, 2Co.7:14; ἔχω τὴν κ. ἐν Χρ. Ἰησ., Rom.15:17; στέφανος καυχήσεως (Ez. l.with, al.), 1Th.2:19; of the cause of glorying, a boast ( = καύχημα), 2Co.1:12.†
(AS)
G2746.s: boasting (properly, the act; by implication, the object), in a good or a bad sense
G2746.k: boasting, whereof I may glory, glorying, rejoicing

G2747.d:
Κενχρεαί (Rec. Κεχγ-; ν. WH, App., 150), -ῶν, αἱ,
Cenchreæ, a port of Corinth: Act.18:18, Rom.16:1.†
(AS)

G2748.d:
κέδρος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אֶרֶז, Num.24:6, al.; χειμάρρους τῶν Κέδρων, 2Ki.15:23, 3Ki.15:13 (קִדְרוֹן) ;]
a cedar: χείμαρρος τῶν Κ. (as in 2Sam, 1Ki, ll. with), Jhn.18:1 (Rec. Tr., WH, R, mg.; τοῦ Κέδρου, T, WH, mg., see: Κεδρών, and cf. Westc., in l; WH, App., 89 f.; Abbott, JG, 513 ff).†
Κεδρών
(see: κέδρος), ὁ,
indecl.
(in FlJ, genitive -ῶνος; Heb. קִדְרוֹן), [in LXX: 2Ki.15:23, 4Ki.23:6, al. ;]
Cedron (OT, Kidron): χείμαρρος τοῦ Κ., Jhn.18:1 (L, Tr., mg., R, txt.; cf. Bl., 10, 5; Lft., Essays, 172 ff).†
(AS)
G2748.s: Cedron (i.e. Kidron), a brook near Jerusalem

G2749.d:
κεῖμαι
[in LXX: Jer.24:1 (יָעַד hoph,), al. ;]
used as passive of τίθημι (LS, see word), to be laid, to lie;
__(a) of persons: an infant, Luk.2:12, 16; a dead body, Mat.28:6, Luk.23:53, Jhn.20:12;
__(b) of things, to lie, be laid or set, stand: Mat.5:14, Jhn.2:6 19:29 20:5-7 21:9, Rev.4:2 21:16; trop., Θεμέλιος, 1Co.3:11; before prep. with accusative, πρός, Mat.3:10, Luk.3:9; εἰς, Luk.12:19; ἐπί, trop., κάλυμμα, 2Co.3:15. Metaphorical, ὁ κόσμος ἐν τ. πονηριῷ κ., 1Jn.5:19; to be laid down, appointed: of law, with dative of person(s), 1Ti.1:9; before εἰς with accusative (of purpose), Luk.2:34, Php.1:16, 1Th.3:3
(cf. ἀνά-, συν-ανά-, ἀντί-,…
G2749.o: middle voice of a primary verb;
G2749.k: be (appointed, laid up, made, set), lay, lie

G2750.d:
κειρία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: Pro.7:16 (מַרְבַד)* ;]
a vernacular word,
__1 1, a bed-cord (Aristoph., AV., 816; Pr, l.with).
__2. In pl., swathings (cf. Field, Notes, 96 f.): Jhn.11:44.†
(AS)

G2751.d:
κείρω
[in LXX chiefly for גָּזַז, Isa.53:7, al. ;]
to cut short the hair, shear: a sheep, Act.8:32 (Isa, l.with). Mid., to have one's hair cut off, be shorn: absol., 1Co.11:6; τ-. κεφαλήν, Act.18:18.†
(AS)

G2752.d:
κέλευσμα, -τος, τό
(κελεύω), [in LXX: Pro.30:27 * ;]
a call, summons, shout of command: 1Th.4:16 (see M, Th., in l).†
(AS)

G2753.d:
κελεύω
[in LXX: I Est.9:53, Tob.8:18, al., and frequently in 1-4Mac ;]
to urge on, bid by word of mouth, order, command (mostly of one in authority): with accusative and inf. aor., Mat.14:19, 28 18:25 27:64, Luk.18:40, Act.4:15 5:34 8:38 22:30 23:10 25:6, 17; with ellipse of accusative, Mat.8:18 14:9 27:58, Act.12:19 21:33; with accusative and inf. Pres., Act.21:34 22:24 23:3, 35 25:21 27:43; with ellipse of accusative, Act.16:22; ptcp. aor., Act.25:23.†
SYN.: see: ἐντέλλω (AS)
G2753.s: "hail"; to incite by word, i.e. order

G2754.d:
κενοδοξία, -ας, ἡ
(κενόδοξος), [in LXX: Wis.14:14, 2Ma.2:15 2Mac 8:10 * ;]
__1. foolish fancy, vain opinion, error (LXX, ll. with).
__2. vain­glory, groundless conceit: Php.2:3.†
(AS)

G2756.d:
κενός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX chiefly for רִיק and cognate forms ;]
empty (Gen.37:24, Jdg.7:16). Metaphorical,
__(a) empty, vain: λόγοι, Eph.5:6; ἀπάτη, Col.2:8; κήρυγμα, πίστις, 1Co.15:14;
__(b) vain, fruitless: ἡ χάρις, 1Co.15:10; κόπος, 1Co.15:50; ἡ εἴσοδος, 1Th.2:1; κενά, Act.4:25 (LXX); εἰς κενόν, in vain, to no purpose (Diod., LXX; cl. διὰ κενῆς), 2Co.6:1, Gal.2:2, Php.2:16, 1Th.3:5;
__(with) of persons, empty-handed: Mrk.12:3, Luk.1:53 20:10-11; vain, Jas.2:20.†
SYN.: μάταιος, of the aim or effect of an action, κ. of its quality (Lft. on Cl. Rom., 1Co., § 7; Tr., Syn., xlix) (AS)

G2757.d:
κενοφωνία, -ας, ἡ
(κενός, φωνέω), [cf. κενολογέω (צָפַף), Isa.8:19 * ;]
empty talk, babbling: pl., 1Ti.6:20, 2Ti.2:16.†
(AS)
G2757.o: from a presumed compound of G2756 (κενός) and G5456 (φωνή);

G2758.d:
κενόω, -ῶ
(κενός, which see), [in LXX: Jer.14:2 15:9 (עָמָל pu.)* ;]
to empty. Metaphorical, to empty, make empty, vain or of no effect: καύχημα, 1Co.9:15; ἑαυτόν, of Christ, Php.2:7 (v Lft.; ICC, in 1, and esp. Gifford, Incarn., 54 ff.); pass., πίστις, Rom.4:14; ὁ σταυρός, 1Co.1:17; καύχημα, 2Co.9:3†
(AS)
G2758.s: to make empty, i.e. (figuratively) to abase, neutralize, falsify
G2758.k: make (of none effect, of no reputation, void), be in vain

G2759.d:
κέντρον, -ου, τό
(εκντέω, to prick), [in LXX: Pro.26:3 (מֶתֶג), Hos.13:14 (קֹטֶב), Hos.5:12, Sir.38:25, 4Ma.14:19 * ;]
__1. a sting (4Mac, l.with): Rev.9:10. Metaphorical (as Hos.13:14): τ. θανάτου, 1Co.15:55 (LXX), 1Co.15:56,
__2. a goad: pl., Act.26:14.†
(AS)
G2759.s: a point ("centre"), i.e. a sting (figuratively, poison) or goad (figuratively, divine impulse)

G2760.d:
κεντυρίων, -ωνος, ὁ (Lat. centurio);
a centurion: Mrk.15:39, 44-45 (Mt, Lk, use ἑκιτόνταρχος (-ης), q.v).†
(AS)
G2760.s: a centurion, i.e. captain of one hundred soldiers

G2761.d:
κενῶς
adv., [in LXX: Isa.49:4 (רִיק)* ;]
in vain, to no purpose: Jas.4:5.†
(AS)

G2762.d:
κεραία (WH, κερέα, see App., 151), -ας, ἠ
(κέρας),
a little horn: of the point or extremity which distinguishes some Heb. letters from others (e.g. ד from ר; DCG, ii, 733), Mat.5:18, Luk.16:17.†
(AS)
G2762.s: something horn-like, i.e. (specially) the apex of a Hebrew letter (figuratively, the least particle)
G2762.o: feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of G2768 (κέρας);

G2763G.d:
κεραμεύς, -εως, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX for יָצַר, Psa.2:9, Jer.18:2, al. ;]
a potter: Rom.9:21; ὁ ἀγρὸς τοῦ κ., Mat.27:7, (LXX).†
(AS)

G2763H.d:
κεραμεύς, -εως, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX for יָצַר, Psa.2:9, Jer.18:2, al. ;]
a potter: Rom.9:21; ὁ ἀγρὸς τοῦ κ., Mat.27:7, (LXX).†
(AS)

G2764.d:
κεραμικός, -ή, -όν
(κέραμος), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:41 (פֶּחָר)* ;]
__1. (cl.) of a potter (e.g. γῆ).
__2. In LXX and NT, = cl., κεραμεοῦς (Plut., κεράμειος, Polyb., -μαῖος, etc), earthen: Rev.2:27.†
(AS)

G2765.d:
κεράμιον, -ου, τό
(κέραμος), [in LXX: Jer.35:5 (גְּבִיעַ), etc. ;]
an earthen vessel, a jar or jug: ὕδατος, Mrk.14:13, Luk.22:10.†
(AS)
G2765.o: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2766 (κέραμος);

G2766.d:
κεραμος, -ου, ὁ
(κεράννυμι), [in LXX: 2Ki.17:28 (יָצַר כְּלִי)* ;]
__1. potter's clay.
__2. an earthen vessel.
__3. a tile: Luk.5:19.†
(AS)
G2766.s: earthenware, i.e. a tile (by analogy, a thin roof or awning)
G2766.o: probably from the base of G2767 (κεράννυμι) (through the idea of mixing clay and water);

G2767.d:
κεράννυμι
[in LXX for מָסַךְ, Isa.5:22, al. ;]
to mix, mingle, chiefly of the diluting of wine: Rev.18:6; by oxymoron, κεκεράσμενος ἄκρατος, Rev.14:10.†
SYN.: μίγνυμι. κ. implies "a mixing of two things, so that they are blended and forma compound, as in wine and water, whereas μ. implies a mixing without such composition, as in two sorts of grain" (LS, see word κρᾶσις) (AS)
G2767.s: to mingle, i.e. (by implication) to pour out (for drinking)
G2767.o: prolonged form of a more primary (which is used in certain tenses);

G2768.d:
κέρας, -ατος
(pl. not irreg. as in Attic), τό, [in LXX chiefly for קָרַן ;]
a horn: Rev.5:6 12:3 13:1, 11 17:3, 7 17:12, 16; of the projections at the corners of the altar (Exo.29:12, al.): Rev.9:13. Metaphorical, as symbol of strength, κ. σωτηρίας (cf. Psa.18:3, al.): Luk.1:69.†
(AS)
G2768.o: from a primary (the hair of the head);

G2769.d:
κεράτιον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of κέρας),
__1. a little horn (Arist.).
__2. In pl. (the fruit of the κερατέα), carob-pods: Luk.15:16.†
(AS)
G2769.s: something horned, i.e. (specially) the pod of the carob-tree
G2769.o: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2768 (κέρας);

G2770.d:
κερδαίνω
[in Sm.: Job.22:3 * ;]
to gain: with accusative, Mat.25:16-17, 20 25:22; τ. κόσμον, Mat.16:26, Mrk.8:36, Luk.9:25; absol., to make profit, get gain: Jas.4:13. Metaphorical, with accusative of thing(s), to save oneself from, avoid: Act.27:21 (Field, Notes, 145); with accusative of person(s), to gain, win: Mat.18:15, 1Co.9:19-22, Php.3:8; pass., 1Pe.3:1.†
(AS)

G2771.d:
κέρδος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in Aq.: Eze.27:24; Sm.: Psa.30:10, al. ;]
gain: Php.1:21 3:7, Tit.1:11.†
(AS)

G2772.d:
κέρμα, -τος, τό
(κείρω),
__1. a slice, hence,
__2. a small coin: pl., Jhn.2:15.†
(AS)

G2773.d:
κερματιατής, -οῦ, ὁ
(κερματίζω, to cut small, coin into small money),
a money changer: Jhn.2:14.†
(AS)
G2773.s: a handler of coins, i.e. money-broker

G2774.d:
κεφάλαιος, -α, -ον
(κεφαλή), [in LXX (-αιον, τό) for רֹאשׁ, Num_4:2, al. ;]
of the head; metaphorically, principal, chief; mostly as subst., κεφάλαιον, τό;
__1. the chief point: Heb.8:1.
__2. the sum total, amount: Act.22:28 (other meaning, LS, see word).†
(AS)
G2774.s: a principal thing, i.e. main point; specially, an amount (of money)
G2774.o: neuter of a derivative of G2776 (κεφαλή);

G2775.d:
κεφαλιόω (Rec. -αιόω, [so in LXX: Sir.32:8 *]), -ῶ
(κεφάλιον, dimin. of κεφαλή, in late writers)
__1. (-αιόω) to sum up (Thuc., al.).
__2. (In NT, only) to wound on the head: Mrk.12:4.†
(AS)

G2776.d:
κεφαλή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX nearly always for רֹאשׁ ;]
the head: Mat.5:35, Mrk.6:24, Rev.1:14 9:7, al. mult.; figuratively, ἄνθρακες ἐπὶ τὴν κ., Rom.12:20 (LXX); αἷμι, Act.18:6; metaphorically, of a husband, with genitive, 1Co.1:13, Eph.5:23; of Christ, 1Co.11:3, Eph.4:15 5:23, Col.1:18 2:10, 19; of things, κ. γωνίας, Mat.21:42 (LXX)
(AS)
G2776.s: the head (as the part most readily taken hold of), literally or figuratively
G2776.o: from the primary (in the sense of seizing);

G2777.d:
κεφαλίς, -ίδος, ἡ
(dimin. of κεφαλή), [in LXX for מְגִלָּה, וָו, etc. ;]
__1. a little head.
__2. an extremity, capital (of a column).
__3. (As in Exo.2:9, Psa.40:8, Est.6:2) a roll: κ. βιβλίου, Heb.10:7 (LXX).†
(AS)
G2777.s: properly, a knob, i.e. (by implication) a roll (by extension from the end of a stick on which the manuscript was rolled)

G2778.d:
κῆνσος, -ου, ὁ (Lat. census),
a poll-tax: Mat.17:25 22:17, Mrk.12:14 (WH, mg., ἐπικεφάλαιον); τ. νόμισμα τοῦ κ., Mat.22:19 (see MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)
G2778.s: properly, an enrollment ("census"), i.e. (by implication) a tax

G2779.d:
κῆπος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for גַּן, גַּנָּה, גִּנָּה, Deu.11:10, Sng.4:12, al. ;]
a garden: Luk.13:19, Jhn.18:1, 26 19:41.†
(AS)

G2780.d:
κηπ-ουρός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κῆπος + οὖρος, a watcher)
a gardener: Jhn.20:15.†
(AS)

G2781.d:
κηρίον, -ου, τό
(κηρός, wax), [in LXX for נֹפֶת, צוּף, Psa.19:10 118:12, Pro.16:24, al. ;]
honeycomb: κ. μελίσσιον, Luk.24:42 (Rec.; WH, txt., R, txt., omit).†
(AS)
G2781.s: a cell for honey, i.e. (collectively) the comb

G2782.d:
κήρυγμα, -τος, τό
(κηρύσσω), [in LXX: 2Ch.30:5 (קוֹל), Jon.3.2 (קְרִיאָה), Pro.9:3, I Est.9:3 * ;]
in cl.,
that which is cried by a herald, a proclamation. In NT (see Lft., Notes, 161), of God's heralds, proclamation, message, preaching (i.e. the substance as distinct from the act which would be expressed by † κήρυξις): Mat.12:41, Luk.11:32, 1Co.1:21, 2Ti.4:17, Tit.1:3; with genitive cubic., τὸ κ. μου, 1Co.2:4; ἡμῶν, 1Co.15:14; with genitive obj., Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Rom.16:25.†
(AS)
G2782.s: a proclamation (especially of the gospel; by implication, the gospel itself)

G2783.d:
κῆρυξ
(κήρ-, T), -υκος, ὁ [in LXX: Dan LXX TH Dan.3:4 (כָּרוֹז), Gen.41:43, Sir.20:15, 4Ma.6:4 * ;]
a herald: 1Ti.2:7, 2Ti.1:11, 2Pe.2:5.†
(AS)
G2783.s: a herald, i.e. of divine truth (especially of the gospel)

G2784.d:
κηρύσσω
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to be a herald, to proclaim: Mrk.1:45 7:36, Luk.4:18-19" (LXX) (but see Field, Notes, 174) Luk.8:39, Rom.2:21, 1Co.9:27, Gal.5:11, al.; in NT, chiefly of the proclamation of the Gospel, to proclaim, preach: τὸ εὐαγέλιον, Mat.4:23 9:35 24:14 26:13, Mrk.1:14 13:10 14:9 16:15, Gal.2:2, Col.1:23, 1Th.2:9; before εἰς, Mrk.1:39 13:10, Luk.4:44, 1Th.2:9; ἵνα, Mrk.6:12; with inf.. Rom.2:21; κ. Χριστόν, Ἰησοῦν, Act.8:5 9:20 19:13, 1Co.1:23 15:12, 2Co.1:19 11:4, Php.1:15; 1Ti.3:16 (cf. προ-κηρύσσω)
(AS)
G2784.s: to herald (as a public crier), especially divine truth (the gospel)

G2785.d:
κῆτος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX: Jon.2.1; Jon.2.10 (דָּג) Gen.1:21 (תַּנִּין), etc. ;]
a huge fish, sea-monster: Mat.12:40 (LXX).†
(AS)
G2785.s: a huge fish (as gaping for prey)
G2785.o: probably from the base of G5490 (χάσμα);

G2786.s: the Rock; Cephas (i.e. Kepha), a surname of Peter

G2787G.d:
κιβωτός, -οῦ, ἡ
[in LXX: Gen.6:1-22 7:1-24 8:1-22 9:1-29 (תֵּבָה), elsewhere, very freq., as Exo.25:9 (10), for אָרוֹן ;]
a wooden box or chest: of Noah's ark, Mat.24:38, Luk.17:27, Heb.11:7, 1Pe.3:20; of the ark of the covenant, Heb.9:4, Rev.11:19.†
(AS)
G2787G.s: a box, i.e. the sacred ark and that of Noah

G2787H.d:
κιβωτός, -οῦ, ἡ
[in LXX: Gen.6:1-22 7:1-24 8:1-22 9:1-29 (תֵּבָה), elsewhere, very freq., as Exo.25:9 (10), for אָרוֹן ;]
a wooden box or chest: of Noah's ark, Mat.24:38, Luk.17:27, Heb.11:7, 1Pe.3:20; of the ark of the covenant, Heb.9:4, Rev.11:19.†
(AS)
G2787H.s: a box, i.e. the sacred ark and that of Noah

G2788.d:
κιθάρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for כִּנּוֹר, frequently in Psa.33:2, al.); and in (Dan.3:5, al.) for קִיתָרֹס, itself a transliteration of κίθαρις, the Homeric form of κ. (cf. CB, Dn., lviii) ;]
a lyre, harp: 1Co.14:7, Rev.5:8 14:2 15:2.†
(AS)

G2789.d:
κιθαρίζω
[in LXX: Isa.23:16 (נָגַן pi.)* ;]
to play upon the lyre or harp: 1Co.14:7, Rev.14:2.†
(AS)

G2790.d:
κιθαρ-ωδός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κιθάρα, ἀοιδός, a singer)
one who plays and sings to the lyre, a harper: Rev.14:2 18:22.†
(AS)
G2790.o: from G2788 (κιθάρα) and a derivative of the same as G5603 (ᾠδή);

G2791.d:
Κιλικία, -ας, ἡ
Cilicia, a province of Asia Minor: Act.6:9 15:23, 41 21:39 22:3 23:34 27:5, Gal.1:21.†
(AS)
G2791.s: Cilicia, a region of Asia Minor

G2792.d:
κιννάμωμον(Rec. κινάμ-), -υο, τό
(from the Phænician, see LS, see word, and cf. Heb. קִנָּמוֹן)
cinnamon: Rev.18:13.†
(AS)

G2793.d:
κινδυνεύω
(κίνδυνος), [in LXX for יָקֹשׁ ni., etc. ;]
__1. to be daring, to venture.
__2. to be in danger: Luk.8:23, Act.19:27, 40, 1Co.15:30.†
(AS)
G2793.k: be in danger, be (stand) in jeopardy

G2794.d:
κίνδυνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Psa.116:3 (מֵצַר), Sir.3:26, al. ;]
danger, peril: Rom.8:35; pl., 2Co.11:26.†
(AS)

G2795.d:
κινέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for נוּעַ hi., רָמַשׂ, etc. ;]
__1. to set in motion, move: Mat.23:4; τ. κεφαλήν (Psa.22:8, al.), Mat.27:39, Mrk.15:29; pass. (cf. Gen.7:21), Act.17:28.
__2. to remove: Rev.2:5 6:14.
__3. to excite, stir up: Act.24:5; pass., Act.21:30 (cf. μετα-, συν-κινέω).†
(AS)

G2796.d:
κίνησις, -εως, ἡ
(κινέω), [in LXX: Job.16:6 (5), (נִיד), al. ;]
a moving: Jhn.5:3.†
(AS)

G2798.d:
κλάδος, -ου, ὁ
(κλάω), [in LXX for דָּלִיָּה, כַּף, etc. ;]
a young tender shoot broken off for grafting; then, a branch: Mat.13:32 21:8 24:32, Mrk.4:32 13:28, Luk.13:19; metaphorically, of descendants (cf. Sir.40:15), Rom.11:16-19, 21.†
(AS)
G2798.s: a twig or bough (as if broken off)

G2799.d:
κλαίω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּכָה ;]
of any loud expression of pain or sorrow, esp. for the dead, to weep, lament;
__(a) intrans.: Mrk.5:38-39 14:72 (M, Pr., 131) Mrk.16:10, Luk.7:13, 32 7:38 8:52, Jhn.11:31, 33 16:20 20:11, 13 20:15 Act.9:39 21:13, 1Co.7:30, Php.3:18, Jas.4:9 5:1, Rev.5:5 18:15, 19; πολύ, Rev.5:4; πολλά, Act.8:24 (WH, mg.); πικρῶς, Mat.26:75, Luk.22:62; opposite to γελάω, Luk.6:21, 25; χαίρω, Rom.12:15; before ἐπί, with accusative, Luk.19:41 23:28, Rev.18:9;
__(b) trans., with accusative of person(s), to weep or lament for, bewail: Mat.2:18.†
SYN.: see: δακρύω (AS)
G2799.s: to sob, i.e. wail aloud (whereas 1145 is rather to cry silently)

G2801.d:
κλάσμα, -τος, τό
(κλάω), [in LXX for פַּת, פֶּלַח ;]
a broken piece, fragment: Mat.14:20 15:37, Mrk.6:43 8:8, 19-20, Luk.9:17, Jhn.6:12-13 †
(AS)

G2802.d:
Καῦδα (TR, mg., Κλαῦδα; Rec. Κλαύδή), ἡ,
Cauda, Clauda, an island near Crete: Act.27:16.†
(AS)

G2804G.d:
Κλαύδιος, -ου, ὁ
Claudius;
__1. the Emperor: Act.11:28 18:2.
__2. A military tribune, C. Lysias: Act.23:26.†
(AS)
G2804G.s: Claudius, the name of two Romans

G2804H.d:
Κλαύδιος, -ου, ὁ
Claudius;
__1. the Emperor: Act.11:28 18:2.
__2. A military tribune, C. Lysias: Act.23:26.†
(AS)
G2804H.s: Claudius, the name of two Romans

G2805.d:
κλαυθμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κλαίω), [in LXX chiefly for בְּכִי ;]
crying, weeping, Act.20:37; κ. καὶ ὀδυρμός, Mat.2:18 (LXX); ὁ κ. καὶ ὁ βρυγμός, Mat.8:12 13:42, 50 22:13 24:51 25:30, Luk.13:28.†
(AS)

G2806.d:
κλάω
[in LXX: Jer.16:7 (פַּרְנַךְ), al. ;]
to break, break in pieces: of bread, Mat.14:19 15:36 26:26, Mrk.8:6 14:22, Luk.22:19 24:30, Act.2:46 20:7, 11 27:35, 1Co.10:16 11:24; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), Mrk.8:19 (cf. ἐκ-, κατα-κλάω).†
(AS)

G2807.d:
κλείς, -δός Att.. accusative, κλεῖν, later -εῖδα, pl., κλεῖδες, -ας, contr., -εῖς, ἡ,
[in LXX for מַפְתֵּחַ, Isa.22:22, al. ;]
a key. Fig., τ. βασιλείας τ. οὐρανῶν, Mat.16:19; τ. γνώσεως, Luk.11:52; of David (cf. LXX, l.with), Rev.3:7; τ. θανάτου κ. τ. ᾅδου, Rev.1:18; τ. ἀβύσσαυ, Rev.20:1; τ. φρέατος τῆς ἀ., Rev.9:1.†
(AS)
G2807.s: a key (as shutting a lock), literally or figuratively

G2808.d:
κλείω
[in LXX chiefly for סָגַר ;]
to shut: θύραν, Mat.6:6; τ. ἄβυσσον, Rev.20:3; pass., θύρα, Mat.25:10, Luk.11:7 (pl.), Jhn.20:19, 26, Act.21:30; δεσμωτήριον, Act.5:23; πυλῶνες, Rev.21:25. Metaphorical, τ. οὐρανόν, Luk.4:25, Rom.11:6; τ. σπλάγχνα, 1Jn.3:17; τ. βασιλείαν, Mat.23:14; id. absol., Rev.3:7; τ. θύραν, Rev.3:8. (cf. ἀπο-, ἐκ-, κατα-, συν-κλείω.) †
(AS)

G2809.d:
κλέμμα, -τος, τό
(κλέπτω), [in LXX: Gen.31:39, Exo.22:3-4 (2-3) (גָּנַב, גְּנֵבָה)* ;]
__1. a thing stolen (Arist., LXX)
__2. = κλοπή, theft (Plato, al.): pl., Rev.9:21.†
(AS)
G2809.s: stealing (properly, the thing stolen, but used of the act)

G2810.o: probably contracted from (compound of G2811 (κλέος) and G3962 (πατήρ));

G2811.d:
κλέος, -ους, τό
[in LXX: Job.28:22 (שֵׁמַע) Job.30:8 * ;]
__1. a rumour, report.
__2. good report, fame, glory: 1Pe.2:20.†
(AS)
G2811.o: from a shorter form of G2564 (καλέω);

G2812.d:
κλέπτης, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for גַּנָּב ;]
a thief: Mat.6:19-20 24:43, Luk.12:33, 39, Jhn.10:1, 10 12:6, 1Co.6:10, 1Pe.4:15. Fig., ὡς κ. ἐν νυκτί, 1Th.5:2 5:4 (κλέπτας, WH, txt., R, mg.; see Lft., Notes, 73; but cf. also M, Th., l.with), 2Pe.3:10, Rev.3:3 16:15. Metaphorical, of false teachers, Jhn.10:8.†
SYN.: λῃστής, a robber, a brigand who plunders, openly, with violence; κ. is a thief who steals in secret, by fraud and cunning (Tr., Syn., § xliv) (AS)

G2813.d:
κλέπτω
[in LXX for גָּנַב ;]
to steal: absol., Mat.6:19-20 19:18, Mrk.10:19, Luk.18:20, Jhn.10:10, Rom.2:21 13:9, Eph.4:28; with accusative, Mat.27:64 28:13.†
(AS)

G2814.d:
κλῆμα, -τος, τό
(κλάω), [in LXX chiefly for זְמוֹרָה, דָּלִיָּה, Eze.15:2 17:6-7, al. ;]
a vine-twig, vine-branch: Jhn.15:2, 4-6.†
(AS)
G2814.s: a limb or shoot (as if broken off)

G2816.d:
κληρονομέω, -ῶ
(κληρονόμος) [in LXX chiefly for יָרַשׁ, also for נָחַל, etc. ;]
__1. to receive by lot.
__2. to inherit (in cl., usually with genitive of thing(s)): absol., Gal.4:30 (LXX); in general, to possess oneself of, receive as one's own, obtain (as Deu.4:5, al., cf. Psa.25:3, Isa.61:7): with accusative of thing(s) (as generally in late Gk., see M, Pr., 65), of the Messianic Kingdom (cf. Psa.37:11, Sir.4:13 37:26, and see Dalman, Words, 125 ff.) and its bless­ings and privileges, τ. γῆν, Mat.5:5 (cf. LXX); τ. βασιλείαν, β. θεοῦ, Mat.25:34, 1Co.6:9-10 15:50, Gal.5:21; ζωὴν αἰώνιον, Mat.19:29, Mrk.10:17, Luk.10:25 18:18; σωτηρίαν, Heb.1:14; τ.…
G2816.s: to be an heir to (literally or figuratively)

G2817.d:
κληρονομία, -ας, ἡ
(κληρονόμος) [in LXX chiefly for נַחֲלָה, also for יְרֻשָּׁה, etc. ;]
prop., an inherited property, an inheritance: Mat.21:38, Mrk.12:7, Luk.12:13 20:14; in general, a possession, inheritance: Act.7:5, Heb.11:8; of the Messianic Kingdom and its blessings, Act.20:32, Gal.3:18, Col.3:24, Eph.1:14, 18 5:5, Heb.9:15, 1Pe.1:4.†
(AS)
G2817.s: heirship, i.e. (concretely) a patrimony or (genitive case) a possession

G2818.d:
κληρο-νόμος, -ου, ὁ
(κλῆρος, νέμομαι, to possess) [in LXX: Jdg.18:7, 2Ki.14:7, Mic.1:15, Jer.8:10 (יָרַשׁ), Sir.23:22 * ;]
__1. (as in cl.) an heir: Mat.21:38, Mrk.12:7, Luk.20:14, Gal.4:1; of those who as sons of God inherit the privileges of the Messianic Kingdom; of Christ himself, Heb.1:2; of Abraham, Rom.4:13-14; of Christians, Rom.8:17, Gal.3:29, Tit.3:7, Jas.2:5.
__2. (As in LXX: Jg, Mi, Je, ll. with) a possessor: Heb.6:17 11:7 (Cremer, 359 f.).†
(AS)
G2818.s: a sharer by lot, i.e. inheritor (literally or figuratively); by implication, a possessor
G2818.o: from G2819 (κλῆρος) and the base of G3551 (νόμος) (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. (reflexively) getting by apportionment);

G2819.d:
κλῆρος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for נַחֲלָה גּוֹרָל ;]
a lot;
__(a) that which is cast or drawn: Mat.27:35, Mrk.15:24, Luk.23:34, Jhn.19:24" (LXX), Act.1:26;
__(b) that which is obtained by casting: Act.1:17 8:21; of a part in the Kingdom of God (cf. Wis 55), Act.26:18, Col.1:12; pl. of the "cure" of a presbyter, 1Pe.5:3 (see ICC, in l).†
(AS)
G2819.s: a die (for drawing chances); by implication, a portion (as if so secured); by extension, an acquisition (especially a patrimony, figuratively)
G2819.o: probably from G2806 (κλάω) (through the idea of using bits of wood, etc., for the purpose;

G2820.d:
κληρόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 1Ki.14:41 (לָכַד ni.), Est.4:11 A (קָרָא ni.), Isa.17:11 * ;]
__1. to cast lots.
__2. to choose by lot.
__3. to assign by lot, assign a portion: pass., ἐν ᾧ καὶ ἐκληρώθημεν, Eph.1:11 (on the various interpretations, see ICC; AR; Ellic., in l).†
(AS)
G2820.s: to allot, i.e. (figuratively) to assign (a privilege)

G2821.d:
κλῆσις, -εως, ἡ (καλέω)
[in LXX: Jer.31:6 (קָרָא), Jdth.12:10 A, 3Ma.5:14 * ;]
a calling, call; in NT, always of the Divine call to salvation: Rom.11:29, 1Co.1:26 7:20, Eph.1:18 4:1, 4, Php.3:14, 2Th.1:11, 2Ti.1:9, Heb.3:1, 2Pe.1:10 (Cremer, 332).†
(AS)
G2821.o: from a shorter form of G2564 (καλέω);

G2822.d:
κλητός, -ή, -όν
(καλέω), [in LXX for קָרָא, מִקְרָא, Exo.12:16, al. ;]
called, invited (as to a banquet, Æsch., 1Sa 1:41, 3Ma.5:14); in NT, always of the Divine call;
__(a) to some office: κ. ἀπόστολος, Rom.1:1, 1Co.1:1;
__(b) to salvation: Rom.8:28, 1Co.1:24, Ju 1; κ. καὶ ἐκλεκτοὶ κ. πιστοί, Rev.17:14; in gosp. (not in pl., see: καλέω) disting. fr.ἐκλεκτός, Mat.20:16 (WH, txt., R, omit), Mat.22:14; κ. Ἰησοῦ Χρ., Rom.1:6; κ. ἅγιοι, saints by calling, Rom.1:7, 1Co.1:2.†
(AS)
G2822.s: invited, i.e. appointed, or (specially), a saint

G2823.d:
κλίβανος, -ον, ό
(Att.., κρίβ-, but κλ- in Ion., Hdt., ii, 92), [in LXX for תַּנּוּר, Gen.15:17, Hos.7:4, 6 al. ;]
__1. in cl., a clibanus, cribanus, an earthen vessel for baking bread.
__2. In LXX and NT, a furnace (cf. MM, Exp., xv), an oven: Mat.6:30, Luk.12:28.†
(AS)
G2823.s: an earthen pot used for baking in

G2824.d:
κλίμα, -τος, τό
(κλίνω) [in LXX: Jdg.20:2 A (פִּנָּה)* ;]
__1. an inclination, slope, esp. the slope from the equator to the pole (Arist).
__2. a region (Polyb., al.): pl., Rom.15:23, 2Co.11:10, Gal.1:21.†
(AS)
G2824.s: a slope, i.e. (specially) a "clime" or tract of country

G2825.d:
κλίνη, -ης, ἡ
(κλίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִטָּה ;]
a bed, couch: Mat.9:2, 6, Mrk.4:21 7:4, 30, Luk.5:18 8:16 17:34, Rev.2:22 (cf. MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)
G2825.s: a couch (for sleep, sickness, sitting or eating)

G2826.d:
κλινίδιον, -ου, τό
dimin. of κλίνη,
a conch: Luk.5:19, 24 (cf. κλενάριον).†
(AS)
G2826.o: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2825 (κλίνη);

G2827.d:
κλίνω
[in LXX chiefly for נָטָה ;]
__1. to make to bend, to bow: τ. κεφαλήν (of one dying), Jhn.19:30; τ. πρόσωτον (of terrified persons), Luk.24:5.
__2. to make to lean, to rest: τ. κεφαλήν (in sleep), Mat.8:20, Luk.9:58.
__3. As in Hom., of soldiers, to turn (to flight), παρεμβολάς, Heb.11:34.
__4. In late Gk. (as mid, in cl.), to decline: intrans., ἡ ἡμέρα, Luk.9:12 24:29.†
(AS)
G2827.s: to slant or slope, i.e. incline or recline (literally or figuratively)
G2827.k: bow (down), be far spent, lay, turn to flight, wear away

G2828.d:
κλισία, -ας, ή
(κλίνω), [in LXX: 3Ma.6:31 A* ;]
__1. a place for reclining; hence,
__(a) a hut;
__(b) an easy chair;
__(with) a couch.
__2. a company reclining: pl., Luk.9:14 (cf. FlJ, Ant., xii, 2, 12)
(AS)
G2828.s: properly, reclination, i.e. (concretely and specially), a party at a meal

G2829.d:
κλοπή, -ῆν, ἡ
(κλέπτω), [in LXX for גָּנַב ;]
theft: pl., Mat.15:19, Mrk.7:22.†
(AS)

G2830.d:
κλύδων, -ωνος, ὁ
(κλύζω, of the sea, to wash over), [in LXX: Jon.1.4; Jon.1.12 (סַעַר), al. ;]
a billow, surge: Luk.8:24, Jas.1:6.†
SYN.: κῦμα, a wave (AS)
G2830.s: a surge of the sea (literally or figuratively)

G2831.d:
κλυδωνίζομαι
(κλύδων), [in LXX: Isa.57:20 (גָּרַשׁ)* ;]
to be tossed by waves; metaphorically, to be tossed like waves (cf. FlJ, Ant., ix, 11, 3): Eph.4:14.†
(AS)

G2832.d:
Κλωπᾶς, -ᾶ, ὁ (Aram.; on the original, see Lft., Gal., 267 f.),
Clopas: Jhn.19:25.†
(AS)

G2833.d:
κνήθω
(late form of κνάω),
__1. to scratch.
__2. to tickle; pass., to itch: 2Ti.4:3.†
(AS)
G2833.s: to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to tickle

G2834.d:
Κνίδος, -ου, ἡ
Cnidus, a city (and peninsula) on S.W. coast of Asia Minor: Act.27:7.†
(AS)
G2834.s: Cnidus, a place in Asia Minor

G2835.d:
κοδράντης, -ου, ὁ (Lat. quadrans, the fourth part of an as),
a quadrans (AV, farthing): Mat.5:26, Mrk.12:42.†
(AS)
G2835.s: a quadrans, i.e. the fourth part of an as

G2836.d:
κοιλία, -ας, ἡ
(κοῖλος, hollow), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּטֶן, מֵעֶה, קֶרֶב, Deu.7:13, 2Ki.7:12, Gen.41:21, al.; also (Job.3:11 10:18 31:15 38:8) for רֶחֶם ;]
__1. the belly (stomach or intestines or both): Mat.12:40 15:17, Mrk.7:19, Luk.15:16, Rom.16:18, 1Co.6:13, Php.3:19, Rev.10:9-10.
__2. (As often in LXX) the womb: Luk.1:41-42, 44 2:21 11:27 23:29, Jhn.3:4; ἐκ κ. μητρός (cf. Psa.22:11, Job.1:21, al.), Mat.19:12, Luk.1:15, Act.3:2 14:8, Gal.1:15.
__3. Metaphorical (as Heb. בֶּטֶן, cf. Job.15:35, Pro.20:27, Sir.19:12), of the heart: Jhn.7:38.†
(AS)
G2836.s: a cavity, i.e. (especially) the abdomen; by implication, the matrix; figuratively, the heart

G2837.d:
κοιμάω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁכַב ;]
to lull to sleep, put to sleep. Mid and pass., to fall asleep (M, Pr., 162; M, Th., 1, 4, 13): Mat.28:13, Luk.22:45, Jhn.11:12, Act.12:6. Metaph, of death: Mat.27:52, Jhn.11:11 Act.7:60 13:36, 1Co.7:39 11:30 15:6 15:18 15:20 15:51, 1Th.4:13-15, 2Pe.3:4 (cf. Isa.14:8 43:17, 2Ma.12:45).†
SYN.: καθεύδω (AS)
G2837.s: to put to sleep, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to slumber; figuratively, to decease
G2837.k: (be a-, fall a-, fall on) sleep, be dead

G2838.d:
κοίμησις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: Sir.46:19 48:13 * ;]
a reclining, resting: Jhn.11:13.†
(AS)

G2839G.d:
κοινός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: Pro.1:14 (אֶחָד) Pro.21:9 25:24 (חֶבֶר), Wis.7:3, al. ;]
__1. common (general; = Lat. communis): Act.2:44 4:32; κ. πίστις, Tit.1:4; σωτηρία, Ju 3
__2. common (ordinary; = vulgaris); hence in LXX (1Ma.1:47, al.) and NT, unhallowed, unclean (cl., βέβηλος, which see): Mrk.7:2, 5, Act.10:14, 28 11:8, Rom.14:14, Heb.10:29, Rev.21:27.†
(AS)
G2839G.s: common, i.e. (literally) shared by all or several, or (ceremonially) profane

G2839H.d:
κοινός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: Pro.1:14 (אֶחָד) Pro.21:9 25:24 (חֶבֶר), Wis.7:3, al. ;]
__1. common (general; = Lat. communis): Act.2:44 4:32; κ. πίστις, Tit.1:4; σωτηρία, Ju 3
__2. common (ordinary; = vulgaris); hence in LXX (1Ma.1:47, al.) and NT, unhallowed, unclean (cl., βέβηλος, which see): Mrk.7:2, 5, Act.10:14, 28 11:8, Rom.14:14, Heb.10:29, Rev.21:27.†
(AS)
G2839H.s: common, i.e. (literally) shared by all or several, or (ceremonially) profane

G2840.d:
κοινόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 4Ma.7:6 א R* ;]
__1. in cl., to make common.
__2. In LXX, l.with, and NT (as κοινός, 2), to make ceremonially unclean, to profane (= cl., βεληλόω): Mat.15:11, 18 15:20, Mrk.7:15, 18 7:20, 23, Act.21:28; pass., Heb.9:13.
__3. to count unclean (cf. δικαιόω): Act.10:15 11:9.†
SYN.: βεβηλόω. Thayer (see word κ.) mentions that Winer Notes the accuracy whereby the Jews are said to use κ. in addressing Jews, Act.21:28, and β. when speaking to Felix, 24:6 (Cremer, 362) (AS)

G2841.d:
κοινωνέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ch.20:35, Job.34:8, Ecc.9:4 (חָבַר), Pro.1:11, Wis.6:23, Sir.13:1, al. ;]
to have a share of, go shares in (something) with (some one), take part in: with genitive of thing(s) (as usually in cl., so Pr, l.with), Heb.2:14; with dative of thing(s), Rom.12:13 15:27, 1Ti.5:22, 1Pe.4:13, 2Jn.11; with dative of person(s), before εἰς, Php.4:15; ἐν, Gal.6:6 (cf. συν-κοινωνέω).†
(AS)
G2841.s: to share with others (objectively or subjectively)

G2842.d:
κοινωνία, -ας, ἡ
(κοινωνός), [in LXX: Lev.6:2 (יָד תְּשׂוּמֶת), Wis.8:18, 3Ma.4:6 * ;]
__1. fellowship, communion: Act.2:42, 2Co.6:14, Php.1:5; τ. υἱοῦ, 1Co.1:9; τ. αἵματος, σώματος Χρ., 1Co.10:10 : παθημάτων αὐτσῦ, Php.3:10; τ. πνεύματος, 2Co.13:13, Php.2:1; δεξιὰς κοινωνίας, Gal.2:9; τ. πίστεώς σου, Phm 6; before μετὰ: τ. πατρός, 1Jn.1:3 Jn 1:6; ἡμῶν, ἀλλήλων, 1Jn.1:3 Jn 1:7.
__2. contribution (as outcome of fellowship): Rom.15:26, 2Co.8:4 9:13, Heb.13:6 (cf. Art. Communion, DB, i, 460 ff.; MM, Exp., xv).†
(AS)
G2842.s: partnership, i.e. (literally) participation, or (social) intercourse, or (pecuniary) benefaction

G2843.d:
κοινωνικός, -ή, -όν
(κοινωνία),
__1. sociable.
__2. ready to com­municate or impart (R, mg., ready to sympathize, see Field, Notes, 213 f.): 1Ti.6:18.†
(AS)

G2844.d:
κοινωνός, -ή, -όν
(κοινός), [in LXX: Pro.28:24, Isa.1:23 (חָבֵר), Mal.2:14 (חֲבֶרֶת), Est.8:13, al. ;]
__1. as adj., = κοινός.
__2. As subst., ὁ, ἡ κ.,
__(a) a partner, associate, companion: 2Co.8:23, Phm 17; with dative of person(s), Luk.5:10; with genitive of person(s), Heb.10:33; id. before ἐν, Mat.23:30;
__(b) a partaker, sharer: with genitive of thing(s), 1Co.10:18 10:20, 2Co.1:7, 1Pe.5:1, 2Pe.1:4 (see Deiss., BS, 368 n2).†
(AS)

G2845.d:
κοίτη, -ης, ἡ (in Hom., κοῖτος)
[in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁכָּב, also for שְׁכָבָה, etc. ;]
a bed: Luk.11:7; esp. the marriage-bed: κ. ἀμίαντος, Heb.13:4; κ. ἔχειν, of a woman conceiving, Rom.9:10 (cf. peculiar phrases in LXX, Lev.15:18, al.); of illicit intercourse, pl., Rom.13:13.†
(AS)
G2845.s: a couch; by extension, cohabitation; by implication, the male sperm

G2846.d:
κοιτών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(κοίτη = Att.., δωμότιον, see Kennedy, Sources, 40), [in LXX chiefly for חֶדֶר, 2Ki.4:7, Jol.2:16; I Est.3:3, al. ;]
a bed-chamber; ὁ ἐπὶ τοῦ κ., a chamberlain: Act.12:20.†
(AS)

G2847.d:
κόκκινος, -η, -ον
(κόκκος, as used of the "berry" of the ilex coccifera, see DB, iv, 416), [in LXX for תּוֹלָע, תּוֹלָע, שָׁנִי, Exo.25:4, Gen.38:23, Isa.1:18, al. ;]
scarlet: Mat.27:28, Heb.9:19, Rev.17:3; neut., without substantive, of clothing, Rev.17:4 18:12, 16,†
(AS)
G2847.o: from G2848 (κόκκος) (from the kernel-shape of the insect);

G2848.d:
κόκκος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: La 4:5 B א R (תּוֹלָע), Sir.45:11 * ;]
a grain: Mat.13:31 17:20, Mrk.4:31, Luk.13:19 17:6, Jhn.12:24, 1Co.15:37.†
(AS)

G2849.d:
κολάζω
(κόλος, docked), [in LXX: Dan.6:12 (13) (no Heb.), I Est.8:24, Wis.3:4 (and freq.), 1Ma.7:7, al. ;]
__1. to curtail, dock, prune.
__2. to check, restrain.
__3. to chastise, correct, punish: pass., 2Pe.2:9; mid., cause to be punished (3Ma.7:3): Act.4:21.†
(AS)
G2849.s: properly, to curtail, i.e. (figuratively) to chastise (or reserve for infliction)

G2851.d:
κόλασις, -εως, ἡ
(κολάζω), [in LXX: Eze.14:3-7 18:30 44:12, (מִכְשׁוֹל) Eze.43:11, λαμβάνειν τὴν κ. (כָּלַם ni.); Wis.11:13 16:2, 24 19:4, Jer.18:20, 2-4 Mac.5 * ;]
correction, penalty, punishment: Mat.25:46, 1Jn.4:18.†
SYN.: τιμωρία, requital. Arist. distinguishes between κ . as that which, being disciplinary, has reference to the sufferer, and τ. as that which, being penal, has reference to the satisfaction of him who inflicts (see Thayer, see word κ., and cf. Tr., Syn., § vii). But in late Gk. especially, the distinction is not always maintained (see reff. in Thayer) (AS)

G2852.d:
κολαφίζω
(κόλαφος = Att.., κόνδυλοι, the knuckles, the closed fist)
to strike with the fist, to buffet: Mat.26:67, Mrk.14:65, 2Co.12:7; pass., 1Co.4:11, 1Pe.2:20.†
(AS)
G2852.o: from a derivative of the base of G2849 (κολάζω);

G2853.d:
κολλάω, -ῶ
(κόλλα, glue), [in LXX chiefly for דָּבַק ;]
__1. to glue or cement together.
__2. Generally, to unite, to join firmly. Pass., to cleave to, join (oneself to): with dative of person(s), Mat.19:5(LXX), Luk.10:11 15:15, Act.5:13 (but see Field, Notes, 118) Act.9:26 10:28 (see Field, l.with) Act.17:34; τ. πόρνῃ, 1Co.6:16; τ. Κυρίῳ, 1Co.6:17; with dative of thing(s), ἅρματι, Act.8:29; τ. ἀγαθῴ, Rom.12:9; of sins joining together, ἄχρι τ. οὐρανοῦ, Rev.18:5, of dust, Luk.10:11 (cf. τροσ-κολλάω).†
(AS)
G2853.s: to glue, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to stick (figuratively)

G2854.d:
κολλούριον
(TTr., κολλύ-, the more usual form), -ου, τό (dimin. of κολλύρα = κόλλιξ, a coarse bread roll), [in LXX: 3Ki.12:24 hil B* ;]
__1. a small bread roll (LXX, ll. with).
__2. (Usually in pl., LS, see word) an eye salve shaped like a roll: Rev.3:18.†
(AS)
G2854.s: prob akin to the base of G2853 (κολλάω)); properly, a poultice (as made of or in the form of crackers), i.e. (by analogy) a plaster
G2854.o: neuter of a presumed derivative of (a cake;

G2855.d:
κολλυβιστής, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόλλυβος, a small coin, a rate of exchange),
a money-changer: Mat.21:12, Mrk.11:15, Jhn.2:15 (of. κερματιοτής).†
(AS)
G2855.s: probably akin to G2854 (κολλούριον)); a coin-dealer
G2855.o: from a presumed derivative of (a small coin;

G2856.d:
κολοβόω, -ῶ
(κολοβός, docked), [in LXX: 2Ki.4:12 (קָצַץ pi.) * ;]
to cut off, amputate (LXX), hence, to curtail, shorten: Mat.24:22, Mrk.13:20.†
(AS)
G2856.o: from a derivative of the base of G2849 (κολάζω);

G2857G.d:
Κολοσσαί
(so in cl.; -ασσαί, Rec., LTr.), -ῶν, αἰ
Colossæ, a city on the Lycus in Phrygia: Col.1:2.†
(AS)
G2857G.s: Colossæ, a place in Asia Minor

G2858.d:
Κολασσαεύς (Rec. Κολοσ-), -έως, ὁ
a Colossian: pl., Col., tit. (and subscr., Rec., Tr.).†
(AS)

G2859.d:
κόλπος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for חֵיק ;]
__1. prop., the bosom: Jhn.13:23; fig., of close association, ἐν (εἰς τὸν) τοῖς κ. Ἀβραάμ, Luk.16:22-23 (cf. 4Ma.13:16); ὁ ὢν εἰς τὸν κ. τ. πατρός, Jhn.1:18
__2. The bosom or fold of a loose garment falling over a girdle, used as a pocket, hence figuratively, εἰς τὸν κ. Isa.65:6, Jer.32:18 : Luk.6:38
__3. A bosom-like hollow, as a bay or gulf: Act.27:39.†
(AS)
G2859.s: the bosom; by analogy, a bay

G2860.d:
κολυμβάω, -ῶ
[in AI.: Isa.25:11 * ;]
to dive, plunge into the sea: Act.27:43 (cf. ἐκ-κολνμβάω).†
(AS)

G2861.d:
κολυμβήθρα, -ας, ἡ
(κολνμβάω), [in LXX for בְּרֵכָה, 4Ki.18:27, al. ;]
a swimming pool, pool: Jhn.5:2, 4 5:7 9:7.†
(AS)
G2861.s: a diving-place, i.e. pond for bathing (or swimming)

G2862.d:
κολωνία (Rec. -ώνια), -ας, ἡ
(Lat. colonic),
a colony: Act.16:12 (see Lft., Phi., 50 f.).†
(AS)

G2864.d:
κόμη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Num.6:5, Eze.44:20 (פֶּרַע), al. ;]
the hair: 1Co.11:15.†
(AS)
G2864.s: the hair of the head (locks, as ornamental, and thus differing from G2359 (θρίξ); which properly denotes merely the scalp)
G2864.o: apparently from the same as G2865 (κομίζω);

G2865.d:
κομίζω
[in LXX for נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
__1. to take care of.
__2. to carry off safe.
__3. to carry off as booty.
__4. to bear or carry: Luk.7:37. Mid., to bear for oneself, hence,
__(a) to receive: Heb.10:36 11:13, 39, 1Pe.1:9 5:4, 2Pe.2:13;
__(b) to receive back, recover (in cl. so also act.): Mat.25:27, Heb.11:19; metaphorically, of requital, 2Co.5:10, Col.3:25; παρὰ Κυρίου, Eph.6:8 (cf. ἐκ-, συν-κομίζω).†
(AS)
G2865.s: properly, to provide for, i.e. (by implication) to carry off (as if from harm; genitive case obtain)
G2865.o: from a primary (to tend, i.e. take care of);

G2866.d:
κομψός, -ή, -όν
(κομέω, to take care of),
well-dressed, elegant, fine; compar. neut., κομψότερον ἔχειν (cf. κόμψως ἔχειν, Epict., and colloq. Eng., "to be doing finely"): Jhn.4:52.†
(AS)
G2866.o: neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of 2865 (meaning, properly, well dressed, i.e. nice);

G2867.d:
κονιάω, -ῶ
(κονία, dust, lime), [in LXX: Deu.27:2, 4 (שִׂיד), Pro.21:9 * ;]
to plaster or whiten over: of tombs, Mat.23:27; figuratively, of a hypocrite, Act.23:3.†
(AS)

G2868.d:
κονιορτός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόνις or κονία, dust, ὄρνυμι, to stir up), [in LXX for אָבָק, etc. ;]
in cl., dust stirred up (Exo.9:9, Isa.5:24); in NT, simply dust: Mat.10:14, Luk.9:5 10:11, Act.13:51 22:23.†
(AS)
G2868.o: from the base of G2867 (κονιάω) and ornumi (to "rouse");

G2869.d:
κοπάζω
(κόπος), [in LXX: Gen.8:1, Est.2:1 7:10 (שָׁכַךְ), Rut.1:18, al. (חָדַל), חָדַל), Jon.1.11-12 (שָׁתַק), al. ;]
to grow weary; of the wind (Hdt., Jh., l.with), to abate, cease raging: Mat.14:32, Mrk.4:39 6:51.†
(AS)

G2870.d:
κοπετός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κόπτω, mid.), [in LXX chiefly for מִסְפֵּד ;]
= cl. κομμός, a beating of the head and breast, lamentation: before ἐπί with dative of person(s), Act.8:2.†
(AS)

G2871.d:
κοπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(κόπτω), [in LXX: Gen.14:17, Jos.10:20 (נָכָה hi., מַכָּה), Deu.28:25 (נָגַף), Jdth.15:7 * ;]
__1. in cl., a stroke, a pounding (as in a mortar).
__2. In LXX, a smiting in battle: Heb.7:1 (LXX).†
(AS)

G2872.d:
κοπιάω, -ῶ
(κόπος), [in LXX chiefly for יָגַע ;]
__1. (as in cl.) to grow weary: Mat.11:28, Jhn.4:6, Rev.2:3 (cf. Isa.40:31).
__2. Hence, in LXX and NT, to work with effort, to toil: absol., Mat.6:23, Luk.5:5 12:27, Jhn.4:38, Act.20:35, 1Co.4:12, Eph.4:28, 2Ti.2:5; with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.4:38; frequently in Paul. Epp., of ministerial labour: 1Co.15:10 16:16; before ἐν, Rom.16:12, 1Th.5:12 (see M, Th., in l), 1Ti.5:17; εἰς, Rom.16:6, Gal.4:11, Php.2:16, Col.1:29, 1Ti.4:10.†
(AS)
G2872.s: to feel fatigue; by implication, to work hard

G2873.d:
κόπος, -ου, ὁ
(κόπτω) [in LXX chiefly for עָמָל, also for אָוֶן, etc. ;]
__1. a striking, beating (in Jer.45:3 = κοπετός)
__2. laborious toil, trouble: Jhn.4:38, 1Co.3:8 15:58, 1Th.3:5; κ. τ. ἀγάπης, 1Th.1:3; ἔργα καὶ κ., Rev.2:2; κ. καὶ μόχθος, 2Co.11:27, 1Th.2:9, 2Th.3:8; pl., ἐν κ., 2Co.6:5 10:15 11:23; ἐκ τ. κ., Rev.14:13; κόπονς (-ον) παρέχειν (in cl. more frequently π. πράγματα, πονον), with dative of person(s), Mat.26:10, Mrk.14:6, Luk.11:7 18:5, Gal.6:17.†
SYN.: μόλθος, labour; πόνος (which see), toil, painful effort; in cl., "π. gives prominence to the effort (work as requiring force), κ. to the fatigue, μ. (chiefly poetic) to the hardship"…
G2873.s: a cut, i.e. (by analogy) toil (as reducing the strength), literally or figuratively; by implication, pains

G2874.d:
κοπρία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for אַשְׁפֹּת ;]
a dung hill (1Ki.2:8, Psa.113:7 al.): Luk.14:35.†
κόπριον, -ου, τό,
[in LXX (pl.): Jer.25:33 (דֹּמֶן), Sir.22:2, 1Ma.2:62 * ;]
= κόπρος, dung: pl., Luk.13:8 (WH, mg., κόφινον κοπρίων).†
(AS)

G2875.d:
κόπτω
[in LXX for כָּרַת, סָפַד, נָכָה hi., etc. ;]
__1. to strike, smite.
__2. to cut off: with accusative of thing(s), before ἀπό, Mat.21:8; ἐκ, Mrk.11:8. Mid., to beat one's breast with grief, to mourn, bewail: Mat.11:17 24:30; with accusative of person(s), Luk.8:52 23:27; before ἐπί, with accusative, Rev.1:7 18:9 (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐν-, κατα-, προ-, προσ-κόπτω).†
SYN.: θρηνέω, q.v (AS)
G2875.s: to "chop"; specially, to beat the breast in grief

G2876.d:
κόραξ, -ακος, ὁ
[in LXX for עֹרֵב ;]
a raven: Luk.12:24.†
(AS)

G2877.d:
κοράσιον, -ου, τό
(dimin. of κόρη), [in LXX chiefly for נַעֲרָה, Rut.2:8, al.; in Joel 4:3, Zec.8:5 for יַלְדָּה ;]
a colloquial word which survives in MGr. (Kennedy, Sourcs, e154), girl, maiden: Mat.9:24-25 14:11, Mrk.5:41-42 6:22, 28.†
(AS)
G2877.o: neuter of a presumed derivative of (a maiden);

G2878.d:
κορβάν (Rec., T, -βᾶν), indecl. (Heb. קׇרְבָּן),
an offering, a gift offered to God: Mrk.7:11 (cf. κορβανᾶς).†
(AS)
G2878.s: a votive offering and the offering; a consecrated present (to the Temple fund); by extension (the latter term) the Treasury itself, i.e. the room where the contribution boxes stood
G2878.o: of Hebrew and Chaldee origin respectively (H07133);

G2880.d:
κορέννυμι
(κόρος, surfeit), [in Symmachus.: Psa.22:27, Al, Psa.103:5 * ;]
to satisfy: pass., τροφῆς, Act.27:38; metaphorically, of spiritual things, 1Co.4:8.†
(AS)
G2880.s: to cram, i.e. glut or sate

G2881.d:
κορίνθιος, -α, -ον
Corinthian; as subst., ὁ Κ., a Corinthian: Act.18:8 27:1-44 (WH, txt., R, omit), 2Co.6:11; 1Co, 2Co, tit.†
(AS)
G2881.s: a Corinthian, i.e. inhabitant of Corinth

G2884.d:
κόρος, -ου, ὁ
(Heb. כֹּר), [in LXX: Lev.27:16, Num.11:32, Eze.45:13 (חֹמֶר); more freq., 2Ch.27:5, al.(כֹּר) ;]
a cor, a Hebrew measure (AV, RV, measure): Luk.16:7.†
(AS)
G2884.s: a cor, i.e. a specific measure

G2885.d:
κοσμέω, -ῶ
(κόσμος), [in LXX for עָדָה, תָּקַן, etc. ;]
__1. to order, arrange, prepare (in Hom. esp. of marshalling armies): Mat.25:7 (cf. Sir.50:9, al.).
__2. to adorn, furnish: οἶκον, pass., Mat.12:44, Luk.11:25; μνημεῖα, Mat.23:29; τὸ ἱερόν, pass., Luk.21:5; θεμέλιοι, Rev.21:19; νύμφην, pass., Rev.21:2; ἐαυτάς, before ἐν, 1Ti.2:9. Metaphorical, with accusative of person(s), 1Pe.3:5; with accusative of thing(s), Tit.2:10.†
(AS)
G2885.s: to put in proper order, i.e. decorate (literally or figuratively); specially, to snuff (a wick)

G2886.d:
κοσμικός, -ή, -όν
(κόσμος)
__1. pertaining to the world or universe.
__2. of this world, earthly. Heb.9:1.
__3. In ethical sense, worldly: ἐπιθυμίαι, Tit.2:12.†
(AS)

G2887.d:
κόσμιος, -ον (in cl. -α, -ον),
(κόσμος), [in LXX: Ecc.12:9 (תָּקַן)* ;]
orderly, decent, modest: 1Ti.2:9 (WH, mg., -ίως, which see) 1Ti.3:2.†
(AS)

G2888.d:
κοσμοκράτωρ, -ορος, ὁ
(κόσμος, κρατέω),
__1. in Orphic hymns, al. (see AR, Eph., l.with), a ruler of the whole world (and so in Rabbinic writings: קוֺזמוֺקְרָטוֺר).
__2. a ruler of this world (in contrast to παντο κράτωρ): οἱ κ. τ. σκότους τούτου, the rulers of this dark world, Eph.6:12.†
(AS)
G2888.s: a world-ruler, an epithet of Satan

G2889.d:
κόσμος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Gen.2:1, Deu.4:19 17:3, Isa.24:21 40:26 (צבא), Exo.33:5, 6 Jer.2:32 4:30, Eze.7:20 16:11 23:40 (עֲדִי), Isa.61:10 (כְּלִי), al., Wis.2:24 and freq., Sir.6:30, al ;]
__1. order (Hom., Plat., al.).
__2. ornament, adornment, esp. of women (Hom., al.): 1Pe.3:3.
__3. Later, the world or universe, as an ordered system (Plat., al.): Act.17:24, Rom.4:13, 1Co.3:22, Php.2:15, Heb.4:3, al.
__4. In late writers only, the world, i.e. the earth (= ἡ οἰκουμένη, cf. Mat.4:8 with Luk.4:5): Mat.4:8, Mrk.16:[15], Col.2:20, 1Ti.6:7, al.; hence by meton.,
__(a) of the human inhabitants of the…
G2889.s: orderly arrangement, i.e. decoration; by implication, the world (in a wide or narrow sense, including its inhabitants, literally or figuratively (morally))
G2889.o: probably from the base of G2865 (κομίζω);

G2891.d:
κούμ (Tr., txt., κοῦμ, Rec. κοῦμι) (Heb. imperat. masc., used as an interjection, קוּם),
koum (arise): Mrk.5:41.†
(AS)

G2893.d:
κουφίζω
(κοῦφος, light), [in LXX: Exo.18:22, Jon.1.5, al. (קָלַל hi.), Est.5:1, al. ;]
__1. intrans., to be light (poetic chiefly).
__2. to lighten, make light: with accusative, Act.27:38.†
(AS)

G2894.d:
κόφινος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Jdg.6:19 (סַל), Psa.81:6 (דּוּד)* ;]
a basket, probably of wicker-work, such as were carried by Jews for food: Mat.14:20 16:9, Mrk.6:43 8:19 9:17 13:8, Jhn.6:13 (cf. σφυρίς).†
(AS)

G2895.d:
κράβαττος (Rec. κράββατος), ου, ὁ
(a Macedonian word, = Lat. grabatus, cl. σκίμπους), [in Aquila.: Amo.3:12 * ;]
a camp bed, pallet: Mrk.2:4, 9 2:11-12 6:55, Jhn.5:8-11, Act.5:15 9:33 (see Swete, Mk., 24, and cf. κλίνη).†
(AS)

G2896.d:
κράζω
[in LXX for זָעַק, צָעַק, קָרָא, etc. ;]
in cl. chiefly poët.,
__1. prop. onomatop., of the raven, to croak, hence generally, of inartic. cries, to scream, cry out (Æsch., al.): Mrk.5:5 9:26 15:39 (Rec., R, mg.), Luk.9:39, al.; of crying for vengeance (cf. Gen.4:10), Jas.5:4.
__2. to cry, call out with a loud voice: with accusative of thing(s), Act.19:32; before orat. dir., Mrk.10:48, Luk.18:39, al.; (ἐν) φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, Mrk.5:7, Rev.14:15, al.; λέγων, Mat.8:29, al.; of public teaching, Jhn.1:15, Rom.9:27, al.; of importunate prayer (cf. Job.35:12, Psa.3:5, al.), Rom.8:15, Gal.4:6; pf. with Pres. sense (vernac.; M, Pr., 147), Jhn.1:15
…
G2896.s: properly, to "croak" (as a raven) or scream, i.e. (genitive case) to call aloud (shriek, exclaim, intreat)

G2897.d:
κραιπάλη
(κρεπάλη, WH), -ης, ἡ (cf. κραιπαλάω for שִׁכּוֹר, Isa.24:20 29:9)
drunken nausea (EV, surfeiting): Luk.21:34.†
SYN.: κῶμος, revelling; μέθη, drunkeness; οἰνοφλυγία, a debauch; πότος, a drinking bout (see Tr., Syn., § lxi). (AS)
G2897.s: properly, a headache (as a seizure of pain) from drunkenness, i.e. (by implication) a debauch (by analogy, a glut)
G2897.o: probably from the same as G726 (ἁρπάζω);

G2898.d:
κρανίον, -ου, τό
(κάρα, the head), [in LXX: Jdg.9:53, 4Ki.9:35 (גֻּלְגֹּלֶת)* ;]
a skull: Mat.27:33, Mrk.15:22, Luk.23:33, Jhn.19:17.†
(AS)
G2898.o: diminutive of a derivative of the base of G2768 (κέρας);

G2899.d:
κράσπεδον, -ου, τό
[in LXX: Num.15:38-39 (צִיצִת) Deu.22:12, Zec.8:23 (כָּנָף)* ;]
__1. in cl., an edge, border.
__2. In LXX (see supr.) and NT, a tassel or corner: Mat.9:20 14:36 23:5, Mrk.6:56, Luk.8:44.†
(AS)
G2899.s: a margin, i.e. (specially), a fringe or tassel

G2900.d:
κραταιός, -ά, -όν
(κράτος), (in cl. poët, form of κρατερός), [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק and cognates ;]
strong, mighty: 1Pe.5:6.†
(AS)

G2901.d:
κραταιόω, -ῶ
(late form of κρατύνω; κράτος) [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק ;]
to strengthen; pass., to wax strong: Luk.2:40, 1Co.16:13; πνεύματι, Luk.1:80; δυνάμει κ. διὰ τ. πνεύματος, Eph.3:16.†
(AS)
G2901.s: to empower, i.e. (passively) increase in vigor

G2902.d:
κρατέω, -ῶ
(κράτος), [in LXX chiefly for חָזַק hi., also for אָחַז, etc. ;]
__1. to be strong, mighty, hence, to rule, be master, prevail (so chiefly in cl.; in LXX: Est.1:1, I Est.4:38, Wis.14:19, al.).
__2. to get possession of, obtain, take hold of (Hdt., Thuc., al.): with genitive of thing(s) (M, Pr., 65), Act.27:13; τ. χειρός, Mat.9:25, Mrk.1:31 5:41 9:27, Luk.8:54; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.12:11; with accusative of person(s), Mat.14:3 18:28 21:46 22:6 26:4, 48 ff., Mrk.3:21 6:17 12:12 14:1, 44 ff, Act.3:11 24:6, Rev.20:2 (cf. 2Ki.6:6).
__3. to hold, hold fast (Æsch., Polyb., al.): with accusative of thing(s), ἐν τ. δεξιᾷ,…
G2902.s: to use strength, i.e. seize or retain (literally or figuratively)
G2902.k: hold (by, fast), keep, lay hand (hold) on, obtain, retain, take (by)

G2903.d:
κράτιστος, -η, -ον
superl, of κρατύς (Hom.),
__1. strongest, mightiest (Hom.).
__2. noblest, best (cf. κρείσσων), most excellent (find., Soph., al.): voc., κρατίστε, as title of honour and respect (DCG, ii, 727a), Luk.1:3, Act.23:26 24:3 26:25.†
(AS)
G2903.o: superlative of a derivative of G2904 (κράτος);

G2904.d:
κράτος, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX chiefly for עֹז, Job.12:16, Psa.90:11 al. ;]
__1. strength, esp. as in Hom., of bodily strength.
__2. power, might: Heb.2:14; τὸ κ. τῆς ἰσχύος αὐτοῦ, Eph.1:19 6:10 (Isa.40:26, Da TH Dan.4:27); τ. δόςης αὐτοῦ, Col.1:11; κατὰ κράτος, mightily, Act.19:20; a mighty deed, an act of power, Luk.1:51; in doxologies, 1Ti.6:16, 1Pe.4:11 5:11, Ju 25, Rev.1:6 5:13.†
(AS)

G2905.d:
κραυγάζω (κραυγή)
[in LXX: Est.3:13 (רוּעַ hi.)* ;] = κράζω
__1. of animals, to bay, to croak, etc.
__2. Of men, to cry out, shout: Mat.12:19, Jhn.12:13 19:15 Act.22:23; before λέγων, Jhn.18:40 19:6, 12; καὶ λέγων, Luk.4:41 (WH, κράζ -); φωνῇ μεγάλῃ, Jhn.11:43 (cf. Abbott, JV, 269 f.).†
(AS)

G2906.d:
κραυγή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for צְוָחָה, תְּרוּעָה, שַׁוְעָה, etc. ;]
crying, outcry, clamour: Mat.25:6, Luk.1:42, Act.23:9, Eph.4:31, Heb.5:7, Rev.21:4.†
(AS)
G2906.s: an outcry (in notification, tumult or grief)

G2907.d:
κρέας, -έως, pl., κρέα
[in LXX for בָּשָׂר (freq.) ;]
flesh, meat: Rom.14:21, 1Co.8:13.†
(AS)

G2908.d:
κρείσσων
(Epic and old Att..) and κρείττων (later Att..), prop. comparat. of κρατύς, strong, but in sense often (as in cl., see LS, see word) as comparat. of ἀγαθός, [in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;]
better;
__(a) as to ad­vantage or usefulness: 1Co.11:17, Heb.11:40 12:24; πολλῷ μᾶλλον κ., Php.1:23; κρεῖσσον ποιεῖν, 1Co.7:38; ἐστιν, before inf., 1Co.7:9, 2Pe.2:21;
__(b) as to excellence: Heb.1:4 6:9 7:7, 19 7:22 8:6 9:23 10:34 11:16, 35; κ. ἐστι, before inf., 1Pe.3:17.†
(AS)
G2908.o: neuter of an alternate form of G2909 (κρείττων);

G2909.d:
κρείσσων
(Epic and old Att..) and κρείττων (later Att..), prop. comparat. of κρατύς, strong, but in sense often (as in cl., see LS, see word) as comparat. of ἀγαθός, [in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;]
better;
__(a) as to ad­vantage or usefulness: 1Co.11:17, Heb.11:40 12:24; πολλῷ μᾶλλον κ., Php.1:23; κρεῖσσον ποιεῖν, 1Co.7:38; ἐστιν, before inf., 1Co.7:9, 2Pe.2:21;
__(b) as to excellence: Heb.1:4 6:9 7:7, 19 7:22 8:6 9:23 10:34 11:16, 35; κ. ἐστι, before inf., 1Pe.3:17.†
(AS)
G2909.o: comparative of a derivative of G2904 (κράτος);

G2910.d:
κρεμάννυμι
(also κρεμαννύω, κρεμάω; the Pres. is not found in NT), [in LXX (where also κρεμάζω, Job.26:7) chiefly for תָּלָה ;]
trans., to hang, suspend: with accusative of person(s), before ἐπὶ ξύλου, Act.5:30 10:39; pass., Luk.23:39; before περί, Mat.18:6. Mid., κρέμαμαι, intrans., to hang: before ἐκ, Act.28:4; ἐπὶ ξύλου, Gal.3:13 (LXX); metaphorically, before ἐν, Mat.22:40.†
(AS)
G2910.o: a prolonged form of a primary verb;

G2911.d:
κρημνός, -οῦ, ὁ
(κρεμάννυμι), [in LXX: 2Ch.25:12 (סֶלַע)* ;]
a steep bank: Mat.8:32, Mrk.5:13, Luk.8:33.†
(AS)

G2912.d:
Κρής, ὁ, pl., Κρῆτες
a Cretan: Act.2:11, Tit.1:12.†
(AS)
G2912.s: a Cretan, i.e. inhabitant of Crete

G2914.s: Crete, an island in the Mediterranean

G2915.d:
κριθή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for שְׂעֹרָה ;]
barley: pl. (as usually in cl.), Rev.6:6.†
(AS)

G2917.d:
κρίμα (B1., § 27, 2), -τος, τό
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט ;]
the issue of a judicial process, hence,
__1. judgment, the decision passed on the faults of others: Mat.7:2; in forensic sense, with genitive pun., Luk.24:20; esp. of the judgment of God, Rom.2:2 5:16 11:33 (ICC, in l), 2Pe.2:3, Ju 4; κ. λαμβάνεσθαι, Mat.23:13 (Rec., R, mg.), Mrk.12:40, Luk.20:47, Rom.13:2, Jas.3:1; ἔχειν, 1Ti.5:12; βαστάζειν, Gal.5:10; ἐσθίειν ἑαυτῷ, 1Co.11:29; εἰς κ. συνέρχεσθαι, 1Co.11:34; εἶναι ἐν τ αὐτῷ κ., Luk.23:40; with genitive obj., Rom.3:8, 1Ti.3:6, Rev.17:1; of God's judgment through Christ, Jhn.9:39; τὸ κ. ἄρχεται, 1Pe.4:17; τ. κ. τ. μέλλον, Act.24:25;…
G2917.s: a decision (the function or the effect, for or against ("crime"))
G2917.k: avenge, condemned, condemnation, damnation, + go to law, judgment

G2918.d:
κρίνον, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for שׁוּשַׁן ;]
a lily: Mat.6:28, Luk.12:27.†
(AS)

G2919.d:
κρίνω,
[in LXX chiefly for שׁפט, also for ריב ,דּין, etc. ;]
__1. to separate, select, choose (cl.; in LXX: 2Ma.13:15).
__2. to approve, esteem: Rom.14:5.
__3. to be of opinion, judge, think: Luk.7:43, 1Co.11:13; before τοῦτο ὅτι, 2Co.5:14; with accusative and inf., Act.16:15; with accusative and pred., Act.13:46 26:8.
__4. to decide, determine, decree: with accusative, Act.16:4, Rom.14:13, 1Co.7:37, 2Co.2:1; with inf. (Field, Notes, 167), Act.20:16 25:25, 1Co.2:2 5:3, Tit.3:12 (cf. 1Ma.11:33, Wis.8:9, al.); with accusative and inf., Act.21:25 27:1.
__5. to judge, adjudge, pronounce judgment: absol., Jhn.8:16,…
G2919.s: by implication, to try, condemn, punish
G2919.o: properly, to distinguish, i.e. decide (mentally or judicially);
G2919.k: avenge, conclude, condemn, damn, decree, determine, esteem, judge, go to (sue at the) law, ordain, call in question, sentence to, think

G2920.d:
κρίσις, -εως, ἡ
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּט, also for רִיב, etc. ;]
__1. a seperating, selection (Arist., al.)
__2. a decision, judgment (cl.): Jhn.8:16, 1Ti.5:24, 2Pe.2:11, Ju 9; κ. κρίνειν, Jhn.7:24; in forensic sense, Act.8:33 (LXX) (see Page, in l); esp. of the Divine judgment, Jhn.3:19 5:24, 27 5:29-30 12:31 16:8, 11, 2Th.1:5, Heb.10:27, Jas.2:13 5:12, 2Pe.2:4, Rev.18:10; pl., Rev.16:7 19:2; of the last judgment, Mat.10:15 11:22, 24 12:36, 41-42 Luk.10:14 11:31-32, Heb.9:27, 2Pe.2:9 3:7, 1Jn.4:17, Ju 6 15; τῆς γεέννης, Mat.23:33.
__3. By meton. (as in LXX for מִשְׁפָּט, Isa.5:7, al.; דִּישׁוֹן, Dan.7:10), of the standard of judgment,…
G2920.s: decision (subjectively or objectively, for or against); by extension, a tribunal; by implication, justice (especially, divine law)

G2922.d:
κριτήριον, -ου, τό
(κριτής), [in LXX: 3Ki.7:7 (מִשְׁפָּט), Dan LXX TH Dan.7:10, 26, (דִּין), Su 1:49, Exo.21:6, Jdg.5:10 * ;]
__1. a means of judging, test, criterion.
__2. a tribunal: 1Co.6:2 6:4, Jas.2:6.†
(AS)
G2922.s: a rule of judging ("criterion"), i.e. (by implication) a tribunal
G2922.o: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2923 (κριτής);

G2923.d:
κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(κρίνω), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁפַט ;]
a judge: Mat.5:25, Luk.12:14, 58 18:2; τ. ἀδικίας, Luk.18:6; with gem of thing(s) (obj.), Act.18:15, Jas.4:11; (qual.), διαλογισμῶν πονηρῶν, Jas.2:4; of a Roman procurator, Act.24:10; of God, Heb.12:23, Jas.4:12; Christ, Act.10:42, 2Ti.4:8, Jas.5:9; of those whose conduct is made a standard for judging, Mat.12:27, Luk.11:19; in the OT sense (Jdg.2:16, Rut.1:1, al), of a ruler in Israel, Act.13:20.†
SYN.: δικάστης, q.v (AS)

G2924.d:
κριτικός, -ή, -όν
(κρίνω),
critical, able to discern or judge: with genitive obj., Heb.4:12.†
(AS)

G2925.d:
Κρούω
[in LXX: before ἐπί Jdg.19:22, Sng.5:2 (דָּפַק) ;]
with, accusative, τ. αὐλαίαν, Jdth.14:14 * ;]
to strike, knock: at a door (Κόπτειν, in Att..), Mat.7:7-8, Luk.11:9-10 12:36, Act.12:16, Rev.3:20; with accusative, τ. θύραν, Luk.13:25, Act.12:13.†
(AS)

G2926.d:
κρύπτη (WH, R; κρυπτή, LT, Tr.; -όν, Rec.), -ης, ἡ,
a crypt, cellar: Luk.11:33.†
(AS)

G2927.d:
κρυπτός, -ή, -όν
(κρύπτω) [in LXX for אָטַם, מִסְתָּר, etc. ;]
hidden, secret: Mat.10:26, Mrk.4:22, Luk.8:17 12:2; ὁ κ. τῆς καρδίας ἄνθρωπος, 1Pe.3:4; neut., ἐν τῷ κ., Mat.6:4, 6; ἐν κ., Jhn.7:4, 10 18:20; ὁ ἐν κ. Ἰουδαῖος, Rom.2:29; pl., τὰ κ. τ. σκότους, 1Co.4:5; τ. ἀνθρώπων, Rom.2:16; τ. καρδίας, 1Co.14:25; τ. αἰσχύνης, 2Co.4:2.†
κρυφαῖος, -αία, -αῖον
(κρύφα = κρυφῆ) [in LXX for מִסְתָּר, Jer.23:24, al. ;]
hidden, secret: ἐν τῷ κ., Mat.6:18.†
(AS)

G2928.d:
Κρύπτω
[in LXX for חָבָא, טָמַן, סָתַר, צָפַן, etc. ;]
to hide, conceal: with accusative, Mat.13:44 25:18; before ἐν, Mat.25:25 (pass., Mat.13:44, Col.3:3); pass., Mat.5:14, Heb.11:23, 1Ti.5:25, Rev.2:17; ἐκρύβη (on the tense and its formation, see M, Pr., 161; Bl., § 19, 3) κ. ἐξῆλθεν Jhn.8:59; before εἰς, Luk.13:21, Rev.6:15; ἀπό (in cl. more frequently dupl. accusative), Rev.6:16; pass., Jhn.12:36, (Bl., § 34, 4). Metaphorical: Mat.11:25 13:35, Luk.11:52, WH, mg., Luk.18:34 19:42, Jhn.19:38 (cf.ἀτο-, ἐν-, περι-κρύπτω).†
(AS)

G2929.d:
κρυσταλλίζω
(κρύσταλλος),
to shine like crystal, be crystal-clear: Rev.21:11 (ἅπ, λεγ.).†
(AS)

G2930.d:
κρύσταλλος, -ου, ὁ
(κρύος, frost), [in LXX: Job.38:29, Psa.147:17, Eze.1:22 (קֶרַח), etc. ;]
crystal: Rev.4:6 22:1.†
(AS)

G2931.d:
κρυΦῇ
(prop. -ῆ, Rec.; later spelling is due to assimilation to dative; cf. εἰκῆ),
adv., [in LXX chiefly for סָתַר ;]
secretly, in secret: Eph.5:12.†
(AS)

G2932.d:
κτάομαι, -ῶμαι
[in LXX chiefly for קָנָה ;]
in pres., impf., fut. and aor., to procure for oneself, get, gain, acquire (the pf. and plpf., to have acquired, hence to possess, do not occur in NT): with accusative of thing(s), Mat.10:9, Luk.18:12, Act.8:20; with genitive pret., Act.22:28; ἐκ with genitive pret., Act.1:18; τ,ψυχὰς ὑμῶν (MM, xvi), Luk.21:19; τ. ἑαυτοῦ σκεῦος κτᾶσθαι, 1Th.4:4 (where if σ. = body, κ. must = pf., κέκτημαι; see MM, xvi; M, Th., in l; Field, Notes, 72 f. But σ. is most frequently taken as = wife; see Thayer, see word; Lft., Notes, 53 ff.; ICC, in l).†
(AS)
G2932.s: to get, i.e. acquire (by any means; own)

G2933.d:
κτῆμα, -τος, τό
(κτάομαι), [in LXX for כֶּרֶם, etc. ;]
a possession, property: Mat.19:22, Mrk.10:22, Act.2:45 5:1.†
(AS)

G2934.d:
κτῆνος, -ους, τό
(κτάομαι, hence primarily a possession), [in LXX chiefly for בְּהֵמָה Gen.1:25, al., also for מִקְנֶה, צֹנֵא, etc. ;]
a beast, (in late Gk. esp.) a beast of burden: Luk.10:34 pl. (as chiefly in cl.), Act.23:24, Rev.18:13; of quadrupeds, as Opp. to fishes and birds (cf. Ge, l.with), 1Co.15:39.†
(AS)

G2936.d:
κτίζω
[in LXX chiefly for בָּרָא, Psa.51:10, al.; also for קָנָה, Gen.14:19, Pro.8:22; יָצַר, Isa.22:11 46:11; Wis.2:23, Sir.1:4, 9 (and freq.), I Est.4:53, a1. ;]
__1. in cl., to people or found a region or city (1Es, l.with).
__2. In LXX and NT, of God, to create: Mrk.13:19, 1Co.11:9, Col.1:16 3:10 Eph.3:9, 1Ti.4:3, Rev.4:11 10:6; ὁ κτίσας, Mat.19:4 (WH, R, mg.), Rom.1:25; of the divine operation on the soul, Eph.2:10, 15 4:24 (cf. Ps., l.with).†
(AS)
G2936.o: probably akin to G2932 (κτάομαι) (through the idea of proprietorship of the manufacturer);

G2937.d:
κτίσις, -εως, ἡ
(κτίζω), [in LXX: Psa.104:24 (קִנְיָן), Pro.1:13 A (הוֹן), Tob.8:5, Wis.2:6, Sir.16:17, 3Ma.2:2, al. ;]
__1. a founding, settling, foundation (cl.).
__2. In LXX and NT,
__(a) the act of creating, creation: Mrk.10:6 (Swete, in l), Mrk.13:19, Rom.1:20, 2Pe.3:4;
__(b) that which has been created, creation: Rom.1:25 8:39, Heb.4:13; καινὴ κ., 2Co.5:17, Gal.6:15; πάσῃ ἀνθρωπίνῃ κ. (Hort., in l), 1Pe.2:13; collectively, of the sum of created things (Wis.19:6, Jdth.16:14), Mrk.16:15, Col.1:15, 23 Heb.9:11, Rev.3:14; of the irrational creation, Rom.8:19-22.†
(AS)
G2937.s: original formation (properly, the act; by implication, the thing, literally or figuratively)

G2938.d:
κτίσμα, -τος, τό
(κτίζω), [in LXX: Wis.9:2 13:5 14:11, Sir.36:20 (17), Sir.38:34, 3Ma.5:11 * ;]
__1. (cl.) a colony.
__2. a created thing, creature: 1Ti.4:4, Jas.1:18, Rev.5:13 8:9.†
(AS)
G2938.s: an original formation (concretely), i.e. product (created thing)

G2939.d:
κτίστης, -oυ, ὁ
(κτίζω), [in LXX: 2Ki.22:32 (Heb., al.), Jdth.9:12, Sir.24:8, 2 24:1-34; 4Ma.5:1-38 * ;]
__1. (cl.) a founder.
__2. a creator: of God, 1Pe.4:19.†
(AS)
G2939.s: a founder, i.e. God (as author of all things)

G2940.d:
κυβία (Mt. -εία, and so Rec.), -ας, ἡ
(κύβος, a cube, a die),
dice-playing; metaphorically, trickery, sleight: Eph.4:14.†
(AS)

G2941.d:
κυβέρνησις, -εως, ἡ
(κυβερνάω, Lat. gubernare, to guide), [in LXX: Pro.1:5 11:14 24:6 (תַּחְבֻּלָה) * ;]
__1. steering, pilotage (Plat.).
__2. Metaphorical, government: pl., 1Co.12:28.†
(AS)

G2942.d:
κυβερνήτης, -ου, ὁ
