fornication: Act.15:20, 29 21:25, 1Co.5:1 6:13 6:18, 2Co.12:21, Gal.5:19, Eph.5:3, Col.3:5, 1Th.4:3 (Lft., Notes, 53), Rev.9:21; pl. (see WM, 220; Bl., § 32, 6), 1Co.7:2; disting. from μοιχεία, Mat.15:19, Mrk.7:21; = μοιχεία (Amos 8:17 Sir.23:23, al.), Mat.5:32 19:9. Metaphorical (of idolatry: Deu.23:2, Hos.1:2): Jhn.8:41 (Westc., in l), and so perh. (Thayer-Grimm, see word; but see Swete, in 11.), Rev.2:21 14:18 17:2, 4 18:3 19:2.†
(AS)
G4202.s: harlotry (including adultery and incest); figuratively, idolatry

G4203.d:
πορνεύω
[in LXX for זָנָה ;]
__1. to prostitute the body for hire.
__2. to commit fornication: Mrk.10:19 (WH, mg), 1Co.6:18 10:8, Rev.2:14, 20. Metaphorical (as in LXX: 1Ch.5:25, Jer.3:6, Hos.9:1, al.), of idolatry (but see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), Rev.17:2 18:3, 9 (cf. ἐκ- πορνεύω).†
(AS)
G4203.s: to act the harlot, i.e. (literally) indulge unlawful lust (of either sex), or (figuratively) practise idolatry

G4204.d:
πόρνη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for זָנָה ;]
a prostitute, harlot: Mat.21:31-32, Luk.15:30, 1Co.6:15-16 Heb.11:31, Jas.2:25. Metaphorical (see Swete, Ap., 180 f.), of Babylon (i.e. Rome): Rev.17:1, 5 17:15-16 19:2.†
(AS)

G4205.d:
πόρνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Sir.23:16-18 * ;]
__1. a male prostitute (Xen., al.).
__2. a fornicator: 1Co.5:9-11 6:9, Eph.5:5, 1Ti.1:10, Heb.12:15 13:4, Rev.21:8 22:15.†
(AS)
G4205.s: akin to the base of G4097 (πιπράσκω)); a (male) prostitute (as venal), i.e. (by analogy) a debauchee (libertine)

G4206.d:
πόρρω
adv. (in older Attic, πρόσω), [in LXX for רָחוֹק, etc. ;]
far off: Mat.15:8, Mrk.7:6" (LXX), Luk.14:32; comparat., πορρώτερον (-ρω, T), Luk.24:28.†
(AS)

G4207.d:
πόρρωθεν
adv. (τόρρω, which see), [in LXX for רָחוֹק and cogn. forms ;]
from afar: Luk.17:12, Heb.11:13.†
(AS)
G4207.s: from far, or (by implication) at a distance, i.e. distantly
G4207.o: from G4206 (πόῤῥω) with adverbial enclitic of source;

G4209.d:
πορφύρα, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for אַרְגָּמָן, אַרְגְּוָן ;]
__1. the purple fish (cf. 1Ma.4:23).
__2. purple dye.
__3. Later, = πορφυρίς, a purple gar­ment: Mrk.15:17, 20, Luk.16:19, Rev.18:12.†
(AS)
G4209.s: the "purple" mussel, i.e. (by implication) the red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it

G4210.d:
πορφύρεος, -α, -ον contr., -οῦς, -ᾶ, -οῦν
(ποπφύρα), [in LXX for אַרְגָּמָן ;]
purple: Jhn.19:2, 5; as subst., πορφυροῦν (sc. ἱμάτιον), Rev.17:4 18:6.†
(AS)

G4211.d:
πορφυρόπωλις, -ιδος, ἡ
a seller of purple fabrics: Act.16:14.†
(AS)
G4211.s: a female trader in purple cloth
G4211.o: feminine of a compound of G4209 (πορφύρα) and G4453 (πωλέω);

G4212.d:
ποσάκις
interrog. num. adv.,
how often: Mat.18:21 23:37, Luk.13:34.†
(AS)

G4213.d:
πόσις, -εως, ἡ
(πίνω), [in LXX: Da, LXX TH Dan.1:10 (מִשְׁתֶּה) * ;]
__1. prop., drinking: Rom.14:17, Col.2:16 (see Lft.; ICC, in l).
__2. = πόμα, drink: Jhn.6:55 (cf. βρῶσις).†
(AS)
G4213.s: a drinking (the act), i.e. (concretely) a draught

G4214.d:
πόσος, -η, -ον
adj. of number, magnitude, degree, etc.,
how much, how great, how many: Mat.6:23, 2Co.7:11; of time, Mrk.9:21; neut., absol., Luk.16:5, 7; dative, πόσῳ, adverbially, how much, Mat.12:12; id. before μᾶλλον, Mat.7:11 10:25, Luk.11:13 12:24, 28, Rom.11:12, 24, Phm 16, Heb.9:14; π. χείρονος τιμωρίας, Heb.10:29; pl., Mat.15:34 16:9-10 27:13, Mrk.6:38 8:5, 19-20 15:4, Luk.15:17, Act.21:20.†
(AS)
G4214.s: interrogative pronoun (of amount) how much (large, long or (plural) many)
G4214.o: from an absolute (who, what) and G3739 (ὅς);

G4215.d:
ποταμός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for נָהָר, יְאֹר ;]
a river, stream, torrent: Mat.3:5 7:25, 27, Mrk.1:1-45 :, Luk.6:48-49, Act.16:13, 2Co.11:26, Rev.8:10 9:14 12:15-16 16:4, 12 21:1-2. Fig., pl., π. ὕδατος ζῶντος, Jhn.7:38.†
(AS)
G4215.s: a current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e. running water
G4215.o: probably from a derivative of the alternate of G4095 (πίνω) (compare G4224 (πότος));

G4216.d:
ποταμο-φόρητος, -ον
carried away by a stream:
Rev.12:15 (for two exx. in π., see MM, xxi).†
(AS)
G4216.s: river-borne, i.e. overwhelmed by a stream
G4216.o: from G4215 (ποταμός) and a derivative of G5409 (φορέω);

G4217.d:
ποταπός
(late form of cl. ποδ-), -ή, -όν, [in LXX: Dan LXX Su 1:54* ;]
__1. (= ποδαπός) from what country?
__2. In late writers, = ποῖος, of what sort?: Mat.8:27, Mrk.13:1, Luk.1:29 7:39, 2Pe.3:11, 1Jn.3:1.†
(AS)
G4217.s: interrogatively, whatever, i.e. of what possible sort
G4217.o: apparently from G4219 (πότε) and the base of G4226 (ποῦ);

G4218.d:
ποτέ
enclitic particle,
__1. once, formerly, sometime: of the past, Jhn.9:13 Rom.7:9 11:30, Gal.1:13, 23 2:6 (Lft., in l), Eph.2:2-3, 11 2:13 5:8, Col.1:21 3:7, 1Th.2:5, Tit.3:3, Phm 11, 1Pe.2:10 3:5 3:20; ἤδη ποτέ, now at length, Php.4:10; of the fut., Luk.22:32; εἴ πως ἤδη ποτέ, if sometime soon at length, Rom.1:10.
__2. ever: after a neg., Eph.5:29, 2Pe.1:10 1:21; in a question, τίς π., 1Co.9:7, Heb.1:5, 13.†
(AS)
G4218.s: indefinite adverb, at some time, ever
G4218.o: from the base of G4225 (πού) and G5037 (τέ);
G4218.k: afore-(any, some-)time(-s), at length (the last), (+ n- )ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when

G4219.d:
πότε
interrog. adv. of time,
when?: Mat.25:37-39, 44 Luk.21:7, Jhn.6:25; ἕως π., how long: Mat.17:17, Mrk.9:19, Luk.9:41, Jhn.10:24, Rev.6:10. In indir. questions, = ὁπότε, Mat.24:3, Mrk.13:4, 33 13:35, Luk.12:36 17:20 (see Bl., § 25, 4).†
(AS)
G4219.o: from the base of G4226 (ποῦ) and G5037 (τέ);

G4220.d:
πότερος, -α, -ον
which of two. Neut., adverbially, πότερον, whether: Jhn.7:17.†
(AS)
G4220.s: interrogative as adverb, which (of two), i.e. is it this or that
G4220.o: neuter of a comparative of the base of G4226 (ποῦ);

G4221.d:
ποτήριον, -ου, τό dimin. of ποτήρ
(πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for כּוֹס:]
a wine cup: Mat.23:25-26 26:27, Mrk.7:4 14:23, Luk.11:39 22:17, 20 a (WH, R, mg., cm.), 1Co.11:25, Rev.17:4; πίνειν ἐκ τοῦ π., 1Co.11:28; with genitive of thing(s), Mat.10:42, Mrk.9:41; τ. εὐλογίας, 1Co.10:16; by meton., of the contents of the cup, Luk.22:20 b (WH, R, mg., cm.), 1Co.11:25-26; with genitive of person(s), 1Co.10:21 11:27. Metaphorical, of experience of divine providence; of prosperity (Psa.16:5, al.); of adversity (Psa.11:6, Isa.51:17, al.): of the sufferings of Christ, Mat.20:22-23 26:39 10:38-39 14:36, Luk.22:42, Jhn.18:11; of divine punishment, Rev.14:10 16:19 18:6.†
(AS)
G4221.s: a drinking-vessel; by extension, the contents thereof, i.e. a cupful (draught); figuratively, a lot or fate
G4221.o: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of G4095 (πίνω);

G4222.d:
ποτίζω
(πότος), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁקָה hi. ;]
to give to drink: with accusative of person(s), Mat.25:35, 37 25:42 27:48, Mrk.15:36, Luk.13:15, Rom.12:20; with dupl. accusative, Mat.10:42, Mrk.9:41; fig., γάλα, 1Co.3:2; ἐκ τ. οἴνου Rev.14:8; of plants, to water (Xen., Strab., al.; Gen.13:10), figuratively, 1Co.3:6-8 Metaphorical (cf. Isa.29:10 Sir.15:3), of the Spirit, 1Co.12:13.†
(AS)
G4222.o: from a derivative of the alternate of G4095 (πίνω);

G4223.d:
Ποτίολοι, -ων, οἱ
Puteoli (mod. Pozzuoli), a city on the Bay of Naples: Act.28:13.†
(AS)
G4223.s: little wells, i.e. mineral springs; Potioli (i.e. Puteoli), a place in Italy

G4224.d:
πότος, -ου, ὁ
(πίνω), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁתֶּה ;]
a drinking bout, carousal: 1Pe.4:3.†
SYN.: see: κραιπάλη (AS)

G4225.d:
πού
enclitic particle,
__1. anywhere, somewhere: Heb.2:6 4:4.
__2. in some degree, perhaps, about: Act.27:29 (T, μήπου), Rom.4:19; δή που (T, δήπου), surely: Heb.2:16.†
(AS)
G4225.s: as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e. nearly
G4225.o: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun (some) otherwise obsolete (compare G4214 (πόσος));

G4226.d:
ποῦ
interrog. adv., [in LXX for אַי, אַיֵּה, אָן ;]
__1. prop., where?: Mat.2:2 26:17, Mrk.14:12, 14, Luk.17:17, 37 22:9, 11, Jhn.1:39 7:11 8:10, 19 9:12 11:34; ποῦ (ἐστιν), indicating that the subject in question is not to be found, Luk.8:25, Rom.3:27, 1Co.1:20 12:17 12:19 15:55, Gal.4:15, 2Pe.3:4; ποῦ φανεῖται, 1Pe.4:18.
__2. = ὅπου (WM, 640; B1., § 50, 5): with indic., Mat.2:4, Mrk.15:47, Jhn.1:40 11:57 20:2, 13 20:15 Rev.2:13; with subjc., Mat.8:20, Luk.9:58 12:17.
__3. In colloq. (as in Eng.) = ποῖ, whither: in direct questions, Jhn.7:35 9:12 13:36 16:5; in indir. quest., Jhn.3:8 8:14 12:35 14:5, Heb.11:8, 1Jn.2:11.†
(AS)
G4226.s: as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what locality
G4226.o: genitive case of an interrogative pronoun (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as G4225 (πού) used with the rising slide of inquiry);

G4227.d:
Πούδης
(in π., genitive -εντος, see Zorell, see word), ὁ (Latin)
Pudens: 2Ti.4:21.†
(AS)

G4228.d:
πούς, ποδός, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for רֶגֶל ;]
a foot, both of men and beasts: Mat.4:6 (LXX), Mrk.9:45, Luk.1:79, Jhn.11:44, Act.7:5, al.; ὑπο τοὺς π., Rom.16:20, 1Co.15:25 15:27 Eph.1:22, Heb.2:8; ὑποκάτω τῶν π., Mat.22:44 (LXX); πρὸς (παρὰ) τοὺς π., Mrk.5:22, Luk.8:41, al.; figuratively, Mat.15:30, Luk.10:39, Act.5:2, al.; ἔμπροσθεν τῶν π., Rev.3:9 19:10, al.; ἐπὶ τοὺς π., Act.10:25. By meton., of a person in motion (Psa.119:101): Luk.1:79, Act.5:9, Rom.3:15 10:15, Heb.12:13
(AS)

G4229.d:
πρᾶγμα, -τος, τύ
(πράσσω), [in LXX chiefly for דָּבָר ;]
__1. that which has been done, a deed, act: Luk.1:1, Act.5:4, 2Co.7:11, Heb.6:18.
__2. That which is being done (like Lat. res), hence, a thing, matter, affair: Mat.18:19, Rom.16:2, 1Th.4:6 (see M, Th., in l), Heb.10:1 11:1, Jas.3:16; in forensic sense (as frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 233), a law-suit: 1Co.6:1.†
(AS)
G4229.s: a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object (material)

G4230.d:
πραγματία (Rec. -εία, as in cl.), -ας, ἡ
(πραγματεύομαι) [in LXX for חֲשַׁל, etc. ;]
__1. careful application, hard work.
__2. business, occupation: pl., 2Ti.2:4.†
(AS)

G4231.d:
πραγματεύομαι
(πρᾶγμα), [in LXX: 3Ki.10:22 B, 3Ki.9:19 A (חָשַׁק), Dan LXX 8:27 (מְלָאכָה ־אֵת עָשָׂה) * ;]
__1. to busy oneself.
__2. to be engaged in business, esp. to trade: Luk.19:13 (cf. δια-πραγματεύομαι).†
(AS)
G4231.s: to busy oneself with, i.e. to trade

G4232.d:
πραιτώριον, -ου, τό (Lat. prætorium)
__1. headquarters in a Roman camp,
__2. The palace or official residence of the Governor of a province: Mat.27:27, Mrk.15:16 (see Swete, in l), Jhn.18:28, 33 19:9; τ. π. τ. Ἡρώδου, Act.23:35.
__3. the Prætorian Guard: Php.1:13 (see Lft., in l; ICC, 51 f.).†
(AS)
G4232.s: the prætorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes including the whole edifice and camp)

G4233.d:
πράκτωρ, -ορος, ὁ
(πράσσω), [in LXX: Isa.3:12 (נָגַשׁ) * ;]
__1. (poët.) one who does or accomplishes.
__2. In Athens, one who exacts payment, a collector; hence, generally (frequently in π., see Deiss., BS, 154), a court officer: Luk.12:58.†
(AS)
G4233.s: a practiser, i.e. (specially), an official collector

G4234.d:
πρᾶξις, -εως, ἡ
(πράσσω), [in LXX: 2Ch.13:22 27:7 28:26 (דֶּרֶךְ), Job.24:5 A (פֹּעַל), Pro.13:13, Wis.9:11, al. ;]
__1. a doing, deed, act: Mat.16:27; pl., π. ἀποσπτόλων, Ac, title; in late writers especially of wicked deeds or practices (frequently in Polyb.): Luk.23:51; p1., Rom.8:13, Col.3:9; with ref. to magic (see BS, 3235), Act.19:18.
__2. an acting, action, business, function: Rom.12:4.†
(AS)
G4234.s: practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a function

G4235.d:
πρᾷος, πρᾶος, see: πραΰς.
πραΰς, -εῖα, -ΰ, and πρᾷος
(Or πρᾶος, ν. Bl., § 3, 3), -α, -ον (see LS, Thayer, see word), [in LXX (always -ΰς, exc. 2Ma.15:12, -ᾷος, see Thackeray, Gr., 180 f.) for עָנָו, עָנִי ;]
gentle, meek: Mat.5:5 11:29 21:5" (LXX) 1Pe.3:4.†
(AS)
G4235.o: a form of G4239 (πραΰς), used in certain parts;

G4236.d:
πρᾳότης, πραότης, see: πραΰτης.
πραΰτης
(Rec. -ότης, exc. Ja, 1Pe, ll. with, where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης, [in LXX: Psa.45:4 90:10 132:1 (עַנְוָה, עֱנוּת, Est.5:1, Sir.6:1-37 * ;]
gentleness, meekness: 1Co.4:21, 2Co.10:1, Gal.5:23 6:1, Eph.4:2, Col.3:12 (see Lft., in l), 2Ti_2:25, Tit.3:2, Jas.1:21 3:13, 1Pe.3:15.†
SIN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v
(AS)

G4237.d:
πρασιά, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX: Sir.24:31 * ;]
a garden-bed; metaphorically, of ranks or orderly groups of persons: Mrk.6:40.†
(AS)
G4237.s: a garden plot, i.e. (by implication, of regular beds) a row (repeated in plural by Hebraism, to indicate an arrangement)
G4237.o: perhaps from (a leek, and so an onion-patch);

G4238.d:
πράσσω
(Att.. -ττω, and so Act.17:7 Rec.; cf. M, Pr., 25, 45), [in LXX chiefly for עָשָׂה, פָּעַל ;]
= Lat agere, as ποιέω (which see) = facere,
__1. to do, practise, be engaged in: Act.19:19, 36, 1Co.9:17; τ. ἴδια π., to mind one's own business (τὰ ἑαυτοῦ, Soph., Plat.), 1Th.4:11; intrans., to act, Act.17:7.
__2. to achieve, effect, accomplish, perform: Act.26:20, 26 Rom.7:15 9:11, 2Co.5:10, Php.4:9; νόμον (ICC, in l), Rom.2:25; of unworthy acts (for WH. usually ποιέω in cl.), to commit, do: Luk.22:23 23:41, Jhn.3:20 5:29, Act.3:17 5:35 16:28 25:11, 25 26:9, 31, Rom.1:32 (ICC, in l), Rom.2:1-3 7:19 13:4, 1Co.5:2,…
G4238.s: to "practise", i.e. perform repeatedly or habitually (thus differing from G4160 (ποιέω), which properly refers to a single act); by implication, to execute, accomplish, etc.; specially, to collect (dues), fare (personally)
G4238.k: commit, deeds, do, exact, keep, require, use arts

G4239.d:
πραΰς, -εῖα, -ΰ, and πρᾷος
(Or πρᾶος, ν. Bl., § 3, 3), -α, -ον (see LS, Thayer, see word), [in LXX (always -ΰς, exc. 2Ma.15:12, -ᾷος, see Thackeray, Gr., 180 f.) for עָנָו, עָנִי ;]
gentle, meek: Mat.5:5 11:29 21:5" (LXX) 1Pe.3:4.†
(AS)

G4240.d:
πραΰτης
(Rec. -ότης, exc. Ja, 1Pe, ll. with, where πρᾳύτης), -ητος, ἡ, late form of πραότης, [in LXX: Psa.45:4 90:10 132:1 (עַנְוָה, עֱנוּת, Est.5:1, Sir.6:1-37 * ;]
gentleness, meekness: 1Co.4:21, 2Co.10:1, Gal.5:23 6:1, Eph.4:2, Col.3:12 (see Lft., in l), 2Ti_2:25, Tit.3:2, Jas.1:21 3:13, 1Pe.3:15.†
SIN.: ἐπιεικία, q.v
(AS)

G4241.d:
πρέπω
[in LXX: Psa.93:5 (נָאָה pi.), etc. ;]
__1. to be clearly seen.
__2. to resemble.
__3. to be fitting or becoming, to suit: with dative, Heb.7:26, 1Ti.2:10, Tit.2:1; impers., with dative, Eph.5:3; id. before inf., Heb.2:10; πρέπον ἐστίν, with dative of person(s) and inf., Mat.3:15; with accusative and inf., 1Co.11:13 (see Bl., § 72, 5).†
(AS)
G4241.s: to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right)

G4242.d:
πρεσβεία, -ας, ἡ
(πρεσβεύω), [in LXX: 2Ma.4:11 * ;]
__1. age, seniority.
__2. rank, dignity.
__3. an embassy; by meton., of the am­bassadors, embassy: Luk.14:32 19:14.†
(AS)
G4242.s: seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy (concretely, ambassadors)

G4243.d:
πρεσβεύω
(πρέσβυς),
__1. to be the elder, to take precedence.
__2. to be an ambassador (see: πρεσβύτης): 2Co.5:20, Eph.6:20.†
(AS)
G4243.s: to be a senior, i.e. (by implication) act as a representative (figuratively, preacher)

G4244.d:
πρεσβυτέριον, -ου, τό
(πρεσβύτερος) [in LXX: Da TH Su 1:50 A * ;]
a body of elders, presbytery: of the Sanhedrin (cf. συνέδριον), Luk.22:66, Act.22:5; of Christian presbyters, 1Ti.4:14.†
(AS)
G4244.s: the order of elders, i.e. (specially), Israelite Sanhedrin or Christian "presbytery"
G4244.o: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4245 (πρεσβύτερος);

G4245G.d:
πρέσβυς, -εως, ὁ poët. form of πρεσβύτης (which see),
[in LXX (= πρεσβευτής, an ambassador): Num.21:20 (21), al. (מֲלְאָךְ), Isa.13:8 57:9 (צִיר), 1Ma.9:70, al. ;]
an old man.
Compar.,
πρεσβύτερος, -α, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן ;]
__1. of age, elder: ὁ νἱὸς ὁ π., Luk.15:25; as subst., opposite to νεανίσκοι, Act.2:17; to νεώτερος, 1Ti.5:1-2; of the religious leaders of the past, Mat.15:2, Mrk.7:3, 5, Heb.11:2 (= οἱ πατέρες, Heb.1:1).
__2. Of dignity, rank or office (as found in π. and Inscr. of civil and religious offices, including priesthood, in Asia Minor and in Egypt; see Deiss., BS, 154 ff., 233 If.; LAE, 373);
…
G4245G.s: older; as noun, a senior; specially, an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian "presbyter"

G4245H.d:
πρέσβυς, -εως, ὁ poët. form of πρεσβύτης (which see),
[in LXX (= πρεσβευτής, an ambassador): Num.21:20 (21), al. (מֲלְאָךְ), Isa.13:8 57:9 (צִיר), 1Ma.9:70, al. ;]
an old man.
Compar.,
πρεσβύτερος, -α, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן ;]
__1. of age, elder: ὁ νἱὸς ὁ π., Luk.15:25; as subst., opposite to νεανίσκοι, Act.2:17; to νεώτερος, 1Ti.5:1-2; of the religious leaders of the past, Mat.15:2, Mrk.7:3, 5, Heb.11:2 (= οἱ πατέρες, Heb.1:1).
__2. Of dignity, rank or office (as found in π. and Inscr. of civil and religious offices, including priesthood, in Asia Minor and in Egypt; see Deiss., BS, 154 ff., 233 If.; LAE, 373);
…
G4245H.s: older; as noun, a senior; specially, an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian "presbyter"

G4246.d:
πρεσβύτης, -ου prose form of πρέσβυς, which see,
[in LXX chiefly for זָקֵן, Gen.25:8, al.; also (= πρεσβευτής), 2Ch.32:31 Bl (לוּץ), 1Ma.14:22 S, al. (see Thackeray, Gr., 97) ;]
__1. an old man: Luk.1:18, Tit.2:2, Phm 9 (R, txt., but see infr.).
__2. As in LXX, also = πρεσβευτής, an am­bassador: Phm 9 (R, mg., see Lft. and ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G4247.d:
πρεσβῦτις, -ιδος, ἡ fem, of πρεσβύτης,
[in LXX: 4Ma.16:14 * ;]
an aged woman: Tit.2:3.†
(AS)

G4248.d:
πρηνής, -ές
(in Att.. also πρανής), [in LXX: Wis.4:19, 3Ma.5:43 3Mac 5:50 3Mac 6:23 * ;]
headlong, prone: Act.1:18.†
(AS)

G4249.d:
πρίζω = πρίω,
[in LXX: Amo.1:3, Da TH Su 1:59 * ;]
to saw, saw asunder (= π. δίχα, Thuc., iv, 100): pass, Heb.11:37 (cf. δια-πρίω).†
(AS)
G4249.o: a strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw);

G4250.d:
πρίν
__1. as adv. of time, before, formerly (cl.; 3Ma.5:28 3Mac 6:4 3Mac 6:31)
__2. As conic. (cl.), before;
__(a) after a positive sentence, with accusative and inf.: Mat.26:34, 75, Mrk.14:72, Luk.22:61, Jhn.4:49 8:58 (where D. om. γενέσθαι and π. becomes prep. with genitive; see Bl., § 69, 7) Jhn.14:29, Act.2:20" (LXX), WH, txt.; πρὶν ἤ (not such good Attic in this construction; see Bl., l.with), Mat.1:18 Mrk.14:30, Act.2:20, WH, mg., Act.7:2;
__(b) after a negative sentence, πρὶν ἤ: a. subjc. (before ἄν, M, Pr., 169), Luk.2:26; with optative, Act.25:16.†
(AS)

G4251.d:
Πρίσκα, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, Prisca: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.†
(AS)
G4251.s: feminine of Priscus, ancient; Priska, a Christian woman

G4252.d:
Πρίσκιλλα, see: Πρίσκα.
Πρίσκα, -ας, ἡ (Lat.), and Πρίσκιλλα, -ης, ἡ, Prisca: Rom_16:3, 1Co_16:19, 2Ti_4:19; Priscilla: Act_18:2; Act_18:18; Act_18:26; the wife of Aquila, vs. Ἀκύλας.†
(AS)
G4252.s: Priscilla (i.e. little Prisca), a Christian woman

G4253.d:
πρό
prep. with genitive, [in LXX chiefly for פָּנִים ;]
before;
__(a) of place: Act.12:6, 14 14:13, Jas.5:9; π. προσώπου (= Heb. פָּנִים, Deu.3:18, Mal.3:1, al.; Bl., § 40, 9), Mat.11:10, Mrk.1:2, Luk.1:76 7:27 9:52 10:1, Act.14:13;
__(b) of time: Mat.8:29 24:38, Luk.11:38 21:12, Jhn.11:55 13:1 17:24, Act.5:36 21:38, 1Co.2:7 4:5, Eph.1:4, Col.1:17, 2Ti.1:9 4:21, Tit.1:2, Heb.11:5, 1Pe.1:20, Ju 25; π. ἐτῶν δεκατεσσάρων, fourteen years ago, 2Co.12:2; π. προσώπου (see supr.), Act.13:24; with genitive of person(s), Mat.5:12, Jhn.5:7 10:8, Rom.16:7, Gal.1:17; with genitive art. inf. (= πρίν; M, Pr., 100; Bl., § 69, 7), Mat.6:8…
G4253.s: "fore", i.e. in front of, prior (figuratively, superior) to

G4254.d:
προ-άγω
[in LXX: 1Ki.17:16 (נָגַשׁ), Wis.19:11, al. ;]
__1. prop. trans., to lead on, lead forth or forward: with accusative of person(s), Act.16:30 17:5; of bringing forth to trial, Act.12:6 (WH, txt., προσάγ-); before ἐπί, with genitive of person(s), Act.25:26.
__2. Intrans. (Plat., Polyb., and later writers; see Bl., § 53, 1; MM, xxi);
__(a) to lead the way, 1Ti.1:18 (R, mg.), hence, to go before, precede: Luk.18:39; opposite to ἀκολουθέω, Mrk.11:9; before εἰς, Mat.14:22, Mrk.6:45, 1Ti.5:24, Heb.7:18; with accusative of person(s), Mat.2:9 21:9, Mrk.10:32; before εἰς, Mat.21:31 26:32 28:7, Mrk.14:28 16:7;
__(b) to go on, advance (Sir.20:27):…
G4254.s: to lead forward (magisterially); intransitively, to precede (in place or time (participle, previous))

G4255.d:
προ-αιρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: for חָשַׁק, etc. ;]
to bring forth or forward. Most frequently in mid., to take by choice, prefer, propose: 2Co.9:7.†
(AS)
G4255.s: to choose for oneself before another thing (prefer), i.e. (by implication) to propose (intend)

G4256.d:
προ-αιτιάομαι, -ῶμαι
to accuse or charge beforehand: Rom.3:9 (not elsewhere) .†
(AS)
G4256.s: to accuse already, i.e. previously charge
G4256.o: from G4253 (πρό) and a derivative of G156 (αἰτία);

G4257.d:
προ-ακούω
to hear beforehand: Col.1:5 (see Lft., in l).†
(AS)

G4259.o: neuter of a presumed compound of G4253 (πρό) and G833 (αὐλή);

G4260.d:
προ-βαίνω
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
to go forwards, go on, advance: Mat.4:21, Mrk.1:19. Metaphorical, of age (Gen.18:11, al., Lys., Diod., al.), ἐν τ. ἡμέραις, Luk.1:7, 18 2:36.†
(AS)
G4260.s: to walk forward, i.e. advance (literally, or in years)
G4260.o: from G4253 (πρό) and the base of G939 (βάσις);
G4260.k: + be of a great age, go farther (on), be well stricken

G4261.d:
προ-βάλλω
[in LXX for חוּד, מָרַק, etc. ;]
__1. to throw before.
__2. to put forward: with accusative, Act.19:33; of trees, to put forth, produce (sc. φύλλα), Luk.21:30.†
(AS)
G4261.s: to throw forward, i.e. push to the front, germinate

G4262.d:
προβατικός, -ή, -όν
(πρόβατον) [in LXX (π. πύλη): Neh.3:1, 32 12:39 (צֹאן)* ;]
of sheep: ἡ π. (sc. πύλη, see supr.), the sheep-gate, Jhn.5:2.†
(AS)
G4262.s: relating to sheep, i.e. (a gate) through which they were led into Jerusalem

G4263.d:
πρόβατον, -ου, τό
(προβαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for צֹאן, also for שֶׂה, more rarely for כֶּבֶשׂ (כֶּשֶׂב), רָחֵל ;]
__1. in Hom., Hdt., cattle, esp. of small cattle, sheep and goats.
__2. In NT, as in Attic writers generally (cf. MM, xxi), a sheep: Mat.7:15, Mrk.6:34, al.; πρόβατα σφαγῆς, Rom.8:36 (LXX). Metaphorical (in cl. of timidity, stupidity or idleness), of the followers of a leader or master, esp. of those who are subject to the care of the Good Shepherd: Mat.10:6 15:24 26:31" (LXX) Mrk.14:27 (LXX), Jhn.10:7-8, 15-16 10:26-27 21:16-17 (WH txt., προβάτια), Heb.13:20; opposite to ἐρίφια, Mat.25:33.
προβάτιον, -ου, τό,
dimin. of πρόβατον…
G4263.s: something that walks forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or figuratively)
G4263.o: probably neuter of a presumed derivative of G4260 (προβαίνω);

G4264.d:
προ-βιβάζω causal of προβαίνω,
[in LXX: Exo.35:34 (יָרָה hi.), Deu.6:7 (שָׁנַן pi.) * ;]
to lead forward, lead on; metaphorically, to induce, incite, urge: Mat.14:8.†
(AS)
G4264.s: to force forward, i.e. bring to the front, instigate
G4264.o: from G4253 (πρό) and a reduplicated form of G971 (βιάζω);

G4265.d:
προ-βλέπω
[in LXX: Psa.37:13 (רָאָה)* ;]
to foresee: mid., Heb.11:40 (see Bl., § 24, 55, 1).†
(AS)
G4265.s: to look out beforehand, i.e. furnish in advance

G4266.d:
προ-γίνομαι
[in LXX: Wis.19:13 אA, 2Ma.14:3 2Mac 15:8 * ;]
to happen before: pf. pass. ptcp., Rom.3:25.†
(AS)
G4266.s: to be already, i.e. have previousy transpired

G4267.d:
προ-γινώσκω
[in LXX: Wis.6:13 8:8 18:6 * ;]
to know beforehand, foreknow: 2Pe.3:17; with accusative of person(s), Act.26:5; of the Divine foreknowledge, Rom.8:29 11:2, 1Pe.1:20.†
(AS)

G4269.d:
πρό-γονος, -ον
(προγίνομαι), [in LXX: Est.4:17, Sir.8:4, al. ;]
__1. born before.
__2. As subst., in pl., οἱ π., ancestors, forefathers: 2Ti.1:3; of living parents (so Plat.), 1Ti.5:4.†
(AS)

G4270.d:
προ-γράφω
[in LXX: Dan LXX 3:3 cod., 1Ma.10:36 * ;]
__1. to write before: Rom.15:4, Eph.3:3, Ju 4.
__2. to write in public, placard, proclaim (Dem., Plut., al.): Gal.3:1 (Lft., in l).
__3. = ζωγραφέω, to pourtray, depict: Ga, l.with (Syr. Pesh., Chrys.; Field, Notes, 189; CGT, in l).†
(AS)
G4270.s: to write previously; figuratively, to announce, prescribe
G4270.k: before ordain, evidently set forth, write (afore, aforetime)

G4271.d:
πρό-δηλος, -ον
[in LXX: Jdth.8:29, 2Ma.3:17 2Mac 14:39 * ;]
__1. evident beforehand.
__2. clearly evident: 1Ti.5:24-25 Heb.7:14.†
(AS)
G4271.s: plain before all men, i.e. obvious

G4272.d:
προ-δίδωμι
[in LXX: Eze.16:34 A (נָתַן), 4Ma.4:1, al. ;]
__1. to give before, give first: Rom.11:35 (Job.41:2 (11) LXX, al.).
__2. to betray (4Mac, l.with).†
(AS)
G4272.s: to give before the other party has given

G4273.d:
προ-δότης, -ου, ὁ
(προδίδωμι) [in LXX: 2Ma.5:15 2Mac 10:13 2Mac 10:22, 3Ma.3:24 * ;]
a betrayer, traitor: Luk.6:16, Act.7:52, 2Ti.3:4.†
(AS)
G4273.o: from G4272 (προδίδωμι) (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's) hands);

G4274.d:
πρό-δρομος, -ον
(προτρέχω) [in LXX: Num.13:21 (20), Isa.28:4 (בִּכּוּר), Wis.12:8 * ;]
running forward, going in advance. As subst., ὁ π., an advance guard, forerunner: Heb.6:20.†
(AS)
G4274.s: a runner ahead, i.e. scout (figuratively, precursor)

G4275.d:
προ-εῖδον aor. without Pres. in use (see: προοράω),
[in LXX: Gen.37:18 (רָאָה), Psa.139:3 (סָכַן hi.) * ;]
to foresee: Act.2:31 (προϊδών; WH, προιδών), Gal.3:8.†
(AS)

G4276.s: to hope in advance of other confirmation

G4277.d:
προ-εῖπον 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα (3Ma.6:35 *), pass., -είρημαι (2Ma.2:32, 3Ma.1:26, al.),
__1. to say before: Gal.1:9, 1Th.4:6 (on the form -αμεν, see WH, App., 164), Heb.4:7; before ὅτι, 2Co.7:3 13:2, Gal.5:21; of prophecy, Mat.24:25, Mrk.13:23, Act.1:16, Rom.9:29, 2Pe.3:2, Ju 17.
__2. to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly (cl.): so R, mg., in 2Co.13:2, Gal.5:21, 1Th.4:6 (cf. προλέγω; but see supr., and cf. M, Th., 38).†
(AS)

G4278.d:
προ-ενάρχομαι
to begin before: 2Co.8:6; with accusative, τὸ θέλειν, 2Co.8:10 (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

G4279.d:
προ-επ-αγγέλλω
to announce before. Mid., to promise before: with accusative of thing(s), Rom.1:2, 2Co.9:5 (Dio. Cass.).†
(AS)
G4279.o: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G1861 (ἐπαγγέλλω);

G4280.d:
προ-ερέω, -ῶ, see: προεῖπον.
προ-εῖπον 2 aor. from unused Pres. (see: εἶπον, and pf., -είρηκα (3Ma.6:35 *), pass., -είρημαι (2Ma.2:32, 3Ma.1:26, al.),
__1. to say before: Gal.1:9, 1Th.4:6 (on the form -αμεν, see WH, App., 164), Heb.4:7; before ὅτι, 2Co.7:3 13:2, Gal.5:21; of prophecy, Mat.24:25, Mrk.13:23, Act.1:16, Rom.9:29, 2Pe.3:2, Ju 17.
__2. to proclaim publicly, declare openly or plainly (cl.): so R, mg., in 2Co.13:2, Gal.5:21, 1Th.4:6 (cf. προλέγω; but see supr., and cf. M, Th., 38).†
(AS)
G4280.s: used as alternate of G4277 (προέπω); to say already, predict

G4281.d:
προ-έρχομαι
[in LXX: Gen.33:3, 14 R (עָבַר), Jdth.2:19, Sir.35:10 (Sir.32:10) al ;]
__1. to go forward, go on, advance: before μικρόν, Mat.26:39 and Mrk.14:35 (WH, mg., προσελθών): ῥύμην μίαν (cf. Plat., Rep., i, 328e), Act.12:10.
__2. Of relative position, to go before, precede: with genitive (cl.; Jth, l.with); with accusative of person(s) (not cl.), Luk.22:47 (with genitive, Rec.); before ἐνώπιον, Luk.1:17 (cf. Gen.33:3).
__3. Of time, to go before or in advance: Act.20:5, 13 (WH, mg., R, mg.), 2Co.9:5; with accusative of person(s) (= cl. φθάνω), Mrk.6:33.†
(AS)
G4281.s: to go onward, precede (in place or time)
G4281.o: from G4253 (πρό) and G2064 (ἔρχομαι) (including its alternate);
G4281.k: go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on

G4282.d:
προ-ετοιμάζω
[in LXX: Isa.28:24 B, Wis.9:8 * ;]
to prepare before: with accusative of thing(s), Rom.9:23 (οἱς for ἅ by attraction), Eph.2:10.†
(AS)
G4282.s: to fit up in advance (literally or figuratively)

G4283.s: to announce glad news in advance
G4283.o: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G2097 (εὐαγγελίζω);

G4284.d:
προ-έχω
[in LXX: Job.27:6 A (חָזַק hi.) * ;]
__1. Trans., to hold before; mid., to hold something before oneself (Hdt.), hence, metaphorically, to excuse oneself: Rom.3:9, R, mg. (but see Field, Notes, 152 f.; Lft., Notes, 266 f.; ICC and Vau., in l).
__2. Intrans.
__(a) to project;
__(b) in running, to have the start, hence, metaphorically, to excel: pass., Ro, l.with, R, txt. (see reff. supr.).†
(AS)
G4284.s: to hold oneself before others, i.e. (figuratively) to excel
G4284.o: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G2192 (ἔχω);

G4285.d:
προ-ηγέσμαι
[in LXX: Deu.20:9 (בְּרוֹשׁ), Pro.17:14 (פָּנִים), 2Ma.4:40, al. ;]
__1. to go before as leader (in cl., with genitive, dative): Rom.12:10 (Chrys., Vg., al.; see ICC, in l).
__2. In a sense not elsewhere found, ἀλλήλους προηγούμενοι = ἀ. ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας: Ro, l.with (ICC, cf. 1Th.5:13, Php.2:3 and EV "preferring").†
(AS)
G4285.s: to lead the way for others, i.e. show deference

G4286.d:
πρό-θεσις, -εως, ἡ
[in LXX: Exo.40:4, 23 (עֵרֶךְ), 1Ch.9:32, al. (מַעֲרֶכֶת), 2Ch.4:19 (פָּנִים), 1Ma.1:22, 2Ma.3:8, al. ;]
__1. a setting forth (Plat., Plut., al.): οἱ ἄρτοι τῆς π. (cf. LXX, ll. with, elsewhere ἄρτοι ἐνώπιοι, Exo.25:29; οἱ ἄ. τοῦ προσώπου, Neh.10:33), Mat.12:4, Mrk.2:26, Luk.6:4; ἡ π. τῶν ἄρτων, Heb.9:2.
__2. a purpose (Mist., Polyb., al.; 2Mac, l.with): Act.11:23 27:13, Rom.8:28 9:11, Eph.1:11 3:11, 2Ti.1:9 3:10.†
(AS)
G4286.s: a setting forth, i.e. (figuratively) proposal (intention); specially, the show-bread (in the Temple) as exposed before God

G4287.d:
προ-θέσμιος, -α, -ον
[in Sm.: Job.28:3, Dan.9:26 * ;]
appointed before­hand. In Attic law, as subst. (so always in cl.), ἡ π. (sc. ἡμέρα), a day appointed beforehand, a previously appointed time: Gal.4:2.†
(AS)
G4287.s: fixed beforehand, i.e. (feminine with G2250 (ἡμέρα) implied) a designated day
G4287.o: from G4253 (πρό) and a derivative of G5087 (τίθημι);

G4288.d:
προθυμία, -ας, ἡ
(πρόθυμος), [in LXX: Sir.45:23 * ;]
eagerness, willingness, readiness: Act.17:11, 2Co.8:11-12 8:19 9:2.†
(AS)
G4288.k: forwardness of mind, readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind

G4289.d:
πρόθυμος, -ον
[in LXX: 1Ch.28:21, 2Ch.29:31 (נָדִיב), Hab.1:8 (חוּשׁ), al. ;]
willing, ready: Mat.26:41, Mrk.14:38; neut., τὸ π. = ἡ προθυμία (Thuc., al., 3Ma.5:26), οὕτως τὸ κατ᾽ ἐμὲ (= cl. τὸ ἐμὸν) π., Rom.1:15 (but see ICC, in l).†
(AS)
G4289.s: forward in spirit, i.e. predisposed; neuter (as noun) alacrity

G4290.d:
προθύμως
[in LXX: 2Ch.29:34 (יָשָׁר לֵבָב), Tob.7:8, al. ;]
eagerly, readily, with a ready mind: 1Pe.5:2.†
(AS)

G4291.d:
προ-ΐστημι
[in LXX: 2Ki.13:17, Pro.23:5 26:17, Isa.43:24, Amo.6:10 (no proper Heb. equiv.), Dan LXX Bel 1:7, 1Ma.5:19, 4Ma.11:27 * ;]
__1. trans. in fut., 1 aor., and mid. 1 aor., to put before, set over (Plat., al.).
__2. Intrans., in pf., plpf., 2 aor. and mid. Pres. and impf.;
__(a) to preside, rule, govern: Rom.12:8, 1Ti.5:17; with genitive, 1Th.5:12, 1Ti.3:4-5 3:12;
__(b) to direct, maintain: with genitive of thing(s), καλῶν ἔργων, Tit.3:8, 14 (on R, mg., profess honest occupations, see CGT, in l; Field, Notes, 223 f.).†
(AS)
G4291.s: to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by implication) to practise

G4292.d:
προ-καλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:11 A * ;]
to call forth.
Most frequently in mid.,
__(a) to challenge; hence, to provoke: Gal.5:26;
__(b) to invite (2Mac, l.with).†
(AS)
G4292.s: to call forth to oneself (challenge), i.e. (by implication) to irritate
G4292.o: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G2564 (καλέω);

G4293.d:
προ-κατ-αγγέλλω
to announce beforehand: with accusative and inf., Act.3:18; before περί, Act.7:52.†
(AS)
G4293.s: to anounce beforehand, i.e. predict, promise

G4295.d:
πρό-κειμαι
[in LXX: Exo.39:18 (36), Num.4:7 (פָּנִים), etc. ;]
used as pass. of προτίθημι;
__1. to be set before one, to be set forth: Heb.6:18 12:1-2, Ju 7.
__2. to present oneself, be present: 2Co.8:12 (see Mey., in l).†
(AS)
G4295.s: to lie before the view, i.e. (figuratively) to be present (to the mind), to stand forth (as an example or reward)

G4296.d:
προ-κηρύσσω
__1. to proclaim by herald.
__2. Of one who acts as a herald, to proclaim: Act.13:24.†
(AS)

G4297.d:
προ-κοπή, -ῆς, ἡ
(προκόπτω), [in LXX: Sir.51:17, 2Ma.8:8 * ;]
progress (prop., on a journey, then generally): Php.1:12, 25, 1Ti.4:15 (condemned by Atticists, see Rutherford, NPhr., 158).†
(AS)

G4298.d:
προ-κόπτω
[in Sm.: Psa.45:5 * ;]
to cut forward a way, for­ward, advance, in cl. trans. with neut. adj., as οὐδὲν π., τὰ πολλὰ π. In late writers (Polyb., al.), wholly intrans., to advance, progress: of time, Rom.13:12. Metaphorical, Luk.2:52, Gal.1:14, 2Ti.2:16 3:9 3:13.†
(AS)
G4298.s: to drive forward (as if by beating), i.e. (figuratively and intransitively) to advance (in amount, to grow; in time, to be well along)
G4298.k: increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax

G4299.d:
πρό-κριμα, -τος, τό
(cl. προκρίνειν, 1. to prefer. 2. to judge beforehand),
pre-judging, prejudice: 1Ti.5:21 (see Cremer, 378).†
(AS)
G4299.o: from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G2919 (κρίνω);

G4301.d:
προ-λαμβάνω
[in LXX: Wis.17:11 א2, Wis.17:17 א2B * ;]
__1. to take beforehand: with accusative, 1Co.11:21 (but see infr.).
__2. to be beforehand, anticipate (in cl., with accusative, genitive or dative): with inf. (= cl. φθάνω, see Bl., § 69, 4; Swete, in l), Mrk.14:8.
__3. to overtake, surprise: pass., Gal.6:1 (on the virtual disappearance of the temporal force of the preposi­tion in this compound here and perhaps also in 1Co, l.with, see MM, xxi).†
(AS)
G4301.s: to take in advance, i.e. (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise

G4302.d:
προ-λέγω
[in LXX: Isa.41:26 (נָגַד hi.) * ;]
__1. to tell or say before­hand: 2Co.13:2, Gal.5:21, 1Th.3:4 (R, txt.; cf. προεῖπον, but see infr.).
__2. to declare, tell plainly: 2Co, Ga, 1Th, ll. with (R, mg.; see MM, xxi, and cf. Isa, l.with).†
(AS)
G4302.s: to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn

G4303.d:
προ-μαρτύρομαι
to protest beforehand (cf. μαρτύρομαι, and V. Hort, in l): 1Pe.1:11 (elsewhere only in Theod. Met., xiv/AD.).†
(AS)
G4303.s: to be a witness in advance i.e. predict

G4306.d:
προ-μοέω, -ῶ and depon. -έομαι, οῦμαι,
[in LXX: Dan LXX 11:37 (בִּין), Wis.6:7, al. ;]
__1. to foresee.
__2. to provide (RV, take thought for): with accusative of thing(s), καλά, Rom.12:17 (-ούμενοι), 2Co.8:21 (-οῦμεν).
__3. to provide for (before περί, Wis, l.with): with genitive of person(s), 1Ti.5:8 (-εῖ, WH, mg., -εῖται).†
(AS)
G4306.s: to consider in advance, i.e. look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself)

G4307.d:
πρόνοια, -ας, ἡ
(πρόνοος, careful) [in LXX: Dan LXX 6:18 (19) Wis.14:3 17:2, 4Mac.6:1-35 * ;]
foresight, forethought: Act.24:3; π. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive (Dem., 546, 6), make provision for, show care for: Rom.13:14.†
(AS)
G4307.s: forethought, i.e. provident care or supply

G4308.d:
προ-οράω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Psa.16:8) (שָׁוָה pi.), I Est.5:63 A * ;]
to see before (as to place or time): with accusative, Act.21:29. Mid., with accusative, before ἐνώπιόν μου, Act.2:25 (LXX).†
(AS)
G4308.s: to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view

G4309.d:
προ-ορίζω
to predetermine, foreordain: with accusative, Rom.8:30; id. and inf., Act.4:28; id. before εἰς, 1Co.2:7, Eph.1:5; with dupl. accusative, Rom.8:26; pass., Eph.1:11.†
(AS)
G4309.s: to limit in advance, i.e. (figuratively) predetermine

G4310.d: to suffer first or beforehand , (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: to be ill-treated before , ὑπό τινος (Thucydides):—;also, ἀγαθὸν πρ. (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4311.d:
προ-πέμπω
[in LXX: I Est.4:47, Jdth.10:15, Wis.19:2, 1Ma.12:4, 2Ma.6:23 * ;]
__1. to send before, send forth.
__2. to set forward on a journey, escort: with accusative of person(s), 1Co.16:11, Tit.3:13, 3Jn.6; before εἰς, Act.20:38; οὗ, 1Co.16:6; ἕως, Act.21:5; pass., Act.15:3, Rom.15:24, 2Co.1:16.†
(AS)
G4311.s: to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel
G4311.k: accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth

G4312.d:
προπετής, -ές
(προπίπτω), [in LXX: Pro.10:14 (אֱוִיל) Pro.13:3 (פָּשַׂק) Sir.9:18 * ;]
falling forwards, headlong. Metaphorical, precipitate, rash, reck­less: of persons, 2Ti.3:4; of things, Act.19:36.†
(AS)
G4312.o: from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G4098 (πίπτω);

G4313.d:
προ-πορεύω
[in LXX chiefly for הָלַךְ, also for עָבַר, etc. ;]
to make to go before. Pass. and mid., to go before: Luk.1:76, Act.7:40" (LXX) ,†
(AS)

G4314.d:
πρός,
prep. with genitive, dative, accusative
__I. I. C. genitive, of motion from a place, from the side of, hence metaphorically, in the interests of, Act.27:34 (cf. Page, in l.).
__II. II. C. dative, of local proximity, hard by, near, at: Mrk.5:11, Luk.19:37, Jhn.18:16 20:11, 12 Rev.1:13.
__III. C. accusative, of motion or direction towards a place or object, to, towards.
__1. Of place,
__(a) after verbs of motion or of speaking and other words with the idea of direction: ἔρχομαι, ἀναβαίνω, πορεύομαι, λέγω, ἐπιστολή, etc., Mat.3:14, Mrk.6:51, Luk.11:5, Jhn.2:3, Act.9:2, al. mult.; metaphorically, of mental…
G4314.s: a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated)
G4314.k: about, according to , against, among, at, because of, before, between, (where-)by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), X together, to (you) -ward, unto, with(-in)

G4315.d:
προ-σάββατον, -ου, τό
[in LXX: Psa.92:1-15 title. א (שַׁבָּת) שַׁבָּת) Psa.93:1-5 title., Jdth.8:6 * ;]
the day before the Sabbath: Mrk.15:42 (L, Tr., txt., πρὸς σ.).†
(AS)

G4316.d:
προσ-αγορεύω
[in LXX: Deu.23:6 (7) (דָּרַשׁ), ?Est.10:11 (יָדָה hith.), Wis.14:22, 1Ma.14:40, 2Ma.1:36 2Mac 4:7 2Mac 10:9 2Mac 14:37 * ;]
to address, greet, salute; hence, to call by name, address, style: with dupl. accusative, pass., Heb.5:10.†
(AS)
G4316.s: to address, i.e. salute by name
G4316.o: from G4314 (πρός) and a derivative of G58 (ἀγορά) (mean to harangue);

G4317.d:
προσ-άγω
[in LXX chiefly for = קָרַב hi., also for נָגַשׁ etc. ;]
__1. trans., to bring or lead: with accusative and dative, Act.16:20; metaphorically, τ. θεῷ, 1Pe.3:18; before ὧδε, Luk.9:41; pass., with dative, Mat.18:24 (προσηνέχθη, T); in forensic sense, to summon: Act.12:6 (προαγαγεῖν, T, WH, mg., R).
__2. Intrans., to draw near, approach (Jos.3:9, Jer.26:3 (Jer.46:3), al.): with dative, Act.27:27 (WH, προσαχεῖν).†
(AS)
G4317.s: to lead towards, i.e. (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach

G4318.d:
προσ-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(προσάγω),
__1. a bringing to.
__2. approach, access (see Lft., Notes, 284; MM, xxi): Rom.5:2, Eph.2:18 3:12 (but see Ellic., Eph., 59 f., where the transitive sense "introduction " is advocated).†
(AS)

G4319.d:
προσ-αιτέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Job.27:14 * ;]
__1. to ask besides.
__2. to continue asking; hence, to importune, beg, ask alms: Jhn.9:8.†
(AS)

G4320.d:
προσ-ανα-βαίνω
[in LXX: Exo.19:23, al. (עָלָה) ;]
__1. to go up besides.
__2. to go up higher: Luk.14:10.†
(AS)
G4320.s: to ascend farther, i.e. be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat)

G4321.d:
προσ-αναλίσκω
to spend besides: Luk.8:43 (WH, R, mg., om.).†
(AS)

G4322.d:
προσ-αναπληρόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Wis.19:4 * ;]
to fill up by adding to, to supply fully: 2Co.9:12 11:9.†
(AS)
G4322.s: to fill up further, i.e. furnish fully

G4323.d:
προσ-ανα-τίθημι
to lay on or offer besides; mid.,
__(a) to lay on oneself in addition, undertake besides;
__(b) with genitive of person(s), of giving or obtaining information, to consult, communicate: Gal.1:16 2:6 (Lft., in l; cf. ἀνα-τίθημι)
(AS)
G4323.s: to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult

G4324.d:
προσ-απειλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sir.13:3 א * ;]
to threaten further: Act.4:21.†
(AS)

G4325.d:
προσδαπανάω, -ῶ
to spend besides: with accusative, Luk.10:35.†
SYN.: προσαναλίσκω (AS)

G4326.d:
προσ-δέομαι
[in LXX: Pro.12:9 חָסֵר חָסֵר Sir.6:1-37 * ;]
to want further, need in addition: Act.17:25.†
(AS)
G4326.s: to require additionally, i.e. want further

G4327.d:
προσ-δέχομαι
[in LXX chiefly for רָצָה ;]
__1. to receive to oneself, receive favourably, admit, accept: with accusative of person(s), Luk.15:2, Rom.16:2, Php.2:29; with accusative of thing(s), Act.24:15 (R, mg.), Heb.10:34 11:35.
__2. to expect, look for, wait for: with accusative of person(s), Luk.12:36; with accusative of thing(s), Mrk.15:43, Luk.2:25, 38 23:51, Act.23:21, Tit.2:13, Ju 21 (cf. δέχομαι).†
(AS)
G4327.s: to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience)

G4328.d:
προσ-δοκάω, -ῶ
(the simple verb exists only in the forms δοκέω, -εύω) [in LXX: Psa.104:27 (שָׂבַר pi.), etc. ;]
to await, expect: Mat.24:50, Luk.3:15 12:46, Act.27:33 28:6; with accusative of person(s), Mat.11:3, Luk.1:21 7:19-20 8:40 Act.10:24; with accusative of thing(s), 2Pe.3:12-14; with accusative and inf., Act.28:6; with inf., Act.3:5.†
(AS)
G4328.s: to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await
G4328.k: (be in) expect(-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for

G4329.d:
προσδοκία, -ας, ἡ
(ιροσδοκάω), [in LXX: Gen.49:10 (יִקָּהָה), Psa.119:116 (שֵׂבֶר) Wis.17:13, Sir.40:2, al. ;]
expectation: with genitive obj., Luk.21:26; with genitive subjc., Act.12:11.†
(AS)
G4329.s: apprehension (of evil); by implication, infliction anticipated

G4330.d: to suffer to go further , τινά (New Testament) (ML)

G4331.d:
προσ-εγγίζω
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַשׁ, קָרַב ;]
__1. trans., to bring near (Luc.).
__2. Intrans., to approach: with dative, Mrk.2:4 (WH, προσενέγκαι).†
(AS)

G4332.d:
προσεδρεύω
(πρόσεδρος, sitting near), [in LXX: 1Ma.11:40 * ;]
__1. to sit near.
__2. to attend regularly: with dative, 1Co.9:13, Rec. (see: παρεδρεύω).†
παρ-εδρεύω
[in LXX: Pro.1:21 8:3 * ;]
to sit constantly beside, attend constantly (cf. MM, xix): τ. θυσιαστηρίω, 1Co.9:13.†
(AS)
G4332.s: to sit near, i.e. attend as a servant
G4332.o: from a compound of G4314 (πρός) and the base of G1476 (ἑδραῖος);

G4333.d:
προσ-εργάζομαι
__1. to work or do service besides (Hdt., Plut.).
__2. to gain besides, by working or trading: Luk.19:16 (Xen.).†
(AS)
G4333.s: to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides

G4334.d:
προσ-έρχομαι
[in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;]
to approach, draw near: absol., Mat.4:11, Luk.9:42, al.; with infin., Mat.24:1, al.; with dative loc., Heb.12:18, 22; dative of person(s), Mat.5:1, and freq., Jhn.12:21, al.; ptcp., προσελθών, with indic., Mat.8:2, and freq., Mrk.1:31, Luk.7:14, al.; π. αὐτῷ, with indic., Mat.4:3, Mrk.6:35,
Metaphorical,
__(a) of approaching God: absol. (Lev.21:17, Deu.21:5, al.), Heb.10:1, 22; τ. θεῷ, Heb.7:25 11:6; τ. θρόνῳ τ. χάριτος, Heb.4:16; πρὸς Χριστόν, 1Pe.2:4;
__(b) in sense not found elsewhere (Field, Notes, 211), to consent to: ὑγιαίνουσι λόγοις, 1Ti.6:3
(AS)
G4334.s: to approach, i.e. (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to
G4334.o: from G4314 (πρός) and G2064 (ἔρχομαι) (including its alternate);
G4334.k: (as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto)

G4335.d:
προσ-ευχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(προσεύχομαι), [in LXX chiefly for תְּפִלָּה ;]
__1. prayer to God: Mat.17:21 (WH, R, txt., om.) Mat.21:22, Mrk.9:29, Luk.22:45, Act.3:1 6:4 10:31, Rom.12:12, 1Co.7:5, Col.4:2; pl., Act.2:42 10:4, Rom.1:10, Eph.1:16 Col.4:12, 1Th.1:2, Phm 4 22, 1Pe.3:7 4:7, Rev.5:8 8:3-4; οἶκος προσευχῆς, Mat.21:13, Mrk.11:17, Luk.19:46" (LXX) ; π. καὶ δέησις, Eph.6:18, Php.4:6; pl., 1Ti.2:1 5:5; ἡ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, prayer to God (ef. Wis.16:28), Luk.6:12; πρὸς τ. θεόν, before ὑπέρ, Act.12:5; pl., Rom.15:30; Hebraistically (B1., § 38, 3), προσευχῇ προσεύχεσθαι, Jas.5:17 (EV, prayed fervently).
__2. a place of prayer: of a synagogue (3Ma.7:20, seel.; see…

G4336.d:
προσ-εύχομαι
[in LXX chiefly for פָּלַל hith. ;]
to pray (always of prayer to God, or in cl., to gods): absol., Mat.6:5-7, 9 14:23 19:13 26:36, 39 26:41, 44, Mrk.1:35 6:46 11:24-25 13:33 (WH, E, txt., om.) Mrk.14:32, 38-39 Luk.1:10 3:21 5:16 6:12 9:18, 28-29 11:1-2 18:1, 10 22:44 (WH, E, mg., om.), Act.1:24 6:6 9:11 10:9, 30 11:5 12:12 13:3 14:23 16:25 20:36 21:5 22:17 28:8, 1Co.11:4-5 14:14, 1Th.5:17, 1Ti.2:8, Jas.5:13, 18; before λέγων, Mat.26:39, 42, Luk.22:41; with dative instr., 1Co.11:5 14:14-15; μακρά, Mat.23:14 (WH, R, txt., om.), Mrk.12:40, Luk.20:47; ἐν πνεύματι (ἁγίῳ), Eph.6:18, Ju 20; προσευχῇ π. (a Hebraism, see: προσευχή), Jas.5:17; with accusative of…
G4336.s: to pray to God, i.e. supplicate, worship

G4337.d:
προσ-έχω
[in LXX for קָשַׁב hi., שָׁמַר ni., etc. ;]
__1. to turn to, bring to (frequently ναῦν, expressed or understood, to bring to port, land; Hdt., al.).
__2. τ. νοῦν, before dative, to turn one's mind to, attend to; in Xen. and later writers with νοῦν omitted (El., § 53, 1; 81, 1): Act.8:6 16:14, Heb.2:1, 2Pe.1:19; in sense of caring or providing for, Act.20:28; π. ἑαυτῷ, to give heed to oneself (M, Pr., 157; cf. Gen.24:6, Exo.10:28, al.): Luk.17:3 21:34, Act.5:35; id. before ἀπό (M, Pr., 102; B1., § 34, 11; 40, 3; see: βλέπω), Luk.12:1; (without dative) Mat.7:15 10:17 16:6, 11-12, Luk.20:46 (cf. Sir.6:13, al.); before μή, with inf. (M, Pr.,…
G4337.s: (figuratively) to hold the mind (3563 implied) towards, i.e. pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to
G4337.k: (give) attend(-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to unto); have regard

G4338.d:
προσ-ηλόω -ῶ
[in LXX: 3Ma.4:9 * ;]
to nail to: with accusative and dative, figuratively, Col.2:14.†
(AS)
G4338.s: to peg to, i.e. spike fast
G4338.o: from G4314 (πρός) and a derivative of G2247 (ἧλος);

G4339.d:
προσήλυτος, -ον
(προοελαύνω), [in LXX for גֵּר ;]
__1. one who has arrived, a stranger.
__2. Of converts to Judaism, a proselyte (see DB, see word): Mat.23:15, Act.2:10 6:5 13:43.†
(AS)
G4339.s: an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte")

G4340.d:
πρόσ-καιρος, -ον
[in LXX: 4Ma.15:2 4Mac 15:8 4Mac 15:23 * ;]
__1. in season.
__2. for a season, temporary, transient: 2Co.4:18, Heb.11:25; of plants, short-lived: Mat.13:21, Mrk.4:17.†
(AS)
G4340.s: for the occasion only, i.e. temporary
G4340.k: dur-(eth) for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal

G4341.d:
προσ-καλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for קָרָא ;]
to call to. Mid., to call to oneself (see M, Pr., 157): with accusative of person(s), Mat.10:1, Mrk.3:13 6:7, Luk.7:19, Act.5:40, Jas.5:14, al. Metaphorical, of the Divine call: Act.2:39; with inf., Act.16:10 (see Bl., § 69, 4); before εἰς, Act.13:2.†
(AS)
G4341.s: to call toward oneself, i.e. summon, invite
G4341.o: middle voice from G4314 (πρός) and G2564 (καλέω);

G4342.d:
προσ-καρτερέω, -ῶ
(καρτερός, strong, stedfast) [in LXX: Num.13:21 (חָזַק hith.), Tob.5:8 א, Da Th Su 1:6* ;]
to attend constantly, continue stedfastly, adhere to, wait on: with dative of person(s), Mrk.3:9, Act.8:13 10:7; with dative of thing(s), Act.1:14 2:42 6:4, Rom.12:12, Col.4:2; before ἐν, Act.2:46; εἰς, Rom.13:6.†
(AS)
G4342.s: to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor)
G4342.k: attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually)

G4344.d:
προσ-κεφάλαιον, -ου, τό
[in LXX: Eze.13:18, 20 (כֶּסֶת), I Est.3:8 * ;]
a pillow, cushion: Mrk.4:38.†
(AS)
G4344.s: something for the head, i.e. a cushion
G4344.o: neuter of a presumed compound of G4314 (πρός) and G2776 (κεφαλή);

G4345.d:
προσ-κληρόω, -ῶ
to allot to, assign to by lot; pass. (but perh. as nid., EV, consorted with, so Syr.): Act.17:4 (for exx., v, Cremer, 749).†
(AS)
G4345.s: to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with

G4346.o: from a compound of G4314 (πρός) and G2827 (κλίνω);

G4347.d:
προσ-κολλάω, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for דָּבַק ;]
to glue to; pass., reflexive, to stick to, cleave to (Plat.): metaphorically (with dative, Jos.23:8, Sir.6:34 al.), before πρός, Mrk.10:7 (R, txt.), Eph.5:31 (LXX).†
(AS)
G4347.s: to glue to, i.e. (figuratively) to adhere

G4348.d:
πρόσ-κομμα, -τος, τό
(προσκόπτω), [in LXX: Exo.23:33 34:12 (מוֹקֵשׁ), Isa.8:14 (נֶגֶף), Jdth.8:22, Sir.17:25, al. ;]
__(a) a stumble, stumbling: λίθος προσκόμματος (= נֶגֶף אֶבֶן, Isa, l.with), figuratively, Rom.9:32-33, 1Pe.2:8" (LXX) ;
__(b) = προσκοπή, an occasion of stumbling, a stumbling-block: metaphorically, Rom.14:13, 20, 1Co.8:9 (Plut.).†
SYN.: σκάνδαλον (cf. Cremer, 752 f.) (AS)
G4348.s: a stub, i.e. (figuratively) occasion of apostasy

G4349.d:
προσκοπή, -ῆς, ή
(προσκόπτω), [in Gr. Ven.: Pro.16:18 (כִּשָּׁלוֹן) * ;]
an occasion of stumbling, offence: 2Co.6:3.†
(AS)
G4349.s: a stumbling, i.e. (figuratively and concretely) occasion of sin

G4350.d:
προσ-κόπτω
[in LXX for נָגַף, כָּשַׁל ni., etc. ;]
__1. trans., to strike (e.g. hand or foot) against: with accusative before πρός, figuratively, Mat.4:6, Luk.4:11, (LXX)
__2. Intrans., to stumble: absol. (Tob.11:9, Pro.3:23), Jhn.11:9-10; of wind, to rush against, beat upon: with dative, Mat.7:27. Metaphorical, in late writers,
__(a) to offend (Polyb.);
__(b) to take offence at, stumble at: before ἐν, Rom.14:21; with dative, τ. λόγῳ, 1Pe.2:8; τ. λίθῳ τ. προσκόμματος, Rom.9:32.†
(AS)
G4350.s: to strike at, i.e. surge against (as water); specially, to stub on, i.e. trip up (literally or figuratively)

G4351.d:
προσ-κυλίω
to roll up, roll to: with accusative and dative, Mat.27:60; accusative before ἐπί, Mrk.15:46.†
(AS)
G4351.s: to roll towards, i.e. block against

G4352.d:
προσ-κυνέω, -ῶ
(κυνέω, to kiss), [in LXX chiefly for שָׁחָה hith. ;]
to make obeisance, do reverence to, worship;
__(a) prop. (as in cl., of the gods: Hdt., Æsch., Plat., al.), of God, Christ and supra-mundane beings: absol., Jhn.4:20 12:20, Act.8:27 24:11, Heb.11:21 (Westc., in l), Rev.11:1; πίπτειν καὶ π., Rev.5:14; with dative (of the significance of this constr. as com­pared with the usual cl., with accusative, see Abbott, JG, 78 f.; JV, 133 ff.), Jhn.4:21, 23, Act.7:43, 1Co.14:25, Heb.1:6, Rev.4:10 7:11 11:16 13:4, 15 14:7 16:2 19:4, 10 19:20 22:8-9; with accusative (see supr.), Mat.4:10, Luk.4:8 24:52 (WH, R, mg., om.), Jhn.4:22, 24,…
G4352.s: to fawn or crouch to, i.e. (literally or figuratively) prostrate oneself in homage (do reverence to, adore)
G4352.o: from G4314 (πρός) and a probable derivative of G2965 (κύων) (meaning to kiss, like a dog licking his master's hand);

G4354.d:
προσ-λαλέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Exo.4:16 AB2 (דָבַר pi.), Wis.13:17 * ;]
to speak to: Act.28:20; with dative of person(s), Act.13:43.†
(AS)
G4354.s: to talk to, i.e. converse with

G4355.d:
προσ-λαμβάνω
[in LXX: Psa.18:16 (מָשָׁה hi.), Psa.73:24 (לָקַח), etc. ;]
__1. to take in addition.
__2. to take to oneself, take, receive; in NT always mid., -ομαι;
__(a) of things: of food, with accusative, Act.27:33; with genitive part., Act.27:36;
__(b) of persons: with accusative, Mat.16:22, Mrk.8:32 (see Swete, in l), Act.17:5 18:26 28:2, Rom.14:1, 3 15:7, Phm 17.†
(AS)
G4355.s: to take to oneself, i.e. use (food), lead (aside), admit (to friendship or hospitality)

G4356.d:
πρόσ-λημψις (Rec. -ληψις, as in Att..), -εως, ἡ
(προσλαμβάνω),
__1. an assumption (Plat.).
__2. a receiving (cf. προσλαμβάνω): Rom.11:15,†
(AS)

G4357.d:
προσ-μένω
[in LXX: Jdg.3:25 A (חוּל hi.), Tob.2:2 א, Wis.3:9, 3Ma.7:17 * ;]
__1. to wait longer, continue, remain still: Act.18:18; before ἐν, 1Ti.1:3.
__2. C. dative, to remain with: Mat.15:32, Mrk.8:32. Metaphorical, to remain attached to, cleave unto, abide in: τ. κυρίῳ, Act.11:23 (R, txt.; ἐν τ. κ., R, mg., see supr.); τ. χάριτι τ. θεοῦ, Act.13:43; τ. δεήσεσιν, 1Ti.5:5.†
(AS)
G4357.s: to stay further, i.e. remain in a place, with a person; figuratively, to adhere to, persevere in
G4357.k: abide still, be with, cleave unto, continue in (with)

G4358.d:
προσ-ορμίζω
(ὅρμος, an anchorage),
to bring a ship to anchor at; usually in mid., to come to anchor near, and so pass. in late writers (Ael., Dio Cass.): Mrk.6:53.†
(AS)
G4358.s: to moor to, i.e. (by implication) land at
G4358.o: from G4314 (πρός) and a derivative of the same as G3730 (ὁρμή) (meaning to tie (anchor) or lull);

G4359.d: to owe besides or still , (Thucydides): absolute, προσοφείλοντας ἡμᾶς ἐνέγραψεν (Demosthenes Orator):—;Pass. to be still owing, be still due , (Thucydides); so, ἡ ἔχθρη ἡ προσοφειλομένη ἐς Ἀθηναίους ἐκ τῶν Αἰγινητέων the hatred which was still due from the Aeginetans to the Athenians, i. e. their ancient feud, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G4360.d:
προσ-οχθίζω
[in LXX: Lev.26:15, al. (גָּעַל); Lev.18:25, al. (קוֹא), Psa.95:10, Eze.36:31 (קוּט), Sir.6:25, al. (other writers use ὀχθέω, rarely -ίζω) ;]
to be angry with: with dative, Heb.3:10 (LXX), Heb.3:17.†
(AS)
G4360.o: from G4314 (πρός) and a form of (to be vexed with something irksome);

G4361.o: from G4314 (πρός) and the same as G3983 (πεινάω);

G4362.d:
προσ-πήγνυμι
to fasten to: absol., to crucify, Act.2:23.†
(AS)
G4362.s: to fasten to, i.e. (specially), to impale (on a cross)

G4363.d:
προσ-πίπτω
[in LXX for נָפַל, נָגַע hi., כָּרַע ;]
__1. to fall upon, strike against: with dative, of wind, Mat.7:25.
__2. to fall down at one's feet, fall prostrate before: absol., before πρός, Mrk.7:25; with dative of person(s), Mrk.3:11 5:33, Luk.8:28, Act.16:29; τ. γόνασιν, Luk.5:8.†
(AS)
G4363.s: to fall towards, i.e. (gently) prostrate oneself (in supplication or homage), or (violently) to rush upon (in storm)

G4364.d:
προσ-ποιέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 1Ki.21:13 (14) (הָלַל hithpo.), Job.19:14, (Sir 34:30 (Sir.31:30)), Dan LXX Su 1:11 * ;]
to make over to, add or attach to. Mid., to take to oneself, claim; hence, to pretend; with inf. (cf. Xen., Anab., iv, 3, 20), to make as if: Luk.24:28.†
(AS)
G4364.s: to do forward for oneself, i.e. pretend (as if about to do a thing)
G4364.o: middle voice from G4314 (πρός) and G4160 (ποιέω);

G4365.d:
προσ-πορεύομαι
[in LXX for קָרַב, נָגַשׁ, etc. ;]
to come near, approach: with dative of person(s), Mrk.10:35.†
(AS)
G4365.s: to journey towards, i.e. approach (not the same as G4313 (προπορεύομαι))

G4366.d:
προσ-ρήγνυμι
[in Aq.: Psa.2:9 * ;]
to break against, dash against;
__(a) trans. (παιδία πέτραις, FlJ, Ant., ix, 4, 6);
__(b) intrans., with dative: Luk.6:48-49 (cf. προσπίπτω).†
(AS)
G4366.s: to tear towards, i.e. burst upon (as a tempest or flood)

G4367.d:
προσ-τάσσω
[in LXX chiefly for צָוָה pi. ;]
__1. with accusative of person(s), to place at, to attach to.
__2. to give a command, enjoin, appoint: Luk.5:14; with dative of person(s), Mat.1:24; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.8:4, Mrk.1:44; with accusative and inf., Act.10:48; pass., Act.10:33 17:26.†
(AS)

G4368.d:
προστάτις, -ιδος, ἡ
(fem, of προοτάτης),
a patroness, protectress: Rom.16:2.†
(AS)
G4368.o: feminine of a derivative of G4291 (προΐστημι);

G4369.d:
προσ-τίθημι
[in LXX chiefly for יָסַף hi., also for אָסַף ni., etc. ;]
__1. to put to.
__2. to add, join to, give in addition: with accusative before ἐπί, Mat.6:27, Luk.3:20 12:25; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, Act.2:47; with accusative and dative, Luk.17:5, Heb.12:19 (see MM, xxi); pass., absol., Act.2:41, Gal.3:19; with dative, Mat.6:33, Mrk.4:24, Luk.12:31, Act.5:14 11:24; προσιτέθη πρὸς τ. πατέρας (cf. Gen.26:8, Jdg.2:10, al.), Act.13:36; with inf., of repeating or continuing the action signified by the following verb, as in Heb. idiom (Gen.4:2 8:12, al.; cf. WM, § 54, 5; Lft. on Clem., 1Co., xii; but see also M, Pr., 67, 233; Deiss., BS, 67.1; MM, xxi),…
G4369.s: to place additionally, i.e. lay beside, annex, repeat
G4369.k: add, again, give more, increase, lay unto, proceed further, speak to any more

G4370.d:
προσ-τρέχω
[in LXX for רוּץ ;]
to run to: Mrk.9:15 10:17, Act.8:30.†
(AS)
G4370.s: to run towards, i.e. hasten to meet or join
G4370.o: from G4314 (πρός) and G5143 (τρέχω) (including its alternate);

G4371.d:
προσφάγιον, -ου, τό
(φαγεῖν),
Hellenistic for ὄψον ὀψάριον)
a relish or dainty (esp, cooked fish), to be eaten with bread: Jhn.21:5 (have ye taken any fish, Field, Notes, 109; Abbott, Essays, 105; cf. M, Pr., 170n; MM, Exp., xxi).†
(AS)
G4371.s: something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare G3795 (ὀψάριον))
G4371.o: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of G4314 (πρός) and G5315 (φάγω);

G4372.d:
πρόσφατος, -ον
(on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word and cf. -ως), [in LXX: Num.6:3 (לַח), Deu.32:17, Ecc.1:9 (חָדָשׁ), Psa.81:9 (זוּר), Sir.9:10 * ;]
__1. originally, freshly slain.
__2. Generally (from Æsch. on), new, fresh, recent: ὁδός, Heb.10:20 (see MM, Exp., xxi; Rutherford, NPhr., 471 f.).†
(AS)
G4372.o: from G4253 (πρό) and a derivative of G4969 (σφάζω);

G4373.d:
προσφάτως
adv. (see: πρόσφατος), [in LXX: Deu.24:5 (חָדָשׁ), Jdth.4:3, 5, Eze.11:3, 2Ma.14:36 2Mac 14:16 ;]
recently: Act.18:2 (see MM, Exp., xxi).†
(AS)

G4374.d:
προσ-φέρω
[in LXX chiefly for קָרַב hi. ;]
__1. to bring to, lead to: with accusative and dative of person(s), Mat.4:24 8:16 9:2, 32 14:35 17:16, Mrk.2:4 (WH, R, txt.; sc. αὐτόν) Mrk.10:13, Luk.18:15 23:14; pass., Mat.12:22 (act., WH, txt.) Mat.18:24 (προσήχθη, WH) Mat.19:13; with accusative of thing(s), Mat.25:20; id. with dative of person(s), Mat.22:19, Luk.23:36; τ. στόματι, Jhn.19:29; metaphorically, with dative of person(s), to deal with, Heb.12:7 (cl.).
__2. to offer: Mat.2:11, Act.8:18; esp. (as frequently in LXX; cf. FlJ, Ant., iii, 9, 3) sacrifices, gifts and prayers to God: absol., before περί (ὑπέρ), Mrk.1:44, Luk.5:14, Heb.5:1, 3…
G4374.s: to bear towards, i.e. lead to, tender (especially to God), treat
G4374.o: from G4314 (πρός) and G5342 (φέρω) (including its alternate);
G4374.k: bring (to, unto), deal with, do, offer (unto, up), present unto, put to

G4375.d:
προσφιλής, -ές
(φιλέω), [in LXX: Est.5:1, Sir.4:7 20:13 * ;]
__(a) of persons, in both act, and pass. sense (LXX, ll. with);
__(b) of things, pleas­ing, agreeable (EV, lovely): Php.4:8.†
(AS)
G4375.o: from a presumed compound of G4314 (πρός) and G5368 (φιλέω);

G4376.d:
προσ-φορά, -ᾶς, ἡ
(προσφέρω), [in LXX: 3Ki.7:48 (פָּנִים) Psa.40:6 (מִנְחָה), I Est.5:52, Sir.14:11, al. ;]
__1. a bringing to, offering (Plat., al.).
__2. (Less frequently in cl.), a present, an offering; in NT, of sacrificial offerings: Act.21:26 24:17, Eph.5:2, Heb.10:5, 8 10:14; περί ἀμαρτίας, Heb.10:18; with genitive obj., Rom.15:16, Heb.10:10.†
(AS)
G4376.s: presentation; concretely, an oblation (bloodless) or sacrifice

G4377.d:
προσ-φωνέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 1Es.2:21 Est.6:6 Est.6:22, 2Ma.15:15 * ;]
__1. to address, call to; in cl., with accusative of person(s), with dupl. accusative (cf. 2Mac, l.with); absol. (Hom., Od., v, 159, al.): Act.21:40 In late writers, with dative of person(s): Mat.11:16, Luk.7:32 13:12 23:20, Act.22:2.
__2. to call by name, summon: with accusative (as in cl.), Luk.6:13.†
(AS)
G4377.s: to sound towards, i.e. address, exclaim, summon

G4378.d:
πρόσ-χυσις, -εως, ἡ
a pouring or sprinkling upon: Heb.11:28.†
(AS)
G4378.o: from a comparative of G4314 (πρός) and (to pour);

G4379.d:
προσ-ψαύω
in poët. and late writers,
to touch: with dative, Luk.11:46.†
(AS)
G4379.s: to impinge, i.e. lay a finger on (in order to relieve)

G4380.d:
προσωπολημπτέω (Rec. -ληπτ-), -ῶ
(-λήμπτης, which see),
to have respect of persons: Jas.2:9.†
(AS)
G4380.s: to favor an individual, i.e. show partiality

G4381.d:
προσωπο-λήμπτης (Rec. -λήπτης, see Bl., § 6, 8), -ου, ὁ
(πρόσωπον λαμβάνειν, see: πρόσωπον),
a respecter of persons: Act.10:34 (on this group of cognate forms, see Mayor, da., 78 f.; and cf. Thackeray, Gr., 44).†
(AS)
G4381.s: an accepter of a face (individual), i.e. (specially), one exhibiting partiality

G4382.d:
προσωπολημψία (Rec. -ληψία), -ας, ἡ
(προσωπολήμπτης)
respect of persons: Rom.2:11, Eph.6:9, Col.3:25, Jas.2:1 (see Mayor, in l).†
(AS)

G4383.d:
πρόσωπον, -ου, τό
(πρός, ὤψ), [in LXX chiefly and very frequently for פָּנִים ;]
__1. prop., of persons (so always in cl.);
__(a) the face, countenance: Mat.6:16-17, Mrk.14:65, Luk.9:29, 2Co.3:7, Rev.4:7, al.; τὸ π. τῆς γενέτεως (EV, natural face), Jas.1:23; πίπτειν ἐπὶ (τὰ) π., Mat.17:6, Luk.5:12, Rev.7:11, al.; ἀγνοούμενος τῷ π., Gal.1:22; π., οὐ καρδίᾳ, 1Th.2:17; κατὰ πρόσωπον (in front, facing: Thuc., Xen., al.), when present, face to face, Act.25:16, 2Co.10:1 10:7, Gal.2:11; id. with genitive, as compound prep., in the presence of (not cl.; see Bl., § 40, 9; M, Pr., 99 f.; Thackeray, Gr., 43 f.), Luk.2:31, Act.3:13; similarly ἀπὸ π.…
G4383.s: the front (as being towards view), i.e. the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person
G4383.o: from G4314 (πρός) and (the visage, from G3700 (ὀπτάνομαι));
G4383.k: (outward) appearance, X before, countenance, face, fashion, (men's) person, presence

G4384.d:
προ-τάσσω
[in LXX: 2Ma.8:36 R (Α, προστ-) * ;]
__1. to place in front.
__2. to arrange beforehand: Act.17:26, Rec. (for προστ., Edd.).†
(AS)

G4385.d:
προ-τείνω, [in LXX: 2Ma_7:1-42, 3Ma_2:1 * ;]
to stretch out, stretch forth: of preparations for scourging (see Field, Notes, 136 f.), Act.22:25.†
(AS)
G4385.s: to protend, i.e. tie prostrate (for scourging)

G4386.d:
before; (adv.) before, formerly, an earlier time
former, prior, Eph. 4:22; before, former, prior, Eph. 4:22; before, formerly, Jn. 6:62
G4386.o: neuter of G4387 (πρότερος) as adverb (with or without the article);

G4387.d:
A. Compar., πρότερος, -α, -ον,
[in LXX for רִאשׁוֹן ,לִפָנִים, etc. ;]
before, of time, place, rank, etc.; in NT always of Time, before, former: Eph.4:22. Adverbially, πρότερον, before, aforetime, formerly: Jhn.7:50, 2Co.1:15, Heb.4:6; opposite to ἔπειτα, Heb.7:27; τὸ π., Jhn.6:62 9:8, Gal.4:13, 1Ti.1:13; αἱ π. ἡμέραι, Heb.10:32; αἱ π. ἐπιθυμίαι, 1Pe.1:14.†
(AS)

G4388.d:
προ-τίθημι
[in LXX: Exo.40:4, 23, Lev.24:8 (עָרַךְ) Psa.54:3 (שׂוּם), etc. ;]
__1. to set before, set forth publicly; so also in mid.: with accusative of person(s), Rom.3:25 (for a suggested alt, rend., see MM, xxii).
__2. Mid., to set before oneself, propose, purpose: with inf., Rom.1:13; with accusative of thing(s), Eph.1:9.†
(AS)
G4388.s: to place before, i.e. (for oneself) to exhibit; (to oneself) to propose (determine)
G4388.o: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and G5087 (τίθημι);

G4389.d:
προ-τρέπω
[in LXX: Wis.14:18, 2Ma.11:7, 4Ma.12:7 4Mac 15:12 4Mac 16:13 * ;]
to urge forwards, exhort, persuade. Mid., in same sense (as also in cl.): Act.18:27.†
(AS)
G4389.s: to turn forward for oneself, i.e. encourage
G4389.o: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and the base of G5157 (τροπή);

G4390.d:
προ-τρέχω
[in LXX: 1Ki.8:11 (פָּנִים רוּץ), Job.41:13 (14) A (דּוּץ), Tob.11:3 (before ἔμπροσθεν), 1Ma.16:21 * ;]
__1. to run forward.
__2. to run on, run in advance: Jhn.20:4; before εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν, Luk.19:4.†
(AS)
G4390.s: to run forward, i.e. outstrip, precede
G4390.o: from G4253 (πρό) and G5143 (τρέχω) (including its alternate);

G4391.d:
προ-ϋπ-άρχω
[in LXX: Job 42:18* ;]
__1. to be beforehand in.
__2. to be before or previously: with ptcp., Luk.23:12, Act.8:9.†
(AS)
G4391.s: to exist before, i.e. (adverbially) to be or do something previously

G4392.d:
πρό-φασις, -εως, ἡ
(φήμι), [in LXX: Psa.141:4 (עֲלִילָה), ??עֲלִילָה), ??Dan.6:4-5(5-6) (עִלָּה) Pro.18:1, Hos.10:4 * ;]
a pretence, pretext: Mat.23:1 (WM, R, txt., om.), Mrk.12:40, Luk.20:47 Jhn.15:22, Act.27:30, Php.1:18, 1Th.2:5.†
(AS)
G4392.o: from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G5316 (φαίνω);

G4393.d:
προφέρω
[in LXX: Pro.10:13 (מָצָא ni.), Tob.9:5, al. ;]
to bring forth: with accusative of thing(s), before ἐκ, Luk.6:45.†
(AS)

G4394.d:
προφητεία, -ας, ἡ
(προψητεύω) [in LXX for נְבוּאָה, חָזוֹן ;]
the gift (and its exercise) of interpreting the Divine will and purpose, prophecy, prophesying: of OT prophecy, Mat.13:14, 2Pe.1:20-21; of NT prophecy, Rom.12:6, 1Co.12:10 13:2 14:6 14:22, 1Ti.4:14, Rev.11:6 22:19; pl., 1Co.13:8, 1Th.5:20, 1Ti.1:18; οἱ λόγοι τῆς π., Rev.1:3 22:7, 10 22:18; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς π., Rev.19:10 (Luc., FlJ, LXX, π.; see Deiss., BS, 235 f.; MM, xxii).†
(AS)

G4395.d:
προφητεύω
(προφήτης), [in LXX chiefly for נָבָא ni., hith. ;]
to be a προφήτης (which see), to prophesy: in the primary sense of telling forth the Divine counsels, Mat.7:22 26:68, Mrk.14:65, Luk.1:67 22:64, Act.19:6, 1Co.11:4-5 13:9 14:1 14:3-5 14:24 14:31 14:39, Heb.11:3; with the idea of foretelling future events (an idea merely incidental, not essential; see Lft., Notes, 83 f.), Mat.11:13, Act.2:17-18" (LXX) Act.21:9; before περί, Mat.15:7, Mrk.7:6, 1Pe.1:10; ἐπί, with dative, Rev.10:11; λέγων, Ju 14; ὅτι, Jhn.11:51.†
SYN.: μαντεύομαι, q.v (AS)
G4395.s: to foretell events, divine, speak under inspiration, exercise the prophetic office

G4396.d:
προφήτης, -ου, ὁ [πρόφημι, to speak forth),
[in LXX chiefly for נָבִיא ;]
one who acts as an interpreter or forth-teller of the Divine will (see Lft., Notes, 83f.; Tr., Syn., §vi), a prophet;
__1. in cl. (Æsch., Hdt., Plat., al.), of the interpreters of oracles.
__2. In NT,
__(a) of the OT prophets: Mat.5:12, Mrk.6:15, Luk.4:27, Jhn.8:52, Rom.11:3, al.;
__(b) of prophets in general: Mat.10:41 13:57 21:46, Mrk.6:4, Luk.13:33, al.;
__(with) of John the Baptist: Mat.21:26, Mrk.6:15, Luk.1:76;
__(d) of Christ: Mat.21:11, Jhn.6:14, Act.3:22, 23 7:37" (LXX) ;
__(e) of Christian prophets…
G4396.s: a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet
G4396.o: from a compound of G4253 (πρό) and G5346 (φημί);

G4398.d:
προφῆτις, -ιδος, ἡ fem, of προφήτης,
[in LXX: Exo.15:20, Jdg.4:4, 4Ki.22:14, 2Ch.34:22, Isa.8:3 (נְבִיאָה) * ;]
a prophetess: Luk.2:36, Rev.2:20.†
(AS)
G4398.s: a female foreteller or an inspired woman

G4399.d:
προ-φθάνω
[in LXX chiefly for קָדַם pi. ;]
with ptcp. (as in cl., but more frequently the simple φθάνω, which see),
to anticipate: Mat.17:25.†
(AS)
G4399.s: to get an earlier start of, i.e. anticipate

G4400.d:
προ-χειρίζω
(πρόχειρος, at hand) [in LXX: Exo.4:13 (שָׁלַח), Jos.3:12 (לָקַח), Dan LXX 3:22, 2Ma.3:7 2Mac 8:9 2Mac 14:12 A * ;]
__1. to put into the hand, deliver up: pass., Act.3:20.
__2. More frequently as depon., -ομαι, to take into one's hand; hence, metaphorically, to propose, determine, choose: with inf., Act.22:14; with accusative of person(s), Act.26:16.†
(AS)
G4400.s: to handle for oneself in advance, i.e. (figuratively) to purpose
G4400.o: middle voice from G4253 (πρό) and a derivative of G5495 (χείρ);

G4401.d:
προ-χειρο-τονέω, -ῶ
(see χειροτονέω)
to choose or appoint beforehand: Act.10:41 (Plat., al.).†
(AS)

G4402.s: before the dance; Prochorus, a Christian

G4403.d:
πρύμνα, -ης, ἡ
prop. fem. of adj. πρύμνο, -η, -ον, (sc. ναῦς), the hindmost part of a ship, the stern: Mrk.4:38, Act.27:29; opposite to πρῷρα, Act.27:41.†
(AS)

G4404.d:
πρωί (Rec. πρωΐ),
adv. (πρό), [in LXX chiefly for בֹּקֶר ;]
in the morning, early: Mat.16:3 (R, txt.) Mat.21:18, Mrk.1:35 11:20 13:35 15:1, Jhn.18:28 20:1; λίαν π., Mrk.16:2; ἅμα π., Mat.20:1; ἀπὸ π. (cf. ἀπὸ πρωΐθεν, Exo.18:13), Act.28:23.†
(AS)
G4404.s: at dawn; by implication, the day-break watch

G4405.d:
πρώιος (Rec. -ϊος), -α, -ον
(πρωί), [in LXX for בֹּקֶר בַּ לַּ ;]
at early morn, early; as subst., ἡ π. (sc. ὥρα, cf. ἡ ὥ. ἡ π., 3Ma.5:24), early morning: Mat.27:1, Jhn.21:4.†
(AS)
G4405.o: feminine of a derivative of G4404 (πρωΐ) as noun;

G4406.d:
πρώϊμος, see: πρόϊμος .
πρόϊμος (Rec. πρώ-, of which προ- is a late form; see Bl., § 6, 4; WH, App., 152), -ον,
[in LXX: Deu.11:14 (יוֹרֶה), etc. ;]
= the more common πρώιος (which see),
early: of rain (as most frequently in LXX), Jas.5:7.†
(AS)
G4406.s: dawning, i.e. (by analogy) autumnal (showering, the first of the rainy season)

G4407.d:
πρωινός
(Rec. -ϊνος, see WH, App., ή, -όν (πρωί), [in LXX chiefly for בֹּקֶר ;]
= cl. πρώιος,
at early morn, early: ἀστήρ, Rev.2:28 22:16.†
(AS)
G4407.s: pertaining to the dawn, i.e. matutinal

G4408.d:
πρῷρα (Rec. incorrectly πρώρα, see Bl., § 3, 3; LS, see word), -ης (for Att.. -ας, see Bl., § 7, 1; Mayser, l 2), ἡ,
the forward part of a ship, the prow: Act.27:30; opposite to πρύμνα, ib. Act.27:41.†
(AS)
G4408.s: the prow, i.e. forward part of a vessel
G4408.o: feminine of a presumed derivative of G4253 (πρό) as noun;

G4409.d:
πρωτεύω
(πρῶτος) [in LXX: Est.5:11, 2Ma.6:18 2Mac 13:15 * ;]
to be first, pre-eminent, have the first place: Col.1:18.†
(AS)
G4409.s: to be first (in rank or influence)

G4410.d:
πρωτοκαθεδρία, -ας, ἡ
(πρῶιος, καθέδρα),
the chief seat: Mat.23:6, Mrk.12:39 (see Swete, in l), Luk.11:43 20:46.†
(AS)
G4410.s: a sitting first (in the front row), i.e. preeminence in council

G4411.d:
πρωτο-κλυτία, -ας, ἡ
the chief place at table (see Swete, Mk., l.with): Mat.23:6, Mrk.12:39, Luk.14:7-8 20:46.†
(AS)
G4411.s: a reclining first (in the place of honor) at the dinner-bed, i.e. preeminence at meals

G4412.d:
πρῶτον, πρῶτος, see: πρότερος
A. Compar., πρότερος, -α, -ον,
[in LXX for רִאשׁוֹן ,לִפָנִים, etc. ;]
before, of time, place, rank, etc.; in NT always of Time, before, former: Eph.4:22. Adverbially, πρότερον, before, aforetime, formerly: Jhn.7:50, 2Co.1:15, Heb.4:6; opposite to ἔπειτα, Heb.7:27; τὸ π., Jhn.6:62 9:8, Gal.4:13, 1Ti.1:13; αἱ π. ἡμέραι, Heb.10:32; αἱ π. ἐπιθυμίαι, 1Pe.1:14.†
(AS)
G4412.s: firstly (in time, place, order, or importance)
G4412.o: neuter of G4413 (πρῶτος) as adverb (with or without G3588 (ὁ));
G4412.k: before, at the beginning, chiefly (at, at the) first (of all)

G4413G.d:
B. Superl., πρῶτος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for רִאשׁוֹן, also for אֶחַד, etc. ;]
first,
__1. of Time or Place;
__(a) absol., as subst., ὁ π.., Luk.14:18, Jhn.19:32, 1Co.14:30; ὁ π. καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, Rev.1:17 2:8 22:13; neut., τὸ π., opposite to τ. δεύτερον, Heb.10:9; τὰ π., opposite to τ. ἔσχατα, Mat.12:45, Luk.11:26, 2Pe.2:20; anarth., Mat.10:2; pl., Mat.19:30, Mrk.10:31, Luk.13:30; ἐν πρώτοις (EV, first of all), 1Co.15:3;
__(b) as adj.: πρώτῃ; (sc. ἡμέρᾳ) σαββάτου, Mk 16:[9]; φυλακή, opposite to δευτέρα, Act.12:10; equiv. to adv. in English, Jhn.8:[7] 20:4, 8 Act.27:43, Rom.10:19, 1Ti.1:16, 1Jn.4:19; = πρότερος (see…
G4413G.s: foremost (in time, place, order or importance)
G4413G.k: before, beginning, best, chief(-est), first (of all), former

G4413H.d:
B. Superl., πρῶτος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for רִאשׁוֹן, also for אֶחַד, etc. ;]
first,
__1. of Time or Place;
__(a) absol., as subst., ὁ π.., Luk.14:18, Jhn.19:32, 1Co.14:30; ὁ π. καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, Rev.1:17 2:8 22:13; neut., τὸ π., opposite to τ. δεύτερον, Heb.10:9; τὰ π., opposite to τ. ἔσχατα, Mat.12:45, Luk.11:26, 2Pe.2:20; anarth., Mat.10:2; pl., Mat.19:30, Mrk.10:31, Luk.13:30; ἐν πρώτοις (EV, first of all), 1Co.15:3;
__(b) as adj.: πρώτῃ; (sc. ἡμέρᾳ) σαββάτου, Mk 16:[9]; φυλακή, opposite to δευτέρα, Act.12:10; equiv. to adv. in English, Jhn.8:[7] 20:4, 8 Act.27:43, Rom.10:19, 1Ti.1:16, 1Jn.4:19; = πρότερος (see…
G4413H.s: foremost (in time, place, order or importance)
G4413H.k: before, beginning, best, chief(-est), first (of all), former

G4413I.d:
B. Superl., πρῶτος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for רִאשׁוֹן, also for אֶחַד, etc. ;]
first,
__1. of Time or Place;
__(a) absol., as subst., ὁ π.., Luk.14:18, Jhn.19:32, 1Co.14:30; ὁ π. καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, Rev.1:17 2:8 22:13; neut., τὸ π., opposite to τ. δεύτερον, Heb.10:9; τὰ π., opposite to τ. ἔσχατα, Mat.12:45, Luk.11:26, 2Pe.2:20; anarth., Mat.10:2; pl., Mat.19:30, Mrk.10:31, Luk.13:30; ἐν πρώτοις (EV, first of all), 1Co.15:3;
__(b) as adj.: πρώτῃ; (sc. ἡμέρᾳ) σαββάτου, Mk 16:[9]; φυλακή, opposite to δευτέρα, Act.12:10; equiv. to adv. in English, Jhn.8:[7] 20:4, 8 Act.27:43, Rom.10:19, 1Ti.1:16, 1Jn.4:19; = πρότερος (see…
G4413I.s: foremost (in time, place, order or importance)
G4413I.k: before, beginning, best, chief(-est), first (of all), former

G4413J.d:
B. Superl., πρῶτος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for רִאשׁוֹן, also for אֶחַד, etc. ;]
first,
__1. of Time or Place;
__(a) absol., as subst., ὁ π.., Luk.14:18, Jhn.19:32, 1Co.14:30; ὁ π. καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος, Rev.1:17 2:8 22:13; neut., τὸ π., opposite to τ. δεύτερον, Heb.10:9; τὰ π., opposite to τ. ἔσχατα, Mat.12:45, Luk.11:26, 2Pe.2:20; anarth., Mat.10:2; pl., Mat.19:30, Mrk.10:31, Luk.13:30; ἐν πρώτοις (EV, first of all), 1Co.15:3;
__(b) as adj.: πρώτῃ; (sc. ἡμέρᾳ) σαββάτου, Mk 16:[9]; φυλακή, opposite to δευτέρα, Act.12:10; equiv. to adv. in English, Jhn.8:[7] 20:4, 8 Act.27:43, Rom.10:19, 1Ti.1:16, 1Jn.4:19; = πρότερος (see…
G4413J.s: foremost (in time, place, order or importance)
G4413J.k: before, beginning, best, chief(-est), first (of all), former

G4414.d:
πρωτοστάτης, -ου, ὁ
(πρῶτος, ἵστημι) [in LXX: Job.15:24 AB * ;]
prop., of soldiers, one who stands first, one in the front rank (Thuc., Xen.); hence, metaphorically, a leader: Act.24:5.†
(AS)
G4414.s: one standing first in the ranks, i.e. a captain (champion)

G4415.d:
πρωτοτόκια, -ων, τά
(πρωτότοκος) [in LXX (with seel. -εῖα, -εία): Gen.25:31 ff. Gen.27:36, Deu.21:17, 1Ch.5:1 (בְּכוֹרָה) * ;]
the rights of the first-born, birthright (= cl. ἡ πρεσβεία): Heb.12:16.†
(AS)

G4416.d:
πρωτότοκος, -ον
(πρῶτος, τίκτω) [in LXX chiefly for בְּכוֹר ;]
first-born: Luk.2:7; pl., Heb.11:28. Metaphorical, of the priority of Christ (originally perh. a Messianic title, cf. Psa.89:28, Heb.1:6; see ICC on Col.1:15): Heb.1:6; π. πάσης κτίσεως, Col.1:15; ἐν πολλοῖς ἀδελφοῖς, Rom.8:29; π. (ἐκ) τ. νεκρῶν, Col.1:18, Rev.1:5; pl., of the elect, ἐκκλησία πρωτοτόκων, Heb.12:23.†
(AS)
G4416.s: first-born (usually as noun, literally or figuratively)
G4416.o: from G4413 (πρῶτος) and the alternate of G5088 (τίκτω);

G4417.d:
πταίω
[in LXX chiefly for נָגַף ni. ;]
__1. trans., to cause to stumble (1Ki.4:3, cf. Deiss., BS, 681).
__2. Intrans., to stumble. Metaphorical, in moral sense, Rom.11:11, Jas.2:10 3:2, 2Pe.1:10.†
(AS)
G4417.s: to trip, i.e. (figuratively) to err, sin, fail (of salvation)

G4418.d:
πτέρνα, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX for עָקֵב ;]
the heel: figuratively, ἐπαίρειν τὴν π. ἐπί, Jhn.13:18 (LXX).†
(AS)

G4419.d:
πτερύγιον, -ου, -τό
(dimin. of πτέρυξ), [in LXX chiefly for כָּנָף ;]
__1. a little wing.
__2. Anything like a wing, as a turret, battlement: τ. ἱεροῦ, Mat.4:5, Luk.4:9.†
(AS)
G4419.o: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4420 (πτέρυξ);

G4420.d:
πτέρυξ, -υγος, ἡ
(πέτομαι), [in LXX chiefly for כָּנָף ;]
a wing: of birds, Mat.23:37, Luk.13:34, Rev.12:14; of creatures seen in a vision, Rev.4:8 9:9.†
(AS)
G4420.o: from a derivative of G4072 (πέτομαι) (meaning a feather);

G4422.d:
πτοέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for חָתַת ni. ;]
to terrify. Pass., to be terrified: Luk.21:9 24:37 (WH, mg., θροηθέντες).†
(AS)
G4422.o: probably akin to the alternate of G4098 (πίπτω) (through the idea of causing to fall) or to G4072 (πέτομαι) (through that of causing to fly away);

G4423.d:
πτόησις, -εως, ἡ
(πτοέω) [in LXX: Pro.3:25 (פַּחַד), Sir 50:4 א1, 1Ma.3:25 R * ;]
a fluttering, excitement, caused by any emotion, but esp. by fear, hence, terror: φοβεῖσθαι πτόησιν, to be afraid with (cogn. accusative) or of any terror (see ICC, in l): 1Pe.3:6.†
(AS)

G4424.d:
Πτολεμαΐς, -ΐδος, ἡ
Ptolemais, a maritime city of Phœnicea: Act.21:7.†
(AS)
G4424.o: from (Ptolemy, after whom it was named);

G4425.d:
πτύον, -ου, τό
[in Sm.: Isa.30:24 * ;]
a winnowing shovel or fan: Mat.3:12, Luk.3:17.†
(AS)

G4426.d:
πτύρομαι depon.,
to be startled, frightened: Php.1:28. (The active πτύρω is also found in some late writers.) †
(AS)
G4426.o: from a presumed derivative of G4429 (πτύω) (and thus akin to G4422 (πτοέω));

G4428.d:
πτύσσω
to fold; of a scroll, to roll up: βιβλίον, Luk.4:20 (cf. ἀνα-πτύσσω).†
(AS)
G4428.s: and thus apparently allied to G4072 (πέτομαι) through the idea of expansion, and to 4429 through that of flattening; compare G3961 (πατέω)); to fold, i.e. furl a scroll

G4429.d:
πτύω
[in LXX: Num.12:14 (יָרָק), Sir.28:12 * ;]
to spit: Mrk.7:33 8:23, Jhn.9:6 (cf. ἐκ-, ἐμ-πτύω).†
(AS)

G4430.d:
πτῶμα -τος, τό
(πίπτω), [in LXX: Jdg.14:8 (מַפֶּלֶת), Job.16:15 (14) (פֶּרֶץ), Isa.51:19 (שֹׁד), Jdth.8:19, Wis.4:18, al. ;]
__1. a fall, metaphorically, a misfortune, calamity (Trag., Plat., Polyb., al.; LXX).
__2. That which has fallen;
__(a) of buildings, a ruin (Polyb.);
__(b) of living creatures, in cl. (poët. only) usually with genitive, νεκρῶν, etc., but also absol., as in late writers and NT, a fallen body, a carcase, corpse: Mat.14:12 24:28, Mrk.15:45; π. αὐτοῦ, Mrk.6:29; αὐτῶν, Rev.11:8-9 (cf. Rutherford, NPhr., 472 f.).†
(AS)
G4430.s: a ruin, i.e. (specially), lifeless body (corpse, carrion)

G4431.d:
πτῶσις, -εως, ἡ
(πίπτω), [in LXX chiefly for נֶגֶף, מַפֶּלֶת, and cogn. forms ;]
a falling, fall (Plat., Plut., al.): Mat.7:27; metaphorically, Luk.2:34.†
(AS)
G4431.s: a crash, i.e. downfall (literally or figuratively)

G4432.d:
πτωχεία, -ας, ἡ
(πτωχεύω), [in LXX chiefly for עֳנִי ;]
beggary, destitution: 2Co.8:2 8:9, Rev.2:9.†
(AS)

G4433.d:
πτωχεύω
(πτωχός), [in LXX: Jdg.6:6, Psa.79:8 (דָּלַל); Jdg.14:15 A, Pro.23:21 (יָרַשׁ); Psa.34:10 (רוּשׁ), Tob.4:21 * ;]
__1. to be a beggar, to beg (so chiefly in cl.).
__2. to be poor as a beggar, to be destitute, poor: opposite to πλούσιος ὤν, 2Co.8:9.†
(AS)
G4433.s: to be a beggar, i.e. (by implication) to become indigent (figuratively)

G4434.d:
πτωχός, -ή, -όν
(πτώσσω, to crouch, cower), [in LXX for עָנִי, דַּל, רָשׁ, etc. ;]
of one who crouches and cowers, hence,
__1. as subst., a beggar: Luk.14:13, 21 16:20, 22.
__2. As adj.,
__(a) prop., beggarly: metaphorically, στοιχεῖα, Gal.4:9 (see Lft., in l);
__(b) in broader sense (opposite to πλούσιος), poor: Mat.11:5 19:21 26:9, 11, Mrk.10:21 12:42-43 14:5, 7, Luk.4:18 7:22 18:22 19:8 21:3, Jhn.12:5-6, 8 13:29, Rom.15:26, 2Co.6:10, Gal.2:10, Jas.2:2-3, 6, Rev.13:16; π. τ. κόσμῳ, Jas.2:5; metaphorically, Luk.6:20, Rev.3:17; π. τ. πνεύματι, Mat.5:3.†
SYN.: πένης, q.v (AS)
G4434.s: akin to G4422 (πτοέω) and the alternate of G4098 (πίπτω)); a beggar (as cringing), i.e. pauper (strictly denoting absolute or public mendicancy, although also used in a qualified or relative sense; whereas G3993 (πένης) properly means only straitened circumstances in private), literally (often as noun) or figuratively (distressed)

G4435.d:
πυγμή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Exo.21:18, Isa.58:4 (אֶגְרֹף) * ;]
the fist: πυγμῇ νίψασθαι τ. χῖρας (Τ, πυκνά; Vg., Goth., Copt., crebro), to wash the hands with the fist (diligently, R, txt.; up to the elbow, R, mg.; the exact meaning is doubtful; see Swete, in l): Mrk.7:3.†
(AS)
G4435.s: the clenched hand, i.e. (only in dative case as adverb) with the fist (hard scrubbing)
G4435.o: from a primary (the fist as a weapon);

G4436.d:
πύθων, -ωνος, ὁ
__1. in cl., Python, a serpent slain by Apollo, who is hence surnamed the Pythian.
__2. In Plut. (ii, 414 E), a name given to ventriloquist soothsayers (ἐγγαστρίμυθοι; cf. Lev.19:31 20:6, 27, 1Ki.28:7), and perhaps in this sense πνεῦμα πύθωνα, a python-spirit: Act.16:16.†
(AS)
G4436.s: a Python, i.e. (by analogy, with the supposed diviner there) inspiration (soothsaying)
G4436.o: from (the name of the region where Delphi, the seat of the famous oracle, was located);

G4437.d:
πυκιός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: Eze.31:3 A (חֹרֶשׁ), 3Ma.1:28 3Mac 4:10, 4Ma.12:12 * ;]
__1. close, compact, solid.
__2. frequent: 1Ti.5:23. Neut. pl., πυκνά, as adv., much, often: Mrk.7:3 Τ (see: πυγμή), Luk.5:33. Comparat., πυκνότερον, very often or so much the oftener (seeBl., § 44, 3,): Act.24:26.†
(AS)
G4437.s: clasped (thick), i.e. (figuratively) frequent; neuter plural (as adverb) frequently

G4438.s: to box (with the fist), i.e. contend (as a boxer) at the games (figuratively)
G4438.o: from a derivative of the same as G4435 (πυγμή);

G4439.d:
πύλη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly and very frequently for שַׁעַר sometimes for דֶּלֶת, פֶּתַח ;]
a gate: Luk.7:12, Act.9:24 12:10 16:13, Heb.13:12; ἡ Ὡραία Π. τ. ἱεροῦ, Act.3:10. Metaphorical, Mat.7:13-14; πύλαι ᾅδου (Wis.16:13, 3Ma.5:51, and cf. κλαῖς ᾅδου Rev.1:18): Mat.16:18.†
(AS)
G4439.s: a gate, i.e. the leaf or wing of a folding entrance (literally or figuratively)

G4440.d:
πυλών, -ῶνος, ὁ
(πύλη), [in LXX chiefly for פֶּתַח, שַׁעַר ;]
__1. the porch or vestibule of a house or palace: Mat.26:71, Luk.16:20, Act.10:17 12:13-14
__2. The gate-way or gate-tower of a walled town: Act.14:13, Rev.21:12-13, 15 21:21, 25 22:14.†
(AS)
G4440.s: a gate-way, door-way of a building or city; by implication, a portal or vestibule

G4441.d:
πυνθώ᾽ομαι
